I was flying to Luanda by TAAG Angola Airlines When I was going to the gate I saw the plane which looked like an elderly but friendly Boeing I had never flew by Anogla Airlines before therefore I was full of hope and enthusiasm for a pleasant and relaxing journey But soon after boarding the plane the magic of the trip was gone and a mixture of amazement and concern started to raise in my head and the same expression was evident on the faces of passengers around me Plane inside looked well worn but I still hoped to watch a movie and rest a bit before arriving in Luanda Sadly entertainment panels were not working and were damaged so I thought to myself not a big deal I will watch something on my phone but when I tried to plug cable to USB port to charge it a little USB port was not working either I wanted to change my seat to look for a working panel but it turned out that none of them are working and many of the USB charging ports were simply missing in many seats and there was just a hole in the seats I tried to stay positive well I have a book to read so I can read for a while instead right Unfortunately the seat lights were not working either and the whole cabin was dark I tried to deploy the foot rest but to my surprise both foot rest pedals were missing too Since the passenger cabin has so many defects it surely must have failed some periodic checks or maybe they were never carried out I learned later is that TAAG Angola Airline was blacklisted banned from EU airspace for many years for failing to meet regulatory oversight standards and restrictions were lifted only before covid It seems to me that decision was premature and perhaps needs to be reevaluated as clearly this airline is not carrying out basic checks On the positive note the cabin crew gave an excellent safety demonstration on the use of life jacket

Astana is a small international airport that is well connected to Europe via Frankfurt London Paris and Amsterdam through Kazakhstans Air Astana The airport has only one terminal for Domestic and International flights A new terminal is being constructed next to the existing facility which is planned to be opening in spring The arrivals and baggage reclaim is small Immigration quite smooth and officers were friendly but remember to fill in your immigration card with a blue or black pen not with a red one as it is not accepted I had almost no queues Taxi pickup at the terminal is not wellorganised and taxi recruiters can be annoying The central hall for departures is quite spacious and there is sufficient seating around the checkin area Checkin areas are small and somewhat oldfashioned but work fine Friendly ground staff Short queuing time at checkin passport control and security Emigration passport control is fine There are few FB and retail facilities at the international departure gates There is plenty of seating at the end of the concourse close to the small cafe in the back Transferring between international flights is quick and easy Passengers do not have to pass immigration only security screening It took me only minutes from arrival gate to departure gate FB and retail facilities are limited especially in the departure are after immigration Food choice is limited Very good wifi while waiting for checkin or for your flight Password can be obtained via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean Remote arrivals and departures via bus in winter when temperatures can go below Celsius can be cold and slippery but also a very interesting experience When the new terminal will be opened in I assume less aircraft will be handled via busses

Check in in Bangkok swift and friendly lounges and boarding in Bangkok and Hong Kong always top notch Service and catering on both flights good What annoys me with flying economy on CX is their unwillingness to credit any Avios in non CX One World programs I was willing to pay a higher fare to get my points but there isnt any which credits points in Economy That is the reason to make me think twice to fly Cathay again in Y in the future

Fortaleza Praia February The flight was operated in a reasonable B by no means new but not as rickety as I had been led to believe The seating was alleconomy and the leather seats fine but slippery Seat pitch was OK and I am a tall chap certainly an inch or more greater than its competitors The flight departed minutes late at and due to the hour I declined the meal offered which looked bland but edible We arrived in Praia on schedule and my bags did the same connecting to Sal and Mindelo without delay All in all a reasonable experience

Another really good experience First leg Madeira to Ponta Delgada flight on a Q turboprop Flight left early and arrived early Polite check in staff in Madeira checked both our carry on and checked luggage all the way to Toronto OK snack and non alcoholic beverage service on a hour flight Second leg Ponta Delgada to Toronto on an Airbus On time departure and arrival Good unique Portuguese meal pasta with tuna bacon and chorizo two passes of the beverage cart Both flights had courteous and professional cabin crew for planes that were full lots of announcements from the flight deck about possible turbulence A better entertainment system would have been welcome for the second hour flight

Feedback on my initial visit to MCI new terminal I am a Kansas City native this review is critical as it should be Overall impression is outstanding compared to the s era terminals It addresses the needs of a st century Midwest airport with all the modern necessities one would expect as a flying customer First impression walking in its big It spans wide and the design incorporating natural lighting with an abundance of windows is refreshing The evening sunlight streaming in through different angles really provides a nonrestricted feel as you walk about the terminal The respective airline checkin counterplacements are easy to identify and span the width of the front end of the terminal for easy access Security access is fairly streamlined and the entire process is able to accommodate large volumes of travelers nonTSA airport VMD corp more natural light as you progress through each arm of the terminal ABC with interior lighting not overbearing The walkways are wide and allow for excellent views of the tarmac exterior gates and various angles of the entirety of the taxiways and runways Additionally the escalators and walking escalators are positioned nicely and push you through terminal in a speedy manner More shops etc at each terminal branch providing basically anything the traveler would need The vibe and local venues are all a welcome addition and definitely fulfill the needs of the traveler Individual gates and structured well and offer comfortable seating and ample wireless device charging The one thing that seems odd is the placement of the gate flight monitors It is essentially in the seating area of the individual gates Why not place it directly behindabove the agent boothdesk for easy and quick access and explanation poor design decision Boarding the plane the traveler is treated to long glass jet bridges that allow for excellent views of adjacent aircraft and outside weather conditions This is a well thought out design that many major airports do not offer Overall the new MCIKCI terminal is a massive upgrade to the Kansas City area It has the opportunity for expansion and I would expect future modifications to address design shortfalls and customer feedback We concluded it feels like a mall when walking though the new terminal Three things need immediate addressing Mens restroom upkeep and sanitary conditions unacceptable Need to revisit the options of installing automatic hand blower machines and look at the cleaning schedules to ensure conditions do not deteriorate to the point of being an embarrassment Cleaning crews need to maintain a regular schedule on vacuuming the terminal carpet paper and debris everywhere Please explain how the gate flight monitors are controlled by the city How is this beneficial to the traveler or airline staff Local control to changemodify the monitors shouldnt even be a discussion This new terminal is supposed to represent the pride of Kansas City aviation

My flights were delayed for many hours due to weather in Dallas El Paso airport is the best airport to be stranded in It has an easilyaccessed smoking area in a lovely courtyard Its small enough to get around quickly but big enough to have decent food My delays would have been much worse in a larger airport but El Paso airport made my delays manageable Staff were also great Security and the like especially outside directing vehicle traffic were nice and helpful offering extra help or information if I needed it Love this airport The only minor annoyance was that it did not have a lot of charging ports in the seating areas so I had to stand while my phone was charging

Check in at LHR T was quick and easy and minimal queue for security Business Class passengers on Malaysia Airlines have access to the Qatar Airways lounge which is excellent and we enjoyed a nice light breakfast before the flight Malaysia use A for the flight to KL and my wife and I had chosen seats D and G meaning that both seats have aisle access Malaysia Airlines cabin crew are some of the best in the industry and as always the service was very good The meal service starts with signature satays followed by smoked salmon for the main course I tried the Malaccanstyle seabass fillet very tasty An area where Malaysia Airlines could improve is in the inflight entertainment the choice of films is quite limited and well below the standard of airlines such as Emirates Flight arrival into KL was minutes ahead of schedule which left quite a long transfer time for our connection to Penang The Malaysia Airlines lounge in the domestic departures area is ok but can get very busy Our onward flight to Penang was on an B one of the upgraded aircraft with new business class seats and WiFi based entertainment system which you use with your own device We did not use this for such a short flight We were impressed with the service on this minute flight which included a small hot meal Arrival into Penang was on schedule and the bags were delivered promptly Overall a great couple of flights with Malaysia Airlines

Having spent far too much time of my trip to Paris looking at reviews of BVA and becoming convinced that Id definitely miss my flightmy luggage would be pulled apartId have to stand for hours with no rest to say I was pleasantly surprised by my airport experience would be an understatement Beauvais is a hub for budget airlines No one should be under any illusion that youre flying out of CDG or another mega airport in a capital city Could the departure hall use a lick of paint Probably Could a few more benches be put in Absolutely But as a functioning airport with many flights departing at similar times it manages the best it can We arrived at the airport early due to all of the fearmongering in reviews but it allowed us to see that the airport tries its best to manage the flow of traffic There are screens over security confirming when youll be able to go through passport control in relation to your flight time approx hours for us in line with the bag drop opening and from there through to the end of security it was barely even minutes until we were in duty free As I removed my liquids and electricals in advance as nearly all airports expect and clearly have signposted as is the same in BVA there were no issues with security Duty free is admittedly sparse but there were signs up confirming that maintenance work was ongoing The toilets were adequate and there was a caf open for use as well as vending and hot drinks machines There were plug sockets FYI not usb ports and in the grand scheme of things a fair number of benches there are departure gates and of those are in a separate area so the space is distributed fairly In fact the only issues that I could see occurring were from fellow passengers themselves People with luggage double the size of the restrictions were being asked to pay the fee at the gate but this should not be a surprise for anyone who spends even seconds looking at their boarding card information Likewise an outgoing flight was held but this was due to passengers being late to the gate the call was done in English French and the language of the flight destination so there really were no excuses If people try to blame the airport for this then they should be taking a longer look at themselves Im ultimately reviewing BVA for what it is a budget friendly space to travel for those of us who dont want to break the bank

I have mixed feelings about this airport Upon arrival the checkin process took almost no time at all and I was on my way in a matter of minutes Terminal signs presecurity were limited but easy enough that I was able to find the C security checkpoint quick enough Security was a different story The wait was brutal taking over an hour to clear On top of this the staff were not very fast chatting to everyone about travel plans flying etc Terminal signage postsecurity was much clearer and my gate was found quite fast Departure was also very efficient and boarding went by fast and I was departing on time Overall this airport has good and bad but its one of the better airports that Ive been to

Checked in amazing helpful staff her name was Nikki at London Heathrow Airport she was friendly and amazing service also told me my flight was delayed which I did not know and made sure everything was okay Highly recommend

The airport itself is good but the design looks simply ok The airport is big it has old and new parts the new part looks better It has many checkin desks fast security check and very nice that they have priority security check and priority passport control Some nice business lounges and good duty free

I read a huge amount of negativity about this airport prior to my trip there it was a five hour transit stop going from London to Bangkok I was certainly concerned reading all the previous reviews However I didnt experience any real issues The airport is very large so easy to find a quiet spot there are plenty of power outlets and getting online is extremely simple you just log on and take a pic of your passport Granted you wont be able to do very much online unless youve got one of the VPNs that work behind the great China firewall but if you have an iPad with a couple of movies downloaded the time will soon pass There was a reasonable amount of shops open both for coffee and souvenir shopping The train that youll need to take to get to your gate is frequent clean and fast Overall Ive been to more interesting airports but my message would be dont stress out reading the negative reviews I had no issues whatsoever

Nice small low cost but very aged airport needs full reconstruction asap Everything looks like the s but not nice way The floor was dirty so they need to improve cleaning as well Restaurant was closed so there was nowhere to even get a coffee Staff were kind and helpful Will fly there again as FR and W operate nice cheap flights otherwise no chance will be back

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

Privilege Style operate an old Singapore Airlines and I took their flight between Miami and London Gatwick as Norwegian were unable to run their new Boeing Dreamliner I see a lot of people complaining about Privilege Style however I had an amazing experience in their business class cabin I actually chose to fly with Privilege Style so I could experience the old Singapore Airlines business class cabin and I wasnt disappointed The business class cabin was in a configuration and was completely booked out however the seat I had was very spacious and I had so much room to myself The cabin crew in the business cabin looked after us like a true business class experience which I was not expecting We had a welcome drink and there were plenty of staff for the small number of people in the cabin I pressed the call button at one point and a cabin crew member came over straight away The food was very good too nothing special but it was better than I expected It was also served quickly too which was great theres nothing worse than waiting hours for your meal We had blankets and a pillow provided too really making this feel like a business class flight and I liked how the cabin crew stopped economy passengers from using our toilets As we flew over the Atlantic the cabin lights dimmed and most people got sleep Ive flown business class several times before and for the price I paid this is one where I got the most value Note that the entertainment system is a bit rubbish but I knew that and took my laptop preloaded with some films and my own noise cancelling headphones Im posting this because I did research before this flight online and couldnt find any positive reviews about the business class experience and for that reason I was worried about what it was going to be like I hope this review helps people who might be thinking about booking with Privilege Style

General Mitchell is a breath of a fresh air Its clean friendly and efficient Theres actually a classy little used book store and a museum full of model planes and blimps and whatnot If you get lost it is your fault my friend The whole place is like one of the models in the museum accurate well labeled and miniature Everything is right in front of you Theres an Amtrak station a block away minutes and to get to Union Station in Chicago is hard to beat This airport is tiny but its the easiest one Ive ever dealt with

Highly recommended airline offering excellent value for money I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals a hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my hour transit a free single hotel room and a free shuttle from airport to hotel all for It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

The Buffalo Niagara Airport was quite an experience It was easily accessible and was fantastic with the hotels right across the road The staff were okay We were flying early in the morning so they might have been tired but they seemed alright The airport was larger than I expected The parking was easy and cheap Overall it was a nice experience

I go to Jacksonville airport a lot since this is my hometown airport It is a nice clean and small with only gates Due to the size you dont really need signage at all Despite the small size there is still a bunch of food options before and after the security checkpoint There is also some good shops like Brooks Brothers and a PGA Tour Shop There is also a big pavilion with rocking chairs right before security Its a great place to wait if youre waiting on an arriving flight There is also pretty good employees well besides the TSA people One time I had to go through the regular checkpoint instead of PreCheck and they only had one metal detector and one ProVision open It took about minutes to pass through because of this I got to my gate when they were calling the last boarding zone when I was supposed to board in the first boarding zone However a great airport and I recommend it

From Jeju Korea to Taipei and back I was hesitant to fly with an unknown local Taiwanese company but I have to say that I was nicely surprised the service is good and plane clean The hostess are courteous and the planes looks internally and externally wellkept The flight was pleasant and trouble free even with a baby Far much better from the china eastern flight I took from Shanghai to Jeju which was baby unfriendly I would compare Far Eastern Air transport as Dragonair a bit more clean

I flew TokyoSapporoTokyo I was pleasantly surprised at the efficiency and professionalism of the staff The crew spoke English We departed and arrived ontime The great price combined with the excellent service ensures I will fly Skymark again

The airline is convenient for the short trip between Bali and Lombok with few other carriers on this route There are regular flight schedules Due to passenger volume a twin propellor plane is used which are never as comfortable as a jet Overall I am happy the service exists however on this leg of the journey the plane had been sitting on the tarmac for a while and the air temp inside was extremely hot and even when in the air the air con was substandard and the cabin temperature was still warm to hot As is common with propellor aircraft there is no aerobridge which on this flight meant cross through rows of planes to get to the bus Both Air Wings flight departed and arrive on time which is good

I was extremely impressed with Providence TF Green Airport It is high up on the list of my favorite small airport and heres a lowdown on it The Terminal It is all very straightforward with everything well signposted and not complicated at all Security is efficient and the multiple times weve gone through there wasnt much line at all After Security there is a decent selection of Shops and Dining The shops include the standard souvenir and news shops plus a few interesting clothes and accessory shops Foodwise there is a small but good variety of places to eat ranging from a Dunkin Donuts to an Oyster Bar The seating in the terminal is comfortable and regularly equipped with charging outlets The WiFi is nothing special free for minutes but at least its there Connections Norwegian Air advertises the airport as BostonProvidence While Providence isnt too far from Boston it is still a good hour driving The RIPTA bus service passes reasonably frequently and is a good way to get to downtown Providence I recommend that or the Peter Pan Coach over the MBTA train as that passes infrequently and only works on weekdays To get to Boston using Public transportation I would recommend taking the Coach as the train not only rarely passes but it takes forever as it stops at every station along the route And there it is A nice little airport clean and with good amenities The main problem is the lack of connections especially late at night which might make an uber the only option I really recommend it though even as a lowcost alternative to Boston

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Very clean aircraft The cabin crew were very attentive and nice Seat pitch was good aircraft cleanliness was OK but could use improvement The inflight meals were sufficient for a one hour flight I was served a chicken sandwich The presentation of the food was good and it also tasted nice as well Overall I would recommend this airline to anyone who is trying to visit Myanmar for a cheap price

The Seat I sat in seat A next to the window this seat was spacious and much better than other airlines Ive flown in this region There was ample legroom the width was reasonable and the window on the Embraer was large as normal The configuration of the cabin is interesting and is incredible due to lacking a middle seat The Service The staff were perfectly friendly kind and polite with us and offered us gingerbread men and water during the flight The gingerbread was better than I expected and the water was normal The Ground Service The flight was perfectly on time and we landed on schedule The boarding was normal and was completely seamless which was surprising at Gatwick Overall the flight was seamless and comfortable I booked this flight using miles so I cant comment on the price but I would definitely recommend Helvetic Airlines if you are flying to Switzerland over lowcost airlines like EasyJet in the same region

Im a frequent traveller and this was our first time using Air Astana from London to Delhi I read some great reviews nevertheless I was quite apprehensive to say the least Well how wrong was I Air Astana in my humble opinion is indeed providing amazing in flight service and great user experience We flew Airbus LR that appeared to be fairly new extremely clean and looked after Our economy cabin was looked after well we had nice amenity kit the food served was nice and tasty and with proper cutlery Equally choice of beverages was excellent too The crew is well trained and do their best to keep passengers happy On the improvement side we spent about hours in Almaty and found the airport to be quite small and quite basic which I think is a bit of let down and so I think thats the area they need to actively work on if they really want to get more customers flying with them I certainly will fly with them again and recommend it

This post World War II airbridge landmark is probably the best airport location worldwide Nowadays it is called Zentral Flughafen and that is because the Ubahn is only a minute walk From here it only takes minutes to get anywhere in the city The terminal is completely outdated but very charming Planes park literally in the terminal and boarding and deboarding happen always dry thanks to the roof of the hangar The toilets are clean there is a delishopbar and all major car rental companies have a desk Unfortunately THF is not smoke free passengers still smoke in the smoking area of the already small waiting areas at the gates

I flew Skymark Airlines from Kobe to Tokyo Haneda on August th and I must say that I was pretty impressed by the quality of the airline They do not provide any food but service is good I had too much luggage and they only charged me for the extra kilos I had checked Seats are very comfortable and legroom is better than most international airlines I guess its at least inches maybe Nice flight and on time I will fly Skymark Airlines again in the future when I return to Japan

Feedback on my initial visit to MCI new terminal I am a Kansas City native this review is critical as it should be Overall impression is outstanding compared to the s era terminals It addresses the needs of a st century Midwest airport with all the modern necessities one would expect as a flying customer First impression walking in its big It spans wide and the design incorporating natural lighting with an abundance of windows is refreshing The evening sunlight streaming in through different angles really provides a nonrestricted feel as you walk about the terminal The respective airline checkin counterplacements are easy to identify and span the width of the front end of the terminal for easy access Security access is fairly streamlined and the entire process is able to accommodate large volumes of travelers nonTSA airport VMD corp more natural light as you progress through each arm of the terminal ABC with interior lighting not overbearing The walkways are wide and allow for excellent views of the tarmac exterior gates and various angles of the entirety of the taxiways and runways Additionally the escalators and walking escalators are positioned nicely and push you through terminal in a speedy manner More shops etc at each terminal branch providing basically anything the traveler would need The vibe and local venues are all a welcome addition and definitely fulfill the needs of the traveler Individual gates and structured well and offer comfortable seating and ample wireless device charging The one thing that seems odd is the placement of the gate flight monitors It is essentially in the seating area of the individual gates Why not place it directly behindabove the agent boothdesk for easy and quick access and explanation poor design decision Boarding the plane the traveler is treated to long glass jet bridges that allow for excellent views of adjacent aircraft and outside weather conditions This is a well thought out design that many major airports do not offer Overall the new MCIKCI terminal is a massive upgrade to the Kansas City area It has the opportunity for expansion and I would expect future modifications to address design shortfalls and customer feedback We concluded it feels like a mall when walking though the new terminal Three things need immediate addressing Mens restroom upkeep and sanitary conditions unacceptable Need to revisit the options of installing automatic hand blower machines and look at the cleaning schedules to ensure conditions do not deteriorate to the point of being an embarrassment Cleaning crews need to maintain a regular schedule on vacuuming the terminal carpet paper and debris everywhere Please explain how the gate flight monitors are controlled by the city How is this beneficial to the traveler or airline staff Local control to changemodify the monitors shouldnt even be a discussion This new terminal is supposed to represent the pride of Kansas City aviation

I believe myself to be semiwell traveled and have experienced many airport scenarios in my lifetime middle aged and will have to give kudos to Dallas Love Field TSA agents for their remarkable work getting me from the baggage claim area for general boarding all the way to my gate with time to spare in as little time as I can possibly fathom I actually witnessed a family who did not make their flight one prior to mine but same gate and persisted by raising their voices that the gate agent should have known they were there but because TSA took so much time they were late The truth later came out that they were ONLY in line for one hour on a holiday weekend That is exceptional but poor timing on their part Everyone in the aviation world knows that on a holiday weekend there is a hour minimum time preparation period to make your flight So a free plug for DLF consider this Saying all of this not only was TSA awesome in their timeliness but the gate agents kept their cool and handled the situation with excellence

PBHCCU CCUPBH Y class Check in staff at Paro very helpful friendly smiling Cabin crew similarly accommodating and friendly Clean cabin decent space for Y class Light refreshments and sandwiches veg or nonveg served on this short minute segment Every flight has been spot on time or slightly early Good announcements from cockpit to point out Himalayan peaks when near Paro Competitive prices A good alternative inout of Bhutan from Drukair

Flying from Cape Town to Dublin to attend a conference and later return to Chicago from there I was looking forward to my first chance to check out Hamad Doha Airport Qatar Airways was fine except we arrived late in Doha We had to take a crowded bus to the terminal and it took over a half hour There were traffic jams on the tarmac I then had to run a long way through jammed concourses and just made my connection to Dublin On the way I saw crowds of people a bunch of luxury stores and chain eateries and some trees and plantings in one area Color me unimpressed

Flew them on the Frankfurt Sarajevo trip on board their B I found the airline staff professional and friendly which cant be said about the customs at SJJ airport most of whom looked downright angry and like they hate their job The BH airlines crew were great and boarding was quick and breeze The flight arrived a few minutes early and I found the cabin fairly modern and clean

Its a smaller airport compared to Mumbai not a problem actually Some toilets on the arrival hall are not good This airport has more shopping options now and its enough actually There are spa and lounge facilities available here The lounges are okay I have never experienced any delay to date Overall an above expectation feel It gets my job done

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

If youre coming from a western country be aware that this airport functions a bit differently than what were used to First you and all your bags have to pass through security bags in the scanner you in a light body search and then you enter the hall where the airlines check in counters are You do not need to present a boarding pass to enter this first hall meaning you can come in with a friend or family member who isnt flying This hall has some chairs toilets and or shops After you check in and drop your bags with your airline you proceed to immigration At this point you can only get through if you have a valid boarding pass You get to a second hall with the duty free and a couple more shops and restaurants Last you move to the area where your gate is Theres different areas with different gates each with their own security line if you go to the wrong gate area like I did you need to ask airport staff to escort you out so you can go to the correct area This security check is the same as the first one bags on the scanners and you get a light body search Then you proceed to your gates waiting area where you have toilets and shops No one ever checks for liquids or electronic equipments and I even had my own bottle of water in my bag when I went through both security checks Men and women have different security lines so that man are searched by a male officer and women searched by a female one As for facilities there were enough chairs for everyone but chairs were not the most comfortable If you like shopping in airport this is also not the best place not enough offer of shops and even the duty free doesnt have much to offer The airport is generally clean and there are western toilets plus free water On arrivals immigration lines are often under staffed so prepare for waiting mins If youre looking to exchange money at the airport you need go back the stairs after you collect your luggage because the money exchange counter is on the departures floor

Although a low cost airline Shaheen Air was quite nice although the airport checkin was pretty bad with only one line and the agents taking forever The flight had a gate change times and we had a one hour delay announced at the last minute before boarding was to finish The flight attendents were very friendly during the flight and the aircraft was decent also the meal some chicken mayo bun with a chicken leg along with marble cake was pretty delicious and filling The plane was leased and originally from SpanAir so the cabin had grey leather seats but it was comfortable though Also a nice touch from Shaheen Air was the pretakeoff water which was provided and newspapers in English and Urdu

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

I flew on Ravn Alaska with my girlfriend back in February We flew from Anchorage to Homer and back with ease The flight was brief and enjoyable The staff were friendly and welcoming Checkin a breeze Boarding a breeze Baggage pickup a breeze The overall experience was fantastic Looking forward to flying with Ravn again and taking in those unforgettable Alaska sights

The signs at Fuzhou airport are quite helpful since available in both English and Chinese The border security counter has a rating system where you can rate them based on your experience If you dont speak Chinese it may be slightly difficult to get around Queue was quite long and it took quite long to find your baggage However it was an OK experience The staff was very friendly and friendlier than I had expected
It is a shame that the people at security do not speak English This is an international airport For the rest it is okay food is good and it is reasonably clean

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

I arrived today from Heho with a sick child probably from food poisoning and was helped like I never thought I could We were taken charge of by a great team of officers nurse doctor that took us to the airport clinic and took care of my daughter Everyone has been great and we are really grateful to each of you They will recognize themselves

The airport claims it has smooth transit and easy to read signs in English helpful staff and an efficient process My experience was the complete opposite After arriving and trying to find my departure process I was told to go back backandforth to the same places by people who could not understand what I was saying this took minutes to an hour and each time I had to rewait in line again So finally I said Im not leaving till you direct me to the right place

I was very impressed by the level of care and support I received at the airport Having a severe reaction to an insect bite and no Antihistamine tablets with me The local team and Airport police went out of their way to help I wish I had noted their names they looked everywhere and obtained tablets for me while making sure I was comfortable and relaxed Thank you very much as the level of care and support at a busy airport was very welcome and impressive

I dont know what all the fuss was about Bad reviews about security dirty airport unfriendly staff no seating I experienced none of that In view of the negative reviews we arrived hours before take off and were through security in five minutes Very cheerful efficient and friendly staff Bought some items at duty free and the lady there was extremely pleasant and helpful Plenty of seating Good food and drink offers and both the airport and toilets were very clean Boarding process straightforward and stressless On return our plane landed about minutes behind schedule This unfortunately coincided with other flights landing at the same time so passport control was very busy but it only took about minutes to get through The staff there were smiling at I understand why passengers complain but its also useful to get positive reviews sometimes I hope my next experience of Leeds Bradford will be as good as this one

Excellent small airport Arrived from JFK and departed to JFK homepoint DTW Arrival It was raining so as a courtesy we were bussed to terminal ride minutes Passage through passport control took minutes The passport control officer smiled and welcomed me Ample shops landside I was able to buy postcards and stamps to mail them to friends Taxicabs to town do not have meters rate is fixed at euros Careful driver clean taxicab Departure minutes at security minutes at passport control Passport control officer smiled again why are US CBP personnel so unable to master the skill of smiling Airside only tiny snack shop Lovely sunny morning so we walked a few feet on tarmac and up staircase into airplane

Modern airport departure and arrival were quick efficient and smooth This not a big nor busy airport so there is never any big queues Immigration police cordial and friendly Almost feels like there is too much airport staff for volume of passengers particularly when departing staff in the multiple cafs looked bored I appreciated the clean toilets and multiple drinking water fountains where you could fill up water for free Duty Free felt was the biggest letdown very generic and poor Not much local Dhofari or even Omani products I think it could be better used to sell the country and region one final time before visitors leave instead of overpriced cheap souvenir tat or the usual generic Toblerone you can find at any airport in the world Even local products like the luxury Amouage perfumes were at the usual price with no deals which was a shame

Recently travelled with a broken ankle The staff were very helpful getting me on and off the plane The special waiting area was a nice touch because I was scared of getting knocked by other passengers

Airport has a weird system for departure You have to go to a security check point outside the airport to be patted down manually by security guards while your vehicle luggage is sniffed by gaurd dogs Then you are dropped off at a terminal for security check again this time through electronic devices where you get a special colored sticker on your luggage Afterwards you proceed to a shuttle bus carry your own luggage that will take you to another terminal about a minute drive where temperatures reach degrees Celsius in the summer At the nd terminal a security check is done to ensure you have been security checked at the previous terminal Now some of this can be avoided if you have a special VIP pass that skips step And a VVIP that skips all steps The check in counters are ok about of them run by Dubais DNata Immigration is slow and queues are long Duty Free is small with tobacco chocolates and alcohol available One coffee shop available behind Duty Free After passing immigration but before your gate you pass through another security check point remove your shoes belts etc Plenty of seating at the gates plus one coffee shop although AC is never working in the summer and no wifi connection through out the airport Staff are all generally friendly

Beautiful state of the art equipment but some poor organisation despite lots of friendly staff Nobody tells you the procedure join this queue then shuffle along only to be told you should have gone to the luggage weighin queue first Weigh luggage then rejoin back of check in queue Told to go to security shuffle along for a bit then someone asks for departure card Leave security queue go to desk where you collect and fill departure card then rejoin back of security queue Suggest check in desk staff give you a departure card so you will know to fill it in before going through security Takes a while to shuffle through that and go through immigration departure check then security check All took about one and a half hours At gate we were divided into groups Not enough seats for group although most passengers are in this group Infrastructure is very impressive and no doubt they will eventually streamline procedures Sign posting would be a good start Shopping and dining facilities are mostly not yet open so I cannot comment on this aspect yet So first taste of new terminal not half bad Clean spacious excellent kit friendly staff but poor procedures

Return leg of my round trip Again the great thing about this airline is the departure from Bangkoks main airport rather than the budget terminal across town Check in was done smoothly and boarding is by passenger ramp instead of being bussed about the airfield so is very convenient and quick Flight departed on time and was fairly uneventful Flight arrived minutes ahead of scheduled time The only let down of the journey was deplaning at Ha Noi was by ground service ramp and bus to the terminal

This is a lovely little regional airport barely minutes from Tours It took just a few minutes to clear immigration then off to the car rental office which is in a hut outside the terminal building in the car park Be warned that car rental here is scandalously expensive It cost over for days Anyway on my return I went to the small caf before security which offers a small but tasty range of snacks and drinks at reasonable prices Clearing security took a couple of minutes and boarding was a breeze All in all just how air travel should be in an ideal world
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

We chose Eastar Jet because of its reasonable price for the round trip from Seoul Gimpo to Jeju First we made booking for pax name of one of us is lack one word so we submitted to correct Immediately I received a call from Seoul to let me know how to change and remind me via email On the day of flight theres a storm in Jeju so we hardly to landed We were afraid that we have to flight back to Seoul luckily we landed safe after few trial times On the return way days later at the airport we were informed that the flight was cancelled due to the storm But Eastar Jet told us that they would find another airline for us then we had tickets of Jin Air then boarding without any problem We were satisfied of services and staff of Eastar Jet from booking until last minute Thanks Eastar Jet for making our trip more memorable and happy

This is a very nice airport Pretty clean and very manageable My only reason for posting a review is there was no functioning water fountain neither for drinking or filling water bottles in the concourse Didnt work when we arrived still didnt when we left six days later Drumming up money for the concession stand Had to buy water for the trip out Bad look for an otherwise pleasant place

Things have improved vastly since the new terminal opened and the new baggage claim is very good far faster than Edinburgh or Glasgow Return journeys can be a bit of a pain but the new departure lounge is reasonably good Airport staff weve found to be generally polite and helpful Our tips for a happier return trip Buy any food or drink in your resort Dont be in a rush to go through security to the departure lounge its much nicer outside or in the checkin hall If you smoke there is a smoking room in the departure lounge Think about investing in a portable balance for weighing your baggage as if you are overweight it could cost you

At first I was not impressed by the airport as from outside it looks small and not modern But once in I was happily surprised with the efficiency of the airport both in the arrival and departure halls The wifi woked perfectly The facility is simple but clean and fast to navigate through The airport business class lounge was a great surprise Beautiful design very attentive staff great food and drinks selection Well done CKY

A very big shout out to Jude and Liz at the checkin service desk as well as Tup the client manager on the flight I happened to leave a bag containing a priceless religious item at the checkin desk as we were running late for the flight And in my haste I left the bag at the desk I totally forgot about it and would have been extremely devastated and upset if I realised I left it behind Once we boarded the plane and settled in a very kind Tup and other staff member came up to us and returned the bag to us I can only guess that Liz and Jude realised I was a religious Jew and made the effort to return the bag to us on the plane before it took off My wife and I were so touched by this extremely kind gesture We spoke to Tup during the flight and expressed our gratitude but I wanted to leave this note of thanks to Jude and Liz too We always try and fly Rex your staff are friendly and happy so different to the other airlines we have flown on domestically And this incident just reinforces the good vibes we get when flying Rex

Domestic passenger Arrived at and departed on from Terminal No issues disembarking Having staff there to ensure passengers with baggage to reclaim dont inadvertently leave without collecting it is helpful On return it took a while to clear security With a number of airports across the UK now using the new scanners meaning liquids can stay in hand luggage its a pity Terminal had not restarted this Good range of shops and restaurants in departures with clear signage and ample seating Flight pushed back on time but there was a wait of about minutes as it sat in a queue for takeoff clearance From previous experience excellent for international travel as most major cities across the world reachable with a direct flight but Gatwick remains my first choice for regional travel

A couple of points firstly there is now a new terminal so most of the tips above do not now apply Agree about the prices for coffee etc they are outrageous They now handle more international flights for example to Bangkok so I would like to think they are better equipped for international flights now I have Never been stopped by the immigration people I find them very friendly Last point the taxis There is no doubt they are expensive They are on the clock but from the airport the clocks run fast From my old apartment it was km to the airport and on one occasion km back Better to pay rmb for the bus directly outside the airport then get a taxi from the Aviation hotel in the city Hope this helps

Las Palmas to Tenerife Not a great experience The plane had SwiftAir livery even though it was CanaryFly flight The plane was old and produced terrible noise during takeoff I have flown the ATR not once but it was only such experience The airline had a free seating policy It was OK as there were only people in the plane capable of The crew provided only water

This is my local airport and not a bad little place Yes at times TSA slows things down to a crawl but the TSA workers here seem to actually have a sense of pride and a sense of humor I have a steel hip and this has caused numerous delays in other airports but either they know me by now or they have their collective ish together Food offerings are decent and the Powells Bookstore is a great place to grab a book for your flight My only bummer is that it IS a smaller metro airport and thus fewer international nonstops

We arrived and departed on the BA flight from LGW Arrival was amazingly quick It took less than half an hour to deplane go through passport control and collect bags Being a Club World passenger undoubtedly helped but even so we were pretty impressed There was almost no queue to go through security at the time of departure lunchtime midweek so the process was painless Again we were lucky that it was so quiet A new business lounge has just opened by Gate Its rather small but has good food choice Getting to San Francisco is a cinch using the BART connector shuttle to Coliseum and thence onwards to downtown San Francisco In fact the whole experience is much better than at SFO And because of the competition between BA and Norwegian fares from the UK are very reasonable at present

Norman Manley Airport originally Palisadoes Airport is an old military field that like MBJ has grown As most tourist arrivals are via MBJ KIN gets overlooked when improvements are in the works Indeed an old tired airport with crowding a problem both inside outside the buildings There is an improvement programme underway for the airside facilities with pax facilities coming in second place Walking tofrom the plane is interesting but the smell of jet fuel can be nauseating Like MBJ the approach provides interesting views Kingston and surrounds notably the hills above town The drive in from the airport is a beautiful ride along the peninsula though if going into town will be through some rough spots Recent hurricane damage has been repaired for the most part Overall a far below MBJ in all aspects but workable

Tanahmerah to Korowai Batu This route is a governmentsubsidized one operated with tiny aircraft carrying only about a dozen passengers No advance booking possible but Dimonim staff were helpful in getting us on a flight the same day Departure time was uncertain but we eventually got on the plane Once aboard it was a great flight offering sweeping views of the rivers and rain forests below Cheap too

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Flew Star Peru from Lima to Cusco Pleasantly surprised after reading dire reviews here Departure was more or less on time in small rather old plane It was mostly empty too Seats not incredibly comfortable but very short flight anyway Price not a bargain but not terribly expensive no point booking in advance BTW as fares do not seem to really vary that much Flight was fine and service was rather good and polite onboard with snacks drink and luggage all included in fare No issues at all

Albrook Panama City to Bocas del Toro After reading comments about this airline I was a bit worried but our flight with Air Panama was really okay Checkin at the airport was quick there were no lines My bag was kg so I had to pay dollars for the kg overweight Totally fine There are no infoscreens at the small airport of Albrook but as there are only leaving a couple of flights a day its obvious when boarding starts The flight left at so right on time The fokker used for this flight is old but seatpitch was okay for this minute flight to Bocas After a loud and bumpy take off the crew handed out some crisps and a soda After minutes of cruising with some wonderful views at the rainforest and Caribbean beaches the pilot started decent into Bocas airport After a soft landing and a short taxi to the small apron our luggage appeared within minutes We really enjoyed this flight in this old air Panama fokkerairplane

Perfect trip throughout except for one strange thing that comes first I partly paid the fare with miles This can only be done via agent by filling the form on the site and waiting for the response Also miles paid booking doesnt appear at your regular account so some difficulties to access it Otherwise it was fine Online check in no problem Bag drop with automatic counter didnt work well but resolved within minutes on the regular desk Boarding efficient take off on time ordered meal arrived and was ok Landing on schedule Legroom is ok no problem with overhead bag allocation Toilets clean Crews nice and efficient The plane was clean cabin in good condition The room for improvement is booking with miles and legroom Tighter than Ryanair

My son who is epileptic had a seizure during the security check in We had already requested Special Assistance at the desk and the airport team were incredibly helpful and took us to a quiet room to wait until our flight was called They checked on us every minutes and arranged a wheelchair and preferential boarding once the Gate opened They also ensured that the crew were aware of our situation and forwarded the request for assistance to Gatwick

After guessing at which line to wait for checking my luggage Im still waiting in a line that doesnt move for longer than an hour The reason the conveyor belt that moves the luggage is broken When I left Washington the same problem happened just that the IAD airport organized porters with carts and we didnt wait at all The disorganization level at this airport is outstanding

Paris Orly to PointePitre Overall good experience decent food friendly service on the inbound flight Outbound all of the crew disappeared at night difficult to get something to drink Some security concerns upon landing in Paris Crew didnt check the cabin at alltwo teens sleeping in lie flat position until touchdown No one to wake them up no one to remind them to put their seat in an upright position never saw that before Seats are ok but angled lie flat

This was the nicest transatlantic flight Ive taken and Ive been traveling to and from Paris a lot It was a very large and comfortable plane The flight attendant who took care of us was delightful The seats were very comfortable and went almost completely flat for an actual sleep The food was even decent We flew back on Air Canada which was fine but I was sad it was not the same as the way out I will try to fly with Corsair on my next trip in October Thank you

This is a very nice airport Pretty clean and very manageable My only reason for posting a review is there was no functioning water fountain neither for drinking or filling water bottles in the concourse Didnt work when we arrived still didnt when we left six days later Drumming up money for the concession stand Had to buy water for the trip out Bad look for an otherwise pleasant place

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

Having no low cost carriers until relatively recently between Bangkok and Taipei this was one of the few major Asian routes which meant a plane change in a third country to find a decent fare for budget travelers Now it is served by two V Air and Tigerair Taiwan On the basis of this flight both are excellent and put similar carriers in the shade The Tigerair Taiwan afternoon flight to Bangkoks Don Mueang airport was boarded efficiently using a bus gate and taxiing commenced minutes early FAs were smartly dressed and super efficient smiling as they carried out their duties My preordered meal was piping hot unlike on some fullservice carriers who serve from a trolley All in all a seamless and flawless flight

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

With family in Brittany Im a regular user of Rennes St Jacques and have seen its traffic grow significantly in volume over the past decade What a shame that the airport itself has not been able to keep up The only passenger facilities are a small caf gift shop and once you get beyond security theres a popup snack stall closed on Sundays and a vending machine No shops eating establishments or even the token Duty Free Generally I pass through the airport quickly so this isnt really a concern but if you are unfortunate enough to be delayed its not fun My main issue is with the speed of checkin which can only be described as glacial When there are two or more imminently departing flights at the same time the queues barely seem to move at the risk of passengers almost missing their plane I speak from experience here Staff are pleasant and bilingual but absolutely inefficient at processing large volumes of passengers I want to like Saint Jacques its clean friendly and has a good bus service to the city centre but it hasnt really done enough to move with the times and comfortably accommodate its passengers If it had a choice of amenities expanded checkin with more staff and a better departure lounge it would be pretty much the perfect regional airport

Short hop from Nice to Calvi Hardly any people onboard Crew were not particularly friendly or welcoming but we were served a cookie and soft drinks Landed smoothy although slightly delayed due to a missed approach However tickets were cheap and luggage included All in all a decent experience

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

We booked different domestic flights tofrom and in Sulawesi with Lion Air as there were no real alternatives What I was afraid for having read reviews here already happened days before departure of our first flight as I got a message our initially booked first flight was cancelled and we were rebooked on a later flight From the flights booked were cancelled and we got rebooked Luckily I managed to arrange my pickup at the Makassar and Ternate airports where we already arranged travel Our flights from Makassar to Palopo and back were the only ones that remained as booked Palopo flights on an ATR twinturboprop had Wings Air owned by Lion Air flight numbers All other flights were on s Service on board of the flights was nonexistent but at least the flights were smooth and left on time as per the new schedule Also baggage reclaim went smooth but this of course shouldnt be an issue as all airports were quite small The positive note is staff at the airports were nice and friendly and always did their best to assign us seats with more legroom which was much appreciated

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

London to Hanoi via Shenzhen Boarding was a little prolonged and we were called to the gate much earlier than needed on the London Shenzhen leg Both of my flights left slightly late The crew were friendly seat was comfortable and food was surprisingly good considering We had two full meals and drinks on the first leg and a snack box on the second The entertainment on the London Shenzhen leg had enough options to satisfy me though far fewer than other airlines The system was modern and worked well The Shenzhen Hanoi leg had no entertainment Crew announcements were hard to hear and very brief in English Transiting in Shenzhen was as chaotic as expected but took around an hour in total I had to follow signs to domestic transfers wait in a holding area to fill in some forms through immigration then headed upstairs to departures of my own volition My checked bag went all the way without having to collect in Shenzhen The flight was a bargain and I definitely would use again

Ground service is terrible compared to in the air Manual checkin process with no computers This airline seems to be the only one to have a lounge in the domestic terminal in Yangon Airconditioned and friendly associates offering a cheese croissant No bathroom inside so that was a drag People in Lotus class got a private van to the plane which was nice compared to cramming onto a bus Onboard the flight was pretty good The front of the plane is much quieter compared to the back Their inflight magazine was pretty decent and the english grammatically correct Even on short flights they gave you food On my YGNMDY flight which was about minutes they served a full breakfast Seats were pretty comfortable on par with United A first class seats I dont really see the need for inflight entertainment on such short flights

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip

Hiroshima is a small regional airport with virtually all flights internal Japanese flights Most westerners visit Hiroshima using land routes from other cities so the airport is not as western friendly as bigger Japanese airports This means there are few public announcements in English though the standard of English for check in staff was very good The food concession stands also cater to Japanese tastes only so you are out of luck if you only like western food There are also no magazines or books in any language other than Japanese Surprisingly wide range of souvenirs though most wont be much use to long haul travelers eg frozen salmon steaks oysters etc Transport to downtown very good as a limousine bus leaves from outside terminal and arrives pretty much next to the Bomb Dome which most people are going to

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

My sister and I flew from LGW to Banjul I have nothing but praise for the cabin crew We flew out on th Nov at The crew were amazing we have flown many times and although some passengers were difficult they never wavered from the job in hand and seemed to be happy genuinely I wish I took the crews names as they were on the go the whole hrs

Singapore to Yangon Ontime departure from Changi terminal The economy cabin felt clean and the crew were friendly My expectation was for a basic and efficient service which was we got This was an evening flight so we had a basic dinner which was okay as good if not better than the Premium Economy meal from Melbourne to Singapore Same wine Sauvignon Blanc This time no other option so I opted for the red Comfortable good service no complaints

STNGSE Arrived on Ryanair Single runway so only one plane can landtakeoff at a time Very compact with everything close by A very short stroll from the aircraft to the terminal where Passport Kiosks quickly processed everyone The Baggage Claim is one conveyor and there are limited toilet facilities before getting to Arrivals Hall Arrivals is midway between the Checkin Desks and the Security Scanning Outside the airport there is a taxi rank usually stocked with cars for each flight and the bus to the centre of Gothenburg Picnic tables are still outside on the grass where you can relax Security is OK and then a smallish Departure Lounge which is very busy if flights are going at similar times The Duty Free has various things but no alcohol There is a cafe selling hot and cold drinks sandwiches and similar and a small bar selling drinks There are Departure Doors of which Gate has Passport Control for nonSchengen flights NB Whilst Security is quick if there are two flights at the same time the process slows especially as most passengers travel with volumes of hand luggage that need liquids etc removed It is a good little airport and friendly in size

We had an absolutely delightful experience with Privilege Style The staff were very nice and accommodating Seating was exactly as expected and food was fine enough for a flight meal Thank you for a great experience We look forward to flying Privilege again

I have flown here only on private aircraft The commercial airlines have yet to discover this often overlooked resource The parking and terminal buildings are great Reminds me of how Chicago Midway used to be before the most recent spate of reconstruction like a hometown feel Very clean facilities and the commercial pax I have spoken to all seem to enjoy it Mostly the lack of a commute to Chicago I think

Nice medium size airport Looks new or revamped and spotless clean Easy to move around and offers enough services Serious but very efficient staff which is all I ask for Fast check in fast security even going through passport control was relatively fast it was a late fly though so there wasnt many people

Brussels to Eskisehir with Tailwind Airlines Nice flight The crew was okay the plane was outdated The food was okay too not free or included though There wasnt any kind of inflight entertainment Great if you dont want WiFi connection or when you dont want to know where you are

Mumbai to Paris Excellent and clean Aircraft A Awesome Cabin service and cabin crew Amazing food and drinks Clean and comfortable business class seats even though they are not lie flat but comfortable sleep at an angle The highlight is excellent on board crew who took care of guests in an excellent manner Excellent AudioVideo system clean and neat restrooms I would like to say the most affordable business class product for a very quality product Would recommend all the way

Very early flight out of HK bussed from the terminal near gate downstairs so easy A bit of messing around at check in echeck in you need to show visas etc Plane spotless and staff attentive Bathrooms clean Return we prebooked one bag between us for the hold which we would recommend its about USD to do so whereas on the spot its more like US plane is immaculate and the staff responsive and quick Prebooked meals are served quickly and hot and cold drinks available Walked off to a far gate but train takes you to immigration Great for short flights and I feel they are better earlier in the day as more likely to be on time Seat is fine for a hour flight I would say Drinks arent extortionate nice cold prosecco for HK the app website is a bit tricky I joined it but had to do it all on the laptop first then open the app and register Sort of CX connected but not really Its a bit counterintuitive

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

I wouldnt want to be a cheerleader for Ryanair So many things can go wrong But when things go right as they did on this trip I think it should be said that the airline provides a good service at a reasonable cost Most of the annoying announcements have gone and by paying a few pounds extra you can get a seat up front and take an extra bag on board The cabin crew were efficient and friendly particularly on the return flight where they were smiling and looked happy to be there

I fly this airline regularly between Yellowknife and Edmonton Staff is generally friendly and the complimentary food service is a nice touch but generally inedible Unfortunately they have the tendency to change your seats without notice and you will not find out until checkin time Much of the reason for this change is that if they notice a flight is only half booked they use half of the plane for cargo which eliminates the first rows of seats Thus when booking on Canadian North make sure you book the back row of seats between and you likely wont have to worry about your seat being changed Prepare to be packed in like sardines on most Canadian North flights though Seat pitchwidth is standard

I very much enjoyed flying with SAS Very attentive and cheerful staff ontime departures and landings free coffee and tea service incl refill clean and modern planes A delightful experience My only little complaint is the ticket fare but after all it was in highseason and ok for such a good service

Surprisingly nice flight for a Chinese airline The business class named first class is of the usual type in China ie rows of seats with old seats and small reclining angle The crew was very attentive wine Chinese was decent and so was the food nothing special but ok Reading material is of course restricted to the China Daily and there is no individual entertainment but on a hours flight especially on a night flight this is not essential Flights both ways were on time I would recommend this flight as it is the only airline to fly directly between Bangkok and several places in the Shandong province schedule is terrible but it is still better than transferring

Been coming to GCM for years Yes tourism has increased based on reports by almost over last years which is fantastic for this beautiful Island But the airport although complete remodelled is poor at best Aesthetically pleasing it is too small and very uncomfortable Why go half way for something inadequate from the start Fortunately the entire staff are awesome and eased the pain Suggest a change in schedule of when flights arrive may assist even by minutes Two recent issues I dealt with The runway pothole was a total screw up From accounts in paper it appeared that new asphalt from night before was destroyed by a jet blast Asphalt needs to cure Second and personally involved is that our plane needed to wait one hour after everyone was boarded for maintenance to return a log book This made our connection for our next flight impossible with all the inconveniences associated How can you allow this calamity to occur is still not sitting well with me If you expect tourism to continue to visit your beautiful Island you need to improve

After guessing at which line to wait for checking my luggage Im still waiting in a line that doesnt move for longer than an hour The reason the conveyor belt that moves the luggage is broken When I left Washington the same problem happened just that the IAD airport organized porters with carts and we didnt wait at all The disorganization level at this airport is outstanding
