Hilo International Airport was once THE airport on the Big island before Kona International Airport on the other side of the island opened in the ss Now Hilo Airport is a shadow of its former self with jetways no more than of which are in use at any given time The decor is kitschy s Hawaiiana and the terminal is warm and welcoming Hilo is one of the few US airports where the gate area and the ticketingbag claim are in separate buildings separated by an atrium The ticketingbag claim area has a bar a bookshop a souvenir shop selling Hawaiiana and packaged tropical fruit and a lounge area The gate building has no facilities The parking and car rental areas are just across the street from bag claim and the total walk from gate to kerb is only a few hundred feet Access to and from Hilo town is easy and traffic is usually light

The airport has definitely improved and it looks a lot more modern than it used to be before They have a decent dutyfree shop with a good selection of items I really liked the sports bar that they had there which was also showing the Fifa World Cup games live and the food was good too The airport staff is very friendly and welcoming and there are also stalls where you can get a massage There is also enough seating if you are traveling in transit

Malaga to Birmingham I booked this flight online one week before flying I needed to book for adults one child and one infant However I found when checking prices it was cheaper make two separate bookings than the whole group at once I booked for two adults then another booking for one adult and two children This is unbelievable Also you arent allowed to check in online until hours before you fly unless you book a seat for euros each Which is a bit impossible as you are in holiday at this point Just another money making scam However we booked for free while in Spain and our hotel were kind enough to print our boarding passes for us The plane was clean but the seating is just too cramped My husband had sit with his knee protruding into the isle and the trolley kept knocking him when going past Food and drinks are too expensive luckily we bought some snacks and refreshments from the departure lounge before leaving Malaga The staff however are really helpful and Im sure they know its not the comfortable of places to sit for hours and do make an effort in making people feel welcome and providing a good service They were quick to help with the needs of my month old The pilot kept us informed of any changes as we were experiencing a lot of turbulence We were also informed as we approached the UK coastline and also times for arrival were given The plus side we didnt have any hold luggage and were able to check in infants pram at the departure gate Meaning we didnt have to wait in the long bag check in queues Overall we paid premium prices for seats on a below average quality plane Thanks to the stewards for their efforts in trying to compensate for this

Arrived early for check in and flew through very quickly as it had not yet offically opened Unlike last year when I was a little late and it took more than minutes while my Passport was checked and rechecked Immigration was quick took about two minutes and the security check was also quick I came through here last year and had to be pushy to get both to Passport Control and then through Security as otherwise qiven the queues I would have missed my flight The airport is quite spacious and there are a few shops I went straight to Turkish Airlines Lounge and stayed there until it was time to board the place This was straightforward This was my third time going through Vnukovo and the experience was similar to that of my first time

I have been to some of the worlds best star SIN ICN HKG HND airports but Sapporos New Chitose tops them all Why So much to do and enjoy Airport History Museum Royce Chocolate World factory openair Observation Deck Movie Theatre Onsen Sky Museum interactive airline stuff for kids and adults Hello Kitty Theatre Hotel amazing number and variety of food court options Aside from these frills New Chitose excels in what really matters to travelers Despite huge crowds SapporoTokyo is one of the worlds busiest routes terminal is spacious and easy to navigate Efficient checkin countersone dedicated to just school groups Spotless restrooms plenty of seats in departure areas Easy to use frequent every minutes JR train connections minutes to Sapporo Station Polite hardworking security teams Short waits on the runway for takeoffs

As you pull into Long Beach Airport the parking structure is conveniently located right across from the terminal Checkin and security screening took less than minutes in the afternoon hours Long Beach has an open natural and airy terminal You will find palm trees small birds and abundance of sunshine on this terminal There are enough seats for you to sit and relax Dining options are very good Free wifi also works well This airport does not use jet bridge so you will enter and exit the aircraft using stairs or ramp Baggage claim area is small but appropriate for an airport with a vintage look

Arrived from Bangkok on Thai flight and still bussed to the terminal in June Queues for visa on arrival handled relatively quickly and luggage handling dealt with promptly and efficiently Friendly staff with a relaxed atmosphere

Small functional airport which is a bit drab for a holiday destination like Langkawi Clean but a bit rusty A decent common hall with shopping and eating before check in after baggage claim but next to nothing to do on the airside Still more pleasant than KLIA or Subang

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

For an African bush airline I have to hand it to Mack Air for having its act together I arrived in Maun Botswana from Cape Town and after clearing immigration walked to the Mack Air desk where I saw my name posted The staff promptly and courteously took me in tow gave me my boarding pass and took care of my luggage Shortly thereafter the staff escorted me to my plane which was a very presentable Cessna Grand Caravan The pilot and a few other passengers arrived and soon we were off to the air strip and safari lodge The procedure was very much the same following the stay at the lodge when I flew on to Kasane Botswana The plane was spotless the crew very good and safety briefings were properly handled And at Kasane Mack Airs folks were on hand to see that I connected with my onward ground handler As a pilot and as a former airline employee I can honestly give Mack Air a fine rating It is a good bush airline with all the trappings of larger carriers I would fly with them anytime

I would like to sincerely thank flight Stewardess Irdina from royal brunei BI dubai to london for her excellent hospitality She was very attentive cheerful friendly helpful and professional Other crew members also giving excellent service to the passengers Thank you for making our flight more enjoyable meaningful and memorable Looking forward to fly RB again soon

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji

Bornholm to Copenhagen The flight on halfanhour was smooth and on time Very relaxed boarding and in the air you are offered coffeetea and a piece of chocolate by smiling crew Seats OK aircraft clean and announcements informal Danish as also often experienced on ofter Scandinavian carriers DAT now serve several routes inside Denmark and have always been ontime Tickets on this route however somewhat expensive compared to earlier days

Departure is very tedious Our flight got delayed not due to the airports fault but it took hours for them to get our luggage back Most of the luggage returned were wet and damaged Arrival however is very quick and easy

OV th March and OV th March AmsterdamTallinn Decent legroom nice inflight magazine and even boarding with a proper jetway at Tallinn for the return flight Good inflight service featuring a solid drinks menu with Estonias superb A LeCoq lager and Viru Valge vodka not a bad little airline at all I had flown them before in on a CopenhagenTallinn round trip with similar results

I am beyond happy with the assistance I received from this airline and staff I had back pain and an injury before my flight and walking at the airport was very difficult for me They immediately provided me with a wheelchair and a wonderful staff member who took care of me all the way until I boarded the plane The ground staff the crew and the entire experience were absolutely perfect I cant believe how kind helpful and professional everyone was I feel truly blessed Thank you so much
The aircraft was on time from Manchester and on the return journey from Lourdes Bartres the aircraft left early The staff were a bit distant the food good overall OK

Was on flight with Vietnam Airlines from Hanoi to OsakaKansai on its business class Nothing to complain as ground staff cabin crew were professional and offered the best that they could Seat was comfortable I chose the Japanese breakfast and found that it was somehow delicious Inflight entertainment surprisingly was excellent with new movies and music album No WiFI onboard even in business class which may be something the airline should consider to improve

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

BrusselsAleppo DamascusBrussels Cheapest tickets to Syria direct flights from Brussels to Aleppo and Damascus friendly crew adequate food Although older Airbus they were clean and looked well maintained and a lot of legspace

Airport conditions are fairly reasonable given the recent difficulties Do try to have your visa in good order before arriving Visa on arrival is only possible if it has been arranged in advance and takes some time to issue at the airport Apart from that the arrivals process is OK Just follow everyone else Departing is also not too bad However as has been pointed out the signs are all in Arabic so it can be difficult to know where to go Check in is a little chaotic Finding the departure lounge may not be that easy Staff are actually quite helpful and polite There are a few shops and a basic business lounge Wireless internet is available and works quite well

In November Phnom Penh air travelers started using a spacious new terminal equipped with percent more checkin counters than now twice as many immigration counters and three times as many Xray machines for carryon bags In Cambodias largest airport expansion mil in a generation the new airport terminal will seem like an upscale shopping mall There is a large food court twice as much floor space for duty free and a host of new food and beverage vendors never seen that far west on Russian Boulevard Last week the VIP and Premium lounges opened and are as good as any in a terminal this size It all looks very clean and organized though I have yet to see the new terminal when there are great numbers of people arriving or departing

Late evening arrival into CFU on the th May arriving minutes early from EMA Deplaned quickly and minimal delay at passport control only due to people disembarking at the same time there were also several friendly assistants to help manage the queue and answer any questions Baggage was starting to appear on the carousel as we entered the collection area so again no great delay and straight out to waiting transport On our return journey early evening departure th May small queue for checkin and baggage drop Plenty of friendly JET staff to assist and pre tag cabin baggage so maybe a minute delay but the queue was inside the building and checkin desks open Security again was very quick with only about people in front of us whilst I wouldnt say the security staff were unfriendly they were perhaps best described as efficient Then into the departure lounge with more than enough seating for all the waiting passengers from various flights with a variety of shops and food and drink establishments available Again passport control to gates was fast and friendly with no great delay and even at the gates there was food and drink available which looked very appetising Flight boarded quickly and departed about minutes behind schedule It has to be said that since the completion of the refurbishment of this airport the experience is vastly improved The toiletswashrooms are no longer an area to be feared and requiring a bio hazard suit to use The whole airport is clean and bright with sufficent staff on hand There is also a greater choice of food and drinks available So a really pleasant and relaxing experience flying into and out of Corfu compared with previous occasions

Every time on arrival from either holiday work meetings interstate or visiting relatives in Melbourne I feel all the renovations look great but please put the car park ticket machines near the carousel arrival hall out of the weather When some people pay at the gate they hold up the traffic I travel with Virgin regularly and cant wait for the renovations to be finished

I had have one of the best experiences with Air Astana because my April trip from Dubai to UstKamenogorsk via Almaty and Astana and back included flights and all were in time Different types of aircrafts such as B from DXB to ALA Airbus long range from ALA to NQZ Astana and Embraer E to UKK all were clean and their condition was also good Of course in this challenge ALong range definitely wins because it was brand new As for food everything was nice and wide choice of beverages is still available as before pandemic And one more thing I took part in air Astana stop over holidays program for international travellers and my hosting in Almaty and Astana in hotels was very friendly On international flights airline gives complimentary amenity kit even in economy class I just have to mention that my screen of entertainment system on my way from Dubai to Almaty didnt work Thats why I took one point from my overall mark

Excellent new terminal spacious and with lots of checkin counters Flew China Southern to Nanjing and the checkin was swift as was security All passengers get patted down regardless of whether you beep or not which was a bit of a nuisance Beyond security good amenities and restaurants We had an early morning departure and the terminal was very busy but it is definitely large enough to handle the number of people One downside is we got a bus to the plane which took minutes

Please can someone improve the signage when you leave Nice airport to go to the motorway to Monaco We always end up going round and round roundabouts looking for the sign to MonacoGenoa and end up going through parts of Nice and joining the motorway at a later junction If we take the train to Monaco from St Augustin Station the signage from the airport to the station is inadequate Please can the airport management arrange to improve the signage to and from the airport to the station and Monaco One wonders does anyone care about the customers at Nice Airport For example the BA checkin desk is substandard with unfriendly staff The whole experience at Nice airport is not a pleasant one If senior staff at Nice airport read this review one wonders if they are bothered to do anything about it We live in hope

There is also an excellent restaurant on the mezzanine floor overlooking the runway It opens at noon which gives adequate time for a good lunch before the departure of the Luton flight at Information on bus transportation to and within Nimes is at httpwwwtcnfr
I had special assistance booked here The check in staff were incredibly kind and helpful and the assistance staff were fantastic Could not fault my experience

Superb airport Small Friendly service No queuing went through security in under minutes Fast free wifi with constant connection and no connectivity issues Burger and chips SEK cl beer SEK Decent viewing facility but minimal air traffic to view

Munich to Bologna and Pisa to Munich both on an Embraer economy Both flights handled efficiently southbound on time northbound delayed by about mins on departure due to to late arrival of incoming flight there had been thick fog at MUC early that morning which had sent things adrift for much of the morning However support given to those with tight connections Modest inflight service snacks and drinks wine came in proper glasses Air Dolomiti worked okay for us

VKOAER Overall pleasantly surprised by the product Online checkin via Aeroflots website was quick and efficient Vnukovo airport is clean spacious and comfortable with lots of Rossiyas checkin counters and assistance desks The aircraft was new and clean although legroom was a bit tight seats themselves were very comfortable Cabin crew were quick efficient and friendly Free food included a nice sandwich tea coffee juices and Coke You could also purchase a nice craft beer with snacks Overall a very pleasant experience for a middle discountsector airline

I read some scary reviews here which made me leave for the airport more than hours before my flight But after a very good journey on the excellent Aeroexpress train I have nothing to report DME is no Changi for sure but it is a completely average airport No big queues and from checkin to lounge it took me minutes max The bulk of it spent with a slow passport officer who did not speak English and was confused by my dual nationality and me living on a third country But the rest of the security measures XRAY of all luggages on entry second check of boarding pass and passport are on pair with other specially Asian airports Granted this is a Sunday afternoon so things could get busier during the week But this is it just an adequate airport Not one of the modern Shopping Centers you find these days but just a regular place to wait for your next flight Maybe the view from the lounge is different but I learned long ago to not leave home without my Priority Pass Contrary to some of the reviews here the airport does offer wifi and it does accept any international number Maybe this is one of the benefits of traveling after the WC

Infrastructure lacking excellent welcoming courtesy Plane from VIE landed on the one runway turned around and taxied to a parking area from which we descended staircases promptly rolled up to the front and rear doors This airport does not know the concept of gate We walked to a huge barn of a building and all joined the line of nonUkrainians At this point some passport control official undertook a mental exercise called thinking lets open the other line for Ukrainians for these passengers That immediately cut the wait in half my wait was minutes The passport official who stamped my passport smiled note to US CBP agents thats when the ends of the mouth go up and said Welcome Then enter the other half of the huge building with a currency exchange a clean bathroom and not much else Overeager taxicab drivers were in abundance but I and many of us took the Viking bus to our river cruise ship

Such a small airport But perfectly sized for the amount of people and traffic Nice staff and very clean facilities Just need to ensure there are some drinks and food available past security as the drink vending machine was broken
Superb flight Left on time and arrived early This typifies the reason why Bangkok Airways is world best regional airline You got a little bag with a sandwich and water which was tasty

Sunshine Coast Airport MCY services mainly flights to Sydney SYD and Melbourne MEL with some services to Adelaide ADL and seasonal international services to Auckland AKL New Zealand A new low cost airline will soon be operating from the airport which will make flights north to several cities in Queensland and other flights to Melbourne and regional New South Wales and regional Victoria The airport terminal is located in Marcoola about mins north of Maroochydore Private Airport transfer services Taxis Ubers and public buses service the airport however the public bus system does not run a timetable that would service all arrivals or departures Paid short term and long term parking is available with some of the long term parking having sails to provide limited protection from the elements There is also an offsite private parking business within the airport precinct that offers secure indoor and outdoor paid parking The terminal has Checkin counter areas for airlines at the northern end and a covered breezeway then leads to security screening and the departure area at the southern end of the terminal The luggage carousels for arriving passengers luggage are also located at the southern end of the terminal along with rental car counters toilets Luggage sometimes can take a while to arrive on the carousels as it appears the incoming aircraft is unloaded and the bags for the departing flight are then loaded before the arriving flight luggage is finally brought into the terminal and loaded onto the baggage carousel The departure area has food outlets that sell food and drinks at the usual airport prices as well as a few shops including a surf shop and a news agency books newspapers etc The northern end of the departure lounge also operates as the international departure and arrival area when the seasonal Auckland flights are operating at other times it forms part of the domestic departure area Gates serve both as Arrival and departure gates and their are currently no aerobridges so you will walk down stairs onto the tarmac and into the terminal Facilities are available for disabled passengers who cannot utilise the stairs The airport at times can be very busy especially if flights are delayed otherwise their is plenty of seating As most flights are coming from Sydney and Melbourne weather or other delays can have a knock on effect causing delays to outbound flights The real advantage of using this airport is avoiding around a hr min trip to Brisbane Airport on a good day when there are no traffic delays or accidents on the M to Brisbane Airport The airport is expanding and the terminal facilities will improve as part of the expansion project Overall a very good airport experience

The Fokker was certainly old but clean The flight announcements were made in Farsi and English to my surprise The flight was smooth on time and without any nervousness Food was surprisingly excellent Chicken rice and a bottle of Pepsi

I booked return flights from Sydney to Rome via Guangzhou where the airline provides an easy and comfortable option of a free hotel depending on the gap between your next flight The stopover option is incredibly well handled with transport provided to and from your hotel I thoroughly recommend this as Guangzhou has a great easy to use metro system and its very easy to get around The A fleet used are in excellent condition with pleasant staff although meals can be a let down one on my return journey was actually inedible However the real test of a good airline is when things dont go to plan My return flight from Rome was cancelled due to a technical issue after we had boarded the flight We spent hours on board with regular updates provided before the Captain made the decision not to fly Prior to disembarking which involved reentering Italy and collecting our bags lunch was served on board a nice touch Once back in the terminal we were given further meal vouchers and asked to return an hour later On return we were bussed to the nearby Sheraton where all accommodation and meals were covered for hours while the plane was repaired and put back in service These changes left only hours to change to my rescheduled flight from Guangzhou to Sydney however to my delight China Southern provided a hotel option close to the airport allowing for a refreshing stop and rest before the final long leg back to Sydney So sure I arrived on Sunday morning instead of Friday night as planned but the way I was looked after was very good I would certainly recommend China Southern and will fly with them again

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Okinawa Naha Boarded on time and with no troubles staff were friendly and welcoming Seats were reasonably comfortable Im ft tall and my knees werent touching the back of the seat in front of me which was definitely a welcome surprise on a low cost carrier No entertainment systems available but not an issue as I usually travel with my iPod and something to read anyway Flight was calm and we experienced no turbulence en route You need to purchase on board food or bring something with you but we knew this in advance so brought some food bought at Narita departures terminal All round good flights cheap and efficient and did exactly what we wanted Took us from A to B with no fuss or issues A solid experience Id recommend and plan on using again in the future

Overall an excellent airport Coming in and going out immigration was fast efficient and friendly The airport is very clean and welllaid out for its size and does not feel crowded at all Decent choice of shops and places to eat

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines

Never have I been to an airport with staff so keen to help and so lovely After a baggage mishap at Shanghai Airport I arrived at Fukoaka knowing that my bag was not on the flight that I was on Upon arrival immigration was a breeze even with a British passport and I went straight to the arrivals desk where four people immediately helped me They were so kind and helpful and sorted out my problem immediately They reassured me that everything would be ok and even gave me a yen note to pay for the delivery of my luggage to where I was staying somewhere around hours away from Fukoaka The whole airport experience was wonderful in comparison to the rude service I received at Shanghai Pu Dong Airport Thank you to everyone who helped out a traveler who had lost his baggage

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

Dusseldorf to London City Very nice flight including free Snacks and drinks Legroom was okay and staff was friendly but seemed a little stressed due to a huge amount of hand luggage in this flight Inflight magazines were old

Great Airport We travelled from Manchester and from landing to leaving the airport it only took us minutes For the return flight we checked our bags in minutes and took just another to get through security etc The departure lounge is bright and welcoming and boarding just took a few minutes Good experience I wish more airports were like this

Airport conditions are fairly reasonable given the recent difficulties Do try to have your visa in good order before arriving Visa on arrival is only possible if it has been arranged in advance and takes some time to issue at the airport Apart from that the arrivals process is OK Just follow everyone else Departing is also not too bad However as has been pointed out the signs are all in Arabic so it can be difficult to know where to go Check in is a little chaotic Finding the departure lounge may not be that easy Staff are actually quite helpful and polite There are a few shops and a basic business lounge Wireless internet is available and works quite well

I have been through Abidjan a few times and whilst I was impressed on my first visit progressive improvements since then mean that it is definitely the best airport I have been to in Africa There is now decent and free wifi in the departures area a comfortable new cafe and the information boards are clear

Tehran to Cologne with Iran Air A wonderful airline with good service The flight took hours and we had meals breakfast with breads and a lot of other things and lunch was chicken with saffron rice and a small salad yogurt and a cake Drinks were also for free My seat had enough space and it was comfortable A small delay of minutes but that was because some passengers were late

After a week away we returned to Atlanta and couldnt find our vehicle Somehow the parking space location was deleted in my phone Nokuthuba Bray found us wandering around trying to find it It took about an hour but she went above and beyond to find it We are grateful for her great effort

Pleasant surprise Planes were new and clean Staff was attentive and efficient Flights were on time We prebooked meals which were quite nice We booked during holiday season so tickets were on the more expensive side but all in all good value Would fly with them again

Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island

Gatwick to Monastir return We took off on time both ways the aircraft are dated but seat was comfortable Food going was fine but only a stale sandwich coming back Crew pleasant The toilets are a lot to be desired and we made sure that we used the airport facilities before boarding on the return flight

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

I usually travel to Tenerife South and North airports several times a month The most important thing for me is the fastest way thru security and food services On both airports usually time waited for security screening is less than min average time min staff polite and very helpful The food and services offered in Tenerife South is much better than the older airport in the north of the island I have used both airports VIP lounge They are nice have lots of food and drink and usually are ok Sometimes during peak season can be a bit crowded or even full

Travelled with my brother and mother The travel operator booked the flights I never heard or know this airline before The route flown was domestic from Tehran Mehrabad to Shiraz We were dropped at the wrong terminal Apparently Kish Air operates from Terminal We were dropped to Terminal Ground staff at airport were polite As we brought a wheelchair the ground staff required the wheelchair to be shrinkwrapped Airport wheelchair requested without much fuss Flight was a little delayed minutes Airport ground staff were fantastic during the boarding process My mother used a disabled friendly vehicle Aircraft was an old MD Chicken pickle sandwich and peanuts served during flight with orange juice box Cabin crew very friendly The toilet was foul The water did not work in the tap or closet Upon arrival in Shiraz once again excellent airport ground serviceKish Air flight crew and captain also friendly and welcoming

Not a shining example of modern airport technology but it works Arrival was quite easy since by the time our visas had been processed the queues had gone Departure very easy with short queues The only downside would be the fact that smoking seems to be allowed everywhere and ashtrays are not in use Hence the cafe is rather uncomfortable Everyone was very friendly and helpful

The cabin crew on my recent Malaysia Airlines flight were exceptional During boarding the lead crew in red colour is standing at the gate to warmly welcome all passengers with a great smile the crew demonstrated a level of hospitality that exceeded my expectations The lead crew manager in particular stood out helping the team with economy class drink service even after finishing their duties in business class This showed impressive leadership and teamwork During the meal service the crew team carefully put ice in the cup They remember my request As the economy class toilet is full of passengers the lead crew member guides me to use the business class toilet The announcement is very clear with a warm feeling of hospitality in dual languages I ordered a special nonvegetarian meal on my flight and I was thoroughly impressed The chicken dish with Malaysian sauce was delicious I would rate the meal quality as starsThe boarding process is smooth and well organized The webcheck in is easy to use My flight is from Bangkok to Singapore via Kuala Lumpur I can get two digital boarding passes from digital checkin without any system issues The autocheckin feature is available too This aircraft does not have IFE as it is a hours mins short haul flight However all passengers can connect to MH studio by their own devices There are many entertainment selections from movies TVs The only reason I dont rate five star is to compare with Singapore Airlines Emirates and those global premium carriers that provide IFE for all flights However it is value for money for the level of entertainment I received I would not hesitate to fly with Malaysia Airlines again and would highly recommend the airline to others

Dhaka to Coxs Baza Booked a discounted ticket more than a month ago Didnt expect too much Just on time departure arrival Thats what I got Boarding luggage handling was smooth Cabin crew wasnt exactly cordial but professional enough It was a min ride but the captain was able to make it bumpy despite clear weather Cheese sandwich cake was good enough for a shorts haul flight like this but as expected no IFE Aircraft was manufactured in so common for local Bangladeshi carriers But the seats were good pitch even for a Dutch national who flew alongside me was well over Hope for a similar experience with Regent next time

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion

TUNTIP Checkin at Tunis was efficient and staff generally friendly Boarding at the gate was chaotic While on the runway the plastic emergency exit covering came off The pilot came and put it back on Plane then proceeded with takeoff The food was standard and staff friendliness on board ok although only with limited English skills Onboard announcements were in Arabic only The interior was worn emergency cards in seat pockets were still from the former owner of the plane a defunct French airline

I was transiting with Air China in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal Most international flights operate from Concourse TE but some use TD In my cause both arrival and departure were from TE On transit passengers need to go through document and security and customs check The walking times are not really long and mostly travelators are available There are transfer service checkpoints one from each side of the concourse The crowd is not really well organized and staff is not really helpful Not everyone speaks English which is quite frustrating when you actually need to communicate with airport or security staff Arriving early in the morning get ready to spend h queuing for transit Other than that I have to note that Terminal is very modern by its looks and layout The ceiling is high which makes it seam like the airport is free and spacious Walking distances are not too long Most gates are accessible in less than minutes of calm stroll Between TE TD and TC there is an automated people mover train which is easily accessible after security I didnt use it but I located its station and observed it a little There are few restaurants which in my opinion are quite reasonable priced Early in the morning only few Chinese restaurants and Western cafes were opened The food is actually quite delicious I would note good availability of seating spaces Some are equipped with universal power outlets and USB chargers If you want to use WiFi better use WiFi kiosks as SMS sometimes doesnt go through Be aware that you wont be able to use most messengers and social networks Also it was nice to have drinking fountains within short reach from most seating areas I would suggest considering Beijing Capital Airport as transit hub for Asia Clean and modern airport with all the necessary facilities for longer transits

Arrived in Paro airport at pm There WERE flights that had arrived Immigration was quick and the staff were very polite We got our bags and we left the airport in less than minutes For our departure check in took minutes and immigration another The departure lounge is small but adequate Lots of craft shops and a few places to eat Very casual airport and the staff are very friendly The cafe food was however awful but the coffee was nice Wifi available but kept disconnecting All in all a charming little airport for this stunning country

This review is for Terminal Terminal is dramatically different RGN has undergone vast changes during the last years There remain remnants of the underdeveloped facility that once was but the outside world has arrived in Yangon and at least as far as the airport is concerned it is a good thing CustomsImmigration at both arrival and departure is reasonably fast On the absolute worst day you might wait minutes but an average wait will be minutes or less Lines at check in counters move quickly which is terrific Departure lounges are a lot nicer than they once were Now they sport clean comfortable spaces dependable WiFi and food that works in a pinch Restaurants in the airport are not great but if you want a decent cup of coffee some KFC a Burger King something or other youll be ok Souvenir and duty free shops still have a long way to do Alcohol and cigarettes are fairly priced There are perennially empty luxury clothing brands without customers There are a couple of small boutiques selling attractive textiles carvings local bath products delicious local coffees etc Services are generally more than adequate in the predeparture areas There is a bag wrapping counter for flimsy luggage convenience stores plenty of seating free WiFi etc Taxis downtown should be priced out before you leave Money Change desks offer the exact same rate as all the other places in the country so theres no reason to hold on to your foreign currency The airport is still a work in progress but leaving and arriving in this amazing city is a lot less unpleasant than a few years back

Guayaquil to Baltra I wish to say a few positive words to review my trip to Galapagos with this nice airline which proved to be punctual reliable and with great customer service I had to anticipate my return flight from Baltra to Guayaquil so I decided to call the customer service on their international line I was a bit scared as reding the previous reviews I was expecting the worse Actually the customer assistant on the phone not only spoke perfect English but also managed to help me with the change easily and at no additional cost In few minutes the new ticket was delivered to my email together with all the information regarding the entrance requirements to Galapagos The whole checkinboarding process was easy and quite fast both ways and departure and arrival time perfectly punctual The plane was probably a bit outofdate but the crew and the pilots did their best to make the flight as pleasant as possible Drinks and a snack were served during both flights and we got lots of announcements from the cockpit Smooth takeoff and landing completed the journeys so overall a nice experience and nothing to complain I have to say that I travelled much better than with other airline companies

UIOCCS There were no problems to speak of nor was the experience extraordinarily positive First off I should say that I had problems in booking via the Santa Barbara website and so had to visit their agency in Quito I had my bags fairly thoroughly checked by migration people in Quito but thats understandable given the flow of drugs in the region The flight itself was fine Boeing no obvious neglect crew were friendly enough food was decent We did leave about mins late At the Caracas end our bags were slow in arriving It seems that there are problems but you may get lucky and avoid them as I did

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Japan Airlines on a flight to Tokyo NRT and was incredibly impressed by the exceptional customer service I received from Ha a ground staff agent From the moment I approached the checkin counter She was incredibly friendly helpful and professional She went above and beyond to ensure that my checkin process was smooth and efficient Her genuine care and attention to detail made me feel truly valued as a customer She went out of her way to make my travel experience as pleasant as possible and I am incredibly grateful for her assistance I was so impressed with her service that I immediately sought out her manager to express my appreciation I am confident that she is an asset to Japan Airlines

Travelled last month from Subang to Penang Flight was great Flight attendants were friendly and welcoming No in flight entertainment but there were magazines Only serve Peanuts fresh baked bread a mineral water and a wet towel for each passenger Baggage allowance was also ok as the limit was Kg Price was also cheap as I only paid RM for a one way flight One my return flight to Subang there were only passengers and the flight still continued even thought not even of the plane was full I would recommend the Airline to people who want to travel in Malaysia

FCOTSRIAS Business Class Checkin in FCO terrible just counter minutes waiting time No lounge offered Inflight service with very friendly and attentive staff good food Transit in TSR as well despite of being a small and old airport was ok Here again very polite staff

Manchester to Tripoli Airbus A Plane was a little old and tired looking Only passengers on board and I was the only one in Business Class Seats were OK food was fine The flight took off on time and arrived in Tripoli on time Based on costs and timings this was very good value compared to British Airways

Small airport by international standards Immigration and customs smiling and welcoming Departure easy with only one aircraft departure tax has to be paid and quite rigorous security procedure but done with typical Cook Islands good nature Walk from terminal to aircraft across tarmac necessary Could be a wet one in a tropical downpour

I am so impressed with Air North The last time I flew with a different airline I remember waiting ages for drink service that only came around once and paying something ridiculous for a small snack But Air North blew that experience out of the water Complimentary food and drinks are one thing but this was only a hour flight and they kept us busy the whole time serving drinks a lovely sandwich a cookie and then more drinks I was positively full at the end of the flight And when I complimented the cookies oatmeal chocolate chip served warm the very lovely stewardess Keely got me and my sister my travelling companion a few for the road She gave us good tips for visiting the Yukon too The airline was clean flight was smooth and service was fantastic I wish Air North flew everywhere they would be my first choice every time
A reliable airline with excellent service from checkin to boarding to in flight service Gracious staff Prompt at times early Amazing and use airbridge in Bangkok

Why do we always want to fly the big airlines VLM has the efficiency of a budget airline the service of a high value airline and the punctuality of a German airline They have friendly staff and after landing you are out of the airport in minutes Moreover book well in advance and you have a very attractive fare

We booked our return flight as a direct flight which was canceled and then simply staying in Paris We started more than hours later missed our connecting train were poorly provided with drinks unfortunately not a great experience Our direct flight to Colombo from Frankfurt was great very nice staff super on time

KIVKBPODS Both flights were codeshared with Aerosvit but operated by Dniproavia planes KIVKBP Embraer that has seen better days KBPODS plane was an oldlooking Boeing Service onboard was good Offered drinks and a double sandwich despite both flights being under hr Flights departed on time They almost lost my luggage on the first flight as it was sent to connecting flights but were able to locate it relatively quickly and hand it back Overall a relatively good experience for the price paid

Excellent safe clean on time and we got a hot meal on board which I did not expect given the fact that during the ticket purchase I was prompted to buy a meal which I did not want to do They are a little bit expensive but the flight took a long time hrs Excellent service thank you

Hannover is a medium sized airport with all facilities you expect Great plus are the short ways good signage short waiting times at the checkin security and baggage delivery Always very clean Easy to reach by car bus or train They have a good selection of restaurants like high quality Mvenpick or even McDonalds supermarkets decent duty free and a great aviation exhibition Welt der Luftfahrt and observation deck When you fly Lufthansa or Star Alliance and have a status you get access to a stylish lounge with great apron views A nice airport I like to use a lot

A small but efficient airport with a good tax free selection As mentioned before the transfer time to Oslo is long about hours more to downtown Oslo compared to Oslos main airport Gardermoen as this is not really an airport meant to serve Oslo However it costs about the same to get to Torp as it does to get to Gardermoen due to the outrageously expensive but very efficient Airport Express Train going to the latter airport When choosing between coach and train to Torp note that the train takes slightly longer and is about NOK more expensive but more comfy and a beautiful journey at times
Excellent experience at this airport Not just departing but upon arrival as well Very smooth quick organised and excellent staff Look forward to returning soon

We were originally booked in Premium Economy with Air Canada Due to a substitution of aircraft we were switched onto Omni in economy class While the aircraft was fairly old and we were delayed hour in takeoff everything else was fine Seats were comfortable food was okay and cabin crew were very friendly and efficient Air Canada processed the promised refund due to us being downgraded We would be okay with flying Omni again but prefer flying on an aircraft with a premium economy cabin

Istanbul to Tripoli This airlines is decent and I was served particularly well The food and beverages were great and the in flight entertainment contained a lot of movies to watch Also the WIFI was pretty fast and effective
The airport is new modern and colorful Everywhere is clean There are nice looking green areas with flowers and trees outside The employees were polite and smiling

A small airport for the tiny capital of Montenegro so that means big queues for border control no online check in hardy any shops or food and beverages Staff were friendly and correct Best to prebook a taxi in order to get to town which will be around euro

Seat C A swift flight mainly with Sleep as it was an overnight flight Airplane was clean although the business class seating looked very old well worn arm buttons and seat capsule panelling The Bahrain Gulf Air lounge was a super treat with Dinner options such as Pizza and Lasagne all were very good I certainly look forward to booking my next Gulf Air flight

Was transiting between fight from Brisbane to flight to Townsville with wait time of three hours Boarding areas large enough for amount of passengers Lots of windows with views over runway Shops and eateries limited but probably appropriate for airport this size Check in area clear Security staff friendly and talkative Noted the airport has a new Ibis Airport Hotel nearby and looks rather flash Had a pleasant time while at this airport

Belfast to Bourgas We were checked in at Belfast international we walked through check out and still had approximately another minute wait on the steps downstairs before the shuttle busses came to get us not very safe or the best place to be waiting a long time with young children The flight over was fine but for some reason even though I booked certain seats over and back they did not show up when collecting our tickets they were very helpful and allocated us the same seats in Belfast but coming back from Bulgaria the seats we requested were given to someone else Staff on the flights to and from Bourgas were lovely But getting back into Belfast after getting through the security checks we went to get our bags and we were waiting at the baggage claim area almost an hour before bags started coming out everyone actually clapped when they started arriving very slowly one at at time for the first mins again not very convenient with tired young children starting to get impatient I honestly dont think well fly with BH Air again or recommend them

Excellent small airport which is newly built few flights in the afternoon when it is at its busiest It is located way out of town hence you need to have pre booked transport to reach the town as no public transport is available The building is air conditioned which is a relief from searing heat The washrooms needed a bit of TLC The shopping was expensive as is the case at any international airport Food options are plenty Aircraft turn around time is quick Overall a good airport WiFi is free for one hour

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

Milan to New York return via Dusseldorf I had a very positive experience with AirBerlin on all four of our flights The prices were phenomenal all four of us flew economy roundtrip for less although they did charge me quite a bit for seat reservations with small kids you cant really make a good case for oh honey sorry you get to sit to that stranger Everything ran on time The seats are as about tight as most US airlines though not as bad as Uniteds back rows But we fit fine video was working with lots of options for watching food was okishand the attendants were quite helpful and very nice Really I have no complaints And yes I did check in luggage on the way back because who doesnt overshop in Italy and I got them back in NYC We were all nervous about this due to all the bad review of lost luggage In fact it is why I am writing the review as I promised myself I would write a good review if we arrived home intact with a good experience I fly Business for work I was expecting worse but was very pleased as were my husband two kids

Milan to New York return via Dusseldorf I had a very positive experience with AirBerlin on all four of our flights The prices were phenomenal all four of us flew economy roundtrip for less although they did charge me quite a bit for seat reservations with small kids you cant really make a good case for oh honey sorry you get to sit to that stranger Everything ran on time The seats are as about tight as most US airlines though not as bad as Uniteds back rows But we fit fine video was working with lots of options for watching food was okishand the attendants were quite helpful and very nice Really I have no complaints And yes I did check in luggage on the way back because who doesnt overshop in Italy and I got them back in NYC We were all nervous about this due to all the bad review of lost luggage In fact it is why I am writing the review as I promised myself I would write a good review if we arrived home intact with a good experience I fly Business for work I was expecting worse but was very pleased as were my husband two kids

Tulsa International Airport is in my opinion one of the easiest airports to navigate Its not super large and everyone is very friendly We were able to ride a free shuttle to our car as it was about degrees when we arrived The man driving the shuttle was very nice and took us all the way to our car It was very convenient and nice

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options

The airport is outside the capital and it could be a minute drive depending on the traffic Aesthetically its not the nicest facility and in some places it seems like a warehouse The security is really good and the immigration formalities for Iranians are fine Im not entirely sure how immigration is for non Iranians but I heard that its alright but they have their own line which could take them longer to clear immigration if the line is long The customs formalities are alright I never had any problems as a regular traveler there The toilet facilities are not so clean but there is almost always an attendant there cleaning the place and offering to watch your bags in return for a small tip The staff in general are pleasant enough The duty free isnt the best in the world but the prices are reasonable Good opportunity to buy some Iranian products as gifts for friends and family The eating options are pretty good with two open air cafes after passport control with deserts and sandwiches and beverages at reasonable prices Theres a decent fastfood restaurant in the international departure area and the prices are alright there too If you have a long transit there is a mosque at the departure terminal where you can prey relax and even take a nap Theres no public transportation to and from the airport so the only way to get there is by car A taxi to Tehran for Iranians is about USD I heard the business class lounge is good as well as the VIP terminal WiFi is basically non existent for passengers Enjoy your time in Iran

Fly or times a year Mexico City to Ciudad Victoria Planes are small Fokker Turboprops Always very friendly staff and have been on time Seats are rather small an excellent lounge with drinks and snacks at a number of airports Service onboard with snacks and drinks are adequate

Bari Airport looks new but they have not yet found a way to avoid a minute wait for security checks Leaving tourists in a minute queue for security is not a good way to attract tourists If the queue is minutes on th April what will it be in July and August Puglia is a great region to visit and Bari is an excellent gateway Pity the local autorities cant run an airport

I Flew on flight TK on the th February from Istanbul to Bangkok which was an excellent business class flight experience The food on board was as usual very good indeed as was the superb service provided by cabin crew hostess Grulsah She was extremely friendly and very professional for which I would like to thank her for If I had one perhaps negative comment to make and that is regarding the dated seating layout on the airbus A Which with a layout of doesnt provide much in the way of privacy and should if possible be changed to a layout That aside the flight itself arrived into Bangkok exactly on time Highly recommended

Arrived here for the safari and climb up Mt Kilimanjaro Arrived around hrs you walk into a big room with two areas I have a visa and I do not have a visa So we got in the no visa line Well actually it wasnt so much a line as a big confluence of people and soon we found out why there are multiple windows you need to go to before passing through customs to collect your baggage I had read a blog about the visa scenario at JRO before I left so I had an idea of what to expect but upon returning home I reread the blog and realized that I didnt retain all of what was stated It was all there but like most things in life experience trumps book knowledge You need to get in the far right line first to pay for the visa for USA for non USA Bring large bills preferably new I had been told this prior to the trip so I came prepared with new bills circa or maybe it was Bottom line they werent from before which is the cut off year for American bills accepted in Tanzania After you pay you go to the nd line and get your photo taken and the visa is placed in your passport Get through with that and you realize you still cannot see your baggage you need to go to the rd line for fingerprinting By this time all of the I have a visa people were gone so there were more lines available for this last step All in all it took us minutes from the time we entered the room to the time we saw our baggage Yes its a long time but if you purchase your visa before travelling you only save maybe minutes and you need to consider the fact that you have to mail in your passport for an extended period to receive that visa Add to that you need to purchase the passport photos for the visa for us its worth it to spend the extra time in the airport and never allow your passport to be sent in the mail You save money on the photos because they take your picture at JRO The return leg went very smoothly you get in line they run all of your bags and you through security then you turn in your checked baggage and go through security again with your carry on took about an hour and we were at our gate no worries

My recent return flight from Melbourne to the Gold Coast with REX Airlines was excellent Everything from booking to disembarking on the return flight was easy The staff were friendly and professional Given that CV issues are currently dominating travel within Australia I felt REX Airlines handled everything beautifully

A moderate sized airport with fast security processing times decent dutyfree shopping and enough seats with a power socket Signaling isnt the clearest however as the airport was build in steps Half of the gates are bus boarding only It has a convenient metro connection to the city center Wifi was quite good and staff friendly and helpful

I recently flew UL with family from MELCMBMEL return Given the many negative reviews seen here I was expecting a very poor product But to be honest I was pleasantly surprised Of course there is certainly room for improvement the seats could be more comfortable upholstery needs to be changed arms loose or broken needs an overall clean At times the quality of annoucements were not the best Boarding in CMB was a bit disorganised considering the flights were very full on both sectors But the IFE system for me and everyone around me was working in both sectors many reviewers here are complaining about it not working A decent selection of movies TV and music Good head sets Food was average airline food cant complain Cabin service was very professional helpful efficient and attentive Bagage was delivered to belt on time Checkin at both ends was OK Will definitely consider again I got what I paid for For those complaining please pay more and choose another airline

Departure was fairly easy and quick and there was an English guide for completing the customs form You can only spend local money in the cafe or burger place but duty free only accepts dollars and euros Escalator up to departures and not big inside but okay and clean Arrival is very slow so be patient There is no queuing at passport control so I just took a seat on the side and waited until only a few people left and was much easier At customs you need to complete two forms and I couldnt see an English guide whereas there was one in departures so ask a local or fill it in best as you can and customs officers will help with rest There is a separate queue for tourists and they speak a little English make sure you keep the second copy as you will need it when you come to leave the country Taxi ride into centre around Som ie but youll need to haggle a lot Overall its a fairly small airport and arrival does take a long time but it seems they are trying to improve things all the time

This is a very small airport but it is clean convenient and easy to get around Passing through security was a breeze no big queues to wait at The waiting room was easy to find and it was nice clean and comfortable There isnt many places to eat or shop but I really dont care for that Airport staff was ok they arent the friendliest out there but they werent rude either It is a shame there is no public transport access to the airport except for a mini bus that links to the major hotels but not to the city

Upon leaving Europe back to Los Angeles my flights had me departing LJU to connect at CDG for my flight to LA For some reason my travel agent had booked the two flights separately under two different confirmation numbers while in Slovenia I had called the airline and even the hotels concierge did as well and we both found out only the gate agent can make sure and both flights are listed as one continuous trip mainly for the sake of routing checked luggage all the way through The gate agent with the assistance of a coworker easily got this done and I was only charged for an extra checked bag my initial flight was in economy while my connecting flight was in business Thankfully both flights were on the same airline in the end everything went smoothly Upon arrival at LJU I was amazed how much of a small town airport feel it had You could walk through the entire airport in minutes There were only about four checkinticket windows and no one was in line Proceeding to security there were about three rows to enter through and once again no one else was in line My time initially at checkin took about minutes to get my flights worked out and to pay the extra checked bag fee and then within ten minutes I was through security and enjoying a drink near my gate A very laid back and friendly experience Sort of a calm before the storm I would have at CDG in three more hours

Getting in yesterday was ok except for having to walk great distances when my partner and I have hip issues Being offered a ride on an electric cart that did not happen Then today we sat in the check in area for more the an hour waiting for someone to push our wheelchairs to our gate We were taken to the head of the line only to have to wait But everyone was very nice

This airport was previously known as London Manston which is a bit of a joke because of how far it is from London However with a name change new terminal and new budget airline EUJet has started to raise its profile I travelled through there on the way tofrom Amsterdam The airport is small which works to its advantage Check in was very fast and the staff very helpful The car park is right outside the terminal entrance and is very cheap day or week The small cafeteria is good and clean The aircraft are right out side the terminal so no long bus rides or endless walkways On the way back it took less than minutes to reach my car from the time the wheels touched the ground I had no luggage All in all a very good experience

I traveled to Bengkulu Indonesia to visit friends for the first time in November Flew on Lion Air Upon arriving at the airport we deplane using stairs and walked on the tarmac to the arrival building It was late afternoon with the sun just about to set The airport building is very quaint Nice outdoor gardens greet you and on the day I arrived a nice afternoon breeze Slowly make the way to the inside of the terminal where one luggage belt half inside the terminal and a portion outside the terminal awaits The luggage eventually arrives and it gives you time to see the pictures of some of the sights to see in Bengkulu Once luggage in hand you go outside where there are various options for transport to where ever you are going I was met by friends that took me to the hotel Two weeks later I left Bengkulu and experienced the departure area You go through the usual security immediately upon entering the terminal say your good byes outside the door then walk to the check in desk where you obtain your boarding pass and check your luggage English is not widely spoken at the airport if at all but I had no issues whatsoever You then go to the gate area nice seats air conditioned tvs bathrooms and probably restaurants though I left on the first flight out and I not see anything to buy food or drinks Eventually they called the flight once again no English and we boarded the same way nice walk outside to the waiting aircraft All in all a really nice experience in this airport

Excellent airport Arrived at am on the BA London flight First time visit to India so I stopped off at the biometric finger print machine queued for minutes and completed he task in mins Went to border control There is a separate queue for business class travellers and they checked my boarding pass I could have done the finger prints here The agent wanted to see my eVisa print out Kind of defeats the object of have an eVisa But processed and passport stamped and quickly through By the time I arrived at the baggage claim my luggage had already arrived I then exited to meet my pre booked driver Took about mins from getting off the plane to getting into the car Departure had to get a ticket check before entering the terminal I have checked in online but mobile boarding pass not available Had to show the eTicket on my phone to get into the terminal I also had a print out of the itinerary Check in business class for BA flight to London only agent so about mins spent Dedicated business security lane was reasonably efficient Went to the Encalm business lounge to find a queue but this was the Priority pass queue the agent called business and first class travellers to the front I was then redirected to another lounge Enclam Prive I dont know what the differences are but I needed an airline invite to get in Nice big lounge with a huge choice of food some cooked to order Efficient boarding in groups and policed very well Overall a great airport experience
Comfortable enough flight which was fairly on time We were surprised that there was no catering on this flight of about hours Only took hand baggage

Nice airport Fairly modern The washrooms were clean and well maintained Its a fairly small airport There seemed to be a lot of security around the day we departed Airside international there is not much choice of food however I noticed across the road seemed to be popular with locals There was a coffee shop ouch for an iced coffee also some food there very expensive Going through security etc you go upstairs via escalator The oddest sight all booths open for both security and immigration yet we were the only ones there First time thats ever happened and I suspect last There were a few places to eat or drink airside and they seemed ok although we were not hungry Definitely liked this airport A very positive experience

Before two years I used to fly with them and it was a pleasant one Now its far behind that quality I enjoy Now there is no comfortable space between the two seats Very difficult to sit if the front seater reclines his seat to mine Also there is no entertainment option QR code is not visible Every airlines targets only for maximum profit not the comfort of the pax All other things are okay

Flew Air Niugini because of the B very nice cabin in a xx configuration Took seat A bulkhead seat very comfortable with heaps of leg room Staff were amazing and very attentive food was OK entertainment was enough for this flight of approx hrs

PortoOslo th Aug on a B Ticket purchased on DYs homepage CheckIn online not possible on computer but need mobile app No extra costs having BPs printed out in the airport Large handluggage were accepted regulations appear strict but are not enforced in any aggressive way Airport crowded and incredibly hot in sunny afternoons Boarding in groups is a nuisance as the groups get amalgamated into a large cramped pool before final boarding Those passengers called last upon for boarding de facto became the first to board Onboard spacious well bolstered seats better than for most other airlines yes Direct flight almost took hours I got a prepaid hot meal served which was nice and tasty Full flight A significant boarding delay of hour created congestion at gate and caused late arrival of more than one hour No IFE but WiFi worked

Singapore airport is magnificent and extremely wellmaintained with its facilities gardens waterfalls etc but arriving in the country has been made very difficult for Nordics There is no one at the immigration department upon arrival you first have to fill out a variety of information in English on a small computer which can take up to an hour If the machine accepts everything be happy There was no one to assist you in the queue of dozens of people at the machines And if you are accepted you go to another automatic machine where you present your passport and other necessary documents Your bag has been spinning for a long time waiting for you to pick it up from the belt When leaving the country everything seemed to be OK but then the departure security check began which was anything but friendly The border control officers who were clearly enjoying it gave orders and ripped off the jackets of older people who did not obey at the same second A militarystyle manly arrogant woman took my passport and boarding pass away because they noticed my diabetes pills everything was drugs to them Then I was ordered aside and subjected to various tactile tests with a digital device They couldnt didnt care to read prescriptions Overall it had the feel of being in the military chain of command

Departure from Memphis The airport was ok I regard it as the best airport I experienced during my trip much better than Newark EWR and better than Chicago OHare ORD The stores and restaurants was plentiful but the airport is quite small The staff was friendly and efficient It was also quite clean much better than the other airports I passed through this trip in the USA It was easy to navigate through too Many small airports are better than their reputation
Worst company Never gonna take this company again I should have look at the reviews before booking Hate their service The price can be good but youll prefer any other companies its a promise
