Szczecins Solidarity Airport is one of the smaller regional airports in Poland The cartaxi ride from Szczecin takes a bit longer than expected but once there you will find a pleasant airport located in a wood away from the city It has only a small terminal but it is very modern fresh and complete with all facilities bookstalls shops cafs etc that open also for early morning departures Im told there is a small hotel nearby The staff is helpful Only a handful of flights depart each day so the terminal does not get crowded and the atmosphere is casual and relaxed And the security check was very thorough which I appreciated

Qazaq Air from Almaty to Shymkent returning a few days later Very good value considering tickets were booked less than hours before departure Nice new aircraft and smartly attired crew who were all trilingual Baggage is included in the ticket price and hand luggage was not strictly monitored but since both flights were not full there was plenty of space in the overhead lockers Check in at both ends was perfunctory and more or less wordless but the flights were punctual the return flight leaving minutes before the scheduled time of which was greatly appreciated by all on board There was even a snack service with a good choice of drinks all included in the ticket price Another retro touch was the basket of sweets offered round before take off I would definitely fly this airline again and hope they expand their destinations The only thing I would say against them is that at present their small fleet seems to mean that certain routes are served with en route stops that added to the slower speed of the Q aircraft could make some trips around Kazakhstan quite arduous Overall though excellent and amazing value

When cabin crew ask for your feedback and thoughts on how they could improve you know they are genuinely committed to improving service To be honest I could not fault them on our hour mins flight The plane was fairly new very clean and the welcome aboard and service throughout exceptional I had to compliment the crew on the food The steak was perfect and tasted as if it had been cooked onboard It bettered my steak experience from steak cooked on board in first class I really look forward to flying Aircalin again and experiencing that level of customer service and care Highly recommended

I had a better experience than most of the other people who posted reviews here The airplane departed on time in Tblisi and arrived even a bit earlier Seats are comfortable Checked luggage is free which is very rare these days Be prepared for zero interaction with the staff members in the plane though Only at the entrance the staff greets you They seemed quite friendly though Theres no option to buy food and no information apart from an announcement that the landing has started The life vests looked quite old frayed and stained at least the one that the safety instructor showed maybe the ones stored under your seat are newer If you dont need luxury and you bring your own food this airline is really fine I dont know how they act in case of delays or cancellations though

Flew GA Amsterdam to Jakarta from Madrid Spain GarudaIndonesia had arranged with the Schiphol VIP Center to meet me at the plane door upon arrival from Madrid and I was taken to the VIP centre for check in security and immigration formalities This is a great service as it bypasses all queues Within the VIP Lounge at Schiphol Airport there are full service including a full Al La Cart dining When I it came time to board the aircraft I was assisted by a member of the VIP team that took me by car to the aircraft stairs At the aircraft door I was meet by the cabin crew Fauziah Pradita Maurenia Ade Indrawati and Chef Aris Gumilar who give me a very warm welcome and guided me to my seat The First Class Team gave outstanding service from boarding in flight dining and general overall service There was a very good selection of food for both evening meal and for breakfast The meals can be served on demand however as I wanted to have some sleep I requested my meal two hours after takeoff The quality portion and presentation of the food was outstanding There was quite some turbulence throughout the flight however I still had an excellent sleep We were slightly delayed arriving in Jakarta but this was caused by the delay in departing Schiphol as it is over minutes taxi to the remote runway When I arrived in Jakarta I was meet at the aircraft door by Yudi from the First Class Team who help and assisted me through immigration luggage collection and through customs and out to a car provided by GarudaIndonesia to take me to my home I used the onboard Wi Fi and connectifity and speed was excellent This was another excellent flight and I thank the Cabin crew for their outstanding service

On the understanding that Srinagar being the capital of Indian administered Kashmir is at the centre of one of longest running conflicts in the world then one should expect a particularly unique experience regarding airport security Srinagar airport in this respect does not disappoint On arrival on Jet Airways from Delhi one is immediately struck by the fact that this is a military airfield masquerading as a civilian airport MiG fighters and helicopter gunships abound at the far end of the airfield and all buildings are camoflauge painted The odd civilian Boening looks incongruous For arriving foreigners you are accosted by a security official fairly politely it must be said to fill in a long registration document He then accompanies you out of the arrival and baggage collection hall on a dirt track to the carpark to ensure you are being met by whoever you had claimed you were on the form Only then can you be on your way If you are not being met I am not sure what your fate would be Departure though is an object lesson in airport security The first hurdle is a kilometer or so before the airport terminal where you are stopped at a roadblock and put your luggage through an xray machine Entering the airport and only passengers are allowed not guests or friends you again put bags through another xray sceeening Then you are allowed to go to check in after which you must as a foreigner fill out another lengthy departure registration form for the police No hand luggage whatsoever is allowed on Delhi bound flights so all you can carry is what you can fit in your pockets therefore travel with a multipocket vest or similar to maximise carry on potential Hand carried clear plastic water bottles do suprisingly seem OK though to carry on The waiting area after check in is basic but OK as long as you dont mind being stared at suspiciously by numerous armed army and poice men Then there is another long queue for a more detailed security check which involves turning out all pockets and being individually scanned Finally you are through to the actual departure area but this is not the end After being released to go out on foot to your waiting Boeing you again go through another security check all pockets and a patdown before eventually you board the plane Great views of the Himalayas to the north on the flight out but since cameras are not allowed on board the memories stay in your mind and not on film

After reading lots of reviews I was really sceptical about flying with WOW air I still went ahead and booked my ticket to detroit as it was the cheapest option for a one way and I had to book last minute which is always more expensive I decided to pay for selected seats up the front with extra leg room on both flights and got really lucky with having no one in my row for the first flight The second flight I chose a seat with no middle seat and was really happy with this decision As its a cheap airline a lot of people do not pay for the seat upgrade its really not expensive to purchase the extra leg room and well worth it for the comfort Plus you will likely not have many people around The food and drink on board is very expensive but as I knew this beforehand I purchased food and water at the airport to take on the flight with me I think I was lucky with the reliability of both my flights taking off on time as this was the one thing I was worried about The seats are very dirty front seat pocket but all airlines are usually quite unhygienic so this was to be expected The service on board I thought was great very friendly staff and attentive Overall I would say you get what you pay for and you are taking a risk booking with WOW air but lucky for me I had a good experience with them and would book again
A quick hop from Bangkok to Chiang Rai here No frills did the job perfectly left slightly early and arrived well on time Seats comfortable for an hours flight I still love the liveries of the airline

ArkhangelskARH to TromsoeTOS with a stop in MurmanskMMK Fast and easy checkin and boarding Decently comfortable and rapid security check Aircraft Antonov has seen better days but was OK for a short flight Cabin crew polite and professional Got served drinks on the first leg to Murmansk then snacks selection of meats with bread and piclkes on the way from Murmansk to Tromsoe Departure and arrival according to the timetable Luggage arrived OK Overall experience fine apart from the high price

Minsk Airport was recently renovated and even though the layout may be outdated it looks brand new The airport is easy to get around and there are plenty of signs and directions for the passengers I did not experience any queues at all neither at checkin nor with the security and passport control it was all very quick and professional The terminal is extremely clean just like the city is which is almost surreal at times given that it is the place where thousands of people pass through every single day Food and shopping options seem standard for the airport of this size there is a dutyfree shop a souvenir shop fast food restaurant and a few cafeterias The only problem is that I havent seen any money exchange offices Airport staff are very professional and efficient When it comes to wifi there is a minute free connection however one can buy a very cheap wifi service for several days which also works in the city The main downside of the airport is the fact that it is so far away from the city and that there are no low cost options

Brussels to Casablanca on Jetairfly and everything was great The price wasnt too expensive there were no delays and the staff were polite and professional Only negative point is the leg space but thats okay for less than hours in my opinion I will fly with them again

Orlando to Jackson I am a frequent traveler and have flown my entire life My mother is a Delta flight attendant of years and when I was young she would take me on her flights I had flown over times before the age of Given this background I am very particular when it comes to my air travel Going into flying with Via I had my reservations as I normally stick to the main carriers but their service and in flight experience greatly exceeded both me and my fiancs expectations Would gladly fly with Via Air again and look forward to the next chance I get to fly with them

I had a pleasant experience on my Teheran Mehrabad to Shiraz flight It was a little bumpy due to weather but a delicious packed snack and drink were served for the short flight All the crew were very friendly and are a credit to their airline The A EPIEG was clean with a decent seat pitch for my foot frame and I was given a row of seats to myself All in all a very nice company who charged a very reasonable for my one way ticket I wish Iran Air the very best with each new addition to their expanding fleet and this wont be the last time I fly Iran Air

Vistara is overall good The seats were comfortable the food was kind of okayish staff service on point inflight entertainment was okay This my first time flying with Vistara and i am sure that i will be flying again with this airline The ground service could have been more better than this the bus took a little bit of time

John Wayne Airport is all about efficiency and comfort This airport has one of the most direct and easy access to the freeway of any airport that I have been to I took Southwest Airlines from John Wayne to Las Vegas Checkingin my bags at the airline counter and going through security took me no more than minutes There are plenty of open seats at this terminal and a variety of restaurants to choose from Southwest terminal has large windows from which passengers can enjoy views of aircraft taking off and landing John Wayne also provides free wifi

It was the cheapest way to go back after yet another season in Asia and honestly I didnt expect too much But the plane was quite new and the cabin was in a good condition Departed on time unlike the connecting domestic flight by another airline before There was an inflight entertainment system available and it seems to be modern but after a night spent in two different airports I hardly used it for anything other than the D map Although the food was served not as elegantly as some airlines do it was quite delicious and I could choose what I preferred on both meals despite sitting not in the middle of the cabin Note that there are only soft drinks available but for me it doesnt really matter The seats are not exactly Emirateslike but still quite comfortable for an hours flight The headphones were usual cheap earbuds unfortunately but they also included an adapter which I took away and which will let me plug in my own headphones on some later flight great and I just dont understand why airlines besides those smart few who provide multiuse washablecup large headphones couldnt distribute just that on request rather than generating tons of cheap headphones waste The flight was smooth and arrived minutes early Definitely would fly Tianjin Airlines again if the price is right and the route will fit my plans and will stop at Chongqing or Tianjin where I havent been yet as well should I have time for that

Was looking forward to flying with Solomon Airlines who were operating this flight on behalf of Air Vanuatu Check in was quick efficient and polite Boarding passes issued and invitation to the Air New Zealand Lounge where we sipped champagne and ate nibbles while we waited for our flight Boarding was quick and we sat in our allocated seats A C in Business Class Immediately offered champagneJuice or water before takeoff Naturally we had Champagne on this midday flight Cabin was clean airy and bright and the cabin crew were an absolute delight Friendly smiles everywhere and typical south pacific hospitality Lunch served was fresh very inviting and very tasty naturally followed by more champagne Flight time hours went by very quickly Even though the aircraft did not have WiFi no IFE and no charging ports that really didnt bother us as we were forewarned by researching in advance and we came prepared Its when youre not prepared travelling with kids and their electronic bits and pieces that they are forever glued to is where this could be an issue Be prepared Highly recommend Solomon Airlines and would be very happy to fly with them again

After a long transatlantic flight the last leg of my flight was with TAM from Sao Paulo to Porto Alegre When I landed in Sao Paulo I still had a couple of hours before my next flight I went to TAM desk for the checkin and the person there offered me to take an earlier flight which was in half an hour I was extremely happy about this Its the first time that I was so satisfied with the airline staff The flight was ok and with some snacks and a drink nothing too special but as youd expect in a one something hour flight

I have flown times on La Companie so far and could not be happier It makes me laugh to see complaints about ground accommodations and old planes etc this is an airline that flies to a manageable airport Orly with lower taxes than for example CDG it is a boutique operation with limited flights and proposes business class flights RT for as low as vs on poorer major airlines It is great value for the price and grumpy people can still spend their on a coach ticket booked on United coping with the CDG mess and see if they are offered hot towels full meal champagne and most importantly business class seats with better air quality
The airport is new modern and colorful Everywhere is clean There are nice looking green areas with flowers and trees outside The employees were polite and smiling

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

Flew GA Jakarta to Amsterdam I was picked up at home by a car provided by GarudaIndonesia and was them met at the terminal kerb side by GarudaIndonesia First Class Team Nidya Ahda who helped me with check in security and through immigration formalities Although the airport was very busy this process was very quick In the Jakarta airport FirstClass lounge there is full menu and drinks service available however I chose a sandwich When it came time for boarding Naiya assisted me to the aircraft door where I was meet by the FirstClass cabin crew Romad Wanda Cartika and Chef Angga who provided me with a very warm welcome I was quite tired therefore after a short snack after takeoff I bedded down and had a very good sleep for hours There was a good selection of food available for breakfast The breakfast meal can be ordered on demand therefore I chose for breakfast to be served hours prior to landing The quality of food portion size and presentation were outstanding and refills of tea and coffee are none stop When we arrived in Amsterdam Schiphol airport we were met at the plane door by the Schiphol VIP Team who took me to the VIP centre where we go through immigration and checkin for my onward flight This is also a great service and it avoids all the queues I used the onboard Wi Fi and the connectivity was very excellent I would like to thank the GarudaIndonesia First Class Team on the ground and to the Cabin crew for the outstanding service they provided

The service was simply outstanding on this my first flight with Hainan Airlines Very comfortable business class seat on B provided with plush Sofitel duvet and bedding beyond anything I have received on other airlines Food was excellent many courses and beautifully served Cabin staff service was exceptional friendly and very attentive more than Singapore Airlines and seemed very genuine Onboard entertainment was okay but lacking compared to many airlines Look forward to further flights with this airline

We arrived at Dinard airport at around in April The airport is tiny so dont expect much The queue for the passport control was queuing out of the door and took around mins to pass The airport has one small baggage belt that gets very cramped When you get into arrivals there are car hire desks Overall the arrival experience was ok considering what a small airport Dinard is On our departure there was only bag drop desk for an entire flight Next step is security where you have to show your passportboarding pass times to different people There is only security lane which took mins clear and when you get into the departure lounge it is no better there either there are no shops whatsoever no not even a magazine shop just a few vending machines Overall this airport was ok

Book flight for Thanksgiving Left Nov one way to Fresno Flight was nice and comfortable no complications Book flight back from Reno Nevada December at am direct flight to Portland only to have canceled and reschedule for over booking Unable rescheduled on Sunday to fly so forced rebook by airline for Monday No base seat available so force to buy a higher price ticket or be reschedule for Tuesday Refunded dollar from Sunday then force to pay dollar Monday or be scheduled There more but I book flight through Alaska and flight was Via Skywest So their more even late leave airport on Monday and ground stewardess take minute to play with another passenger tablet before being able board plain Flight suppose be am left Reno after am

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

Short hour hop from Vancouver to Castlegar and all good The plane looks tiny on the ground but the ride was smooth and on time Not much time for more than a swift Sprite and pretzels before we made the descent This landing is one which all Air Canada pilots practice over and over on the simulator as it is apparently one of the most challenging in Canada Not bad on a sunny day such as we travelled but I am sure on a wet evening it would be quite a tricky path through the mountains Also advised that the route can get cancelled for days at a time due to fog No such problems for us as flights out and back were fine Great to arrive at an airport and your bag is there in literally minutes Give this route a go but make sure to check the Castlegar weather first

The airport is much improved since I was last here in Arrivals not much to say there was just my flight in so the baggage queue was pretty tame Departure check in was a breeze even though there were three flights due to depart that morning There is free wifi and plenty of seating The new terminal building is spacious and modern with a nice outside seating area overlooking the runway and apron Security was also a breeze with only a very small queue and security staff seemed pleasant enough No air bridge though so if its raining you have a couple of minutes walk before you get to your aircraft Overall a nice little airport

Sal is a great small airport which is easy to use lots of signs and decent food options Good taxi services and shuttle buses to hotels Clean and airy and bright Would recommend Aeroplanes park very close and many airlines fly to Sal which is useful Friendly staff
UIA is always a great experience in businessclass Great service onboard Very lovely crew The lounges in KBP and MUC are also very relaxing Looking forward to flying UIA again

This is a very pleasant airport especially compared to Schiphol Its efficient staff are friendly and the decor resembles a hotel lounge rather than the average airport look At peak times when a lot of leisure flights depart it can however get quite crowded As this airport is labelled as RotterdamThe Hague Airport there has to be a public transport link to The Hague This is inadequate consisting of a small shuttle bus connecting the terminal with the nearby metro station where you need to change Its all a bit of a hassle as the minibus is often too small for the number of passengers and baggage and runs infrequently outside rush hours The schedule should rather be adjusted to the arrival and departure times of flights Better still would be a direct public transport link to The Hague

I am incredibly grateful for the staff at Chiang Mai airport I left my phone in my grab unable to get in touch with grab due to my phone being in my grab car and details being on the app on my phone so I immediately went to the staff in line She took me to the tourist police by exit number in the international departure hall They took details such as where I got the grab from my phone number the car colour i couldnt remember the license plate number In less than minutes they were able to get in touch with the car driver and I got my phone in the next minutes after that Thank you so much to the tourist police staff on shift at am on Jan I cant remember the other staffs name that brought me to the tourist police but i took a photo with her I wish them all the best and am so grateful for their willingness to help

The crew were extremely nice the flight was about hours and hours for the flight back to Hong Kong The flight was really smooth Props to the pilots The food was light and average The drinks were cool the in flight entertainment was out of service but pretty sure the airline is on a budget Warning that the ticket only includes kg of luggage to take on the plane and have to pay individually for luggage in cargo hold kg round trip more than HKD Seat was alright had decent recline trying to avoid flying with Hong Kong Airlines until maybe a few years later when they earn some money back Overall above average flight

Short flight to Shiraz from Tehran Mahan Air already has a reputation of being an airline of choice for travelling within Iran for both safety and service and I could see why While the type of plane is old an A it was well maintained and clean The seating was very impressive definitely the widest and the most legroom I have had in a long time in both long and shorthaul flights For a hour flight I was surprised to be served a substantial cold meal Nonalcoholic beverages are served on the flight The service was courteous and efficient but not warm We landed minutes early The airfare was dirt cheap one way at last minute You cant book directly on their website with an international card but can certainly book through thirdparty sites but checkin is available online

Flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino return with both flights spot on time noting that both legs were fully booked without any empty seats onboard No checked in baggage so headed straight to the gate The Ryanair mobile App is helpful apart from the nagging up selling but its understandable Its great boarding passes can be saved viewed in Google Wallet Boarding was managed well in PRG and CIA even with the full of passengers with Prague being strict on carry on luggage sizes as some fellow travellers were being a bit cheeky The cabin crew on my return flight were especially superb and professional with a smile Both legs were on a Boeing s I suspect there are no Max stationed in Prague One had an updated interior with slim seats and notably much more comfortable esp Legroom than the other although both were in top condition including cleanliness This product is ideal hassle free for quick flights around Europe

We took a short flight from Vientiane to Luang Prabang and service at every touchpoint from checkin to arrival was delivered with smiles professionalism and efficiency A clean aircraft with ample leg room was another example of their star service If my experience was the standard that Lao Airlines delivers then this airline will surely go places Highly recommended

Initially booked in Economy Class but when I was about to board agent took my boarding pass and voila got upgraded to Business One thing that stands out with Philippine Airlines is the hospitality and warmth of their crew both on ground and on board Food may not be at par with other big Asian carriers but for what they lack makes it up with their service One thing to consider as well is the ticket price being the most affordable Ill keep using PR as it is the most convenient affordable and with genuine service PRs exclusive Mabuhay Lounge at MNL T is one the best thing that happened with PR so far Keep it up

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

This is a very pleasant airport especially compared to Schiphol Its efficient staff are friendly and the decor resembles a hotel lounge rather than the average airport look At peak times when a lot of leisure flights depart it can however get quite crowded As this airport is labelled as RotterdamThe Hague Airport there has to be a public transport link to The Hague This is inadequate consisting of a small shuttle bus connecting the terminal with the nearby metro station where you need to change Its all a bit of a hassle as the minibus is often too small for the number of passengers and baggage and runs infrequently outside rush hours The schedule should rather be adjusted to the arrival and departure times of flights Better still would be a direct public transport link to The Hague

One of Brazils better airports although its design is stark and gloomy though airy Used aforementioned Conexio Aeroporto bus service to get there punctual fast and good quality Food wise all the usual airport restaurants are here but on the third floor to the left is a real find if you want real food and youre on a budget the Restaurante Social looks like a university canteen but serves palatable food at nonairport prices

vIve flown with Spirit several times and also contacted their customer service center in the past to cancel a flight Spirit can vary wildly in terms of cancellations delays timeliness and staff attitudes If using a ratio two experiences to every one have been overwhelming positive But the remaining one experience has royally sucked Still I take my chances with Spirit because theyve come to treat me more respectfully as a customer than most other US carriers pound for pound It helps that I understand the concept of ultrabudget airlines having flown them around the world and that I treat airline staff with courtesy and politeness This most recent trip from Orlando to Louisville was mostly positive friendly airline staff on ground and friendly though not particularly attentive in air they only came down the aisle once to collect trash Checkin online was easy though it helped that I wasnt checking a bag The flight took off and arrived early The immediate seat was clean enough but the seat back pocket and tray table were a bit nasty They tout their WiFi as being the fastest of any US airline though I havent tried it But I did manage to use their unpaid WiFi connection to track the flight route to Louisville on my phone so that was cool In all Spirit as great as long as you keep a good attitude and dont have any real expectations Thats the point of budget airlines right And just hope you dont get delayed by eight hours as I did once with Spirit years ago

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

RGNMDL on ATR We were a bit sceptical when our travel agency booked on Air Yangon because we couldnt find much about this airline in Skytrax The plane left twenty minutes earlier than in our tickets stated so do reconfirm the day before No hassle with luggage and weight security checks as in the whole country very relaxed but efficient Comfortable seating on this short trip little snack for those who are extremely hungry Friendly staff clean plane and very pleasant flight We felt safe and would fly with them again

International arrivals at St Petersburg airport are at the newer terminal which is spacious but simply decorated probably below the standard of a modern airport but international flights are not too frequent and it is never congested On your first arrival you may feel uneasy but it is smooth if you know your way To book a taxi it is good to book inside with taxi stands which charges a reasonable standard fare of under ruples to town and if you do not have the currency you may even charge your fare on a credit card The train is not recommended as it terminates far from town To go to the airport book a taxi but specify the use of a metered city taxi or you pay double if not specified hotels will book you a nonmetered taxi and if so agree on a fare first The airport is inadequate in facilities such as shopping and food outlets but is not bad

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

This is a pretty nice small airport where you can find anything you would expect from it There are flaws like anywhere else They definitely need more staff which is obvious The offering of time killers are updated with new shopping places but still have to work on it My main issue was the parking which was pretty expensive so I had to search around for other solutions since the parking at the airport ended up more expensive than my Wizz Air ticket I use Google and found a private parking spaces but you can also look for others I suggest this one definitely Overall it is a decent airport that keeps on upgrading every year I visit it

This was the first time I flown with Vanilla Air parent airline is ANA They have a different terminal for low cost airlines Terminal at Narita Airport for LCCs and also at Okinawa Check in was smooth for both flights I had no expectations whatsoever The inflight service was basic and for and hour flight is just fine Seats were comfortable and the cabin crew was nice This is a low cost carrier and I will recommend it and I will be flying again Within Japan is it rather difficult to get a bad service

We had a great flight with French Bee from Paris back to NYC We booked late for our first ever Europe trip so we didnt want to buy expensive tickets We took a risk going with French Bee since its cheap about one way We were nervous seeing all the bad reviews especially with cancellations Turned out to be an awesome experience on time good foods no turbulence

Very nice very small domestic regional airport I arrived from IAH Houston on a tiny little Saab and I collected my luggage and was outside in about minutes I also departed there for IAH with eventual connection to LHR and was surprised by the very welcoming attitude of the Continental staff The security staff seemed less happy to be working but I was through in under minutes Its a nice little airport with a nice little cafe and a few static displays to look at Its also used by USAF so its common whilst waiting for your flight to see an FA land or depart

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion

Recently flew throughout Myanmar on the following routes YangonMandalayHehoMandalayNyaung U BaganHehoThandweYangon on their Fokker and ATR aircraft Checkin interesting as there are no computers and everything is weighed manually Ground crew cordial but not overly friendly Flight crews were friendly and always helpful Catering is good for the short flights with croissants and drinks being offered on even the shortest of flights unthinkable in Europe Aircrafts were always spotless and comfortable

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

The wheelchair attendant verified everything for me Verified with me verified with the LYFT driver by asking his name verify the LYFT ride by licenses plate verified I felt ok and I knew where I was going For me its humiliating to be pushed in a wheelchair I never felt humiliation this time I truly felt cared for This trip wasnt the greatest vacay Ive had but when I got home I felt great I want to thank this positive smart caring young man Some ppl have a gift a few share it in this way If your lucky enough to meet this young man at DFW Airport youll know its him Im talking about here

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Smooth arrival domestic in the new airport It is the only airport that I have arrived at that there is actually free onwards buses to most of the tourist resorts north of the airport about every five minutes I did not know about this free service but if passengers have lots of luggage they need to be mindful that it could be a long haul from the bus stop in their resort to their actual hotel I took a taxi from one of the three or four tax agencies outside arrivals they were actually half the price of taxihailing apps There were some nice airy restaurants in the arrival area and presumably these are available to departing passengers Five stars from me

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

On our departure from Simferopol to Moscow we were very pleased with friendly and efficient service at the checkin and the information desks But upstairs in the waiting area we were struck by absolutely different attitude The attempt to have some drinks before boarding finished with success only at the third cafe Its name somehow Happy potatoes Sorry not very sure But I am absolutely sure about the names of the cafes where we were met with rudeness and unhelpful attitude The names of those cafes are Skybar and We were flying on the st of July Such a shame to be let down by such a beautiful airport

I fly into Rimini Airport at least times a year to visit family It is a small airport and the restaurant and shops are expensive I love this airport You cant get lost and the best bit is you can go outside on a very large balcony and watch the planes land take off etc Also great if you smoke You are allowed to smoke only outside I would recommend this airport it is still small and friendly

Anchorage airport north terminal is clean and spacious with very fast and efficient checkin and security There are lots of interesting things to look at in the airport Plenty of eating options and shopping Clean bathrooms and good WiFi No complaints at all

HELLPA return with A Booked flights months earlier and reservation for exit seats for extra charge from their call center was kept at check in Generous legroom Friendly attentive crew flight deck announcements and clean aircraft made hrs flight more enjoyable for a leisure flight Also our pre booked Holiday Meal on outbound flight was surprisingly tasty and hot and portions were more filling than we have had for this route with other carriers Only minus was inbound flight meal which was bit tasteless perhaps due to LPA catering Drinks for purchase but all in all flight with them DK offered more holiday feeling than our national carriers charter flight offers Baggage came fast at LPA but in HEL it took more than min due to ground handling problems

I have been to many many airports all over the world and Little Rock is one of my favorites It is small but modern and clean There are never long lines and the personnel are always helpful and friendly After being away from home for months I always look forward to the simplicity and comfort of LR airport I like that baggage claim is after you meet up with the people waiting to get you as well

Over minutes to get through passport control Travelers and staff looking cold and tired as midnight passes flights luggage all coming onto carousel others silent and still It was an opportunity to shine and it wasnt taken even a hot drink would have made it more bearable No explanation for delays given by any staff

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

Having used Tijuana many times in the past I was surprised while using it recently after a year break The renovations are still under way but it is a clean modern and efficient airport that works well The queues are generally quick and the staff know what theyre doing With some great connections to mainland Mexico and a couple of new discount airlines using the airport it is a great alternative to SAN Only annoying bit is the lack of any decent food and beverage once youre through security Over priced and average The upside is you can check in for most flights in Mexico up to minutes before take off so basically you can just walk through security and to the gate

Be Aware Arrival at the airport was okay the immigration line was long but it moved pretty quickly The airport was clean and looks pretty new Our main problem with this airport is the departure security check point where you have to apparently place all liquids below the authorised limit in ziplock bags Nowhere in the airport is there a sign saying that all liquids must be in clear plastic bags The check in agent said nothing nothing from the airline and did I say no signs We got to security and were told to throw away our items or pay US per ziplock bag If that didnt feel like an organised racket then I dont know what else qualifies This type of action is dishonest in every respect but at that point we had no choice Weve travelled through London Luton and they have the same plastic bag policy but not only are signs of it everywhere they provide the bags This felt like a shady scheme and we quite honestly will try to avoid this airport in future PS Duty free alcohol was cheaper in out home country as well

I recently flew with China Southern Airlines from Gatwick Airport to Changchun Airport via Zhengzhou to visit my family in China As I bordered the Boeing I was greeted with kind flight attendants who directed me to my seat On my seat was a pillow a thin blanket and headphones for the inflight entertainment We departed on time around in the evening UK time There was meals served and many drinks services with a variety of drinks ranging from fruit juices alcohols beer fizzy drinks and waters The meals were served on trays made up of a warm main dish with a side dish such as vegies and a desert Overall the food was tasty and plentiful There was a wide variety of movies which included Chinese and Western movies in many languages there was also fun mini games and an inflight map showing the progress of our flight I would say my flight to Zhengzhou took around and a half hours The seats were reclinable and padded well In my opinion it was quite comfy and I fell asleep quickly after watching a movie The cushion was soft and surprisingly the blanket offered a good amount of warmth The bathrooms and seats were all cleaned and maintained well and overall the flight was relaxed and peaceful My only complaint is that the cabin was a bit warn out and old with some pieces of fabric missing from the front bit of my seat This did not serve as an issue to me it was only aesthetically unpleasing Another suggestion from me is to offer an amenity kit as the flight was long haul Overall I had an amazing experience with friendly staff delicious meals and extreme comfort and good entertainment that kept me busy

PER to MRU Efficient check in at Perth Airport Air Mauritius provides access to the Aspire Lounge at Perth which is actually a very good albeit open access lounge Aircraft was delayed due to delayed connecting passengers Boarding was around minutes late Aircraft quite modern clean and well presented Good amenity kits Welcome drinks served Business class seat is a standard lie flat but works well On the shorter routes like this they dont provide a mattress topper Lunch and drinks served after take off Food was good smoked salmon starter and lamb main Reasonably selection of IFE Staff responded quickly to any calls I managed a few hours sleep Afternoon tea served prior to arrival For an hours and minute flight the offering was a little limited and not presented with much flair Arrival was delayed and though off aircraft quickly immigration was slow Luggage waiting for us when we had cleared immigration My feeling is this represents a solid mid range business product

Eilat to Tel Aviv The plane arrived minutes late but that was ok The boarding was quick and nice The cabin crew was good nice and helpful minutes on the flight and we got some snacks I love Israirs snacks Of course you could get some water with it The landing was pretty shaky

We took a TAME flight to Baltra Galpagos Checkin was very easy with very short queues and very clear instructions given how to get to your gate For the Galpagos Islands you are required to go through a host of quarantine checks and you are required to pay US per person to receive a certificate Without such a certicate you will be unable to board nor will you be allowed past the passport control at Baltra The airport terminal is very organised and gates are well spaced Great airport Also when arriving in Baltra you are required to pay an additional entry fee of US

Singapore to Yangon I didnt know what to expect when I booked this flight but I dont regret The airplane was clean staff was friendly and food was good Also a lot of space for the legs good entertainment and opportunity to charge phonetablet In the EmiratesGaruda league in my opinion

Flew with AIRDO a low cost airlines owned by ANA from Tokyo Haneda to Hakodate Flight was on time and full of passengers who were en route to observe the cherry blossoms in Hakodate Cabin crew was really professional friendly and attentive Legroom was good seat was comfy cabin was clean Soft drinks water apple juice tea orange juice coffee was served to all passengers even it was a low cost airlines Both of take off and landing were smooth

Flew Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air As I knew nothing about this airline I was a bit apprehensive but there was no need to be Checkin was fast and friendly Boarding was by bus and once on board the courteous cabin crew made us feel very welcome The plane was definitely old but very clean and our exit row seats had plenty of legroom Other seats looked a bit cramped but the flight was short Surprisingly a quick drink was served during the minute flight which operated minutes early Overall a pleasant experience The only negative was that the Fasten Seat Belt signs in the cabin were not working

On the th of March I was flying back to Bangkok from Tokyo At the end of an hour flight with N masks I was exhausted and didnt do the usual always look back the trolley search that I normally would I didnt realize it until I was getting ready the next morning that I have lost my expensive skincare that I bought for mom as a gift Brand new and properly packed in the duty free bag I panicked and thought there was no hope that I would find the goods I called the airport just to try our luck The airport staff told me to describe the items that we lost and would contact us after checking with the lost and found department Only a few moments later the airport called me that they found my items at the lost and found A janitor had turned them in We can arrange to collect the items anytime It all seemed crazy to me because the items were in perfect condition I was so grateful and could not believe that my stuff would be able to be found The airport staff were extremely helpful and nice It made my day and I still feel so thankful even until today

The Fokker was certainly old but clean The flight announcements were made in Farsi and English to my surprise The flight was smooth on time and without any nervousness Food was surprisingly excellent Chicken rice and a bottle of Pepsi

Firstly poor info there is no airport mapplan nowhere on internet let alone on their web site The good info should also include that the trolleybus minibus works from till So the airport is OK and the queuing times are good At the arrival one waits up tp some min if there are no other planes passengers coming The taxi people are annoying but bearable The airport is practically in the outskirts suburbia and well communicated by minibus also one can walk some min to the nearest tram line if they wished trams work till There is a kiosk with food and drinks plus a freezer with icecream Several exchange offices rates are a bit worse than those of the city centre vs per euro No shopping in departures is rather a pleasant surprise

Transiting here despite a short interval of one hour between flights was easy Its been revamped since last visit and has a lovely new feel The signage was excellent We had to go through security despite having just alighted however that was fast and easy Our next gate was not far away to walk The toilets were in good condition Return transit turned out to be longer as our plane was delayed hours and we had to enter the country Again this was done quickly and efficiently I have no complaints at all Departing was just as easy although being such a small airport there is not much to do or see there bring your own bookentertainment All in all a good experience with this small but efficient airport

Simferopol Airport in has one brand new pier and the other two renovated All look extremely busy at peak season but very well organised clean bright well airconditioned spacious and friendly for travelers Large and convenient parking available Airports transfer options include shuttle buses taxis and even trolleybuses there is the longest km trolleybus line in the world between Simferopol Airport and the coastal city of Yalta on the Black Sea There were no queues at the entrance and pretty short ones at registration desks There could be more seats available at the lounge area than the airport now has Security officers are polite and efficient It was a pity the airport still had outdoor boarding halls but we were assured that it was a matter of time a year or two Overall it is an easy airport to use It will be nice to come back here later

Time warp but in a positive sense I guess this is how a small town airport must have looked and felt years ago Sleepy atmosphere old building completely unorganised staff but friendly and quick We got through immigration baggage collection and customs within minutes all without any tips Enjoyed the experience Return flight checkin was quick no hassle The best airports are those in which you dont spend any time If it wasnt for the complete lack of any facilities Id give it four stars

Entebbe airport sets good standards for an airport in Africa Though I do not recommend staying in it for hours it is still a clean safe place Coming from Sydney it is ok Its clean and the lounge is amazing Though having kids with me did make a hassle Otherwise its a nice quiet airport to go to Especially when the border security allowed me to go from the back to the front of the line I like it

The international terminal is small and because of that there are no endless walks which is great The visa on arrival staff were very quick and it only took a few minutes to be processed then it was the same going through immigration Our bags were waiting for us in the baggage hall after immigration then it was over to the taxi desk and straight into cab and on to our hotel On departing once again immigration was very quick then we had a short wait in the departure lounge which was very nice with a few shops and a good cafe

Panama City to Caracas a journey of hrs There was very little legroom but we were served quite a decent meal and considering it was a short flight I was impressed We departed on time but arrived min late

Surprisingly nice flight for a Chinese airline The business class named first class is of the usual type in China ie rows of seats with old seats and small reclining angle The crew was very attentive wine Chinese was decent and so was the food nothing special but ok Reading material is of course restricted to the China Daily and there is no individual entertainment but on a hours flight especially on a night flight this is not essential Flights both ways were on time I would recommend this flight as it is the only airline to fly directly between Bangkok and several places in the Shandong province schedule is terrible but it is still better than transferring

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

I was very impressed by the level of care and support I received at the airport Having a severe reaction to an insect bite and no Antihistamine tablets with me The local team and Airport police went out of their way to help I wish I had noted their names they looked everywhere and obtained tablets for me while making sure I was comfortable and relaxed Thank you very much as the level of care and support at a busy airport was very welcome and impressive

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

Spent a few hours at Saskatoon Airport for a layover Comfortable seating and general overall layout Decent selection of food and drink for a smaller airport I enjoyed the interactive flight map Friendly and helpful staff Loved the amount of window space Nice airport

I am sat in a light and airy air conditioned building drinking Cappicino Freddo The queue for checking in was small but very organised and the whole building is welcoming Arrival was just as good although a slight wait for baggage due to three aircraft coming in close together This airport has come on a lot since last year and I recommend it The indicator boards all seem to be working ok and the WiFi is good What more can you want Dont blame the airport for things they dont control

Flown HanedaChitose and FukuokaHaneda in the new A Very good seats almost like business class seats Service on board was excellent Drinks and snacks for a small fee about euro for a coffee Will fly with them again when in Japan

Norwich to Guernsey with Aurigny Air Online service very good when I was booking my seats months after booking the flights I noticed I had spelt my wifes name incorrectly but email to aurigny put that right with no extra charge The flight to Guernsey from Norwich was on time and landed early the same when coming back The flight had people coming back so about full complementary drinks are served which made a nice change The flight crew kept us informed through out the flight I would recommend this airline

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance

My recent return flight from Melbourne to the Gold Coast with REX Airlines was excellent Everything from booking to disembarking on the return flight was easy The staff were friendly and professional Given that CV issues are currently dominating travel within Australia I felt REX Airlines handled everything beautifully

I flew from Marseille to Ajaccio Overall I was satisfied The outbound leg was carried out with an ageing but very well kept ATR and the return with a recent A Both flights were on time and the crew was polite and smiling Given the short duration of the flights both around minutes the inflight service consisted solely of drinks but thats fine The basic fare always includes a checked in luggage and the price was correct I spent euros return to fly on midJuly booking just weeks prior to departure The only minus was the long waiting time to collect the luggage at AJA minutes despite having just aircrafts to unload but I dont blame it on Air Corsica

Szczecins Solidarity Airport is one of the smaller regional airports in Poland The cartaxi ride from Szczecin takes a bit longer than expected but once there you will find a pleasant airport located in a wood away from the city It has only a small terminal but it is very modern fresh and complete with all facilities bookstalls shops cafs etc that open also for early morning departures Im told there is a small hotel nearby The staff is helpful Only a handful of flights depart each day so the terminal does not get crowded and the atmosphere is casual and relaxed And the security check was very thorough which I appreciated

Passenger wise Indias th busiest airport but infrastructure wise one of the most smallest airport in India When flight lands they dont even provide bus to arrivals but needs to walk from aircraft to terminal via on tarmac Arrivals is very small only baggage belt in a limit spaces but baggage can take more time Toilets are just ok should be more clean Prepaid cab and also uber have pick up point just after exit no issues finding them at the same time many taxi drivers will approach you offering ride Airport needs proper management new terminal is under construction and hope that it is better managed

Brilliant both times we flew them Brilliant food crew especially the Thai based very comfortable seats got a decent amount of sleep Kept snacks in the galleys Stocked bathrooms with toothbrushes eye masks etc Good wifi connectivity decent ife Brilliant airline and will definitely fly again
St Petersburg to Moscow Efficient check in Comfortable seats and a fairly decent snack sandwich Certainly good value for money and spot on with departurelanding times Would use again

Pros Very good interiors and wellmaintained seats cleanliness lighting Ample space available between knee and seat in front of you Wellmannered and clear language English and Hindi speaking crew led by Ms Unnati Didnt have food nor used washroom so cannot comment on that Journey was comfortable and no bumpy rides encountered Communication from cockpit was also clear everytime Cons Boarding was not done in zoneseat number wise Quite some mosquitoes seen before take off which bit me and some passengers Crew applied some spray but wasnt enough Pricing was a big letdown as huge increase seen while booking on Feb for my journey date of Feb in a short span of time Slight delay in takeoff after closing of doors

On December st I had booked a flight for my dad and his brothers to Cape Town I joined them we were helped by Thabile Mchunu at Counter and she was absolutely amazing My elders had never taken a flight before and he kindness and friendliness was amazing and helpful to calm the nerves

The new Hanoi international terminal opened at the end of December excellent and well planned a big improvement on the old terminal It only took me a few minutes to check in and pass the security very efficient happy helpful staff all the way

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

I took the am flight from Basra to Erbil an Iraqi domestic flight I bought the ticket the day before at the Iraqi Airways ticket office in Basra They were friendly spoke English and only take Iraqi dinars no credit cards I paid roughly the equivalent of The flight left on time and was fine The equipment was a B On the short flight they served a breakfast tray with a lot of very sweet things chocolate milk an Iraqi Twinkietype cake a soft roll with jam and a banana It wasnt really to my liking but it was nevertheless an energypacked breakfast which is more than one gets on European carriers these days The flight attendants were friendly and we landed in Erbil on time I was satisfied with my flight and wish other people would also leave reviews for this airline

Very pleasant flight from Athens to Thessaloniki with Ellinair Easy process of booking and echeck in the boarding pass is sent to the mobile so no app or printer is needed Athens Airport was a breeze the fee included checked baggage so I chose to check in my hand luggage also for free the company did it with a smile Departure and arrival on time flight about full Good legspace service included very small snack and drinks Immaculate and smiling crew Quick retrieval of baggage in Thessaloniki Excellent experience

Travelled from Gteborg Landvetter Airport to Pristina in July and returned to Gteborg in August The airport of Pristina is very compact and small It has a restaurant in the checkin area and some shops In the departure area there is a dutyfree shop small but has some good stuff in it When arriving to Pristina we had to walk all the way to the arrival hall which in my opinion looks very old Baggage took a long time to get to the baggage carousels and they were on the wrong carousel They were on the carousel for a Swiss flight instead of where they shouldve been Staff were very helpful helped us to take the bags down from the carousel and explained to us that there was a misunderstanding between the staff But one bad thing is that they didnt bring baggage carts so we had to carry the baggage all the way to the car waiting for us but the walking distance to the parking is really short so frankly it was not a big deal When departing there were enough baggage carts and the whole checkin process and everything worked pretty smoothly and fine Theyre currently on the final phase of building the brand new terminal which can be seen from the runway Hopefully when I arrive and depart next time it will be from the fresh and modern new terminal

When I arrived at this airport from incheon the immigration lines were long It took me more than an hour to get out of the airport I headed to Incheon a few days later Security and immigration was actually fine although I found the facilities a little old There were plenty of places to shop and relax but I wished that there were more food choices Overall this is a small but functional airport

I have to say my second arrival in Dar was much better than the first First time arrived amid a plague of flying cockroachlike insects that were all attracted to the light inside the terminal Spent ages swatting them in a huge line for immigration that took over an hour only to then be told I needed a special permit and had to pay USD I already had a business visa Not wanting to argue I joined the next disorganised line paid my USD and waited another minutes to get my passport back Notable that everyone in the special line was Caucasian Second time all desks open for immigration friendly hello from the official and a quick stamp and on my way No special permit needed this time for some reason Bags came out quickly and was out of the airport within minutes of landing Lets hope that the new terminal will be finished on time and that there will be no more special line

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines

Quite impressed as I was not expecting much the ticket was very cheap brand new aircraft very cleaned and smelled nice Pretty good legroom seat next to me vacant so it was comfortable flight Two hot meal services main meals not very good but was happy with fresh fruit on the tray insider tip when offered SEAFOOD NOODLES dont expect wok stir fried asian style noodlesyou will get something that I would expect in Swedish kindergarten see photo below crew dont speak much English and the service is somehow chaotic but not too bad IFE quite limited but enough for me

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

UstKamenogorsk to Karaganda I recently took a group tour in Kazakhstan and this flight was part of the itinerary The checkin counters at UstKamenogorsk airport were kinda Sovietstyle but the process was efficient and we were soon in the rather featureless departure lounge bring coins there is a coffee vending machine for entertainment Aircraft wasnt new but was well presented It was completely full apparently this flight doesnt run very often but one flight attendant managed to serve a soft drink to everyone during the short flight We had an airline pilot in our group he had been wondering what to expect but in the end thought the flight was fine Luggage came quickly and nobody had any loss or damage Overall a decent service

Boise is a smaller sized airport which takes in most if the states airline traffic Walking into the airport from the parking garage in the winter time can be quite grueling and in summer afternoons the outside can be very hot Check in lines are never too long and the check in area is large with very pretty murals on the walls to look at Lighting in any part of the terminal is not a problem with great natural light Pre TSA there is only one eating area that is nothing special and the baggage claim is older giving you a s esque feel For the size if the airport the baggage handlers do take their sweet time getting the bags to their destination I have waited over half an hour for bags before Moving on to TSA the lines are usually quick and screening does not take long There is only one full body detector but traffic still flows freely Due to the recent TSA problems though the lines have reached back towards check in but lines are never hectic in the morning Post TSA is a set of large windows and an eating area The windows give a great view across the airport Food in the airport is classy but a little sub par The McDonalds that used to be the main attraction is now replaced with more Boiselike restaurants Five guys and Einsteins bagels take up most of the hunger goers On the other side of the eating are is a local brewing company Shopping in the upper terminal is nothing to write home about there is an MSNBC and cute convenience stores The airport has no specialty shops and the stores all sell the exact same things like candy magazines and little Idaho potato dolls The C terminal below is dark and again very s esque Birds have been seen inside the upper terminal before they are adorable and not a nuisance to passengers They give a somewhat natural ambiance One of the biggest problems with the airport is their horrendous seats and very few charging ports Most of the ports are up against walls or beams Restrooms are located in one spot in the B terminal and one location just past TSA Overall the airport seems very clean friendly like most of Idaho A pretty good airport Not great but pretty good

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Very pleasant flight from Athens to Thessaloniki with Ellinair Easy process of booking and echeck in the boarding pass is sent to the mobile so no app or printer is needed Athens Airport was a breeze the fee included checked baggage so I chose to check in my hand luggage also for free the company did it with a smile Departure and arrival on time flight about full Good legspace service included very small snack and drinks Immaculate and smiling crew Quick retrieval of baggage in Thessaloniki Excellent experience

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

A typical small Australian airport which operated well Some distance out of the city it is served by a bus and taxis fare Check in was easy there being more than enough desks for the traffic Security was efficient with a bookshop and cafe airside All gates are walk to the plane which are never far away Compared to many this is a nice airport

My son who is epileptic had a seizure during the security check in We had already requested Special Assistance at the desk and the airport team were incredibly helpful and took us to a quiet room to wait until our flight was called They checked on us every minutes and arranged a wheelchair and preferential boarding once the Gate opened They also ensured that the crew were aware of our situation and forwarded the request for assistance to Gatwick

A good experience overall with Eastar Jet flying from Jeju to Gimpo The flight was cheap and easy to book on the airlines website I was sent an email a couple of days before flying Pity it was only in Korean I assumed it to be a routine one that airlines commonly send and assume I was correct as there were no repercussions Baggage is a stingy kg why and mine was I was charged for one extra kilo which seems like taking rules to extremes Everything else was satisfactory Checkin was quick the flight was more or less on time and reasonably comfortable and baggage reclaim quick

I had booked this fare at a very discounted rate as I needed to travel back to BLR The check in experience was good I had arrived early and there was still time for check in to open so I was told to wait for mins before check in in my luggage Post that I had noticed that the inbound was delayed due to which the departure was also slightly delayed by mins The crew were welcoming and this flight was not completely full During boarding I had noticed that a lot of people had come with trolleys and they were told to check in their luggage which is good as a lot of folks come carrying big trolleys that just block the cabin overhead bins The flight tried to make time en route and landing in BLR was swift along with luggage retrieval One point to note here is that the seat pitch may be on the tighter side compared to other airlines but otherwise this was a good trip where the crew also distributed water bottles to everyone during boarding

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry

Pretty good airport Nice restaurant shops and post security amenities They recently finished a terminal expansion project which I must say looks very nice Not many cheap airlines though Overall good airport
