I could not believe how quiet the airport is now Ryanair have decreased their flights checked in with baggage in less then minutes and through security to departures in no time Once airside there is not much to do but there is several duty free shops a caferestaurant and a SubwayMcDonalds outlet as well as two outdoor smoking terraces All in all a nice clean little airport with helpful and friendly staff
Nothing to do Old airport looks like some maintenance is needed Not a lot of shops or seating Toilets not clean at all No ventilation in terminal humid Definitely not what I would expect in Nice

Been coming to GCM for years Yes tourism has increased based on reports by almost over last years which is fantastic for this beautiful Island But the airport although complete remodelled is poor at best Aesthetically pleasing it is too small and very uncomfortable Why go half way for something inadequate from the start Fortunately the entire staff are awesome and eased the pain Suggest a change in schedule of when flights arrive may assist even by minutes Two recent issues I dealt with The runway pothole was a total screw up From accounts in paper it appeared that new asphalt from night before was destroyed by a jet blast Asphalt needs to cure Second and personally involved is that our plane needed to wait one hour after everyone was boarded for maintenance to return a log book This made our connection for our next flight impossible with all the inconveniences associated How can you allow this calamity to occur is still not sitting well with me If you expect tourism to continue to visit your beautiful Island you need to improve
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

The girl who initially was nice to us at the information desk then proceeded to question us at the departure lounge She looked disappointed when we produced our negative results and examined them very closely Travelling right now is stressful enough without somebody who is having a bad day create more stress

Tokyo Haneda to Sapporo return with Skymark Airlines First leg on Boeing NG New cabin comfy seat and generous legroom for a lowcost airline Even though I didnt purchase any the drinks and snakcs are sold at a cheap price Departure and arrival on time Return leg delayed for mins due to congestion at destination airport Return aircraft was an older Boeing Very warm cabin temperature But overall worth the ticket price Definetely better than AirAsia and JetStar

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

Took a trip recently travelling from Sydney to Melbourne on Rex Airlines new intercity jet service It was a chance to test out their new service having many years ago flown on a regional flight to a country NSW town A couple of standouts were immediately obvious starting with the check in staff and process at Terminal in Sydney Not only were the kiosks easy to use for check in but on proceeding to the desk for bag drop the staff were very friendly and helpful On board the planes have good legroom and it was nice although a short flight to at least get a snack and cup of coffee Then on the return leg had to change my flight to an earlier time and again the service stood out The call centre reservations staff member was delightful There was no robot at the end of the phone and they cared about helping make changes Everything about the experience really was good old fashioned country service with a smile It really sets them apart from their competitors

There was hardly any delay just minutes The plane was old but reasonably clean Staff were friendly I could buy a good sparkling white wine The flight was safe and uneventful So bring your own noise cancelling headphone and enjoy a decent flight at low cost

My mother and I experienced Tokyo Narita International Airport Good service the staff smiled when my mother and I went in to buy things When I transited at Tokyo Narita International Airport To return to Lax International Airport to continue studying I did not know where to go There were two guides very polite the first staff held a map The second staff asked me if I needed a car to gate B At that time I was at gate because flight NH Ana Airlines departed from Ho Chi Minh City to Tokyo Narita International Airport I will come back many more times because the staff is very good

This is a small airport to say the least It only has gates and this is after it is being modernized and expanded Construction is still going on so it can be a bit noisy Security is fairly painless There is only one restaurantlounge airside or curbside Hopefully this will change when construction is complete Airside has floor to ceiling windows affording views of the spectacular Tetons Almost as impressive is the array of private jets lined up toward the south end of the airport If you fly here be sure to take a daytime flight in and book an F side window seat for a jawdropping view of the Tetons on approach

Given the early morning departure only fast food restaurants were open The terminal was not crowded and there was plenty of seating at the gates Terminal is bright spacious and with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield There was no line going through TSAPre It took me less than minutes to go through I have taken several flights from DAL and have always found TSA officers to polite and courteous Airport was very clean and the WiFI signal was excellent and easy to connect to On return to DAL a week later in the evening rush the terminal was very busy and did not appear to be crowded with plenty of space to disperse the crowds at the gates and concourse

We were very pleasantly surprised with our experience in Premium We normally fly Premium Economy on British Airways and this was a far better experience the plane was lovely and new and the crew were much friendlier The premium experience on board is good nice to have additional space and a private section of the cabin and the crew were generous with drinks The food was fine and we were pleased to be served two hot meals on the way out Our checked bags came off very promptly at both ends the Premium labels did seem to make a difference The only slight negative was that our flight left Gatwick late afternoon and the Premium check in line took longer than the normal one as they seemed to give priority to those checking in for next mornings flights Strange but didnt spoil the overall experience

Yangon to Mandalay with Golden Myanmar Airlines was very pleasant and positive The airline online booking system was good checkin counter staff very friendly and the checkin was easy The flight left the gate as per schedule and the flight was comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and efficient Passengers were served with light snacks during the approx hrs flight

It was years ago I used this airport and wow so much has changed The check in on nd level had moved to a much more spacious rd level It made the experience totally different in a positive way No longer does it feel cramped Staff are friendly and signage are very clear The only thing that still need improving is the variety of shops available air side and food options It is still pretty basic at this stage With more and more airlines flying to OKA they can be more ambitious and open up more shops and restaurants to cater for us

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji

Mid size airport with Indian standard with connectivity to most big cities in India after covid no international flight For arrival its easy to use we arrives at baggage hall and same hall have a prepaid taxi counter and a snack shop and a liquor shop Toilets were clean and also the terminal looks clean plenty of baggage trolleys also have paid porter facility Cabs are available book through their kiosk and avoid taking from touts outside It is situated within the city so if travelling light may walk towards outside and get auto that would be cheapest option to travel Ola Uber also available

Very clean and well taken care of This airport is served by so many great airlines with diverse destinations I do think that GRR needs more international routes At GRR the airport is not too big so it makes efficient travel Also they have a good selection of shops and stores The airport facility looks really modern and cool for being over years old The only cons is that sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the staff doesnt manage high groups of passengers well Would give an if I could

DubaiKabulDubai in early December Kamair continues to be OK Both flights were close to being on time the only small delay down to Dubai air traffic They are now doing the luggage security check in Kabul which means you have to point out your case before it is loaded onto the aircraft Dont forget to do this if you want to see your case at your destination

We booked different domestic flights tofrom and in Sulawesi with Lion Air as there were no real alternatives What I was afraid for having read reviews here already happened days before departure of our first flight as I got a message our initially booked first flight was cancelled and we were rebooked on a later flight From the flights booked were cancelled and we got rebooked Luckily I managed to arrange my pickup at the Makassar and Ternate airports where we already arranged travel Our flights from Makassar to Palopo and back were the only ones that remained as booked Palopo flights on an ATR twinturboprop had Wings Air owned by Lion Air flight numbers All other flights were on s Service on board of the flights was nonexistent but at least the flights were smooth and left on time as per the new schedule Also baggage reclaim went smooth but this of course shouldnt be an issue as all airports were quite small The positive note is staff at the airports were nice and friendly and always did their best to assign us seats with more legroom which was much appreciated

Gatwick to Venice We were hesitant about this airline having read reviews but booked it for the low price I have to say the flight exceeded our expectations Checkin and boarding were both an extremely smooth process I think we were at the bag drop desk for a total of minutes and boarding was much quicker than with other lowfrills airlines We paid in advance for extra legroom seats my partner is so this is an essential for us and were surprised by the amount of space and comfort We sat at the front of the plane with plenty of room to stretch out unlike Ryanair and EasyJet whose exit row seats only have an extra inch or so Flight took off and landed on time and was far more comfortable than wed anticipated There are definitely some areas to be improved upon in terms of the preflight process I have not come across any other airline in the past few years that makes you print out your own boarding pass rather than making it available electronically Its also pretty irritating to be told you cant check in online unless you pay for it this could potentially lead to long queues at the airport on the day These points lower my overall score for the airline but the flight experience itself was very pleasant

Shenyang is my home airport The recent move to the new terminal is a big improvement although there is no smoking room Food and beverage shops ok but overpriced Check in always quick and efficient Same can be said for passport control and security Lounges for frequent fliers are nice with if depart around midday a decent lunch Delays are not very frequent here and if there are delays they are always caused by traffic control Warm in winter and cool in summer Clean toilets Good signs and all within walking distance of minutes maximum

Mahan Air from Kuala Lumpur to Tehran Check in was fast and friendly The signage to find the premier lounge in Kuala Lumpur airport was almost nonexistent and took me a while to locate the lounge which offered minimum amenities Boarding was efficient and the A was packed for this flight The aircraft interior was new and clean with smiling crew The flat bed was great and plenty of food was offered for this hour flight Perhaps the refreshment pizza and a burrito at the end of the flight was a bit too much Only negative thing I can think of was not much entertainment and it was limited to public LCDs Considering the business class fare was almost cheaper than other airlines which operated indirect service it was a good buy I was especially impressed by the very attentive flight attendants Overall a good flight

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry

IzmirAdnan Menderes is architecturally a very pleasing airport with lots of glass and steel giving it a very modern look The food and shopping were very good the restrooms were spotless and clean and it was very easy to navigate There is free wifi but only for two hours

Upon arrival in Rhodes a suitcase was delayed Indicated at the counter The handling was done very well We arrived on the next flight and were taken directly to our address Super The entire flight also went great Friendly professional staff Flying with Aegean is a relief Bij aankomst op Rhodos was er een koffer vertraagd Bij de balie aangegeven De afhandeling is super gedaan Met de volgende vlucht meegekomen en direct naar ons adres gebracht Super Ook de gehele vlucht was super verlopen Vriendelijk professioneel personeel Vliegen met Aegean is een verademing

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of Air KBZ flying from Yangon to Mandalay I bought the ticket just two days before the flight and the fare was very reasonable Checkin was fast and efficient and a Air KBZ employee approached me in the line and escorted me to the checkin desk and helped me checkin The domestic terminal is small and a bit chaotic but this is not Air KBZs fault and should be remedied when the new domestic terminal is finished There are no screens announcing that boarding has commenced so you have to pay attention to the airline employees who walk up and down the waiting area with handheld signs with your airline and flight number on it Boarding was via a bus to the aircraft The plane was clean in good condition and the seats were comfortable The flight crew was helpful and friendly We were served a light breakfast on this minute flight The flight took off and landed on time I would certainly fly Air KBZ again

Was transiting between fight from Brisbane to flight to Townsville with wait time of three hours Boarding areas large enough for amount of passengers Lots of windows with views over runway Shops and eateries limited but probably appropriate for airport this size Check in area clear Security staff friendly and talkative Noted the airport has a new Ibis Airport Hotel nearby and looks rather flash Had a pleasant time while at this airport

Seats in economy cabin very comfortable compared to a lot of airlines The hot meal was of good quality however on a hour flight it was the only hot meal and a small roll before landing You need hot meals on such a long flight we were so hungry when we got off the aircraft Half of the crew were tui Scandinavia crew they were lovely very glam and hard working the uk based crew could learn a lot from these guys The uk based crew on my flight out looked a mess and done the bare minimum and werent very pleasant Drinks were plentiful also which they only served at specific times throughout the flight as I heard them say no to a few people when they asked outside of the service I think this is great stops people getting drunk and annoying on a long flight which makes it more pleasant for everyone The hours went quickly and Id fly with TUI again

Travelled in and out of this Burmese provincial airport early last year arriving from Mandalay and leaving to Rangoon Pretty basic but it was OK and really belonged to another age of flying This because you could wander out onto the runway between planes arriving there werent many and if you wished you could go to your hold luggage which was stacked on a trolley awaiting the planes arrival and put things in or take things out of it Many of the Burmese passengers availed themselves of this facility as our plane was an hour late arriving When its light appeared in the sky on its approach an airport official suggested we all go back into the terminal so we did An airport still in an age of innocence with no apparent need for security of any kind

My flights were delayed for many hours due to weather in Dallas El Paso airport is the best airport to be stranded in It has an easilyaccessed smoking area in a lovely courtyard Its small enough to get around quickly but big enough to have decent food My delays would have been much worse in a larger airport but El Paso airport made my delays manageable Staff were also great Security and the like especially outside directing vehicle traffic were nice and helpful offering extra help or information if I needed it Love this airport The only minor annoyance was that it did not have a lot of charging ports in the seating areas so I had to stand while my phone was charging

Initially booked in Economy Class but when I was about to board agent took my boarding pass and voila got upgraded to Business One thing that stands out with Philippine Airlines is the hospitality and warmth of their crew both on ground and on board Food may not be at par with other big Asian carriers but for what they lack makes it up with their service One thing to consider as well is the ticket price being the most affordable Ill keep using PR as it is the most convenient affordable and with genuine service PRs exclusive Mabuhay Lounge at MNL T is one the best thing that happened with PR so far Keep it up

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

Such a small airport But perfectly sized for the amount of people and traffic Nice staff and very clean facilities Just need to ensure there are some drinks and food available past security as the drink vending machine was broken

Our arrival was great No problems The airport was clean People were friendly Renting a car was a bit of a pain because it was in another building a long way to drag several bags When departing we arrived hours early but had to wait about minutes before checking our bags There were only people working one for frequent flyers and one for the rest of us The couple at the head of our line had a problem and it took minutes for the lady to get the problem worked out When we got in line there were people in line By the time we were being checked in there were people in line Again everything was clean and the people were very pleasant

Travelled from Dusseldorf to London Stansted booked as Air Berlin flight but actually it was Etihad Regional operated by Darwin Airline I could not book the seat in advance and were forced to wait at the airport until checkin counter opened Flight was stated as delayed by minutes but actually this was more than minutes with very few announcements Flight itself was comfortable SAAB is unique aircraft with one seat on one side and two seats on the other side of the cabin which I like Fortunately I sat on one seat which was good for me As it was an evening flight they gave a bread snack which for a short flight is fair As I like this aircraft maybe if I have a chance I will take this flight again however I would not recommend to my friends
An old Fokker departure and arrival on time very smooth landing proficient bilingual staff and excellent food omelette with herbs coleslaw and chicken

Departure hall clean spacious and air conditioned Well organised queuing system with KLM staff tagging hand baggage in advance to make check in run smoothly Each airline had their own desk Security fast just remember to have your red immigration card Food outlets fine but limited Shopping limited as two shops sold the same items Duty free had a good range of perfume and drinks but beware if you are European and outside the Eurozone prices are more expensive for cosmetics than what you would pay in High Street shops Didnt fully investigate alcohol but you need to look carefully for offers and compare them to a local supermarket We werent travelling with children but I didnnotice any play facilities on offer Seats OK Arrival Hall just had fans but didnt have to wait long for luggage There are toilets in the baggage reclaim hall these were clean and well maintained For a small island a really good airport

I had read the worst reviews about NDjili International Airport and did not exactly look forward to the experience of arriving and departing there But my hopes were set on some other articles I had found about a new international terminal that opened end of built by Chinese contractors I must say the new terminal the staff working there and the guarded parking and dropoff areas in front of it are exceptionally good It is a small but very bright and clean building Customs officers are professional and nice to the passengers same applies to security staff at Xray machines and where one must pay for an exit visa when leaving DRCongo Airconditionong works well and there is a nice business class lounge Do not expect any shopping outlets there is only one bar but the latter can easily compare to those in the better European airports Thumbs up for the new terminal hope it stays like it is today The road from the airport to downtown Kinshasa was also completely refurbishes good pavement lighting at night Travel times tofrom the airport to the embassies area of the capital are now only h to be compared to h a few years ago I was said

We booked the flight because it was rather cheap on ctrip hours before departure my wife got a message that my flight from Changsha to Chengdu was cancelled and we should call the airline company Due to Chinese New Year and the Coronavirus it was pretty hard to contact anybody so we decided to take the car to the airport At the airport the ticket desk was unable to change my ticket Sichuan Airlines was unable to change my ticket so we had to call ctrip After nearly hours we got the schedule change and I was able to get an earlier flight Would have wished the airlines had offered me the schedule change by themselves Service on the flight ChangshaChengdu was nonexistent I am not sure if that was due to turbulence or to the virus but it was just a twohours flight and I had brought some food of my own In Chengdu I had to get my luggage and wait for hours to check it in again fortunately there is a good lounge for transit passengers at Chengdu Airport At pm the Sichuan Airlines counters got really busy as there were many flights departing It was really crowded but service was quite quick I was pretty surprised when the flight to Rome got cancelled maybe due to personnel shortage because of the virus My gutfeeling says the flights to Prague and to Rome were pretty empty so they cancelled one flight Passangers to Italy got rebooked to our flight and even that one was not full Seats were a bit narrow and my earphones did not work but I was so tired takeoff at am that I did not need any inflight entertainment Luckily there was no foodservice at the start so passangers were able to sleep The flightattendants handed out bottled water and snacks when I awoke I found snacks and water on the vacant seat next to me Very thoughtful hours before landing they served breakfast It was not a lot we did not even get trays It was Chinese food and I liked it but for Europeans who cannot eat spicy food the choice was not good I am used to spicy food but even I considered the breakfast to be quite spicy No drinks were offered for breakfast Luckily I always try to get a seat near the galley so I could get hot water during the flight for my tea Allinall Sichuan Airlines was quite cheap the aircraft semiclean and inflightentertainment choices were okay If you are not too tall and do not need to many amenities I can recommend this airline Worst flight I ever had to China but still reasonably comfortable

Apart from the usual lateness which one comes to expect from some regional airlines this was an excellent flight The aircraft was practically brand new and the cabin crew were professional Between booking and the actual flights it had changed its name from Afrijet to FlyGabon

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai

Miami to Brussels On this Boeing plane Jetairfly has a separate cabin called comfort class and I was able to book seats there for an extra fee Only seats in this cabin with FAs doing a great job Seats configuration in xx while regular economy is xx Legroom was very good After take off we were offered Champagne followed by a hot meal together with wine coffee and digestif Before landing breakfast was served I would recommend this airline if you can get seats in this cabin

Johannesburg to Cape Town The SLOW lounge at JNB sets the standard with an impressive array of food even at am and ample seating The bar service is good too and some neighbours had already finished their third refill of pink champagne by the time they boarded the same flight As is common on other BA flights Group passengers were kept waiting on the airbridge before boarding actually commenced Service on board was friendly and efficient but very much old school BA as far as the fourcourse lunch was concerned At least one was able to see the main course before choosing it Departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule and baggage collection was speedy too Overall a decent flight

The wheelchair attendant verified everything for me Verified with me verified with the LYFT driver by asking his name verify the LYFT ride by licenses plate verified I felt ok and I knew where I was going For me its humiliating to be pushed in a wheelchair I never felt humiliation this time I truly felt cared for This trip wasnt the greatest vacay Ive had but when I got home I felt great I want to thank this positive smart caring young man Some ppl have a gift a few share it in this way If your lucky enough to meet this young man at DFW Airport youll know its him Im talking about here

This airport was previously known as London Manston which is a bit of a joke because of how far it is from London However with a name change new terminal and new budget airline EUJet has started to raise its profile I travelled through there on the way tofrom Amsterdam The airport is small which works to its advantage Check in was very fast and the staff very helpful The car park is right outside the terminal entrance and is very cheap day or week The small cafeteria is good and clean The aircraft are right out side the terminal so no long bus rides or endless walkways On the way back it took less than minutes to reach my car from the time the wheels touched the ground I had no luggage All in all a very good experience

First impression of Minsk airport was given by its exterior grand Brutalist Sovietera architecture Very impressive Inside the terminal doesnt feel grand and impressive I was in transit only so I only saw the arrival gates transfer area and the airside departure areas The arrivals area is a bit of a maze and signage not that clear So be sharp when looking for the transit area after arrivals The transfer area was old fashioned with worn fakeleather couches that seem to taken from a landfill Queuing time at the transfer area was OK around minutes After boarding card check passengers process through security which was a bit of a joke as passengers are not checked at all after passing the walkthrough metal detector The departures area with its shops is a bit of a maze and the gate waiting areas are very small There is not a lot of choice in shops what I saw was mostly liquor or food and beverage outlets Seating in the gate waiting areas is limited but on the upper level of the departures area there is sufficient space to take a rest on one of the seats At the upper level there are also seats on which you can recline but these seats are quite hard and not very comfortable to take a good nap There are also sleeping cabins here Wifi works great login via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean especially at the upper level where not a lot of people go The terminal it not really fit for PRM passengers as there are a lot of stairs but not escalators and just a few lifts They did install stairlifts at the gates a rather silly solution in my opinion but is works This airport is fine when you have a short transfer In case of a long transfer it can be boring and FB options are very limited

Great little airport used mainly by Porter airlines Check in was efficient and you go down to an airport lounge open to everyone They serve free tea coffee and soft drinks along with cookies and nuts The wifi is free and fast Boarding is effortless and the scenery on take off is stunning The only downside was that when the lounge is busy it gets a little grubby with dishes lying everywhere Otherwise it comes highly recommended

I booked return flights from Sydney to Rome via Guangzhou where the airline provides an easy and comfortable option of a free hotel depending on the gap between your next flight The stopover option is incredibly well handled with transport provided to and from your hotel I thoroughly recommend this as Guangzhou has a great easy to use metro system and its very easy to get around The A fleet used are in excellent condition with pleasant staff although meals can be a let down one on my return journey was actually inedible However the real test of a good airline is when things dont go to plan My return flight from Rome was cancelled due to a technical issue after we had boarded the flight We spent hours on board with regular updates provided before the Captain made the decision not to fly Prior to disembarking which involved reentering Italy and collecting our bags lunch was served on board a nice touch Once back in the terminal we were given further meal vouchers and asked to return an hour later On return we were bussed to the nearby Sheraton where all accommodation and meals were covered for hours while the plane was repaired and put back in service These changes left only hours to change to my rescheduled flight from Guangzhou to Sydney however to my delight China Southern provided a hotel option close to the airport allowing for a refreshing stop and rest before the final long leg back to Sydney So sure I arrived on Sunday morning instead of Friday night as planned but the way I was looked after was very good I would certainly recommend China Southern and will fly with them again

Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Hong Kong To be honest I did not expect much from a LCC The crew onboard were professional and nice and they tried their very best to communicate with passengers using English The plane was clean and tidy I do not mind having to pay for food and beverages and I do not care about the lack of entertainment Yet the seats are hard as rock which makes me feel like I am sitting on a wooden plank The seat pitch is completely ridiculous that I cannot even tie my shoelaces My height M Sleeping or even resting on the flight is simply Mission Impossible no matter how tired I was given the seat lacks basic support and the unbelievable seat pitch If your only parameter is cost and you can forgo all sorts of comfort go fly with them

Superb airport Small Friendly service No queuing went through security in under minutes Fast free wifi with constant connection and no connectivity issues Burger and chips SEK cl beer SEK Decent viewing facility but minimal air traffic to view

Milwaukee is a great airport to spend a couple of hours in Decent food selection a great interminal aviation museum and the most incredible airport used bookstore Ive experienced Wish I had brought another carryon bag as I could have filled the thing with all the great books at reasonable prices I wanted to buy

FDHTHF Friendly staff clean aircraft with comfortable leather seats Orders for drinks and snacks taken and served individualy Prices on their inflight menu are OK Landing in Berlins Tempelhof airport is a fantastic experience Too bad the airport is due to be closed soon Even with bags to claim aircraft to subway station took less than Minutes Beat that

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

Very pleasant airline Friendly and helpful crew Reasonable prices for food and drinks on board There was limited choice but that is ok on a hour flight This was the second time I flew with SmartLynx We had a nice flight and I would fly again with this airline

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

I fly this route regularly but usually in Economy as this was a busy weekend there were no economy tickets remaining so I booked BusinessClub Europe I never deal with checkin as Im always hand luggage only I headed straight into the airport and decided Id try out the OneWorld lounge at Schiphol as this was included There was a huge queue with people being turned away from the Lounge front desk this however turned out to be for another providers lounge I checked with the front desk and was allowed to enter the OneWorld lounge This lounge was nicely furnished with plenty of food and snacks available nice quiet restrooms within the lounge were also available This space was a welcome change from the hustle and bustle from the rest of the terminal and I relaxed here for a while before my flight The staff were very friendly and attentive When boarding time came I made my way to the gate of course passengers ignored the boarding order and all just crowded the gate this left multiple priority boarding passengers unable to board until most of economy had seated Schiphols ground staff need to be more organised in this respect On the plane as this is only a seating layout the seating was no different to economy I expected this and the Embraers are quiet spacious despite being smaller planes Our food and drinks orders were taken before take off so the dedicated ClubWorld staff could serve as soon as possible on the short flight Food was a cold dish but was a very tasty Asian style chicken and slaw various other snacks were included and I had glasses of champagne because why not Staff were very friendly and attentive despite how short this flight was Arriving at London City was like it is in any class quick and simple Overall the experience was good and for the difference in cost in Avios points I will now be doing this journey in ClubWorld rather than Economy in the future

Weihai Airport is an efficient modern airport that contains international and domestic flights within the same building Arrived at WEH Airport from ICN Left the aircraft via airbridge I was pleasantly surprised by with number of counters opened at passport control that handled the passengers very quickly After clearing immigration I waited for less than minutes for the luggage Arrived back at WEH a week later for flight to ICN The check in staff understood English and took to effort to confirm the destination of my ticket and luggage Security and passport control was also a quick and efficient process I was amazed with the facilities at the airport terminal given the small number of international flight currently being handled by Weihai The departure hall included duty free and other shops restaurants and television for the passengers The Airport was modern and clean The staff were friendly The process of arrival and departures seemsed less stressful and time consuming than larger airports Also being a smaller airport there was plenty of parking and no traffic congestion to and from the airport

Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Okinawa Naha Boarded on time and with no troubles staff were friendly and welcoming Seats were reasonably comfortable Im ft tall and my knees werent touching the back of the seat in front of me which was definitely a welcome surprise on a low cost carrier No entertainment systems available but not an issue as I usually travel with my iPod and something to read anyway Flight was calm and we experienced no turbulence en route You need to purchase on board food or bring something with you but we knew this in advance so brought some food bought at Narita departures terminal All round good flights cheap and efficient and did exactly what we wanted Took us from A to B with no fuss or issues A solid experience Id recommend and plan on using again in the future

Zurich to Geneva return with Darwin Airline Booking and checkin was smooth online checkin was not available Boarding was quick maybe due to light load factors on both segments Both flights were on time arrival even early Very nice cabin crew comfortable seats with huge seat pitch s style on the Saab I can recommend them at least for flights from and to Geneva I am aware that Darwin Airline has some punctuality issues But that never happened to me Great value for money

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

Surprisingly smooth flight on board Czech Airlines checkin was smooth and flight departed on time from Paris and as I had Plus fare they did not bother me about my cabin bag and backpack during boarding On board offer was OK and prices were low the beer which I ordered was cold which is perfect They also offered a water after the paid service so for the price I paid I was more than happy Flight arrived minutes early only downside of the trip was the long wait for the bags in Prague

I had a better experience than most of the other people who posted reviews here The airplane departed on time in Tblisi and arrived even a bit earlier Seats are comfortable Checked luggage is free which is very rare these days Be prepared for zero interaction with the staff members in the plane though Only at the entrance the staff greets you They seemed quite friendly though Theres no option to buy food and no information apart from an announcement that the landing has started The life vests looked quite old frayed and stained at least the one that the safety instructor showed maybe the ones stored under your seat are newer If you dont need luxury and you bring your own food this airline is really fine I dont know how they act in case of delays or cancellations though

Louisville is actually one of the nicest airports in the United States poundforpound In fact Louisville on steroids gives you an idea of what more of our true international gateways should look like but dont I mean Detroit and Minneapolis are good but LAX and JFK Ill start with the good about Louisville Parking is easy and reasonably priced So easy in fact that its literally at the back door of the terminal and nicely covered for all those inclement weather situations The airport is super clean The personnel are aboveaverage in friendliness some of the security and restaurant staff could learn to smile but its hard for me to recount any particularly rude experiences with personnel The terminal is very Louisville and Kentuckythemed making the airport an unmistakable part of the state of Kentuckys cultural identity Security is usually a breeze even if you dont have TSA PreCheck which I have Its almost immediately next door to the state fairgrounds minutes from downtown and minutes from serene natural areas like Jefferson Memorial Forest The terminals are straightforward and wellsigned The public art is very localspecific and themed and attractively positioned As a bonus the airport is UPS primary North American hub so its neat to see the massive cargo planes regularly flying in and out of there The real drawbacks of flying into and out of Louisville are that baggage claim takes a little longer than it should for a relatively small airport and you have to pay close attention to signage right as youre driving off the property to access the freeways and fairgrounds In summary Its hard to go wrong with flying in and out of Louisville Ive been doing it for years and it just feels almost like putting on a comfortable pair of shoes

From the moment you set foot inside Dublin Airport immediately distinguishes itself as a beacon of luxury especially noticeable within the sleek and sophisticated confines of Terminal Its modern aesthetic and design set it apart from the majority of international airports presenting an atmosphere not just of transit but of refined travel experience The layout of Dublin Airport is a testament to thoughtful design and planning The checkin areas are remarkably clear and wellorganized making navigation a breeze for travelers This accessibility extends throughout the airport with ample space lifts and escalators ensuring that everyone regardless of mobility can easily move around Perhaps most impressive is the airports commitment to leveraging cuttingedge technology for security processes The advanced systems in place mean that passengers dont need to remove liquids or electronics from their bags streamlining what is often a cumbersome process This efficiency is further highlighted by the minimal queues with most travelers getting through security in less than five minutesa clear indication of Dublin Airports effective use of technology and operational management The warmth and helpfulness of the staff at Dublin Airport cannot go unmentioned Each interaction is marked by genuine care making the travel experience exceptionally personal and pleasant Dublin Airport also excels in its retail and dining offerings The dutyfree selection is impressive featuring soughtafter brands and exclusive products at prices that challenge those of high street shops The food outlets including some newly launched ones offer a wide array of options catering to diverse tastes and dietary needs all at reasonable prices For travelers seeking a moment of tranquility or needing to attend to work the airport provides numerous lounges and workspaces alongside impeccably clean toilets and abundant seating areas Navigation through the airport is foolproof with gates clearly marked and the overall layout intuitively designed Also has free reliable WiFi unlike other major airports A unique feature that sets Dublin Airport apart on the global stage is its US Customs and Border Protection Preclearance facility allowing travelers to complete all immigration procedures before boarding This means arriving in the USA as if on a domestic flight bypassing the usual long queues upon arrivalan invaluable convenience In summary Dublin Airport is not just a travel hub but a remarkable experience in its own right Its commitment to luxury modernity and efficiency makes it a mustuse airport for anyone looking to elevate their travel experience The seamless blend of advanced technology outstanding customer service and thoughtful amenities positions Dublin Airport as a hidden gem in the world of air travel My advice Run dont walk to Dublin Airport for your next journey Its an experience that not only facilitates travel but inspires more of it

Really nice clean small airport in terms of actual experience On arrival my Aer Lingus flight landed slightly ahead of schedule and I was airside within minutes from leaving aircraft door Immigration was a breeze and quick and the person checking passportsIDs was friendly and welcoming On departure security was fast and efficient and staff were relaxed and friendly The departure area is small but has couple of food options given the size and there was decent dutyfree area although I think greater part of this could be allocated to local products especially food given some of the really great quality stuff I had during my stay in Cork Toilets very clean and maintained and gate areas had plenty of seating The thing I loved though is they sell bottles of water for which you can just quickly tap and take from a stand no pricegouging and they have a refill station centrally located if you need refill it before you take off or if you brought your own bottle much better than Heathrow T when I left The only thing that lets this airport down and why I have marked it down is poor information on its website before travelling doesnt look like its been updated since covid and poor transfers from the airport to the city on arrival Taxis are expensive to the city at given the distance Bus to the city is regular service bus not a dedicated airport shuttle is only every half an hour in either direction and you need Leap card or euros no cards accepted This is inconvenient as international visitors wont necessarily immediately have the either of the former to hand I was lucky that a kind stranger on the bus paid for me using their own Leap card as the bus was waiting when I arrived if I had to go to get cash I would have missed it and had to wait half an hour for the next one Once on the bus it isnt clear when you arrive in the city as it is neither announced nor displayed on the electronic board just random street names and the bus runs with the lights off inside so you travel in the dark and it is all rather disorientating The stop in the city is also a random bus stop not the bus station which also makes it unclear where to get it from when you need to return to the airport from the city Im really perplexed why a city that has a lot of tourism has made it so difficultinconvenient for visitors in this respect and its a shame as the experience at the airport itself was excellent

We had airport assistance for my elderly mother and the chap who met us at the plane Giorgious was excellent He spoke very good English and was super courteous and respectful and helpful throughout our transit He took us through immigration and then onto our lounge for a flight to London with Aegean Airlines He knew us by name within an instant and always explained what was happening next He should be celebrated The staff at the boarding gates were also very courteous and respectful as well I cant speak highly enough of everyone we dealt with at Athens Airport Even the ladies serving at the cafe considering how busy it was was excellent friendly and on point Its always a pleasure when you meet good people doing good things Well done Athens airport

The usual service everything ok Lounge at Madrid airport is just great Late boarding and late departure due to traffic control arrived min late On board crew is just great as usual very attentive full lunch served with open bar Seat comfort nothing special but fine for a hr flight Everything worked out well they need to pay attention to punctuality

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

A fairly typical African airport I was not hassled for bribes or other payments Immigration and baggage reclaim were not a problem on the way in Departure was a bit confusing and facilities limited on the way out They are rebuilding the airport at the moment whilst it is in use So it is in a poor state but looks like it will be very good when complete No business lounge at present The airport is very close to the centre of Ouagadougou so no long drive is required to get anywhere

I was transiting with Air China in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal Most international flights operate from Concourse TE but some use TD In my cause both arrival and departure were from TE On transit passengers need to go through document and security and customs check The walking times are not really long and mostly travelators are available There are transfer service checkpoints one from each side of the concourse The crowd is not really well organized and staff is not really helpful Not everyone speaks English which is quite frustrating when you actually need to communicate with airport or security staff Arriving early in the morning get ready to spend h queuing for transit Other than that I have to note that Terminal is very modern by its looks and layout The ceiling is high which makes it seam like the airport is free and spacious Walking distances are not too long Most gates are accessible in less than minutes of calm stroll Between TE TD and TC there is an automated people mover train which is easily accessible after security I didnt use it but I located its station and observed it a little There are few restaurants which in my opinion are quite reasonable priced Early in the morning only few Chinese restaurants and Western cafes were opened The food is actually quite delicious I would note good availability of seating spaces Some are equipped with universal power outlets and USB chargers If you want to use WiFi better use WiFi kiosks as SMS sometimes doesnt go through Be aware that you wont be able to use most messengers and social networks Also it was nice to have drinking fountains within short reach from most seating areas I would suggest considering Beijing Capital Airport as transit hub for Asia Clean and modern airport with all the necessary facilities for longer transits

This review is for International arrivals and US Departures Ive used this airport in December and then again in March In general a much better experience this time around On arrival sufficient immigration desks were staffed and customs was quick enough so that I was in my hotel within minutes of touching down On departure the new US Departures terminal is much improved from the older version Check in and security is quick and efficient The only place where there are lines is the US immigration pre clearance Airside the terminal is quite pleasant with lots of shops restaurants etc While the main restaurant Kafe Kalik I think is pleasant with outdoor seating I would not recommend ordering food there unless you want to risk missing your flight they took minutes to bring our food

I flew China Airlines of Taiwan from Vienna to Taipei in December with an onward journey to Bangkok and Taipei to Vienna in January in their business class The cabin of the A was kept clean and the equipment is modern despite not having a privacy door the privacy was great A is definitely my favorite airplane I have much less jetlag after long haul flights I heard the airline is upgrading its product in years Service on both flights was truly first class Very engaging and friendly and nothing is too much trouble for the crew On the outbound flight the crew working in my section was super professional on par with the standard offered by Singapore Airlines On my return journey Magret was super friendly and take personal care of the passengers The cabin manager on the return journey was also very pleasant and helpful Food onborad was excellent China Airlines unlike its competitor EVA or Starlux doesnt offer an intensive menu but the food and drink quality is really good On the way back I chose the course prepared by a Michelin star restuanrat in Taipei but my favorite is always the special vegetarian food which is also Michelin star and you need to preorder online The lounge in Taipei is either very busy morning peak hours and also evening or very quiet There is no natural light so it is dark However it is tastefully decorated and the food was very tasty Service like their onboard standard was very personal and friendly There is always a queue for the shower due to the terminal size the lounge isnt large Hopefully this will be addressed once Terminal opens so make sure you put your request in early Onboard wifi worked well and there is no data cap that is a huge bonus Now comes the cons the business class seat on A is equipped with a very large and clear monitor but the entertainment choice is fairly limited not sufficient moviesTVmusic to keep me occupied Also the seat and amenity is great especially the duvet but when the seat is fully flat the leg space becomes a bit constrain

This review is limited to Terminal only Terminal is about years old and a significant upgrade over Terminal The terminal is very clean brightly lit and wide concourses There are dining options aplenty and plenty of seating at the gates Immigration was a smooth process with biometric screening epassport line Took no more than minutes in line Upon exiting customsbaggage claim one has to run the gauntlet of the time share vultures Surprisingly there are no benches for passengers to sit awaiting ground transportation pickup Departure experience was very pleasant Easy checkin with minimal wait times for security and immigration

I am convinced that anyone that has anything bad to say about Stansted is either paid delusional or a banker that hasnt got anything positive to say about anything Ive travelled to airports so not quite as many as some people but Ive been to enough to say that Stansted is bloody marvelous at what it does Its simple clean efficient has a beautiful single terminal building some of the fastest security queues Ive ever seen no matter how many people its trying to push through Stansted is quite simply operationally one of the best ever and Ive never had to wait more than minutes departing Even arrivals moves ridiculously fast and while sometimes you can wait in a queue that looks lengthy to enter the country it never takes that long The people working at Stansted know how to move Its an absolutely marvelous display and it always astounds me whenever I go Its a well signposted airport very easy to navigate the quiet area is fantastic loads of shops and food options My only MINOR criticism is that it can sometimes be difficult to find a place to sit down upstairs but other than that its absolutely a class airport

BrisbaneHoniara Checkin a little slow but request for seat changes so our group could sit together handled without fuss A has comfortable seats with good leg room but no IFE despite old style screens throughout the cabin being available Catering is very basic and catering equipment is old and well used Toilets clean but are old and smelly Highlight was the crew who offered drinks throughout the flight not just responding to requests but proactively out in the cabin for the whole flight Recommend having breakfast before the flight and bring a book or iPad but otherwise an enjoyable flight and cheaper than Virgin

Atyrau to Uralsk I had a few meetings to attend in Uralsk and Aksai and was not looking forward to the hour or more arduous taxi journey from Atyrau to Uralsk in C heat I was recommend to use Qazaq Air as they now have a direct flight from Atyrau to Uralsk I booked a return flight online selected a seat paid via card and my eticket was immediately emailed On arrival to the airport checkin is simple and efficient The flight was serviced by a Bombardier Dash Next Gen aircraft which was very clean and the aircrew well dressed and welcoming The flight h m was very good with a surprisingly powerful takeoff and flight landing mins earlier than scheduled I certainly was impressed with the overall service and the value for money I will be using Qazaq air again for direct flights around west Kazakhstan

I flew TokyoSapporoTokyo I was pleasantly surprised at the efficiency and professionalism of the staff The crew spoke English We departed and arrived ontime The great price combined with the excellent service ensures I will fly Skymark again

LHR T BA Gold Wing worked well Pleasant check in and very fast security screening Concorde room service attentive C gate boarding OK but nothing special for First Passengers Latest BA version of first with only suites with privacy doors Comfortable seat with plenty of stowage Good screen and good choice of IFE Amenity kit good quality and bedding pillows cushions and blankets all good Excellent menu and food very well presented Cabin crew could not have been more attentive and helpful without being obtrusive On time departure and early arrival Bags delivered relatively swiftly and priority tagged bags were first off All in all one of the best BA First flights Ive had in many years Whilst not touching the Middle Eastern carriers BA First on this showing is easily the best way to cross the Atlantic

Air Belgium for Srilankan Airlines Uncomfortable business class seat looks well used only good thing was the massage function Mix of crew from Air Belgium and Srilankan mostly friendly Food was tasty and filling a good variety to chooses from Toilet wasnt overly clean

Flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino return with both flights spot on time noting that both legs were fully booked without any empty seats onboard No checked in baggage so headed straight to the gate The Ryanair mobile App is helpful apart from the nagging up selling but its understandable Its great boarding passes can be saved viewed in Google Wallet Boarding was managed well in PRG and CIA even with the full of passengers with Prague being strict on carry on luggage sizes as some fellow travellers were being a bit cheeky The cabin crew on my return flight were especially superb and professional with a smile Both legs were on a Boeing s I suspect there are no Max stationed in Prague One had an updated interior with slim seats and notably much more comfortable esp Legroom than the other although both were in top condition including cleanliness This product is ideal hassle free for quick flights around Europe

Having gone through so many different airports around the world Kuching Airport is definitely one of the better airports to use Airport workers here checkin counters security immigration etc are generally fine but can be improved especially on the level of professionalism in their communication with passengers The airport may look very new but there is a need to improve some facilities such as seating areas especially the terminal Air Asia uses at one end of the single terminal and the automated passport gates at the arrival hall Cleanliness can be improved as well particularly on the toilets Overall Kuching Airport is a good and hasslefree airport to use

I was very impressed with the experience at Riga Airport So fast through security and no problems with my Japanese hair sticks which look like weapons on xrays Pleasant staff too which makes a real change Wish I could say the same for UK airports Good range of shops and helpful staff but some of the cafes are very expensive just for coffee and cake Slightly let down by toilets and desolate area C after passport control but generally very impressed compared to some nightmare experiences in the UK

We arrived on Monarch which was a great flight from London Gatwick on arrival to Mahon we swiftly disembarked into a very cool air conditioned Arrivals lounge where bags took no more than minutes to reach the conveyors Everything else went smoothly and we proceeded to car rental so all in all I estimate we were on are way to Villa less than an hour of arriving On the return had no problems at check in had a polite and friendly check in lady Aircraft was on time All in all a very good experience of Mahon airport from start to finish

CAA replacement for Thomas Cook flight repatriation back to the UK after firms collapse Staff were excellent plane a little dated but clean and spacious also under subscribed Comfortable great service thank you all

A small domestic airport in Taiwan Fast and friendly staff Surprisingly many shops Looked very clean Because this is a military airport too you can spot military aircraft taking off and land taking photos is forbidden though On time nonchaotic boarding and the plane took off in schedule Recommend
The area looks is not designed for such a huge passenger number some of the staffs are rude and unfriendly The terminal has a nice overview of the taxiways and runways

Tontouta International Airport is located km outside of Noumea If you catch a cab to the airport be prepared to pay for a twoway journey as cabbies are not guaranteed a return fare back into town Theres no point turning up early for your flight The airport only operates when flights are due to arrivedepart Checkin counters the small souvenir shop and cafe dont open till minutes prior to scheduled departures Duty free shopping is only available airside which can only be accessed minutes prior to departure Surprisingly smoking is permitted in all parts of the terminal In summary Tontouta is a very basic facility offering very basic services On a more positive note all the airports ground staff were exceptionally friendly helpful and good natured including checkin agents security immigration and customs officials

We were booked to take flights on Yangon in June A little concerned when we fronted the quaint little desk in Yangon to find it unattended but were assured that there are helpers at all Myanmar airports who take your bag to the desk and deal with it The next flights on Yangon were good Planes were all prop aircraft seating about I think we were on the same plane every time Seats are not allocated which worried us at first but it was not an issue The sticker to identify patrons in the departure lounge are a cute touch Nice little snack and drink no matter how short the flight Staff were friendly and helpful

Warsaw to Tallinn Our flight was in codeshare with LOT Polish Airlines Between our arrival and departure there were minutes gate opens mins before departure the ground crew worked very well so we could catch our Nordica flight to Tallinn with ease The seats are comfortable the legroom is more than okay Bigger meals and drinks are available on purchase but they serve complementary drinks coffee tea water and snacks chocolate bar The cabin crew was kind and the cabin was clean

A very shortened Flight due to favourable Tail Winds saw us arrive minutes early into Bangkok excellent My goal was just to sleep on this overnight flight That goal was achieved and a comfortable hours sleep was enjoyed The actual Seat was looking shabby old No Food or Drink were taken so I can not comment on the service Would fly Gulf Air again if going to the UK

Had a chance to fly Canadian North for the first time from Calgary to Inuvik in the Northwest Territories Check in friendly with no extra charge for my bags The aircraft was a Boeing which replaced the Fokker Flight Attendants were friendly attentive We were served a hot breakfast Return flight equally as pleasant with a hot dinner this time and free wine The service reminded me of the Wardair days I only wish that they flew across lower Canada as well

Such a cute and well designed airport I am very impressed the moment my flight from Malaysia landed I realized this airport is mainly used for private jets and my flight from Malaysia operated by Firefly Facilities look new and very well maintained Immigration process is very smooth as well as luggage delivery Its great to know theres another alternative to fly into Kuala lumpur

Hilo International Airport was once THE airport on the Big island before Kona International Airport on the other side of the island opened in the ss Now Hilo Airport is a shadow of its former self with jetways no more than of which are in use at any given time The decor is kitschy s Hawaiiana and the terminal is warm and welcoming Hilo is one of the few US airports where the gate area and the ticketingbag claim are in separate buildings separated by an atrium The ticketingbag claim area has a bar a bookshop a souvenir shop selling Hawaiiana and packaged tropical fruit and a lounge area The gate building has no facilities The parking and car rental areas are just across the street from bag claim and the total walk from gate to kerb is only a few hundred feet Access to and from Hilo town is easy and traffic is usually light

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him

Hargeisa to Djibouti Air Djibouti operates one single Boeing leased with crew from a company in Tajikistan as well as reportedly a few smaller aircraft We flew from Hargeisa to Djibouti in November The plane had arrived from Mogadishu with a delay but landed in JIB almost on time It was definitely at least years old but appeared to be in a very good state of repair Seats were tight but comfortable Catering consisted of a single bottle of water which was ok on this min hop Okay was also our general impression

OsloCopenhagen th Aug on a B Oslo Airport is shamelessly very pricey Timely arrived minutes prior to schedule smooth flight Easy superfast checkin in Oslo Granted nice soft roomy seats and a full row of loads of space Flight only half full Catering onboard good though only at hefty costs Ticket inexpensive No IFE WiFi or frills But no complaints the price does not allow for much complaints Boardingdeboarding very quick through jetbridges Aircraft and FAs were somehow aged but all worked effectively

Nauru to Pohnpei Small but friendly airline The seat configuration was and the legroom was OK for my ft frame No real inflight entertainment On the relatively shorthaul island hopping only snacks were served but there was beer and wine The best feature of this airline were the charming cabin crew clad in blue and I thought of them as Angels in Blue

Fortaleza Praia February The flight was operated in a reasonable B by no means new but not as rickety as I had been led to believe The seating was alleconomy and the leather seats fine but slippery Seat pitch was OK and I am a tall chap certainly an inch or more greater than its competitors The flight departed minutes late at and due to the hour I declined the meal offered which looked bland but edible We arrived in Praia on schedule and my bags did the same connecting to Sal and Mindelo without delay All in all a reasonable experience

This review covers only interisland travel On the whole it works pretty well The carousel checkin is OK I recommend printing your boarding pass in advance so its easier to access your reservation number First Class is a breeze Customer service if you need to make a change is very helpful although sometimes overwhelmed for the number of customers and the logistics could be improved TSA has always been swift especially if you have PreCheck and Ive found the agents to be friendly Departure gates could use more seating but boarding has always been prompt and efficient for my flights Arrivals are a breeze although sometimes it takes a bit longer for luggage to arrive The lounge is nothing special but clean and nice to use if you have access I usually only take a carryon and on the whole things work well

KigaliJoburg June in an old narrowbody B I was upgraded from an inexpensive economy ticket to business class by using miles in their Dream Miles Frequent Flyer Program Checkin and lounge access in Kigali smooth as usual Luggage was kindly checked in to final destination legs ahead on different tickets and airlines Thats a courtesy winner which hardly any European airlines can cope with Checkin issued my onward Boarding Passes on the spot which made my life easy by staying in transits throughout the journey enjoying entitlements and lounges instead of struggling with immigration and landside eg in South Africa Lounge in Kigali is good though still with room for minor improvements Boarding easy by walking m on tarmac directly to the aircraft The business seats were in rows in x configuration I had D to avoid direct exposure to the rising morning sun In economy seats are narrower and in x configuration Morning flight departed on time and arrived slightly early Onboard seating perfect special meal accommodated other hot meals offered were also good No drinks and no food menu provided Unclear what they actually had onboard for catering Drinks and wine selection sparse and modest However we were offered predeparture champagne Piper Heidshick FAs were generous pampering us well and of world class in kindness and attentiveness They might benefit from further airline exposures IFE is useless no headsets given Given FFP miles instantly according to my original booking Luggage well handled Cannot demand much more for regional flights in business class

I have taken flights on V Air and found it a surprisingly pleasant experience The aircraft seemed new the FAs were very efficient and the meals prebooked at a discount tasty On the latest TPECNX flight I measured the seat pitch at If this is accurate then it puts many of the long distance flights on legacy carriers to shame The first flight in May was held up an hour at TPE due to runway maintenance The other two this month both departed within minutes of the advertised schedule Its about time there were low cost carriers between BKK and TPE I will happily take V Air for future trips

ZHRGVAVCE and back Checkin at Zurich and Venice airport very quick and efficient Good connection times at Geneva airport much better than other carriers Flights departed on time and arrived early Flight Attendants very friendly both ways Flew over the Alps which was nice but small amount of food served on the flights Overall did the job Looking forward to my next trip with Darwin in July

Albury is a pleasant airport The staff are kind and knowledgeable There are gates departure and arrival The lines are short but it is still good to get in early The seats in the boarding lounges are somewhat comfortable When it comes to security its okay The airlines that you need to go through security for are Qantas and Virgin Australia but not Regional Express The terminal is clean especially the toilets The caf is overpriced but the food is ok The only shopping in the terminal is the caf Unlike most airports it is almost impossible to get lost in ABX The only drawback is that to get to and from the terminal to or from the plane you have to walk across the tarmac Out of all the airports I have been to ABX has been the best

Toluca Airport located about minutes away from Mexico City is a nice alternative to Mexico City Airport It mainly has flights within Mexico and limited service to the USA Florida Las Vegas Houston The best thing about this airport are the short lines Check in and security took less than minutes Its small but has a new feeling to it and covers the most basic needs It has a few shops and a Food court consisting of Subway Dominos hamburger joint and smoothly All seems clean and tidy Boarding is done via Airplane stairs and several ground transport options exist to Toluca and Mexico city

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum

We booked our return flight as a direct flight which was canceled and then simply staying in Paris We started more than hours later missed our connecting train were poorly provided with drinks unfortunately not a great experience Our direct flight to Colombo from Frankfurt was great very nice staff super on time

Its a small airport with the most basic of facilities but there were no delays in either direction I hope that means they have sorted out immigraton though it may be that my BA flight from London City arrived at a quiet time My only gripe is about one woman on security who was quite unfriendly when she told me I had to return to checkin because she didnt like the look of a vase I had in my carryon bag Otherwise the staff seemed quite friendly

I recently flew with China Southern Airlines from Gatwick Airport to Changchun Airport via Zhengzhou to visit my family in China As I bordered the Boeing I was greeted with kind flight attendants who directed me to my seat On my seat was a pillow a thin blanket and headphones for the inflight entertainment We departed on time around in the evening UK time There was meals served and many drinks services with a variety of drinks ranging from fruit juices alcohols beer fizzy drinks and waters The meals were served on trays made up of a warm main dish with a side dish such as vegies and a desert Overall the food was tasty and plentiful There was a wide variety of movies which included Chinese and Western movies in many languages there was also fun mini games and an inflight map showing the progress of our flight I would say my flight to Zhengzhou took around and a half hours The seats were reclinable and padded well In my opinion it was quite comfy and I fell asleep quickly after watching a movie The cushion was soft and surprisingly the blanket offered a good amount of warmth The bathrooms and seats were all cleaned and maintained well and overall the flight was relaxed and peaceful My only complaint is that the cabin was a bit warn out and old with some pieces of fabric missing from the front bit of my seat This did not serve as an issue to me it was only aesthetically unpleasing Another suggestion from me is to offer an amenity kit as the flight was long haul Overall I had an amazing experience with friendly staff delicious meals and extreme comfort and good entertainment that kept me busy

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes

Decent sized airport with friendly staff Arrivals area was pretty small but the airport itself was well connected to the city with the bus service running just a few steps outside the arrivals I travelled during the peak holiday season so was dreading departure from Glasgow but I was pleasantly surprised as the security was well managed and we went through smoothly The restaurants were bearing the brunt of the holiday season with not enough seating but it was still nice nonetheless
