Toykos nd airport smaller and closer to the city Arrival process OK but suffered from being rather manual with queues for immigration and then passport control despite offering online advanced registration Baggage reclaim quite quick Excellent transport links by bus train or taxi clear signs in Japanese and English Ticket Machines for trains ONLY take cash but do give change and are fantastic value for money Leaving Japan the process is very speedy with Bag Drop etc and then Security and automated passport gates There is a cafe on the Arrivals Level if you arrive too early to checkin or are waiting to be picked up on arrival Within the terminal is the usual array of shops and eating places focused more on the regionallocal travellers rather than the full Duty Free range of goods you might find elsewhere in the region Reasonable seating near the departure gates and overall quite quick turnround of planes

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance

Was on flight with Vietnam Airlines from Hanoi to OsakaKansai on its business class Nothing to complain as ground staff cabin crew were professional and offered the best that they could Seat was comfortable I chose the Japanese breakfast and found that it was somehow delicious Inflight entertainment surprisingly was excellent with new movies and music album No WiFI onboard even in business class which may be something the airline should consider to improve

My flight was to Milan from Toronto and return Checkin was fast the crew were polite and efficient on the ground and in flight For the most part both of my flights were on time just on the way back there was a delay of hours but Expedia had informed me through email days prior of my flight I was pleasantly surprised regarding the meals served on board to and from Italy not only you can choose from a menu but the food was delicious Also I found that choosing the option to pay for checked baggage on Air Italy site was much cheaper than paying at the airport I paid in Canadian dollars instead of euros I usually fly with Air Canada but Air Italy was much cheaper in comparison The only thing that I would appreciate is that when choosing the option to pay for my checked bag online that it would indicate checked baggage included at time of booking The flight was smooth and very pleasant I will definitely fly with Air Italy again in the near future

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

I used to live in Albany and have used this airport many times Albany is a really nice regional airport It is very close to the Interstate The standard parking is extremely convenient across an indoor footbridge no shuttles The airport is physically very appealing and flow through checkin to the gates is generally smooth Same on the return also note that rental car stuff seems to be a convenient arrangement as well ALB is as close to get there at the last minute and be OK as any these days B terminal is the nicest Of course this is a regional airport without many of the amenities of a large one The coffee shop and barrestaurant are better than most though I now live in LA and have a much greater hassle Burbank airport seems similar in size to Albany but Albany is much much nicer

Have flown with Air Canada many times and have always had a good experience Our last trip was to Florence via Zurich Flights LX out and LX in No issues whatsoever Check in was smooth boarding in Toronto was about the easiest we have experienced in a while seats were fine service was good The only minor issue was that the seatback in the seatback in front of me was broken somehow and I couldnt put the tray back easily Also whats with offering WiFi but only to Aeroplan members of a certain level I find that annoying Other that that everything was good

Departure from Memphis The airport was ok I regard it as the best airport I experienced during my trip much better than Newark EWR and better than Chicago OHare ORD The stores and restaurants was plentiful but the airport is quite small The staff was friendly and efficient It was also quite clean much better than the other airports I passed through this trip in the USA It was easy to navigate through too Many small airports are better than their reputation

Tontouta is a fairly basic international airport There are no skybridges so on arrival you descend the stairs and cross the tarmac to the single terminal and vice versa on departure Customs and immigration are fairly straightforward although a little bit of French will help The airport is a long way from Noumea so it is best to arrange a transfer with your hotel pre booking before you leave is the best Arc en ciel was the best company we thought Heading back out is always a nightmare at Tontouta there is no order for anything Customs is always straightforward when departing Only a small duty free on the other side and only cafe not much to do There are no tv screens or monitors for the flights You just have to rely on the French announcements and a piece of paper at the gate Overall was a good experience and a very good airport for a small tropical island

My family and I were due to travel with Phuket airlines in July this year Gatwick Bangkok In January I started to get concerned with the number of cancellations and late flights I then discovered the Skytrax site and am extremely grateful to all of you who have posted comments In January I re booked with Thai Airlines with whom we have previously travelled it appears to be an extra expense well worth making

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

I had booked this fare at a very discounted rate as I needed to travel back to BLR The check in experience was good I had arrived early and there was still time for check in to open so I was told to wait for mins before check in in my luggage Post that I had noticed that the inbound was delayed due to which the departure was also slightly delayed by mins The crew were welcoming and this flight was not completely full During boarding I had noticed that a lot of people had come with trolleys and they were told to check in their luggage which is good as a lot of folks come carrying big trolleys that just block the cabin overhead bins The flight tried to make time en route and landing in BLR was swift along with luggage retrieval One point to note here is that the seat pitch may be on the tighter side compared to other airlines but otherwise this was a good trip where the crew also distributed water bottles to everyone during boarding

I had a pleasant experience on my Teheran Mehrabad to Shiraz flight It was a little bumpy due to weather but a delicious packed snack and drink were served for the short flight All the crew were very friendly and are a credit to their airline The A EPIEG was clean with a decent seat pitch for my foot frame and I was given a row of seats to myself All in all a very nice company who charged a very reasonable for my one way ticket I wish Iran Air the very best with each new addition to their expanding fleet and this wont be the last time I fly Iran Air

Overall I find Guadalajara Airport to be quite user friendly with helpful staff a decent variety of restaurants cafes and shops Security lines are usually efficient and quick Terminals clean and plenty of seating space Several airline lounges and affordable ground transportation options to the city center and nearby areas One of the easiest Mexican airports to navigate

Estonian Air TallinnCopenhagen June Flew Tallinn Copenhagen in flex class premium economy which means free meal and bar service kgs of luggage and flexibility to change tickets The food consisted of smoked salmon on a slice of bread a small but fresh salad and an appetizing Sacher cake Not too much but enough for the hr minute flight Swift boarding and disembarkation aircraft clean and fresh newspapers available friendly staff clear safety announcements over good audio system and interesting inflight magazine to while the time away Estonian Air is a small and pleasant regional airline

After reading some of the reviews here I was expecting a real hellscape but instead I found a functional if not very exceptional airport with no real issues for me beyond all the walking more about that later I was arriving from and returning to the US through Terminal using United Airlines traveling at what appeared to be busy times for arrival and departure Arrival was uneventful with a quick trip through immigration The terminal seemed well organized and signed ATMS will give you pounds Euros or dollars I was taking an express bus to Belfast which meant going through a labyrinth of covered walkways in the ground transportation area outside the terminaldespite being able fit and used to walking a lot at home this was more than what I wanted after an overnight flight and the signage could have been betterit was easy to get off track The ground transportation area looks like an former surface lot repurposed for shuttles long and shortdistance buses etc Some areas serve both terminals such as those for hotels while others are meant to serve Terminal or Regardless a lot of walking Ditto on departure Departure was easy and went quicklyimmigration and security didnt have much in the way of lines Security had less of the militant hurry up and wait I usually experience in the US and elsewhere There could have been better spaces for putting bags and gear back together after security but otherwise fine There was less in the way of shopping and food service than I expected If you live in a place that heavily taxes liquor you might find some values but otherwise the prices werent great though not as bad some airports Ive used The seating was adequate although it tended to be toward the end of the shopping area The currency exchange couldnt change my leftover pounds to dollars wo converting them to Euros which seemed ridiculous given that theres a nother country that uses Pounds on the island US Customs is available about hours before your flight There wasnt much of a line and I didnt have to go through security a second time I didnt know if this was because of Global Access but it meant I didnt have to give up my water yes they dont let you bring water through this checkpoint Immigration also was quick although it was easy to miss the path to Global Access The US terminal has an abbreviated set of shops and a caf so you can wait until your gate to buy water I didnt see a currency exchange or ATM The gates are posted once you pass customs and immigration The seating was adequate unless you were boarding a jumbo jet This was the one part of the airport where I saw moving walkways but the whole process of getting there involved a lot of walking The general tone of things was more businesslike than friendly which was fine with me Not a bad airport overall but it would be a lot better with less walking

A small airport maybe or passengers a day I am guessing Fifteen flights a day AA to CLT and DFW DL to ATL And UA to DEN and IAH The plusses Fast From drop off to gate in maybe minutes max Friendly staff especially at TSA Small town helpfulness had a cell phone left on a plane returned to the check in desk before I got there to ask for lost and found Nice new departure hall and baggage claim Very airy with lots of light Low cost parking for friends picking me up The minuses The airfares They border on extortionate Many times cheaper to fly from MIA to Europe than to Shreveport And UA AA and DL always seem to have the exact same air fare The local chamber of commerce should work on that Concourses are dated Industrial carpeting remember that Looks like they have not been refreshed since the s Odd quirky amateur art and movie posters and house plants maybe a positive No discount carriers like Spirit Jet Blue Frontier or SWA No mainline jets just smallish regional planes

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

Wonderful regional airline from Luebeck I had a chance to try this airline and the experience was quite comfortable Boarding procedure is in order and each passenger must disinfect hands The legspace is good and cabin is simple yet neat The crew were happy to engage with passengers and the best part was that they serve a small meal on each flight I really appreciate that and the meal was simple yet very tasty and filling You can even book a veggie meal while booking flight Beyond what LH can even offer on regional flights While deboarding they served caramel candies This experience with Lbeck Air took me back to old school days which I miss terribly in aviation world Keep up the standards and service because this will set you apart

My wife was carrying few items which were not allowed due to their oversize more than ml The officer obviously had to throw them away before she goes through the security I was very upset to know as these items were medicated and not readily available I called the airport to enquire about the items and was to know that the items were disposed off in the trash I again called today and able to talk to the relevant person He was very helpful and took the pains and advised the supervisor Within half an hour I was called by the Sergeant who break the news that they found both the items Obviously I was overjoyed and so grateful to the efforts made by the energetic and helpful staff at the Cork airport

My wife and I had the most magnificent experience on Sunday th July when we took a scenic flight with Loch Lomond Seaplanes from Cameron House on Loch Lomond The pilot and staff were exemplary the take off and landing as smooth as operating on tarmac and the inflight commentary first class The day was perfect as we flew over Gare Loch Loch Long Holy Loch Loch Striven Kyles Of Bute Tighnabruaich Loch Fyne along the Crinan Canal and finally turned over the Gulf of Corryvreckan where we saw the infamous whirlpool I cannot praise the whole operation highly enough

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule

We recently flew business class New Delhi to Paro and Paro to Bangkok with Druk Air They are a fantastic little airline being only one of two airlines serving Bhutan We were on a trip via Delhi to Paro for nights and then onto Bangkok Both flights on time lounges were shared and and of a good standard Both flights considering Paro being one of the worlds most difficult airports to land in were flawless by the flight deck some amazing views en route and pointed out by the crew Food and beverage were of a high standard and plentiful for hour flights combined with excellent service from very professional and and delightful Bhutanese crew Would certainly use again Only point out being there is no Entertainment or wifi but the views en route you dont need it

MIAT Mongolian Airlines from Berlin via Moscow Sheremetyevo to Ulaanbaatar Well over h queuing in TXL despite web checkin There was no separate line for baggage drop Long lines at the entrance to the hopelessly overcrowded departure lounge at the gate let to a delayed start Further nuisance in Moscow where pax were forced to leave the plane for passport control only to return into the same plane thereafter Not sure if the above is under MIAT control The actual flight was reasonably pleasant The ageing seemingly well looked after was filled to the last seat Crew was efficient but not overly friendly or extra hospitable The IFE was functional but the film selection rather limited and headset quality poor The seats were tight but not uncomfortable I found the food surprisingly decent and the drinks Austrian wine and Mongolian beer actually very good The crew offered soft drinks very frequently which I consider important on a hjourney Immigration in ULN was swift and friendly and put TXL to shame Return was direct from ULN to FRA h again on a full with similar onboard experience Overall I found the journey with MIAT quite ok but not worth raving about

I was here on a stopover on the way to Bangkok I didnt have too many problems and the terminal wasnt that crowded it was early morning Also free internet worked well which was helpful Staff seemed friendly though not really helpful The toilets were overcrowded and not clean Not many shops or restaurants that I saw Overall this airport is nothing to right home about but my experience wasnt that bad Qatar airways is a good airline and hopefully the new airport in Doha is better than Doha international

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

Very nice small airport located outside Rzeszw easily accesible by the bus from the city center inside the airport was not busy during the time of travel took less than minutes to go through security A duty free shop and a bar available however a very good lounge is avaiable too at a very good price around PLN with very comfortable waiting area and very good selection of drinks and snacks Overall I recommend going from this airport

Changi Airport looking dated but the SQ lounge was outstanding Big working areas excellent shower facilities nice bar plenty of good tasting food spotlessly clean good atmosphere The business class seat lounging and sleeping positions are not comfortable and the seats controls did not work quickly Difficult to use power outlets complicated storage areas sleeping in a diagonal position with very small foothole The IFE feels old with limited choice No live TV Worst deterioration when compared to their past offering was the food beverages Limited choice main course tasted bland and premium drinks served in small sodatype glasses no dining on demand Luckily the complimentary wifi worked well

A typical Ryanair airport Small and miles from anywhere although perhaps suitable for the Alps and skiing access or unless you have relatives nearby However it meant that from the plane to the car hire desk was about metres and we were on our way less than minutes after landing If you need a train the station is literally metres from the terminal door Its not an architectural gem the seating is limited and hard but it has a cafe and a shop and its efficient and has what you need The staff were friendly and allowed us to board first on our return to the UK as my wife had a broken hand in plaster As long as the plane is on time it does the job well

Well where to start Simple straight forward helpful staff at Gatwick They given the passes for the lounge and fast track security The lounge was fairly quiet and so was security mind you it was am on a Monday morning Boarding was quick and once in the seat the service was first class with a team of crew looking after the Premier Economy cabin while waiting we were offered Sparkling wine or Orange Juice Once we had reached cruising height we had the first drinks service and our order for lunch was taken The choices been Sausage and Mash Thai Green Chicken Curry and rice and a Veggie option After lunch which was about hours into the flight and we had another drinks service The Cabin Service Manager then announced that should anyone want more drinks please ring the call bell We had the duty free trolley pass though the cabin about minutes from landing we were served a tea meal of sandwiches scones jam and a drink of our choice You also have a pillow and blanket bottle of water on both legs and you are given amenity kit on the outward leg to use on both legs The head phones are collected at the end of both legs Next thing we knew we were starting our descent into Cancun The return flight was the same format but the food was local sourced but was a choice of beef stew and mash Chicken and Potatoes or the Veggie Option The food was tasty and afterwards the cabin lights were dimmed to allow people to sleep Any drinks etc were ordered from your seat by ringing the call bell We did have a duty free trolley service whilst waiting for the hot meal About minutes before landing we had a breakfast service of Omelette Tomato and Hash Brown which was very nice Next thing we were on finals to land at Gatwick I think the TUI premier economy product is very good value for money the inflight entertainment is very good and has a good range of films TV games music Would I travel Premier Economy again Yes

I recently flew with Aeromexico for the first time with my husband and year old son and we had an exceptional experience From checking in to landing the customer service was topnotch The flight attendants were attentive and kind We were incredibly surprised by the meal we got when we were expecting just a snack It consisted of yogurt fruit cocktail eggs with bacon and vegetables or waffles accompanied by a drink and bread On our return flight we enjoyed a satisfying pasta dinner meal The flight entertainment system was also impressive offering a wide selection of new movies TV series cartoons and music We appreciated the free earphones which allowed us to enjoy the entertainment options without disturbance The aircrafts cleanliness was notable with spotless bathrooms and a well maintained cabin Overall our experience with Aeromexico was outstanding and we would highly recommend them to anyone We look forward to flying with them again in the future

Sat th Dec we sat in departure lounge for hrs with no information from pm Eventually we board pm and told we are being diverted to Madrid to change crews A hour later we are told we are being booked into a hotel in Madrid for the night and flying home in the morning Then the story changed to the hotel has been cancelled and were booking you into a hotel in Gran Canaria go collect your luggage and meet us At a EasyJet rep told us we cant get you a hotel goodnight and check your app for your rearranged flight home We watched the staff leave for there booked accommodation Unable to find a bed we ended up on a beach for the night Our rearranged flight was originally for but left at After numerous apologies from the captain we was offered a free teacoffee or water as a good will gesture but they had no food left as the plane wasnt restocked Landed hrs later The biggest disgrace is they have denied compensation and blamed air traffic control extraordinary circumstances pp Yet two of us have had different excuses I have ATC report confirming they are not being honest I have ATC report showing every flight landing that evening into Gatwick except only one cancelled was ours including Easyjet flights yet they said it was passenger safety Easyjet are a disgrace

Zurich to Ljubljana Very poor customer service Flight was cancelled without sending any email confirmation The flight I was rebooked seemed to be overbooked at the beginning which was not trueand we had to wait min to have our ticket changed Very bad experience overall

Paris to San Francisco Extremely sketchy airline They cancelled our flight back from Paris due to operational difficulties and said they could only book us on a flight days later They would not refund us the money for the flight even though they could not offer anything even close to what we booked Their customer service just sent us in circles call this number call back tomorrow submit a ticket here email this address call this other number The company hides behind their phone reps having them continuously say The company has issued a statement saying they will not refund anyones money for the flight If you cancel a flight and can only replace it with a flight two days later you better give customers the opportunity to take a refund

Mandalay International Airport was built at the turn of the st century It serves both domestic and international destinations and is designed like many airports around the world it just works slightly differently somehow Arriving on a domestic flight you are bussed into the single terminal building where you walk passed unmanned Passport Control Desks to one of baggage carousels before having your baggage hand and hold scanned and into a large Arrivals Hall with the usual selection of booths and a small cafshop selling bottled water There are TV Screens showing which flights are coming or going Marble floors and air conditioned Departures start with the need to scan all you bags hand and hold before going to Checkin Counters which are clearly numbered in banks A B C and D After this is the a boarding pass check and into the Departure Hall which is upstairs Checkin and arrivals are on the ground floor There is a large selection of shops and a couple of barcafes not all of which are open for domestic flights Security Scanning is done at the gate and Gate seems to be where all the domestic flights leave from via a pier down to a bus In the Gate area there are no shops or toilet facilities just rows of seats looking out on to the apron and in the distance the runway parallel to the terminal building The airport is larger than the current traffic levels so it does not feel crowded or too busy but it has a new feeling that none of the other airports in Burma Myanmar have

I recently flew business class on Turkish Airlines from JFK New York to Istanbul and unfortunately my experience was far from what I expected The aircraft felt outdated with uncomfortable seats The cabin temperature was unbearably high turning the entire hour flight into a sauna While the food was passable I found it below the standard of other airlines business class offerings My connecting New York to Rochester flight was canceled with no assistance from Turkish Airlines No automatic rebooking No refund or apology I had to book a sameday ticket on a different airline at my own expense just to get home Reaching customer service was a nightmare they were dismissive unhelpful and indifferent Each call ended with them simply asking me to leave feedback on their website Emails were ignored and when I finally spoke to a ground agent they were rude and uncooperative Despite multiple attempts I received no refund no compensation and no resolution This level of service is unacceptable especially for a businessclass passenger I will never fly Turkish Airlines again
Parking is extremely expensive at Torp Sandefjord Airport NOK Approx an hour better to go to OSL No customs staff available for customs refund of VAT

My pregnant wife me and my month old daughter try to fly from Orlando to Bogota We arrived at the Airport on time and went to the self check in counter There we could not check in because of my daughter So we got redirected to the counter where we waited in line We were second in line before they stopped the line to check in people for different flights with a last call Costa Rica We still had enough time so we waited Once we got to the counter they told us it is too late and we wont be able to fly According to the Supervisor we did not reacted to the last call for Bogota which never was announced My parents in law stood with us in line and also never heard a last call for Bogota We told them we heard Costa Rica but never Bogota Their answer was that if we heard Costa Rica the call for Bogota was much earlier Weird because we heard Costa Rica and still had min until boarding Spirit policy is that they make the last call min prior to boarding So they must have made their last call way to early and not at the correct time They rebooked us for a flight the next day But we wanted to fly out that day because we already drove hours to the airport and have people waiting for us in Bogota So we asked if we can get a full refund if we look for other airlines to fly out that day The supervisor confirmed the refund So we booked a different airline and canceled the rebooked flight for Spirit for the next day They never wanted to give me a printed confirmation of that cancelation They said I have to trust their word We never got the refund and they say we were a No Show

Transferred from a flight from Tokyo All passengers had to reenter security by design which is annoying in itself but the real issue is how this was handled Security was lightly staffed and very thorough which created long wait times But the biggest issue was the personnel and system which was extremely inefficient and especially at some lines From when I placed the bag on the belt to when I could leave with my luggage it took more than minutes and only with standard checks A record by far Would have missed my flight if the time between flights wasnt so long Terrible experience

I have flown with Thomson now Tui before to the Canaries and it has always been okay The staff are friendly and there was very expensive food and drinks on offer should you want to buy anything My biggest issue on my latest flight was the size of the seat There was literally no leg room I am only and my knees were touching the seat in front and they were so narrow they were almost impossible to sit in When I was told to put my bag under the seat in front it left nowhere for my legs It was the most uncomfortable four hours of my life never again

Was booked in as requiring Disabled Assistance with processing through departures Due to the Covid problems paperwork required to depart the airport after our holiday The company I booked and payed for the Covid day test failed to give me a code for the Passenger Location form I spent days of our holiday just trying to get this code Without this form we could not fly home Finally just before pickup time I finally got this code and partially film of two of the forms I thought thats great can finish the two at the airport How wrong I was got to the stage they were calling us on the speakers I cannot thank the two young Special assistance girls at the desk We managed to board the plane mins before take off time Had they not been so understanding and helpful we would not have flown home Zante Airport you have brilliant workers on the Disabled Special Assistance

Luton Airport always used to be a joke and it still is as far as queue management is concerned As you approach Security old young and infirm are forced to walk up and down unnecessarily for miles between taped barriers even when there is hardly anyone waiting to go through Security Staff with ironically Im here to help yellow teeshirts stand aimlessly around and rather than helpfully opening and closing the queuing lanes as demand dictates their job seems limited to shouting at anyone who has the temerity to duck under a barrier even when there is noone in front of them When challenged one of the staff unhelpfully stated if you dont like it you can buy Fast Track ie pay more to avoid walking needlessly backwards and forwards clearly this is the managements intention to make life difficult for most passengers Awful customer service come on Luton Airport time to up your game

Srinagar Airport is quite an experience but then so is the whole of Kashmir for Europeans travelling there The airport is currently in the process of being rebuilt so arrivals are processed in what can only be described as a shed Departures use the halffinished terminal where it is impossible to hear announcements due to the deafening construction noise There is dust and noise everywhere although it looks as if it might be quite nice when its finished Be prepared to be repeatedly screened monitored searched and grilled every couple of steps along the way by a mixture of airport staff troops and military police and dont expect them to be polite or friendly they are not

Horrible level of customer facing employees in Riyadh station today I was flying to Dubai I came minutes prior to the flight time I approached the supervisor he directed me to stay in the queue the line took me minutes to reach the counter then I was surprised that the flight got closed when I re approached the supervisor his tune of voice and attitude was so rude with shameful level of professionalism I approached the station Manager their he refused to state his name or title and did not even listen to my complaints I am so shocked by the quality of Flynass front line employees beside losing my flight to Dubai which is my smaller issue I felt badly directed and unheard when I had an issue

Security rude and disrespectful I am a senior and passed through security as usual Generally I am very pleased that the security check is made as it gives a feeling of safety while flying Much to my regret and have to say some negative comments regarding the check I had to run through The start was very normal but continuation was pretty rude as the woman in charge spoke German without asking me if I could understand it or not She showed me that I had to place my shoes on a little a little step than she asked something in German I got as she was asking me to take off my shoes for inspection which I did Than she started screaming at me and wanted me to put on my shoes again and show only the bottom soles of the shoes without any possibility to hold myself for securing this position I am a frequent flyer and this was the first time I had this type of rude behavior toward a senior

We recently flew from Santorini to Rome on Blue Panorama airlines Upon arriving at checkin we were forced to pay an additional E to Blue Panorama due to the fact that my wifes middle name was not shown on the actual booking For clarity her name appeared as it does on her passport the booking was in their system but it merely did not have her middle name shown on the booking I explained that her legal identity was the same as the booking and showed multiple forms of identification to no avail I am not sure how this could be the case but we were nevertheless forced to pay this extra amount of E We witnessed other passengers being stung in a similar fashion and one family of four was forced to pay E When I objected I was told no pay no fly This is outrageous and amounts to no more than theft and is in my opinion a complete scam being operated by this airline

Both flights I took from Thessaloniki to Athens return had a delay The aircraft was tiny and the air condition was blowing warm air It really felt like a bus The cabin crew was professional kind and tried to counterbalance this mess The ticket was a bit cheaper relative to other companies but very expensive considering the level and the quality of service provided

The flight departed on time but arrived minutes late The legroom and comfort was OK The food is average The ground staff is helpful I would recommend this The inflight entertainment was fun and engaging The only major thing is the flight WiFi is bad

This airport has to be the worst in Europe Not only does it have the least courteous staff in the Swissport staff at the desks typically French in attitude but the airport itself is dated uncomfortable and disorganised There is no or very little seating so people sit on the ground taking up corridor space Your food and beverage offering is minimal slow and abysmal for an international airport Your baggage handling system and technology is not fir for purpose as demonstrated on a recent flight that was cancelled to Copenhagen where it took you hours to get bags off an aircraft that hadnt even left Your airports treatment of passengers on a cancelled flight was shameful and a total abdication of passenger care responsibility I would rather fly to Zurich and take a train than ever fly through your dreadful airport again The only positive area of your airpot is the Business Centre which I used for the second time Efficient courteous functional and professional The rest is a disaster

This local airline is expensive compared to other local airlines To our surprise when we checked in at the airport they told us that we needed to pay extra for luggage Cost the of us an extra AU Check in took almost and a half hour Cabin crew did not have a smile as though they did not want to be there We flew Citilink that was much cheaper and included luggage Avoid this airline at all cost when travelling in Indonesia

Terrible airport Rude staff who outright lie Ridiculously long immigration queues even for those with an onward boarding pass I was last here in March Missed my connecting flight because immigration queue was hours hours Tried to speak tomorrow staff One lied to me and said that the connecting flight was also delayed not true as it turned out One simply looked at me as though I was crazy and said I dont know when I asked her a question and walked off I have gone out of my way to avoid this airport since but was forced to use it again Sincerely hope that this proves to be a better experience Puts the country to shame unfortunately

From going into departures the man at check in never spoke and did not ask any security questions not sociable at all Did not stop there also in E Gates they were talking to people aggressively who were having difficulty using the new system Not going on holiday for that

This airport is one of the worst in the world plagued by senseless security checks and disgusting toilets The toilets are filthy beyond belief with floors covered in vomit broken fixtures and foul odors that hit you the moment you step in Many toilets are unusable with no toilet paper and the sinks are caked in dirt making it impossible to wash your hands properly Its a complete lack of hygiene Theres also zero respect for women and people in wheelchairs making this an awful experience The staff are unprofessional and shockingly even in the unsanitary toilets people are asking for tips Despite the country relying on tourism they treat visitors like animals The atmosphere is hostile with staff shouting and making rude degrading comments After four visits this is definitely my last trip to Egypt You have no idea how many people wont be returning after being treated this way

Literally the worst airport experience Ive ever had My plane arrived after a hour flight Passport control took HOURS Three plane loads of people came into the hall and they had four members of staff working Even the EU passport line was going out the door and took hours Never ever using this airport again Added to which when I eventually got through security trying to find a clean seat to rest for a while before my journey home was impossible filth everywhere on almost every section of seats Bad management is the cause of this How can you expect border control staff to deal with such huge queues Awful

Starting from the journey from Johannesburg the flight was delayed by hrs The return flight was even worse They cancelled the ticket and issued a new one for the following day On the following day we went to Checkin and we were denied boarding They said we didnt have a ticket even though they issued it We were stuck in Dubai in December now needing to book a new hotel find a new flight and no compensation from the airline even though they caused this problem Dont take Air Tanzania if you know whats good for you

We had a total delay of hours Were about to take off and somehow we come back to parking spot because the airplane is too heavy so they can remove some luggage Ridiculous I cant believe this is happening Never ever agin with this airline

Gatwick to Lanzarote Short queue at Gatwick checkin staff were polite Boarding process fine Plenty of overhead locker space as flight not full Departed about mins late as passenger failed to board and bags had to be found and removed from aircraft Announcements from front of cabin and cockpit were clear Announcements from rear of cabin totally unintelligible Announcements in english only Smooth flight Cabin crew professional No attempt at interaction with customers unless you wanted to buy something Typical uncomfortable hard nonadjustable seats Leg room was OK for a m cm adult Clean aircraft Clean well stocked toilet when I used it No bells and whistles but they get the basics right for the price paid Would use again

This whole airport experience was a complete and utter joke The debacle began the second we left the plane where we were subjected to long queues and no apparent wifi connectivity The staff slap a sticker on you without consent and herd you like cattle to the transit area The best description of the transit area is a skeleton Yes it is modern and clean with the initial appearance of many shops and restaurants but spend more than minutes there and you will realise there is hardly anywhere to eat where the food is inedible and there is hardly anywhere to shop and the staff dont speak English So to pass the time we decided to splurge on entry into the airport lounge However we were told in broken English that they only accept Chinese yuan for entry Slightly annoyed we asked where we could withdraw cash or exchange foreign currency the staff member advised there was no ATMs nor currency exchange outlets in the airport So if you want to spend more than minutes in a place with barely any edible food a smoking room resembling a scene from Black Mirror Gulaglike environment covered with security cameras and that simply makes you hate life then I recommend a transit at Shanghai Pudong

It is specific for Delta Airline Checkin process staff at JFK airport My flight was to Seattle on July afternoon pm I checkedin online before I headed to JFK Airpot and so I did not have too much time before departure time In security check point the officer told me that the birth date in my ticket My son booked the ticket for me It is hisour fault I know is not the same as that in my driver license So he asked me to go back to the checkin point for correction The waiting line in the checkin Maybe most of them are for checking in baggages while I do not have that day is super long If I lined up from the end I probably I will miss the flight So I talked to staff around the checkin area It was so crowded Someone said you go to there pointing Totally I talked to difference people around that area Still no one is responsible for my issue They were saying differently It seems I have to line up from the end In the end I stick on one lady She said I understand your situation I can do nothing about it She hinted me I have to line up again Finally I have to cut into the line by some peoples kindness to allow me to cut into the middle of the line I am OK to line up even it is long if I did not check in online I would leave more time to do that My question is For this kind of special situation should Delta Airline have some specific rules to handle would you like the custom to miss their flight Thanks

When arriving at the airport in a taxi I was met by a very nice viewing point for people to watch aircrafts taking off and landing My flight was from NQY to LHR when Flybe was still alive when I entered the airport there were check in desks and a caf right there so not at all difficult to find them when arriving with only hours of sleep at am I had already checked in online so I went straight into security which was very conveniently in the next room It took about minutes to get through security and into the Airports Lounge On first impressions it was quite small with not really much to do but what more can you expect for a local Airport There was only places where you could buy stuff in the departure lounge which was a caf and a Cornish shop that sells Cornish alcoholic beverages and other snacks and the caf sold quite a few things but I only got a water bottle which I think was around There were also toilets which were kept to a reasonably well standard and we boarded our flight with no problems and took off about minutes after departure time

I went there and they did only not notify about my flight being canceled but when I got there they told me that my flight was moved to the Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport First things first Allegiant does not fly out of Sky Harbor and I found that out the hard way I went back into the Mesa airport and yelled out hello very loudly A lady came out and said shes new and In training as well as the other guy I spoke to I ended up coming from Tucson Arizona So I ended up traveling well over miles and all they had to say was sorry we are Under Staffed I could care less whats going on Do your homework and job instead of making excuses and lies for something you know nothing about I asked for a Hotel and shuttle for the inconvenience and they also said its out of our control and this happens sometimes Very unpleasant experience Absolute disregard and care for customers

Small airport checkin was quick and big smiles and friendly checkin agents Security took forever slow process and flight was early am departure so maybe that is why I cant imagine when KLM has a here and they are clearing people compared to a on Surinam Airlines Gate area is small and there are quite a few shops some were closed this early but when they are all open there are plenty of options No jetbridges so you get the experience of walking on the tarmac to your plane Toilets clean and prices in the shops reasonable Arrival is slow with immigration but bags were delivered quickly Plane parked close to the terminal and it was pouring with rain no umbrellas provided but wasnt too bad Airport is minutes from Paramaribo on a road with many speedbumps that is the biggest negative about the airport especially when your flight arrives at midnight and you dont get to your hotel until after am

Holguin to Havana last week Okay apart from issuing duplicate boarding cards to different passengers Return was in a turbo prop plane which was hour late and was infested by cockroaches running along the floor overhead lockers and electrical ducts The plane was generally dirty Obvious lack of maintenance

This place is the pits Ever since they took over which is several years ago the owners impose an Airport Development Tax ADT of per person Yes if you are going to be back in less than weeks it entitles you to free parking how can a tax of per head be free on a quagmire at best with absolutely no security The tax was allegedly to develop the airport hence the name but every cent of it goes into the pockets of the Directors Not a single penny has been spent on improvements The owners will argue that the place has been improved and it has However the franchises that use the place duty free cafe newsagents etc all paid for the improvements so dont believe the owners The place is also filthy and cold and when it rains they have to use buckets to collect rainwater As for the security and checkin staff the checkin staff turn up when they feel like it and the security staff are rude and surly and totally objectionable Completely different to the pleasant and helpful staff at Manchester

Worst airport experience ever We arrived hours before departure and there was no check in or bag drop Check in finally showed as opened less than hours before our flight but we had to stand for over an hour in a confused crowd of hundreds of people as the three check in staff tried to first funnel through all passengers for a flight that left just minutes before ours without having separated the two flight queues or directing the two flight queues to separate desks The result was chaos queue jumping confusion and bad tempers all round including an extremely nasty check in lady screaming at passengers and insisting on measuring peoples carry on handbags even as the situation around her descended into farce We waited for an hour and mins before we could finally drop off our bags that were already checked in online before having to race through security and passport control we didnt even have time to go to the toilet before having to board the plane Security and gate staff were either stressed and rude or oblivious and standing around chatting instead of helping Security and gate staff were totally unaware of what passengers had been through in the check in hall or maybe they simply didnt care I saw one staff member at passport control scolding passengers for being late the same passengers who had been stranded for hours trying to check their bags in There wasnt a manager or supervisor in sight all morning Everyone on our plane was upset furious or stressed especially those travelling with young children Other delights included no luggage trolleys in the drop off zone broken vending machines and broken lifts and escalators we helped one single parent carry their babys buggy down two flights of stairs because none of the lifts worked and no staff wanted to help Avoid this airport at all costs its a horrendous experience

Flown this route return or times Of course a visitor to Guernsey has no choice the airline has a monopoly The flights themselves were only an hour and uneventful Aurigny flight team is usually OK Not rude but not terribly friendly either My last trip the Guernsey airport staff was a very bad dream They treated me like a suspected terrorist Im a pastmiddleaged solo female traveler Kept me until the plane was completely boarded I was the last one allowed on board They opened my suitcase and removed every single item They turned my book upside down and flipped the page looking for who knows what I fully expected sniffer dogs at some point Since the trip itself had been stressful horrendous weather hotel room robbed this last insult was so upsetting I was finally allowed on the plane but fighting tears The flight attendant was nasty and gave me a look for holding everyone up

Booked seats one way from Phnom Penh to Siem Reap on the Bassaka Air web site which only seem to be released month in advance FAs were very attentive in helping store luggage reasonable English spoken Cabin announcements were clear seat comfort was okay The flight is only minutes with take off and landing but they still were able to serve given either juice or water On time flight I would fly with Bassaka Air again good price ticket US with taxes

This is one of the newer Indian airports though unfortunately unlike BLR BOM DEL etc you wouldnt know it Its handicapped by a design that was inadequate in size and not well planned While theres a fair amount of shopping it occupied so much space that the passenger concourse feels congested even on a lowtraffic Saturday morning The airport isnt particularly well maintained It looks clean but thats about it Service standards from the entry to the airportstaffed check in and boarding staff are remarkable by their lack of enthusiasm lack of politeness and lackadaisical pace of work If theyve had much training it was very inadequate

Unprofessional business practices flawed customer service failure to provide services as advertised complete refusal to provide refunds I was booked a flight PHX MSP MCO by my employer The flight to MSP was delayed over an hour due to a controllable error on behalf of Sun Country which caused me to miss my connecting flight to MCO There was another Sun Country flight to MCO from the same terminal I was denied access to this flight because the attendant wasnt allowed to rebook at the gate The flight took off with empty seats in it and me stuck in MSP I was told my checked bag was at MCO by Sun Country representatives I would later come to find this was a lie I was offered a rebook that would have me landing at MCO hours after the original flights landing this was not an option as I had my brothers wedding to attend as his best man I was refused all options to be rebooked on a different airline despite the fact that I was inconvenienced by Sun Country on a mistake that was solely their fault I accepted a voucher for the cost of the flight and figured my employer could keep the voucher and pay me the cost of a rebook with Frontier I rebooked with Frontier and then was informed moments before boarding my new flight that my bag was in MSP Apparently without my consent the bag was refunded as well and left sitting in MSP without my knowledge I only learned because I was called by a Sun Country representative while at the gate to depart with Frontier Sun Country refused to send my bag to Orlando using the voucher I had to leave the terminal grab my bag check it and pay it outofpocket to Frontier and then get back to my gate before departure During this process Sun Country failed to locate me on all online platforms to offer support as the ticket was purchased by someone else on my behalf and I did not have access to their purchasing card information or personal email despite having my ID flight information and personal information to complete an account lookup Avoid flying with Sun Country at all costs

The worst airline in the world in terms of dealing My husband and I traveled from Zanzibar to Entebbe and back on flight number UR from Sep I booked online seats with space in front of them because my husband has a broken leg and needs space to stretch it The airline employees changed the seats and gave us other seats without explaining the reasons or even apologizing knowing that the seats we booked were given to healthy young passengers They changed our reserved seats to other narrow one The plane is very small we can said is nothing more than a luxury bus its price is very expensive compared to the fare it covers and the services provided It has no advantage other than that it is a direct flight from Zanzibar to Entebbe I dont recommend traveling on this airline

New York to Palermo Italy From the moment we confirmed this flight by paying last April had the sinking feeling it was a mistake It is almost impossible to reach airline representatives by phone and if you do it may be returned voice mail hours after you call Seat assignment process was difficult and reviews of performance not good Yesterday the hammer dropped Interminable wait to board our flight in New York JFK then an announcement it had been cancelled A sort of Keystone Cop melee to get passengers into nearby hotel Must say this place is good We are waiting this next morning to see if they fly us out today Meanwhile we missed a prearranged day tour of Palermo scheduled for tomorrow AM So unless you really have to save money and dont mind uncertainty and a sort of make it up as we go philosophy and a tiny airline that has no planes on back up fly Meridiana Otherwise do not book with Meridiana

Brand new airport that looks pretty nice but housekeeping services are poor in and outside the airport They tried to make it local Kansas City restaurants only so dont look for a Starbucks you wont find one Seating at gates is sufficient with work table space as well
Airport very cold No restaurant no coffee shop and no drinks machine smoking area very far from from the gate The announcements are not understandable Very bad experience

After booking with them I went to check their reviews to know what to expect gotta say I was worried from what I read and was trying to see if I can change the airline Rate was too good and all was non refundable so I had no option but to go for it Got an email a few days before that the flight will be delayed for mins On the day of the flight I went in checked in bags total for people no issues boarded on time and pushed back once all boarded and arrived mins early Hard to review service as it was non existent for a mins flight Im not undermining other peoples bad experience i just thought Id comfort others and let them know there are days where its a really good experience

Arriving is easy everything is close by and there are rarely any crowds Departure Well that was horrid The security belt is obviously designed for business people on a day trip Only enough room for a couple of trays So I was trying to balance three trays in my arms to get them across to the belt with others cutting in front of me Then my bags went through I could see the security lady pointing at my e cigarette and battery on her screen now I know they are allowed in carry ons however she had a young man search my bag At no point did anyone talk to me I told him where these were Meanwhile it confused me as I did everything right I felt like a criminal and I was embarrassed Finally when that was sorted I looked for the water fountain to fill my bottle Gone So I had to buy water Sat in the hard seats then and eager to leave this disappointing airport They have a huge sign saying they want to be the best small airport they are dreaming The airport is not touristfriendly it is probably best only for business people on day hops
Worst ever TSA took minutes to get trough such a small airport TSA workers just standing around talking and laughing thats what we pay for Shame on TSA at Greenville GSP

One for the historians of airport architecture a real timewarp from the s and earlier This was the original preWW Berlin airport The paucity of flights serving Tempelhof make for a very stressfree environment Emerging from the terminal one finds oneself in an ordinary residential street the facade of the terminal blending in with the neighbouring apartment blocks The UBahn station is just m away and one is in the heart of Berlin cheaply and in doublequick time But look again at that facade towards the top theres a gap Wasnt that where the old regimes notorious symbol used to stand

Security management was very poor It took more than an hour for security scanning with very long queues at every counter The security staff acted as if they had nothing to do with passengers being late for their flights Even though I arrived at the airport three hours before my flight I almost missed it due to the long queues

By far my worst airport experience We were diverted to Bilbao due to bad atmospheric conditions across UK which in itself is not great but happens However I was not ready how terrible the service will be at the airport no information nor help They even sent us to a wrong hotel On top of that nobody knew what they were doing how to check in the luggage took minutes to start the process with no information what is happening or how to board us again long wait and no information I was truly shocked by this whole situation and the level of unproffesionalism

I would absolutely avoid Doha at all costs Its so big now that simply getting from gate to gate is a lengthy exercise and one of my flights still involved a bus ride Inadequate seating unfriendly staff even in the Qatar business lounge its not good enough I will be looking for a different route to take my regular journeys between the UK and Jakarta

I have been to Asia times and found Air Premia by accident They really do not market in the United States This airline could easily be a leader in the industry but for paying attention to the basics Serve a decent meal on a long haul flight The food was simplest the worse I have ever eaten on an airline Offer more than a dozen movies and tv shows only in one language with subtitles is boring Why fly a Boeing aircraft with all the modern features to service the public and then not use them But there are far more positives to be considered The premium economy was like flying business Plenty of room to relax while crossing the Pacific The staff was young and energetic They hustled to make sure everyone for top notch attention despite being forced to serve dog food The entire crew was also very safety aware Whomever is in charge of this airline needs to be fired and replaced by an expert that understands inflight service

I recently had the most frustrating and shocking experience with Sky Express On May th I booked two tickets from Mykonos to Athens to Frankfurt for September st The booking process was smooth and I received my confirmation immediately However things took a turn for the worse as my travel date approached On August st I attempted to check in online only to receive an error stating that my confirmation number was for a flight in the past I was in shock I immediately called the airline and after waiting for minutes I finally spoke with a representative who informed me that my flight was cancelled then put me on hold for another minutes When she returned she told me that I had supposedly changed my flight on August th to a business class ticket from Athens to Frankfurt on August th This was absolutely impossible as I never made any such change The agent promised to investigate and get back to me Shortly after I received an email from Sky Express which left me in utter disbelief According to their records I had requested this change at the Athens airport This was a complete fabrication To make matters worse they informed me that I needed to book a new ticket from Mykonos to Frankfurt as my original ticket could not be modified I was in a state of panic as I had a connecting flight from Frankfurt to JFK and then to Fort Lauderdale the following day With no other option I had to book a new ticket with a different airline costing me an outrageous I have since emailed Sky Express demanding reimbursement for the original fare and compensation for the new tickets I was forced to purchase This whole ordeal has been incredibly stressful and has left me with a deep mistrust of Sky Express I strongly advise against booking with Sky Express Their lack of communication errors and refusal to take responsibility for their actions have been nothing short of a nightmare Save yourself the headache and choose a more reliable airline

Arrival at Maputo Airport is via air stairs to the ramp to the terminal There is no covering that I could see in the event of rain Inside the arrival area is what seems to be a mass of confusion at the desk where one collects his visa unless you are one of those coming from a country not requiring a visa Following issuance of the visa one then has to clear immigration to have an entry stamp put in hisher passport This is a slow procedure and one is frequently asked where one will be staying so best to keep a copy of your hotel confirmation with you Customs is simple enough where all baggage is screened in an xray machine Following this you are finished and can exit the terminal Note that there is presently no air conditioning in the terminal and it can be hot Also lighting is rather limited Departure is likewise slow I arrived hours before my flight time and had to sit and wait almost hour for the counter to open Again the terminal lacks air conditioning the story being that the system is under repair Following check in one takes an escalator to an upper floor where one processes through immigration which oddly enough is a fairly fast process The departure area has a few shops and some airline lounges but is otherwise fairly devoid of anything Flights are called over a loudspeaker system and one descends again to the ground level and proceeds out of the building across the tarmac to hisher plane The very worst part of utilizing Maputo Airport is the arrival where it seems that confusion reigns mostly due to the matter of issuance of a visa and having it applied to ones passport This occurs even if one has acquired the previsa on line and involves paying the fee for issuance of the visa Note the visa fee can be paid by cash or credit card Visa Master Card only If you have secured the online previsa be sure to bring a print out of it to show to the visa issuing clerks There are some countries that do not require a visa and apparently this number has just been expanded although the expansion has yet to be implemented as of this writing If you have not secured a previsa and are from a country that requires a visa you can be delayed by this process for as much as hours In my case I asked the tour company with which I arranged my bookings and tours in Mozambique to arrange a meet and assist service for both arrival and departure at Maputo Airport This was a good investment and I tipped to man who assisted me with US I highly recommend this type of service for a firsttime visitor

I recently had a very disappointing experience with Air Arabia regarding their ticket cancellation and refund policy I booked a flight for my brother and paid an extra just to make the ticket cancellable Later due to unavoidable reasons I had to cancel the ticket Instead of refunding the amount back to my original payment method Air Arabia held the amount in credit points which is an unfair policy considering I had paid extra for a cancellable ticket When I tried to use these credits for my own flight booking I was shocked to find out that I couldnt use them because the credit was under my brothers name despite the fact that both bookings were made from my own account This makes no senseif Air Arabia is going to hold my money hostage in credit points then at the very least they should allow it to be redeemed within the same account regardless of the passengers name This is a highly restrictive and unfair policy If an airline is unwilling to return the money directly to the customer they should at least provide the flexibility to use it for future bookings regardless of passenger name as long as it is within the same account This experience has left me with a very negative impression of Air Arabias policies Instead of offering customerfriendly solutions they create unnecessary restrictions that ultimately cause financial loss and frustration for their passengers I would strongly advise anyone considering Air Arabia to read their fine print carefully before paying extra for a cancellable ticketbecause in reality your money might not be as flexible as you think I certainly wont be choosing them again unless they make their policies more transparent and customerfriendly Very disappointed with their refund credit policies
