Check in smoothless immigration great lounge perfect When you arrive at the gate here comes the security check All Xray staff do NOT take care of your stuff You fold your jacket you find it in a wreck when you pick it up Put your expensive bag in a tray they take it out and put it directly on the conveyor belt Really this is not acceptable for Singapore I have a stars not for all airport staff but security staff They need to care more

Quito to Galpagos Islands and return to Guayaquil First leg UIOGPS was with a stop in GYE to collect more passengers there was an hour delay announcements were made only in Spanish but when I asked I was informed anyway A short hop to GYE and short stop there and then hrs to GPS both legs were on an older version of A no inflight entertainment but I wasnt expecting as its domestic and not really long flights besides I was enjoying the scenery from the window Their inflight magazine is also only in Spanish which is strange being an Intl airline and a lot of tourists come to visit Ground staff in both UIO and GPS were very helpful and cheerful and when I asked for seats with extra leg room I was offered first seat in Economy on both flights Crew on board doing their jobs but werent very enthusiastic but polite and helpful A sandwich and a coffee were offered which was a sufficient snack Crew constantly talk to me in Spanish a language that I dont speak Return flight to GYE was on time and arrived on time to catch my Intl connection to AMS Luggage was delivered quickly and no hassle for connecting from domestic to Intl at GYE even if its with a different airline I was really surprised with the good service all in all and worth what I paid Just planes are old and need renovation Toilets were kept clean all the time Will recommend it for future if I go to Ecuador again

Naples to New York JFK I flew this airline with caution after the reviews but I was pleasantly surprised One way with Meridiana for was the cheapest flight offered by any airline We got a free checked bag which was nice especially after my experiences with other cheap airlines The flight itself was also nice We flew economy and I felt like I had sufficient room and comfortable seats that retracted It was a ten hour flight and they fed us twice both appetizing meals I would definitely recommend this flight especially for the price

De Havilland Dash of s to s vintage though obviously old with little patches of tranished white paintwork on the airframe revealing its true age Inflight service was better than I expected Hostesses were friendly and courteous Though they serve packet towels some sweets on a tray and bottled mineral water they did so with high level of politeness The only bugbear I can highlight is the lack of a hot snack and hot teacoffee on the flight that wouldnt have cost too much and flight was hr mins

Small airport very friendly staff not too many food choices but the best for long layovers if you need a place for sleep plenty of big chairscouches comfortable and with outlets for charging electronics

Very pleasant and helpful staff With my arm in a sling it was hard to do most things but staff were ready to help and the canteen staff were friendly and professional Could do with more shops and a better variety

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

I found Philadelphia International Airport very confusing to navigate Fortunately we had requested wheelchair assistance for my mum who has limited mobility The guy Cordell who helped us was friendly approachable and kind which made our experience so much more pleasant

London City to Dublin The website is easy to use Checkin and boarding were well organised Staff neatly dressed and and welcoming A drink is included in the cost of the ticket as well as a small snack Departed on time and arrived on time too A very pleasant short flight
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet

I read terrible reviews and I was a bit concerned before boarding todays flight July at However we had a great experience The A was just fine and the service was impeccable They did not speak Swedish but that was not an issue The one hour flight was excellent and the Captain calm and absolutely no issues No inflight entertainment but it was just an hour flight We were min late taking off from Stockholm Arlanda but we were on time coming into Lulea Kallax We loved the service and that the two attendants in the front was always smiling and very accommodating Loved the fact that the staff and pilots greeted us as we left the plane

RSW is a great airport The employees are nice very helpful The shuttle parking employees are the best especially Theresa My husband accidentally left his backpack with meds computer cash on the shuttle in long term parking today I drove Back hours later got it Everything is there They were so kind helpful Theresa had his backpack in the office What a relief So glad there are such good people in the world

Absolute and stunning perfection in everything Crew are the best wonderful and polite people who are there to make your journey a great part of your day Please treat your crew nicely they are literally one of the best and I fly a lot times a month

Thank you to the flight attendants of flight hx today Monday the th I left my phone in my seat on my flight and my phone made it to my next gate very quickly because the staff not only were wonderful but they care enough to not just put my phone in a box I thank you from the bottom of my heart

Mumbai Airport never fails to impress me from the dedicated drop off options or the overall efficiency It is my favourite major airport to travel from I am more impressed with arrival facilities but even departure is as good as it gets Only fundamental issue is its very overcrowded
The new Delta Terminal C is elegant convenient and modern Restaurants gate areas and restrooms were all immaculate Checkin went smoothly Keep it up

This is a small international airport The personnel are polite helpful and efficient Nearly everyone speaks understandable English and some speak other languages as well Whenever possible I use this airport as my point of entry to Mexico The few options for food and drink are very good and the prices are reasonable

Cabin was clean Personal screen was big enough and a lot of entertainment programs were available Seat was very comfortable My personal area was spacious Tullys Coffee was offered with tasty chocolate Flight attendants provided quick and responsive service Everything was excellent

I have never expected that a smallscale airport can be able to provide outstanding and extensive services to travellers The airport was very clean and tidy and everything in the terminal was well organised Incredibly large number of facilities including an observation public bath A wide choice of restaurants was available and the prices were reasonable The sky deck was very large and great for phototaking Airport signs were very clear and staff were always eager to help travellers Convenient access to the city centre The airport gave us a great impression upon our first visit to Nagoya

Pensacola isnt a fancy airport but its fine functional and beautiful Even the exterior architecture greets travelers in a way that reminds them of the waves and big skies of Florida This is also a better alternative in my opinion to flying out of other Gulf Coast airports such as Mobile Tallahassee and GulfportBiloxi Pickup and dropoff are a breeze Checkin is hasslefree Security is a breeze and even more so with TSA PreCheck Dining and shopping options arent ample but do get the job done nicely remember PNS is a small airport Boarding the flight is easy Pensacola is just a very modern efficient airport one that reminds me a lot of other smaller airports like Louisville however no small airports in this country set the world standard like Wellington and Christchurch both in New Zealand do
Little airport very nice Not many dining choices not very important for me because it was a late flight Fast boarding procedure Pleasant view of the tarmac

A modern stylish and clean airport with good facilities but rather small The checkin area in terminal was rather crowded as were the departure gate areas Immigration was rather slow and unnecessarily complicated Customs were simple There wasnt enough seating in the gate area and the restaurant was busy There were plenty of Duty Free shops and in fact too many All in all a very nice airport

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

The passenger terminal in Fargo has limited but all the essential services I used it for arriving and departing to hub cities for onward connections Taxi drivers were near the baggage belts soliciting fares On departure you check in on the main floor and take escalators one flight up To your left is a large enough gift shop with the usual items plus North Dakota State University memorabilia On the right is a food court with a few eateries including a Subway The security check was smooth Once on the airside there is a coffee shop and a kiosk of a shop a miniatiure version of the gift shop on the other side There are quite a few chairs and signage is good A very easy airport to use and quick to get out of and quick to get in

Because of the items in the news about delays and queues we were quite worried about going to Bilbao airport We did have to wait a few minutes at passport control but not too long The airport is a new building very light and modern we didnt have to use any steps at all which was brilliant On our return journey we purchased food and drinks in the cafe they were nicely prepared and the area was very clean and tidy All in all a very good experience and the area can be proud of the facilities

Arriving at Blantyres Chileka airport is a colonial experience Arriving from Johannesburg the airplane is taxied in front of the arrival hall School classes have already been run out to see the big bird landing The building has a wooden veranda and there is a special area were people are expected to cheer after the president has landed The first time I arrived at Chileka the luggage was simply dropped on the tarmac The passengers had to fight to get their possessions Of course quite some passengers did not find any luggage at all as it had stayed behind in Joburg Immigration is quite impressive with a lot of stamps in passports and on listings To get out you have to go through a door then you turn sharply turn left and right Again left until you bump into the departing passengers and their luggage Since half a year we have a new arrival hall at our airport
This airport has beautiful views of the tarmac and a nice and comfortable lounge with easy check in and very friendly staff The food is amazing with an amazing variety of restaurants

Another charming African airport where you can bribe your way into any area of the airport and where power cuts tend to be a problem and staff have to run to the generator to get lights back on Surprising that KLM actually lands here no other western airline company does such a thing

Jashore to Dhaka A not wellknown domestic airline in Bangladesh The flight was late but we did get to our destination in a straight flight with no circling around Being a short flight the cabin service was basic but adequate Not a bad airline

This airport is vastly improved since the previous comment Ideally situated for the catchment area south of the Humber After nightmare journeys just getting to Manchester Aiport my visits to NZ are now via Humberside and Amsterdam Minimum fuss no crowding a relaxed start to a lengthy trip Additional package flights are now offered and the Amsterdam hub is a definite plus There used to be a direct link to LHR with Air UK but this was discontinued before the demise of the airline and never revived Although not essential could be useful on occasion Landing costs I believe

Overall I like BHM Its small staff at least at Delta check in and gate are super friendly The amenities are good for a small regional airport Bags are usually quick to retrieve My one gripe is parking The parking deck is always almost very nearly completely full so finding a space can often take as long as the short flight to connect in ATL The one other thing that annoys me every time I do find a space is total lack of smart carts in the parking lots Hey listen up Airport managers This is an airport and customers travel with baggage Dont you think it would be a great idea to facilitate this process of getting bags to terminals by offering a cart service in the parking lots

The island is lovely the residents are lovely The only down side is the poorly trained passport officials pretending to read passports and carry out security checks I have no idea where these people are found they need training or firing

I dont know how things were in the past but there is no current reason for a one star review Flew from Beijing to Pyongyang From a comfort perspective Air Koryo was just like any international economy class seat Yes the inflight entertainment for the hour flight was basically North Korean propaganda and magazines from North Korea but surely if you are a tourist to North Korea that is exactly what you are interested in In fact youd probably prefer that to say Big Bang Theory episode reruns The food was average The service was perfectly passable

I arrived at night so it was difficult to be as observant as during the day but baggage came off the conveyor belt within minutes and I obtained a modern car with a very pleasant driver for the transfer to my city hotel the transfer costing P which was reasonable Overall an airport that delivered for me on this trip

The security person that checked me was so rude I went through the body scanner and it beeped which it was not a surprise it was always happens to me for some reason and she shouted for me to take my shoes off and go again through it Then during the search done by hand she even lifted my top up without even asking resulting in me being almost half naked in front of everyone I would not recommend this airport at all as I never had such a bad experience in any airports I have been to The pros are that the food is generally good there and there are lots of shops so if you have time to kill it is a good airport for that
Amazing flight even the fact that it was slightly delayed The food was good and the quilty of the staff was high The cabin was clean

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops

Nice clean provincial airport handy for Asturias Cantabria and Galicia The checkin hall is spacious and on the occasions Ive used it it has always been hasslefree The cafe is large and reasonably priced and the toilets clean There are a half dozen care hire booths in the airport I always use the bus to get into and out of Oviedo It is cheap euros single and runs regularly from the stop outside the arrivals hall Regular buses also run to Gijon and Aviles There are plentiful taxis if you want a more expensive drive in The only mild criticism I have of the airport is the time it takes to get through customs on arrival Other than that a pleasant airport which nearly makes flying pleasurable

Landed at the newer of the two terminals Baggage collection was fast and was able to buy a phone card easily on the lower Arrivals level but telephones were only on the upper Departures level Security was tight with baggage tags checked by airport staff No illegal taxi touts hounding you and bus into the city was quick and easy On departing the airline waiting areas were large and comfortable The food in some places was cheap very cheap Same as supermarket price for bottle of Pepsi Had a gate change but was handled quickly and easily Efforts were made to keep me informed despite being the only foreigner on my flight New monorail will soon open from airport to city Airport taxi prices are not too expensive but be prepared for a wild and crazy ride

Clark Airport is well secured and accommodating for passengers and there are plenty of seats provided in the predeparture terminal There are also small food stalls for the passengers who can fill their tummy while waiting their flight to depart

My wife daughter and I used Eastern Airways to fly from Humberside Airport in the UK to Esbjerg in Denmark We had a number of reasons for choosing Eastern The proximity as Humberside is only a minute drive away and our daughter has a disability that requires her to have lots of medical equipment with her in the cabin she requires mechanical ventilation via a trachea when flying and it was our daughters first flight We believed Eastern as a small local airline could provide the service we would need to make the trip a success They did not disappoint From my initial communication with customer services to our flights all the staff were helpful considerate and went above and beyond Nothing was too much trouble and they pulled out all the stops to ensure the medical equipment could be accommodated At one point the captain of the plane enquired with the air steward about our daughters welfare Very impressed and would not hesitate to use the airline again We have told friends and family about the route offered by Eastern and recommended them for a break to Denmark Cannot praise the airline enough and special mention to customer services the staff and the captain who was on both journeys

Although it was busy Australia Day Public Holiday check in was quite easy The plane left on time and staff were efficient and friendly Only water coffee and tea is available for free but for a short flight I dont mind Overall a great flight and a pleasant way to end my Australia Day Break

This review is for T Arrival is smooth and quick as there are only few passengers and many open immigration counters There are counters for Chinese passport holders foreign passport holders APEC and crew as with other airports The signs and direction from arrival gate to the immigration baggage customs and exit are all clear A few steps from the immigration is the baggage carousel and then another few steps is the customs counters and then the exit There are taxi bays outside the terminal building and a bust waiting area I am not sure if the airport is connected by a train to the city proper as I did not use nor check it On departure checkin counters a less crowded as it ws an early flight There is a security check upon entering T and then another one after checkin and then a final and more detailed one after immigration There was no long queue and so I made it quick and fast to the boarding area Just at the back of the immigration is Gate which is my boarding gate and opposite it is Starbucks There are only few stores and restaurants Seats are not a problem as there are many empty ones The toilets are clean and well maintained Directions and signs are clear and understandable Visa and Mastecard are accepted The terminal is old but spacious The thermostat just needs to be adjusted as it is warm and it makes me feel uncomfortable The wifi si not working as well Overall I enjoyed this airport as an airplane enthusiast as it gives me a good view for plane spotting while waiting to board

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

My recent minute flight from DCA to PHL operated by PSA Airlines for American Eagle was a pleasant experience Despite a minor delay while waiting for the crew to arrive from another flight the service was good We were offered a predeparture beverage and even received beverage service during the short flight a nice touch for such a brief journey The CRJ proved to be more comfortable than the CRJ making the quick trip enjoyable For such a short flight theres truly nothing to complain about

While I found the Jacksonville airport to be very clean with exceptionally friendly professional employees my review is regarding one in particular His name is Alejandro a wheelchair provider for people departing and arriving at the airport I first met him on October when I arrived at JAX He was prompt friendly and a very nice person Well when I left JAX I ran into Alejandro again and he recognized me after a week and all the people hed met He was so pleasant I have required wheelchair assistance when traveling for over years and Alejandro is hands down the best

Beijing to Pyongyang Comparing an intraEuropean flight of hours and this flight practically no differences clean aircraft nice stewardesses punctual simple food good and attentive service a normal standard

Almost everything I saw in New Zealand is well organized Auckland Airport is the exception We waited minutes to get through international departures due to long lines for boarding pass scanning passport co tell and security there were only lanes open for the latter plus one for premium passengers Really not up to spec if Auckland wants to be an international hub

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention
Large and fairly spacious airport unless theres a couple of wide bodies departing The terminal is new and smart without being stunning Good range of shops

I cannot say enough how much I enjoyed this airline experience From the check in counter to the TSA at the local tiny airport to the pilots It is totally a different way of flying commercial and just so much more personal I wish more routes were like this because its such a nice experience My flight was also minutes early on arrival which allowed me to get to my next gate with ease Thank you Boutique Air and hope to fly you again some day Maybe there will be wifi next time

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus

Small airport very friendly staff not too many food choices but the best for long layovers if you need a place for sleep plenty of big chairscouches comfortable and with outlets for charging electronics
The best assistance so far for arrival and departure For someone who has less mobility and needs a wheel chair Superb and faster assistance Everything in place on time

Very nice new airport approx km from Warsaw The airport is easy to navigate the staff is very helpful There was no queue to check in or security control so it was good for family travel We ate a dinner in the airports restaurant the meal was tasty and there was a large selection of food for children There is also a small playground for kids nice thing if you have some time to spend The airport is very clean and quiet the terminal has a very good acoustic capabilities and there was no noise when we were waiting for the flight On the arrival journey everything was very quick just few minutes from the airplane doors to the luggage claim and city exit The car parking is just in front of the terminal building its much cheaper than at Warsaw Chopin airport theres also a bus station just next to the terminal
The most wonderful airline Its the best food i have ever had on a short haul flight I wish they flew to Australia Service was friendly and as someone who is cm tall legroom was ample

This airport is consistently name among the best small airports in the USA Shops and eateries that were shuttered because of Covid have now reopened The airport is in the process of adding more amenities and concessions The newly renovated bathrooms are amazing Theyre brightly lit and significant improvement over the preexisting bathrooms Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes The distances from the security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly
Very nice and clean no problems at all It is very small but it was still a very good and modern airport One of the cleanest airports I have been to

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly
Nordavia has been renamed as Smartavia and reviews can be found on this new linkSmartavia Reviews
It was very great flying in Vistara today then any other Company I liked this because of several reasons like hospitality Seat comfort cabin staff service food Etc Keep it up

The airport itself is small and easily accessible The downside is the airport security staff The staff who greeted us first were pleasant and friendly but the ones conducting inspections and overseeing direct searches of people and luggage are gruff at best and grumpy at worst I think they need some training on how to be polite and respectful to passengers This isnt the first time that we experienced this kind of behaviour on the security line The washrooms are limited and in need of cleaning and an upgrade They could also use at least one area for passengers with pets so the animals can relieve themselves as seen in many other airports
Long immigration queues are the main factor why the Queuing Times section receives only stars However the airport staff were polite and friendly which gives some merits on staff service

I would like to express my sincere gratitude and appreciation Excellent service made me spend a pleasant and unforgettable time during my air journey First of all I would like to thank you for the safe and comfortable travel environment you provided me Throughout the flight the crew members maintained a high level of vigilance and professionalism Their smiles warm greetings and meticulous care made me feel the warmth of home
I flew AirAsia into here from Kuala Lumpar A friendly and efficient airport the connecting bus had me in Melbourne in about the same time as to Tullamarine as there was no jerking about

Excellent service Nothing to complain Theyve served an excellent food during the h long flight and was delicious All the flight attendants were polite and worried about the cleanliness and support all the passengers aboard There arent delays and the luggage have arrived perfectly fine A Grade
The airline was fantastic Left and arrived on time You get a snack provided by the airline Very tasty Would always choose to fly with Air North in the future

London City to Dublin The website is easy to use Checkin and boarding were well organised Staff neatly dressed and and welcoming A drink is included in the cost of the ticket as well as a small snack Departed on time and arrived on time too A very pleasant short flight
Clean efficient airport small but with nice stores A variety of airlines and it is never busy
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy

Not a large airport my wife and I found this one more like ones we are used to in New Zealand No airbridges but airstairs do the job well especially at smaller airports Arrival was good a lot of taxi touts which is not unusual in Malaysia we used a coupon taxi for transport to our hotel Did not visit the shops or toilets here had a long wait in departure lounge for our flight Met our needs staff helpful
Brilliant Airport new clean clear spacious Shame so few airlines do fly into MVD

Cochin International Airport is a beautiful environment friendly and comfortable airport From the infrastructure to the furniture the process the staff everything about this airport exudes comfort and positive vibes The airport is powered by solar panels wooden interiors and well functioning toilet fittings and fixtures make this airport an environment friendly one

Even though it was a really full flight I still had a good experience as a frequent flyer for United Airlines Everything was the same on the way and I dont have much to say But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago The food tasted great but was familiar to me and I hope I didnt feel deja vu

I really enjoyed the service provided helpful friendly and assertive cabin crew on all four flights Also the ground staff were also helpful The food was really nice on board and i had loads of free drinks I had managed to use the online portal with ease Will definitely recommend and fly again with KA
There is very good food and Wifi Internet The dutyfree shop has all kinds of brands and it is cheaper than neighboring countries The immigration inspection is fast and not difficult

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

UMEBMA economy This little Swedish airline brings back what flying used to be in the good old days The flight was an hour short hop between Umea a small city up north and Bromma a tiny central airport of Stockholm in an Avro RJ Plane was clean and flight attendants nice free newspapers Aftonbladet and some inflight magazine followed by a coffee service a free meal sandwich fresh orange juice and chocolate cake Before landing we were given hot towels and sweets

SAPBZEFRS I had two flights with this regional airline this past month Ssmall grand caravan planes but both clean and spotless flights on time crew friendly Due to the size of the aircraft theres no FA on board Price paid fair I do recommend if youre flying to Belize

Ohrid St Paul international airport was in terms of size like a trip with the time machine The aircraft is parking literally in front of the Arrivals door where passengers are directed to the Passports control There were only desks working out of which for an airport with flights daily can be considered a good performance Nevertheless despite the size the airport is well organized and clean showing the travelers how flying was at the past times when holding an airline ticket was considered a luxury As an improvement for the administration I think that a shuttle bus from airport to the city roughly km Distance would be to consider synchronized with the flying schedule

A very friendly team of staff overall at Memphis Airport Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

One of the easiest airports to access both inbound and outbound that we have ever experienced Staff on the information desk in Terminal were extremely pleasant and helpful when we asked for assistance Public areas very clean and well kept Plenty of seating for passengers Great food outlets and some interesting local shops as well A real treat to travel through this southern California airport

Flew Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air Nice short domestic flight with a very courteous B crew nothing but smiles and the Best of Cambodian hospitality during this minute flight Was the cheapest option at incl baggage and an onboard refreshment and everything went smoothly througout Would definitely recommend

Tampa International Airport is huge and very confusing that I ended up going to the wrong direction upon exiting I ended up in the sky center I asked one of the people who I assume work there because he has an ID and he happily helped me and walked with me back to where I supposed to go He worked as a chef in PF changs yet he helped me He was waiting for his ride after a long busy day at work yet he got up and assisted me Thank you Sir for going above and beyond There really is hope in humanity
New facilities in the national arrivalsdepartures concourse very nice modern terminal new roads from Quito recently finished so the trip to city is quicker and easier overall great airport

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

I would like to say a huge thank to Yasmin who went to great lengths to find us a new flight the same day but from Bristol airport flight missed just Start of holiday delayed by hours only her professional and helpful support was greatly appreciated Thank you again

Return leg was an older model configured in Business about half full Actually the seating is better than the configuration as you have more feet room Food was really good especially the Salmon Cod and Prawn ceviche a true delight The bed was comfortable and the service attentive movie choice the same as going out days previous One criticism is that priority bags do not come out first I awaited mins for my bag to arrive and nearly missed my connection although arriving at and a departure on next flight at The second leg on older plane entertainment system not working at all Breakfast and service was good arrived on time and again no priority bags first This is one area they need to work on Hence Ground service only star
Very convenient airport as it is not very large Signs are clear getting to and from the airport is easy too Shops are available post office included The terminal is clean

We found Banjul airport very efficient and friendly As we were on foot from the main road we were expecting a long walk to the terminal but we shouldnt have worried as within m of the airport entrance we were asked if we would like a lift in a chauffeur driven car taking the security supervisor to work We gratefully accepted and on reaching the terminal he insisted on helping us check in quickly as we had no hold baggage Boarding cards in hand we rapidly went through security and mins later were sitting in the pleasant open air departure area and ordering a couple of beers and a sandwich Service indeed and for the most part delivered with a smile

Experienced CMN last month arrival from Paris Orly with RAM and continuing to Muscat with Oman Air Had to retreive my luggage pass immigration and recheckin again All was very smooth and from the time the plane landed I was outside less than min later very impressive Agents were all polite and efficient The secret is like everywhere else Be patient respectful and polite and everything will be fine Will not hesitate to use this Airport again

The airport itself is nice as others have commented I travel through here about once a month and the new terminal is very comfortable and pleasant However the local security is capricious at best They seem to give security agents very little guidance but a huge amount of leeway I have had toothpaste confiscated no pastes they said a bar of soap no soaps they said and the list goes on and on I am all for reasonable and tight security but it seems like every trip I have a random item confiscated And it is not just me I see it happen to others all the time too

Decided to fly direct from Brisbane to Dunedin rather than via Christchurch then driving I had previously flown into Dunedin over years ago and the differences were huge from then until now It is a small airport for a small city so it is compact but effectively laid out International flights arrive at an annex that is connected to the main terminal building by a corridor There are no Smartgates at immigration but it only receives a single international flight at a time it was also good that all three counters were manned for quick processing To get to the rental car office you have to leave the terminal turn left and reenter the annex building which was quite a cold walk on a late night flight For the return trip it was a very busy morning with several domestic flights departing near the same time as my international flight thus international passengers were held in the main terminal area until those domestic flights were processed before being allowed through for screening However there is only a couple of vending machines at the international gates with a small duty free so it is better to not rush through

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet

If in a group have someone get off the plane asap get right through and head for the Cambio Exchange counter Otherwise you may be queued up for a while The rates are fair There is a small drinks stand down an alleyway between Arrivals Departures Assuming you were smart enough to bring back some CUC or got a small amount in the airport the beers pop are cold cheap Still only for a Crystal or Buccanero but oddly enough its Peso for a Tucola Cheaper than on the bus if offered Back in March there was extensive work being done to bring more AC to the upper level and close in the open outside balcony on the upper level I guess the crowding factor made them notice The duty free is the best deal in town Not being computerized for checkin does have its drawbacks when it comes to seat selection etc Especially when HOG is a stop on the way and others have already boarded Found no difference between Cubana SkyService its the airport running the show The Customs Immigration staff always seem to be polite but not too friendly after all they do have a job to do protecting Cuba Once we left and nobody wanted my cigar documents another time they were all over the boxes A few pleasantries en Espanol goes a long way Be a gracious tourist and learn some of the lingo Note that liquids in carryons is not the concern as in most other countries Full bottles of rum No problem Bottles of lotion No problem And this is for goods packed before Security screening not after like with duty free stuff

Such a comfortable and convenient airport to use The relaxed feeling that I experienced was something you dont normally feel in airports Everything and everyone seemed to be at a relaxed pace and the friendliness of the immigration staff was very pleasant The baggage arrived promptly and even the customs staff seemed very friendly as I passed by At the exit to the car park I was asked by a couple of international visitors if I could assist them as they lost their car park ticket I went with them to the car park and visitor reception desk and the two ladies there were very understanding and helpful There were hand sanitising dispensers and hand towels available throughout the concourse and what is different about Shannon airport is that the sanitising foam dispensers were well stocked compared to other airports that all seem to have the dispensers but they are all empty

I had a heartbreaking day on my departure day So when I was checking in at Delta I was crying actually more like bawling Well I wasnt at first but when Ms Carol asked me how was my day tears just fell and couldnt stop itfelt heavyso I really appreciate that question a lot she gave me some small talk which made me open up a bit and thats when I started crying She didnt have to continue comforting me but she did and I felt it in my heart Ms Ammi saw me crying and offered me some juice and orange and a Chocolate cupcake and also comforted me despite how busy they were They are the best strangers Ive encountered at that moment too for the longest time and that made me feel way lighter So I think its not about the place or the airline its the people that works within a truly unforgettable experience even though that was a month ago I am talking about the Ground staff of Delta Airlines in Baltimore Airport They did their jobs with passion and understanding and I salute them all

Completely pleasant airport Small very clean shopcaferestaurantprices much lower than in Borispol Easily accessible from center by taxi or trolleybus just plan enough time in traffic peaks of Kyiv and Close to very recommendable planemuseum in pedestrian distancemaybe mins to walk Customs working attentively but very polite Immigration takes usually more time mins in average than emigration but much more quickly than in Borispol The same about security Free wifi works properly and fast Have no post office in terminal but one across parking lot located left direction of entrance behind the power plant of the airport

BirminghamShuttlesworth Airport is absolutely exceptional across the board Modern well laid out and astonishingly clean Good facilities throughout Parking easy and close to the terminal The modernization of all the facilities done smoothly I live miles away close to another commercial airport but gladly drive the three hour round trip to fly from BHM as I will in April
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

I have been using Bangalore Airport for years and as Indian airports go it has been at the better end of pleasant travel experiences The new Terminal for international flights and some airlines such as Vistara is a revelation amazing feeling of space and the plants on nearly every wall and ceiling give a wonderful effect Security is efficient with minimal queues the or times I have departed There are more and more shops and eateries appearing too

This is a good smaller airport to fly in and out of The terminal is new and it shows Also staff are friendly and helpful This terminal is also well located as it is actually on the outskirts of the city not outside of the city In addition it is served by local transit However there is one accessibility issue While the lanes for commercial providers are covered and wide there is only a lane uncovered pickup area on the arrivals level for private vehicles This results in congestion during heavier arrival times

I would like to convey my heartfelt thanks to Sharon and Gayithri who were on duty at the information counter at Seletar Airport Singapore on the eve of CNY reunion evening They both have gone out of their way above and beyond their normal duties in helping me to get a taxi My flight arrived at pm I tried to get a ride to no avail I decided to wait it out at the airport cafeteria after which I thought to try again this time at the taxi stand When I exited the building however the taxi stand seemed empty The police security on duty suggested I ask for help at the information counter by arrivals and I did that Sharon and her colleague persisted and helped me to get a taxi all the way from pm until I finally got into the taxi just short of pm which by the way stopped right in front of the arrival entrance so that I didnt have to walk far I am most grateful and wish to commend Sharon and Gayithri for their exemplary service I will always remember especially Sharon for her kindness and the personal service extended to me a foreigner who had just arrived Singapore and had turned to her for help

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed

Karachi to Gwadar Travelled with this airline after I had travelled on a short a domestic flight early September Flight in general was smooth and scenic Ground staff were also pleasant and helpful I see some betterment in overall operations particularly in terms of punctuality

My recent experience of flying through Tuscon reminded me that in the contemporary climate flying through smaller American airports is generally a lot more pleasant than megaairports A case in point was the security screening I have some metal in my leg that occasionally triggers the metal detector and it happened while going through security at Tuscon The TSA person that dealt with me went through the standard procedure for dealing with this sort of thing this wasnt the first time for me but they also managed to be human about it in stark contrast to what Ive encountered at some other airports where the TSA person I was dealing with might as well have been a robot I would agree that the dining options at Tuscon arent the greatest but I was still able to get something satisfying to eat We even had some entertainment courtesy of the Arizona Air National Guard also at Tuscon airport who were doing training flights in their Fs and treated us to an impromptu airshow There is much to be said for flying through smaller airports In general the experience is faster and less stressful than their larger equivalents

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

I arrived at the George Charles Airport after a flight from Bridgetown Barbados It is a really small airport conveniently located near Castries The airport can only handle smaller aircraft turboprops the main international airport is in the south of the island UVF Aircraft arrival at the platform is greeted by local spectators at the airport fence Arrival hall is a single room that contains one baggage belt and two customs positions Obviously youre out of the airport in minutes

The experience is a unique one and I also have a trouble on how to rate this airline We start off from Singapores Changi Airport and the check in was quite smooth note that their carryon is only kg we get our boarding pass finish security and customs we finally managed to board the plane the cabin crew was very sweet and nice we are not delayed however the landing was super bad

Yangon to Mandalay Lounge photo and In flight meal photo are added We can access Lounge at Yangon International Airport for all Business Class traveler variety of Breakfast Lounge is located at the rd floor of Yangon International Airport Terminal for domestic In flight meal is great but simple because it is just a hour short flight

TIPATH A very comfortable flight on leather seats on new CRJ Breakfast well served with a generous portion Service went smoothly and efficiently crew were English speaking Plane interior clean Flight left on time and seemingly no worries about cent for cent baggage weight checking All in all a very pleasant experience

It is clean modern and spacious It is easily accessible by the Leonardo Express from Termini about half an hour Employees are friendly and helpful and can speak English well The WiFi connection is stable Signposts are clear

Regional onboard service food and beverages LagosNairobi very good International onboard service food and beverages NairobiWashington good Onboard cleanliness satisfactory Nairobi lounge services good Airline customer support at Airport fair Kenya Airways App unreliable Online customer support very poor
I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and helpful Only water coffee and tea were complimentary which is no issue on such a short flight

This was the most amusing flight I have ever flown as I got to share some laughs with not only fellow passengers but with a hostess Anyway I was seated in row row was an exit row so I was invited to sit there since it was empty and was willingable to assist in case of an emergency Te leg room is excellent and I measure cm The staff were professional and courteous Bags came out quickly We were given water upon boarding then a chocolate bar then a croissant filled with chocolate sauce worth the calories and finally a small drink

Never had any problems flying in and out of John WayneOrange County Airport Its clean security is quick and efficient and has that laid back atmosphere that is OC Its very convenient even when it comes to flying internationally you can get almost anywhere in the world with no more than one stopover At times Ill fly out of LAX if Im not in the mood for that stopover but OC always offers a pleasant alternative for convenience and efficiency Because of its curfew a lot of planes depart first thing in the morning so getting there early is advised But overall a great airport

Bremen is a small and convenient airport and my experience proved enjoyable Arriving with Air France I disembarked in the main terminal Very short walk to the baggage claim I picked my suitcase within ten minutes Tram line frequently connects the airport with the city centre every min during peak hours min otherwise travel time min A oneway ticket costs however beware that the machines accept neither credit cards nor bank notes greater than Easy departure with no queue at baggage dropin I breezed through security Bremen uses the fullbody scanner which makes the screening process much faster Security staff efficient and friendly Bright departure lounge but there might not be enough seating facilities if all gates are used at the same time Only issue Not enough toilets facilities either landside well hidden at the very end of the building or airside one toilet block only

Darwin Airport is a small to midsized airport It has limited food options during the off peak times of the day but is sufficient enough There are plenty of seats to wait on before boarding and the maximum time taken through security is about minutes

On the whole SSA is everything youd expect a mediumsized airport to be Its spacious well signposted and safe Checkin is usually fast except for charter flights to Europe security is fast and friendly domestic arrival also fast and efficient The one major problem at SSA are the long queues at customs in the afternoon when several international flights arrive pretty much at the same time If you dont carry a Brazilian passport expect to stand in line for over an hour There are just enough shops and food amenities SSA is still thankfully first and foremost an airport not a shopping mall If you are taking a bus from the city centre to the airport or vice versa be aware that traffic in Salvador is horrendous and the journey at peak times will take at least two hours

Small clean airport Close to the city centre If one arrives for a later flight in the evening arrive with a full stomach as nothing is open after It is an efficient small airport with quick security The TV is still on at full volume in the departure area
Very pleasant service on Madrid flight and Vigo flight Professional pleasant crew who were attentive and friendly The food was of a good quality nothing spectacular but good

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Nice flight on time Smooth check in Nice cafe after formalities at Windhoek Only minor complaint is that email ticket confirmation says you must print out that document which is or pages so I did for people These pages were NOT required at Windhoek check in

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning

My experiences have always been pleasant Security lines are extremely short and there is a lot of open space Checking in is never a hasslewe have been able to pass by the checkin desk in minutes or less on the worst of days Bathrooms are clean and theres always a cafe or news store open Delta seems to have the largest concentration of flights at the airport most of them being on their regional affiliates running under Delta Connection Overall the airport is very good clean and friendly

This airport was very wellrun when me and my family were here We were going to Punta Cana for a family vacation through jetBlue We were able to get through security smoothly and the customs and shuttles were fast The food court provided a wide variety of foods for me and my family to choose from and everything was very modern The bathrooms were clean enough for usage The only con about this airport was the lack of the jet bridge It didnt help that it was raining upon our leaving Punta Cana We experienced torrential downpour and had to quickly get onboard and we were drenched by the time we were on the plane But there were also many good things about this airport and I would not mind visiting it again
You can change your seats at echeck in without charge Both flights were on time Aneo was clean there were no inflight service for the hour flight Stewards were efficient and friendly enough

I have used this airport a lot over the past two years and find it amazingly efficient and the staff friendly from checkin to immigration and security Its hardly ever busy and normally you can get from the plane to the MRT station within about minutes even when arriving on a packed A from HKG Sure the shopping and food options are not great but KHH is so close to downtown on the wonderful new MRT that this is not really an issue All KHH needs now are more international flights

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

ABQ is a nice concept but one that needs some improvements For starters If you have TSA PreCheck here youre golden Security is an efficient and friendly process If you dont have PreCheck then the service at least for a small airport can be quite noncommunicative abrasive and slow The puebloinspired architecture and interior design of the airport render it one of the most beautiful small airports in the USA and the postsecurity viewing area of the runway and mountains is the sort of thing that more airports in this country need However its not always easy to enjoy the design and the views when the tile and carpet flooring and seating throughout the airport are dirty and for a lack of better words dilapidated and outdated Speaking of seating there really isnt enough of it in my opinion The signage directing you to amenities services and locations throughout the airport is helpful but also outdated The dining and shopping options are fine for a small airport so no real complaints Some people complain about the rental car facility being separate from the terminal and requiring a shuttle bus but honestly the bus runs frequently and the ride is pretty short Everything is easily accessible from I and downtown Albuquerque With a little modernization and polishing ABQ has the potential be as good as new again

What a fantastic little airport after leaving Paris CDG behind and all its filth it was such a welcome sight to arrive in a clean modern organized airport What a shame that more airlines dont fly into Pau The staff in the airport were also extremely helpful and polite Much nicer airport than Toulouse which is not far away

Arrival at this airport was simple with its connection to the Hanover SBahn suburban train system Hanover airport is a convenient size not an overwhelming number of gates but large enough to have plenty of connections Checkin today with Swiss Airlines went smoothly we were asked for our destination visa but not grilled and luggage was processed without difficulty Security checking was slow today probably because of Middle East tensions but security personnel were good humoured and friendly Cafes and shops on the land side closed before pm there are limited shopping possibilities on the air side but one good cafe
I really love this airport It is small and very quick Regular security is quicker than TSA Pre The Airport has nice entertainment and its a nice regional airport
Excellent timely departure and arrival The cabin was clean the staff kind and the bags were promptly delivered Nothing to complain about

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality

Flight TF Gothenburg Stockholm Bromma Attentive professional FAs comfortable seats papers for free good in flight magazine on time clean plane smooth boarding and disembarkation clear safety announcements good sound system Best of all a small meal for free with coffeeteasoda and a chocolate candy
No problem with this airline Pleasant onboard service Schedule respected Aircraft ESSAA leased from an Estonian company Very good experience

Khartoum to El Fashir the capital of North Darfur in the Sudan the hr minute flight departed and arrived on time Polite crew who patiently showed people to their seats Two bread rolls one with cheese the other with chicken a cake water soft drink followed by tea and coffee was provided This is more than BA can provide on their domestic or European routes so if Badr airlines can provide it in Sudan on a domestic flight to Darfur why cant BA Overall a great flight and experience

My daughter and myself were at airport this morning waiting for my sister in law coming from London Her flight was delayed we were concerned that maybe she missed her flight We met a lovely young man Philip He was so helpful friendly kind Philip is fantastic with customers Inquiring about flights out of airport Philip was very helpful

Such a comfortable and convenient airport to use The relaxed feeling that I experienced was something you dont normally feel in airports Everything and everyone seemed to be at a relaxed pace and the friendliness of the immigration staff was very pleasant The baggage arrived promptly and even the customs staff seemed very friendly as I passed by At the exit to the car park I was asked by a couple of international visitors if I could assist them as they lost their car park ticket I went with them to the car park and visitor reception desk and the two ladies there were very understanding and helpful There were hand sanitising dispensers and hand towels available throughout the concourse and what is different about Shannon airport is that the sanitising foam dispensers were well stocked compared to other airports that all seem to have the dispensers but they are all empty

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

Finally the new terminal is in operation Arrival and departure were a breeze no queues no trouble with signage nothing to complain about Toilets are clean overall facility is still under final touches of construction The terminal is too big for the amount of flights served so very few people there Pity they have no food and drink outlets landside yet and just a small stall with snacks airside Overall impression very good everything worked there and up to the international standards From plane to taxi in minutes from check in to plane in Good

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here
No boarding bridges But views are very nice Not much wait for luggage The ground service is good

Getting through this airport was such a breeze our home airport is Pearson which is insanely busy We were able to apply for TSA cares for our autistic family Tameeka helped us from start to finish of security and was so warm and thoughtful in helping us navigate their first time through Highly recommend using this service if you have a family member with disabilities We applied for the same program at Orlando and no one helped us the staff were rude and the lady guarding the family and disabled line tried to turn us away Thoroughly disappointed especially compared to Buffalo We will definitely be flying out of Buffalo in the future

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Islamabad to Manchester Very prompt check in for Shaheen Air No hassle Boarding very professional and well organised Friendly cabin staff Clean very aircraft Good quality food served lunch Asian style and evening dinner European style and plenty of cold drinks coffee tea Little treats like chocolates also served during flight Food served on time and promptly This flight had free Wifi which worked well Generally very happy with Shaheen Air I would definitely recommend and I would fly again with them

Berlin Schnefeld to Tel Aviv Fast and efficient check in flight on time very friendly crew Clean plane seat comfort in Economy Plus good Compared to Ups competitors on this route Up has the best flight schedule Have flown Up repeatedly in Economy Plus and never disappointed
Friendly of the staff a new huge mall had been opening Mall del Soll This is the modern and fully functional airport with the biggest mall of the country and four hotels between stars

Nice experience at Zhengzhou airport I departedto Guangzhou and then to Vancouver The service at Zhengzhou was very good Staff are very friendly and efficient They made my trip much easier Great experience

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board

I travelled all around the world I saw many regional airports WroclawBreslau was excellent Everything went quickly Staff were really helpful no queues Brilliant seats before departure No problem with luggage One minus no good access to the city transport You must take a taxi to drive to the center

Upon arrival we were herded into two huge queues in passport control Plenty of people to herd you but only two actually processing passports After minutes one of the herders pointed the remaining twenty or so people in our queue to the automated passport machine She then promptly walked away Unfortunately no one bothered to walk through them as you could simply walk around so we all did Spain has no record of me entering its island Arrivals is like revisiting the s it all needs replacing Departures by comparison was like a different airport well managed very short queues and modern Toilets are very clean

A delightful regional airport set amongst the lush valleys and hills of the Northern Rivers District of New South Wales Nice well designed terminal and with more convenient flight schedules with Regional Express down to Sydney than nearby Ballina which handles mainly tourist traffic Lismore Airport is close to town and has all the usual car rental facilities and is only minutes to the coast Byron BayBallina etc Only downside is as is usual at most airport terminals in Australia blaring televisions all around the terminal causing a racket and breaking the pleasant peace of this delightful place
This airport has beautiful views of the tarmac and a nice and comfortable lounge with easy check in and very friendly staff The food is amazing with an amazing variety of restaurants

What a lovely place The tiniest airport an aerodrome actually I have been to People are lovely they take care of you There is a bar free wifi if it doesnt work in some areas ask for the airlines it is kept clean The only thing is getting there taxi only as far as I know

My daughter and myself were at airport this morning waiting for my sister in law coming from London Her flight was delayed we were concerned that maybe she missed her flight We met a lovely young man Philip He was so helpful friendly kind Philip is fantastic with customers Inquiring about flights out of airport Philip was very helpful

A small modern gate airport Smiling and timely checkin security and boarding Pleasant airy shared lounge with good Mongolian and other ethnic items reasonably priced Ours was the only plane at the airport let alone scheduled to fly around midday but all shops and facilities were fully open and staffed Only criticism is the lack of a bar which I would prefer to for example the bridal wear store

Thessaloniki to Athens I was pleasantly surprised by the service on this short flight approx min Service was quick good selection of drinks and small candies and biscuits Friendly staff aircraft was clean The crew are ready to assist the passengers I will be happy to fly them again

Des Moines KDSM is an all round great airport It is a very easy airport to navigate in and it doesnt take long to get through security at all It always seems to be clean and free wifi is always a plus While there seems to be a lack of shopping and food choices there are a few that all seem to be good places of business Terminal seating is in the process of being expanded as it doesnt hold the demand all of the time Its a great airport to depart and arrive to It isnt very big but will get you where you need to go

Luxor via Sharm to Manchester on A after Monarch refused to let me and my year old daughter board with Kiss Flights tickets There were of us stranded at Luxor and about more in Sharm so we only half filled the plane The crew was friendly professional and sympathetic to the fact we had been delayed for a further hours Whilst the plane was obviously quite new the seats were refurb in my opinion but we had plenty of leg room a very pleasant but simple dinner no alcohol on board but drinks free with our meal unlike Monarch who only give coffee free As soon as we had eaten and duty free had been up and down the lights were dimmed as it was very late Air Memphis may be budget domestic flights but their international flight for me and my companions on board I thinks was excellent

SINRDN Return A new ATR with two flight attendants For a hr flight a packed towel plus a bottle of water was given out Although the attendants werent very enthusiastic the crew members in the flight deck kept us up to date with information

My recent trip from Jakarta to Denpasar with Pelita Air was an absolute pleasure Both departure and arrival adhered to the schedule The seat pitch in their aircraft offers ample legroom Every seat has a USB port and an AC power outlet A tasty light snack and water were provided which was perfect for the short flight duration Departure from Jakartas Terminal was offers a bright airy ambiance and a good selection of shops and restaurants for preflight browsing Smooth Transfers Even for a far gate a bus was available to take passengers to the aircraft The cabin crew were professional and courteous Pelita Air provided WiFi access to their Inflight Entertainment IFE system that allowed me to stream movies shows or music on my device making the flight even more enjoyable A Minor Room for Improvement While the ground staff were generally helpful there were a few instances where they seemed a bit inattentive Perhaps some additional training could improve their overall efficiency
Plane clean and on time Ran out of water after row economy Its a short flight so bring back water in seat pockets of you cant cope No coffee tea or drinks for anyone

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh

I would like to share my positive experience with Egypt Air as this Airline have really exceeded my expectations Friendly and professional cabin crew with delicious catering Highly recommended and for sure will fly Egypt Air again

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

This is a comparatively new airport in Tunisia and I have nothing but praise for it It is clean smart and well organised Check in and Security were quick and once through to airside a really good duty free shop and a bar Great views from the glass fronted terminal although the view of some aircraft can be obscured by the piers Everything ran smoothly and just a pleasure to travel through this airport

Domestic arrival was good canteen facilities are reasonably priced Toilet was clean in arrival hall International departure money exchange facilities available The security check was not particularly friendly boarding was smooth via gate with Virgin Australia using an air bridge

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

Tbilisi to Baku Everything went smoothly here Boarding was quick and on time We were pushed back on time which also meant the flight left on time It was only a short hop of mins I will see how they are again when I fly hours plus on my next flight Overall No issues Airline very smooth and would recommend
Friendly and fast service Enough toilets seats and bins But shops close early and have a extremely poor selection in duty free If you want anything make sure you get it before coming to the airport

I am pleased to commend Mdm Novia for her exceptional professionalism during our recent flight cancellation on November After our Citilink flight from Pontianak to Jakarta was canceled Novia managed all the necessary arrangements for our next flight with outstanding efficiency and kindness Her assistance made a challenging situation much easier and we are very grateful for her dedication and hospitality She truly goes above and beyond in her service

Thank you for your kind service My elderly parents flew out and the patience and attention to their comfort was impressive and appreciative They contacted me upon their arrival and both were very calm and satisfied They have been worried about flying days coming into it All that went away at the airport in Bellingham They were greeted upon their arrival at their destination with the necessary extra services Thank you so much

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

Luang Prabang to Vientiane CheckIn was fast well organized and the staff friendly The departure arrival was on time and the aircraft made a very well maintained impression During the flight despite the short flight time of only minutes there were small bites and drinks The seat absorbency was slightly larger than other airlines Overall a good surprising experience

Second busiest airport in Finland after Helsinki now really quiet thanks to covid Terminal is reasonably big and has jet bridges so you dont need to go outside while boarding unless its a small turboprop like we had which cannot use jet bridges There are couple of shops a bar and a cafe and just like most other airports in Finland there are rocking chairs where to relax and even a piano anyone can play Checkin security and baggage claim went smoothly and fast since there were only a few passengers Airport is well connected to the city by buses and taxi

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place
