Airport uses a lot of natural light The design is modern especially the departure lobby the ceiling its so high The staff in the airport have good manners The luggage arrived quick and theres plenty of checkin counters too The bad thing airline lounges terrible

The current airport consists of two buildings The first houses the security scanners and the second an open air thatched building the manual check in Very pleasant for small groups A new terminal is being constructed and should be ready in a few years Like most things in Lamu this is a simple functional relaxed airport From the terminal you walk meters to the fast boats for the minute ride to Lamu Town or to Shela Beach

It is five years since I have been to the Crimea The airport terminal is new and quite spacious The arrival area worked well and I had free WiFi while I waited for my luggage to arrive from the plane As far as departure was concerned there were plenty of check in counters and the areas were quite well sign posted in Russian and English There are good areas for food and souvenirs both before and after the security clearance It is an airport which seems to work quite well and is a big improvement on the old terminal

A lowcost airline and they enforce bag weights and sizes and number of bags very closely Despite that if you buy early its a good value for travel in and around Kazakhstan Purchase bags early as they charge a lot at airport My flight however was fine arrived on time with no issues Overall satisfied for what I paid
Great airport Excellent shopping facilities Very clear directions Very helpful staff A cut above the rest of the small airports I have visited

I arrived at Yangon airport about am today Dec and proceeded to be processed through security Xray machines I was in a hurry and thus quickly pickedup my luggage but forgot and left my phone wallet and spectacles behind It must have been about minutes later at the airline checkin when I realized my mistake I was in panic and so backtraced my steps However I requested the wrong counter for my belongings But the officers were very helpful and apologetic that they could not find my belongings I then remembered the correct counter near row D and there the security officers were able to retrieve my belongings very quickly I believe they had followed strict procedures and had kept my belongings safe while awaiting my return to claim them After a simple verification I have all my items returned in good order I wish to thank security staff for their prompt and helpful assistance and making my return trip pleasant

GRX is a small regional airport Boarding and disembarking aircraft is usually very quick due to the limited aircraft movements Passenger facilities are limited waiting areas are small no lounges minimal eating outlets and taxis are hard to come by which is surprising for an airport However some of the nicest security screening staff that I have ever come across always smiling and patient with passengers UK and US staff can really learn something here

This airport is very small for the number of passengers and airlines it is serving Everywhere seemed to be crowded and felt cramped I thought they needed more space for better facilities and customer service Transferring from the train coming from London to the terminal and between terminals was very easy and well signage The prayer room is available and wellmaintained and the toilets are clean Not a pleasant experience for shopping and dining as there are too many people in a cramped space

Dane County Regional is a cute little airport lying on the outskirts of Madison and it has had some of the best services I have ever experienced at any airport The airport is incredibly clean and attractive on the inside and the outside This includes nice modern architecture on the outside and mosaic flooring and stained glass handling lights It may not have as many stores as other airports but there is a store for nearly all travel needs such as a Cafe a restaurant a travel store and a Wisconsin Gear store I also noted that there were multiple stores under construction There are hardly any delays and MSN connects to nearly all large nearby airports which provides excellent connection availability The best part was the incredibly fast Wifi and charger ports in the waiting area

Benghasi Domestic to Tripoli Domestic What a nice surprise Buraq Air is the year old private airline in Libya that operates domestically as well as to Cairo and Istanbul It is the vastly preferred carrier to Libyan Arab Airlines My flight from Benghasi domestic to Tripoli domestic was easy to purchase in town not on Sabre or Galilleo unfortunately and was just one way The domestic airport is nothing to write home about but is clean and Benghasians are very friendly with smiles all round This flight operated with a rather longinthetooth you know the ones with long cigarshaped engines but was clean and the cabin crew were polite engaging and presented themselves in smart uniforms smiles all round again This was an all economy configuration but legroom was more than European airlines in J class Soft drinks hot drinks and some cakes made a break during the minute flight

Air New Zealand representative named Leanne was very helpful when I needed help to check in my ft surfboard she was helpful when I needed help to print out my boarding pass exceptional patience and excellent customer skills

We flew from Dubrovnik to Athens and then Athens to Zagreb on Croatia Airlines They were on time within minutes for both flights You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like They allow a smaller carryone bag as well They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space We were served water and drinks on both flights For the price we paid it was a great deal Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing If you had to fault them for one thing it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment Other than that it was a perfect flight Definitely recommend

My husband and myself were at Alicante airport returning from a short break I am disabled following a subarachnoid haemorrhage years ago I really needed to feedback on my support from Carmen who reported she has worked many years in the assistance area she was so kind and helpful and made my journey much more settled I cannot thank her enough Regards Kath Robinson

It was an exceptional experience from start to finish The checkin process was efficient with friendly staff who were more than willing to assist Boarding was wellorganized and the flight departed on time Onboard I was impressed by the cleanliness of the cabin and comfortable seating The flight attendants were professional attentive and ready to help with a warm smile Their hospitality made the journey even more enjoyable

The current airport is small but efficient A new much larger terminal is being build Border and security control was fast and efficient All gates are currently in one large terminal with bus boarding only Staff was acting friendly and speedy Bus brings you to to city in for only Lei

Nimes is one of the most pleasant airports Ive experienced Its quite small is a favourable alternative to Montpellier for those of us whose eventual destination is in the Herault area not least because of its close proximity to the motorway and current absence of major roadworks It is a place to relax and stroll about while waiting to meet incoming friends and carparking is a doddle The flight to and from Liverpool with Ryanair is direct

This is a small new and very well designed airport There is only one runway so there is never too much traffic The business lounge is excellent clean and there is always food and drink and the service is excellent

My brother and I and Flew for the first time everyone was very helpful they even put us in the sky lounge which consists of a buffet and drinks They did no extra charge and they helped out through the whole time without necessarily babying us Thank you for the experience

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated

Flight BA Durban to Cape Town was a disaster plane had technical issues and we were not able to use that plane I was informed visa a phone call from BA while on the way to the airport that there would be no Business Class on the new chartered flight Im not a snob but it was a surprise gift for my year old mother Long story short we flew on Global Air a chartered plane from JNB It was late and cramped but comfortable enough and staff very attentive We were offered ZAR flight voucher as compensation for no Business class The difference between the two classes was ZAR each per ticket Upon return I emailed Comair and was very expertly helped by David who did some bartering regarding refunds At the end of the day I was given a ZAR KululaComair voucher to be used for year as compensation Well done on customer service and well handled by all involved

Small airport with helpful staff In the arrivals hall there is nothing special On departure you can enjoy your time on the st floor snacks bar with some good choices The view to the apron is good from the departure hall The only negative side is that the air conditioning system is not good at all

JAL economy class is outstanding The seats are the widest in the business if a bit hard and the food was healthy and tasty Flight attendants were polite and attentive My only complaint is that the offerings on the inflight entertainment service were subpar it was hard to find a movie that rose above mediocre

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

I have to say this is the best airport I have ever used so straight forward and friendly helpful staff all the way Plenty of shops to have a stroll around and fantastic food Only an hour away from home with great parking I am sure this is my airport of choice from now on Absolutely love it great start to our holiday Thank you Doncaster Sheffield airport

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time
Good airport nice shops and the seating is comfortable great restaurants very respectful staff and flights always on time

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

CPTGBE GBEJNB First flight a clean Bae in very good condition half empty with loads of leg room Food excellent for an airline and service find Second flight on an equally clean ATR with equally good snacks All flights on time Much prefer them to SAX or Airlink

Flew internal flights in Burma with this local airline Surprisingly new plane pretty much on time and with very pleasant crews Also served a good snack gave out towels although flights were only about minutes Was a bit reticent about using them but very pleasantly surprised

Convenient location only mins from the Mosque Excellent modern facilities Nice simple elegant layout with steelwork reflecting date palm trees Convenient location of cafetarias toilets and prayer rooms Friendly staff and security personnel Clean and tidy Ample seating facilities

Flew out of Maputo up the coast to Inhambane Found it to be clean well organised free of queues and with fairly friendly staff We used the domestic terminal which was largely devoid of facilities apart from a couple of shops but also virtually devoid of passengers A surprisingly pleasurable experience

Good checkin and boarding excellent lounge but a disappointing experience with an unfriendly and ignorant worker at the security check There were only a few passengers at the airport no queue at the checkin counter The lounge was impeccable with a friendly staff a very good choice of snacks drinks and reading material The only negative moment was in the priority security line despite that there were no passengers in the line right after am The worker who checked my passport and boarding pass sternly told me that next time she would not allow me to use the priority security line if I dont present my Silver Finnair Plus card The Priority Security note was boldly printed in a big font on my boarding pass which she was holding in her hand so Im afraid to think she could not read English RIX in general is a good airport but the management has to teach priority security line workers to read and understand at least two words in English Priority Security

I flew fom Bergerac airport to Stansted today When i had cleared baggage body and passport check I went to the lounge to realise to my horror that I hadnt got my belt from the body check I spent minutes contemplating how I was shortly destined to be walking round London with my trousers falling down because I didnt have my belt on As we were summoned to the gate I was overjoyed to hear an announcement from Bergerac Airport or Ryanair saying that my belt had been found I am so happy I feel moved to thank and complement whichever staff or system meant that I was reunited with my belt Well done

Rex Airlines is a standout in terms of professionalism and helpfulness Their call centres are here in Australia staffed by knowledgeable and problem solving women sorry men I have just dealt with amazing women Rex is our airline of choice when it flies where we need to go It is hands down better than the other airlines based in Australia and is a reminder that an airline can work well and treat customers with personal and professional service
Loved this airport was friendly decor like someone said is s hawaiian Very comfy armchairs only thing missing was a bar Car hire easy to find and Hilo just down the road

The airport is wellorganized secure and clean with nearly all services available The crew at Air Mauritius is extremely professional and they go above and above to execute their jobs in a courteous and professional manner Nishi the travel consultantpassenger service is amazing in terms of customer service and taking care of passengers with a smile and enthusiasm

arrivals and one departure Arrival is one part and departure is the other Super efficient clean and pleasant Taxis out front Departure area maybe could use more seating Interesting there was a ping pong table there and it was quite popular It has a relaxing feel about it Probably one of the nicest airports anywhere Arrival has a store where you can buy a bus card and load it for say or days travel

This is my preferred airport in SoCal for arriving atdeparting from which I do on a regular basis Big enough to offer connections anywhere in the US for flights to Europe yet small enough offer a quick friendly and efficient service tofrom your gate Drop off facilities outside the terminals needs to be improved but apart from that no real complaints

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance
Fantastic airport I go in and out at least once a month Yesterday I timed my arrival and from walking off the plane to being outside at a taxi was seconds minute check in for departures

GSO is a very convenient and nice airport Parking is super convenient right next to the terminal which makes it nice when picking up people It is a nice and clean airport that I try and fly out of whenever I can I only wish that I could get more direct flights out of there

My Husband and I traveled on American Airlines Flight AA to New York from Florida We were extremely pleased traveling home on this plane This was mainly due to Flight Attendant DeJon DeJon made sure we were comfortable asked us what drinks we wanted and served us snacks and a very nice lunch Mostly he was so congenial and I could see he was working so hard taking care of the passengers My Husband and I are seniors and I can honestly say that we very much appreciated DeJon It made our flight enjoyable and we were glad we flew with American Airlines

Boarding an A was a unique experience and you will enjoy a pleasant flight thanks to the spaciousness and comfort The cabin crew were admirable and friendly the food was good and delicious Highly recommended

My family flew to Daegu from Gimpo From checkin to boarding service rendered by all staff were efficient and excellent Cabin was clean and seats were usual economy class comfy On our return flight from Daegu to Gimpo we were late due to traffic and could not checkin thru self serve kiosk We had barely mins prior to flight departure Approached counter staff for assistance First thing the staff did was radioed the Captain while processing the checking in and printing of boarding passes An agent came over to escort and assisted us throughout the procedure to ensure we boarded the plane without further delay All these were completed within mins and flight departed on time Our biggest compliment is towards the Captain for both flights Journey was smooth and landing was perfect which you dont even feel the plane has landed Flew with many major top airlines in the world but never had this landing experience ever before Cabin Crew rating great and comparable to top airlines Keep it up and will definitely choose and fly Air Busan on all my destinations where served by Air Busan

Rio de Janiero to Curitiba via Sao Paulo Really good experience really smooth inflight entertainment and free food and drink the cabin crew were really friendly This really beats European customer service the leg room is still the same but just the service outweighs it for me

Townsville is a delightful little airport They even use air bridges which was a surprise It is a little crowded as the area for departures arrivals is quite narrow but really very minor issue You exit down an escalator to retrieve your luggage which was pretty fast There is a cafe there and behind are very clean washrooms A positive experience no fuss whatsoever Departing this charming airport the security staff were the friendliest I have come across Lots of glass and places to sit in the departure area and all with a minimum of fuss Well done Townsville Airport I loved it Plus there was almost no traffic outside at all

Hong Kong to Kahsioung A quite nice flight It was my first time flying an Embraer jet I know it is small but the seat is comfortable and wide A delicious hot meal was served in a mins flight The crew is friendly and fluent in English The only bad thing is that the flight was delayed for hours

I work on a consumer programme for ITV and would be interested in hearing from anyone who was on the Phuket Air flight which had a reported fuel leak during a routine stop at Sharjah on Sunday rd April We would be interested in hearing your story Please send your contact details using the Comment Form at the bottom of this page and Skytrax will put you in touch with Sarah

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Granada Airport is located about km west of Granada Single runway small terminal Regular buses run into the city If you arrive late no worries as it is only a short taxi ride In recent years the number of flights have increased Mainly to Madrid and Barcelona but with also Liverpool Stansted Melilla The usual facilities for a small airport so dont expect too much

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements

Ljubljana Airport has undergone a major update over the last few years and has increased in size quite substantially Line of sight signage is good making navigation around the airport very easy Arriving from a Schengen country results in a very fast entry procedure to the country Departing was also a breeze with very friendly and efficient staff we were checked in through security customs and in the lounge in very short time Waiting areas are comfortable and duty free shopping and other outlets well staffed and spotlessly clean

Excellent airport clean spacious excellent traveler services quick luggage check and very friendly staff easyaccess panoramic terrace with degree view of departures and arrivals restaurants and shops with normal prices are positioning several lowcost airlines and it is the base of AirAsia Japan I hope it will increase international connections and always maintain this trend having for several years won the best regional airport in the world

Cartagena to Cali Paid the ticket pesos equivalent to mBP or EUR We left on time we arrived before the scheduled time Some people judge an airline when they spend peanuts for it I find Vivacolombia exceptional for what you pay

You know its a shame that this beautiful airport cannot supply enough helpful staff to assist with directing you to the right place in order to make your connecting flight If only there were those who could advise you what you need to do when you DO have a boarding pass in your possession and that you must take a bus to another part of the terminal to board your connecting flight The whole experience almost tainted the start and end to a brilliant holiday

Clean and efficient I was very impressed with Elmas airport Staff are friendly and the airport is very well connected to the city centre by bus The fare is only Only one negative point once youre past the international departures hall there are no shops only one small cafe near gate otherwise this is one of the best regional airports I have visited so far

Small airport dating back to the early days of aviation when the thinking was that would be aerodromes in most towns Today BUR is convenient airport for those wishing to avoid LAX You pick up your bags from the baggage conveyor belt outside the terminal
Thai smile offers convenient service through their app and self service at Suvarnabhumi Airport with staff support The time of flight is in time Staff gave service with hospitality

Small airport and gateway to the Antarctica Ushuaia is a tourist destination and claimed by Argentina to be the southernmost city in the world Check in is straightforward on street level You go up a flight of stairs for security check and to your gate Ample sitting space There were a couple of small shops selling souvenirs Jetways to aircraft On the main floor there is a large duty free shop selling the usual international brands of chocolates perfumes and liquor Also a cafe for food and drinks Arrival is straight forward Luggage arrived quickly in baggage claim and put through a casual security check Taxi dispatcher at exit arranges for passengers to get into vehicles for their respective hotels English widely understood by airport workers They are also very helpful The town is very close by visible from the entrance to the airport aned reached in minutes The airport caters to the huge tourist flow there Views from the airplane while landing and taking off are dramatic with scenes of the Tierra del Fuego archipelago spread out Window seat is a must Nearly all the flights to Buenos Aires from Ushuaia are to the capital citys domestic airport which is far away from the airport that caters to international flights to the US and Europe

CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

What a pleasure We arrived into Murcia on the nd June and greeted by cheery ground staff straight to passport control a little queue at passport control nice and polite customs officers Went to baggage belt and there were a few others in front of us but mins at the most wait for our baggage Through the exit and outside in under half an hour how amazing was that The return journey went just as smoothly I was blown away by this efficient friendly and calm airport staff are amazing

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Its been seven years since I last flew on Lufthansa I was fortunate enough to fly on Lufthansa for the first time in seven years and the moment I got on that plane I felt good Because it was a short flight I didnt have to worry about anything But the best part was that I got a Milk Chocolate bar from Lindt and whats nice is that they have a Lufthansa logo on it what a finishing touch

The experience is a unique one and I also have a trouble on how to rate this airline We start off from Singapores Changi Airport and the check in was quite smooth note that their carryon is only kg we get our boarding pass finish security and customs we finally managed to board the plane the cabin crew was very sweet and nice we are not delayed however the landing was super bad

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

Friedrichshafen Hamburg It was one of my best experiences on a regional flightairline Aircraft was clean The crew CheckIn to cabin crew was very polite as well as highly professional Flight attendant made clearly understandable announcementssafety demos The only downside is that Intersky asks passengers to pay prohibitive expensive prices for onboard drinkssnacks But since they consider themselves as a low cost airline truly providing LCC price level it was no surprise and everybody is free not to buy anything

A small but pleasant airport On arrival customs officer friendly and smiling Luggage delivered quickly and duty free shops in the arrival lounge On departure staff pleasant including the security check Just be aware that the domestic terminal is very small and offer very few seating possibilities before check in
Simply fantastic what an experience A very time and cost efficient way to travel in Scotland heres hoping they add more routes soon

My experiences with customs and immigration have always been exceptionally pleasurable Over the past year I arrived in Cayman a dozen times to meet with immigration lawyers on the basis that I will move here The officers greet me warmly and I am processed efficiently I usually try to fly in in midweek when it is less crowded However yesterday I arrived on Saturday This was an interesting experience because the airport was almost full to capacity causing long lines and delays I suggest any traveller to avoid arriving or departing on a Saturday or Sunday because there can be many flights arriving and departing The airport is safe clean and convenient Everyone is friendly and easygoing I love it here I suggest everyone come visit at least once in their lifetime This is paradise an expensive paradise though

Spacious clean well located well serviced bright naturally illuminated airport Large halls with folk articles shops and chemist money exchange bureau and wrapping baggage service A breeze Fine areas for check in and spotless lavatories Once checked in fast track to security and immigrations available Smiley faces all over the airport Excellent Duty free shop Very good VIP lounge
Relatively simple layout Staff very friendly and informative Buses into the city centre bus station depart right in front of the terminal but are not as frequent as could be
Its easy to get around very friendly people and easy to get bags and leave Always a good experience and they have free wifi so never a problem with communication

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

I cannot praise enough the airport assistance staff at Girona airport My son has autism and I was wearing the Sunflower Lanyard Assistance staff saw me waiting and came over to me to make themselves know and offer assistance at check in security and boarding the plane Fantastic staff

Excellent airport with ample space and good architecture Checkin very efficient Immigration officers very friendly because now there is a small machine on the left side with which you can evaluate the service of service of the officer from poor to excellent in grades It is true that it doubles as a military airport but you could have a rare sight of military jets standing nearby

Janakpur the capital of Madhesi province in Nepal has the IATA code JKR and the provincial government has recently revamped the airport with a total overhaul new building replacing the old one that means an entirely new terminal but the same old runway It may rank as as the best airport operating domestic flights only in Nepal Belts for luggage handling big hall with sufficient seating facilities restaurant inside and a nice departure lounge Toilets arent clean People are too introvert security personnel needs to improve on behavioural front Not long queue for departure Basic facilities for other things parking enough for passenger load

Zagreb Airport is a small but clean airport The airport staff were generally friendly helpful and efficient Moderate queuing time Seating area was a bit crowded during busy hours and lacking charging sockets around seats Fast and free WiFi

The airport is very small and virtually all of its flights are internal Swedish flights Firstly the airport doesnt open until am on Sundays if you show up earlier you will be waiting outside until it does which in winter in Sweden will not be much fun Secondly the first shuttle bus from Stockholm city centre to Bromma doesnt leave Stockholm until am on Sunday and it takes about minutes By contrast shuttle buses to Arlanda leave every minutes all day These factors are well worth bearing in mind for arrivingdeparting Bromma The lounge is also closed on Sundays The airport has a small selection of coffees and cakes and a very small and not particularly extensive souvenir shop possibly because the primary users are Swedish people on internal flights

Beijing Nanyuan to Hohhot China United is the only airline that uses Beijing Nanyuan a former military airport in the South of Beijing The airport is easy to get to and flights in and out of Nanyuan do not seem to be subject to delays as serious as those at Beijing Capital Theres also very little taxiing Checkin was quick easy but the checkin area is noisy and dilapidated Toilets at the airport werent great The flight was on a newish and the plane was clean Service was friendly and the bacon wrap for breakfast was actually very nice Takeoff and arrival were both on schedule Id use China United again just to avoid the delays at Beijing Capital

Was very impressed with the airport on arrival visa process was so smooth and was done in few seconds and the staff were friendly and smiling on departure Passport control was done fast and staff were nice Plenty of shops and places to eat and drink the design of the airport T is very nice and modern spacious and bright and easy to navigate Im not sure about the public transportation as I had my pick up and drop off arranged by my Htel Overall its a nice airport

Quito is a really nice new airport about km from the city there is very little available around it The airport has free wifi which is always a bonus As it seems with all airports now the prices of small things like coffee etc are expensive My experience with the new airport was excellent not so though with the employees of American Airlines at Quito Airport beware

Surabaya airport is a very quick and efficient airport On arrival the visa on arrival queue was very short immigration there was a short wait of about minutes by the time I was done with both the bags had already arrived Probably one of the quickest experiences for me from exiting the aircraft to curbside Similar experience on departure quick efficient checkin with Cathay Pacific short lines at security and immigration The terminal is spacious and has a lot of natural light from the full height windows on either side the restrooms were very clean Food options are limited to a Burger King and Starbucks the duty free has a good selection for a small airport The premier lounge which was in a temporary set up was the only disappointment Chose to sit at the Starbucks instead Free wifi at the airport is also quite good

Berlin Tegel is a very unique airport both is positive and negative ways After arriving at Berlin Tegel and disembarking the aircraft we had to queue up on the jetbridge as the customs checkpoint was right after the jetbridge A very interesting concept Right after that was a small baggage carousel then out of the departures area This meant that there was basically no departures area We had to wait quite some time for our baggage When we returned to to the airport our checkin process was pretty smooth and the lounge was easily accessible There was a huge observation deck which spanned the roof of a terminal offering beautiful views of the runway and tarmac a good place to spend the time However you have to go through a small security check and buy a ticket before entering Every two gates had its own departure area with seats and its own security checkpoint This meant snaking queues into the public area each time a flight was boarding and it was hard to walk around with baggage because there was little space Inside the tiny departures area there was insufficient seating and insufficient space for the boarding queue Everyone was squeezed at the gate and there was absolutely no order or anything No queues set up

Im a native Sudanese born and raised in Sudan who travels a lot around the World Whenever I visit my beloved Sudan I always feel sad twice The first time is when I arrive at KRT Arrival Terminal This terminal was opened in It was as it is now small with two halls handling maximum of two airplanes at any time But it was nice clean artfully designed and the staff members seemed to be happy working there Unfortunately since then nothing has changed improved or fixed as in some cases and its been getting worse and worse every time I see it The second time I feel sad is when I leave Sudan Not only because Im leaving home but because of the waiting battle at KRT Departure Terminal where bureaucracy is at its highest level This terminal was born more than sixty years ago and never raised Its still small and always seemed very crowded even with one airplane passengers You always have to have extra money with you for the unannounced new fees or stamps Sudan has just signed a peace accord ending more than years of civil war in the South The oil money has started fueling the economy and a new state of art airport is being planned in the east side of the River Nile in Omdurman Hopefully this new airport will be opened soon Theres more than ten millions Sudanese who leave outside Sudan And always willing to visit their family no matter what sometimes twice a year The great generous and passionate people of Sudan deserve much more than what they have now

I really enjoyed the service provided helpful friendly and assertive cabin crew on all four flights Also the ground staff were also helpful The food was really nice on board and i had loads of free drinks I had managed to use the online portal with ease Will definitely recommend and fly again with KA

No frills quick easy safely and clean flights from Dagestan to Moscow The airplane was clean the staff in nice uniforms professional They packed us quickly flew us safely the baggage was out sooner than I made it to the carousel Only a glass of water for the whole flight but it is only hours Nothing to complain about would fly again and recommend

My Husband and I traveled on American Airlines Flight AA to New York from Florida We were extremely pleased traveling home on this plane This was mainly due to Flight Attendant DeJon DeJon made sure we were comfortable asked us what drinks we wanted and served us snacks and a very nice lunch Mostly he was so congenial and I could see he was working so hard taking care of the passengers My Husband and I are seniors and I can honestly say that we very much appreciated DeJon It made our flight enjoyable and we were glad we flew with American Airlines

Toulon to Paris Orly Aircraft on time and clean Good service in flight pleasant staff on departure inflight and on arrival We had to leave bags at plane entry gate and we fetched them at plane exit gate in Paris The aircraft is useful for small flights but is a little small for passengers Flight entertainment would have been appreciated domestic flights in another countries have in flight entertainment even for hr flights

There are substantial and ongoing improvements to Freetown Airport They have been rebuilding the terminal building around the old structure for the last few months Departure and arrival procedures are now quite painless compared with the hot and basic conditions before The check in area is large and clean and I did not have to queue for long They could still do with increasing the air conditioning in that area though Security is good and immigration is using new computers and biometric systems The departure lounge is now quite big and comfortable There are a few well stocked duty free shops The original restaurant is still available as well as a new one upstairs The new one is not well signposted Overall a big improvement FNA now compares favourably with other airports in Africa

I commute regularly between Perpignan and Manchester and it is my favourite airportIt only has one cafe and one shop but these are conveniently situated and adequate for the number of people there I can walk yards to check in there are rarely any queues and there is no need to rush through security The place is small but thats its charm no hassle no long walks and friendly and helpful staff To fly from most airports you need to allow a good two hours to get from a dropoff point to check in and then to a gate In Perpignan minutes suffices

This used to be the old airport for all departures from KL but after this trip I realised this airport isnt old at all In fairness the upgrades have given Subang a good uplifting and made the airport hasslefree for passengers Theres a good restaurant upstairs serving hot food We didnt have any difficulty getting to the gate and we got there with time to spare Signage was good airport checkin and security not too difficult to clear For local and regional departures Subang would be the airport I will consider from now on

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge

Airport is small but functional Clean toilets and security is taken seriously We could not check in online but went through COVID verification and were questioned if we were staying in another EU country for more than days The airport police also gave warnings to people who did not wear their masks Repeat offenders were told they will be asked to leave the airport This is impressive first time seeing mask regulations treated seriously in EU For some strange reason though we were kept on the bus for quite a while prior embarking the plane

Tashkent Airport has become very efficient on the international side Immigration and customs both on the way in and on departure were quite user friendly Not a lot of shops and restaurants but that was not inconvenient Readers should be aware that the domestic terminal is on the other side of the runway and it could take up to minutes to connect from one side to the other side using a taxi

Very disappointed to see that you are busy aping the western culture and forget our own roots As an Indian I am very proud of my heritage and all my traditional food However Cochin airport is a far cry from that You will happily serve cappuccino coffee to please a foreigner while completely omitting to serve a traditional Indian masala tea or a nice bru coffee It is very sad what Cochin airport has come to
Wonderful crew on this very short flight The aircraft comfort better than the ATR which is the main BW commuter No service on this minute hop but all in all great value and on time

Beijing to Pyongyang The Tupolev aircraft is as comfortable as many that are flying around the US The checkin experience was quick at Beijing and Pyongyang The crew were friendly and smiling during the flight The burger was quite tasty and I got a beer with it Baggage quickly delivered at both ends

We use Toulon four or five times each year to travel via Paris to wherever just wish Air France would link TLN to CDG instead of just to ORY which then requires about minutes for the bus transfer between the two Its a small and very quiet airport with about seven or eight flights per day maybe ten at weekends therefore everything is all very laid back Air France checkin is always super efficient with two or three staff in front of the check in area security a breeze and on the CRJ most of the year its a nice meter walk in the sunshine to board at an apron stand Drinks and eats in the terminal and departure lounge are half the price of Nice and Marseille Enough facilities for a couple of flights at the same time but this rarely happens so no queues or crowds anywhere

Amsterdam to Paramaribo Surinam Airways has good service unfortunately the A had some maintenance so they leased an A from Wamos Air but they have the service from Surinam Airways The food was amazing with hot meals The crew was very friendly but the airplane from Wamos Air wasnt so good no IFE for a our flight you can download the app for movies no power outlets just a standard seat with table Overall the service was good but the aircraft not

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

Our flight arrived very late and the hotel shuttle stopped running Bryce was very kind to help us find transportation to our hotel He went above and beyond his job to make sure we arrived safely I was very satisfied

Attractive food comfortable seating In particular the flight attendants are professional and dedicated to helping passengers Head flight attendant Ms Hang and Ms Chi are very enthusiastic and very considerate in assisting passengers The flight crew is friendly and professional xut n hp dn ch ngi tin nghi c bit t tip vin chuyn nghip v rt tn tnh n cn h tr gip hnh khch trong sut chuyn bay tip vin trng c Hng c Chi nhit tnh lm v rt n cn h tr cc hnh khch t bay thn thin v chuyn nghip

There is a need for some chairs and a table to sit and reorganise after the security check This is especially important for people with knee other implants requiring putting on the shoes Cannot do this in standing position I kept the bag on the only one table and was putting on the shoes in standing position One security lady officer showed her displeasure and asked me to remove the bag from the table Not very helpful

A beautiful airport All of you who remember how airline travel was in the sixties and seventies would recognise Ndola Originally built as a RAF airport during the second world war it has continued as the airport to service the Copperbelt region of Zambia I arrived on a domestic flight and departed international to Johannesburg Everything is so laid back and friendly I doubt if there are to many airports that have straw thatched tables for your final beer before departing and straw thatched toilet blocks I love this airport and I usually have tears in my eyes on arrival and also on departure

The Puerto Princesa International Airport had just opened its new terminal The terminal was clean and brand new The airport terminal had no jet bridge or ramp stairs so we had to deplane via an old fashioned staircase at the mercy of the weather thankfully at that time it was already dark The airport lacks formal transportation to the city center although the city streets is just a mere minutes walk away Definitely one of the best provincial airports in the Philippines if you consider dirt runways the norm

Beijing to Xiamen I used Capital Airlines flight from Beijing to Xiamen and I felt that the flight attendants were in excellent service Although the meals is a sandwich the taste is quite good that my son ate three I ordered coffee my wife drank tea which is very traditional Chinese The plane arrived minutes late but it arrived on time which pleased me It is worth mentioning that in front of my pocket there is an tablet computer there are many videos and movies it is very convenient The only problem is that carbin crew sells souvenirs during the flight but its understandable that airlines want to make more money On the ground Hainan Airlines owns the T terminal in Beijing and the Capital Airlines is a subsidiary of Hainan airlines so it is also at t Boarding pass checked baggage boarding is very convenient the terminal is also very clean

Although I had a long layover here and as a single female passenger I was a tad concerned after having read other reviews However the airport is absolutely fine interesting architecture in the landside area a few cafes small shops selling local goods and lots of banks People were very friendly and there was a sense of calm compared to most airports I have been to especially in my home country Scotland and the UK Customs and security were a doddle and once airside there are the usual airport shops plus a few local and individual shops with interesting goods on sale The gate area was modern bright and airy again it was very ordered and peaceful

SCAT has a very poor reputation but I had no problems with them Check in was performed by a handling agent in Almaty and as usual with any airline there it was perfunctory but efficient I had selected my seats previously online with no issues The flight started to board a little late alongside an Air Astana flight departing minutes later to Astana resulting in many passengers going to the wrong gate and being turned back there This is more an airport issue than an airline one though The flight pushed back around minutes behind schedule The aircraft although rather old felt comfortable and the crew were very efficient They managed to serve candies before take off a boxed meal and a drink followed by tea and coffee and more candies before landing all for a hour minute flight Baggage was included in the ticket price and the onboard service was friendly The price was less than many European low cost carriers would charge for their most basic service Their low safety ranking nearly put me off but according to their website they are working on getting accreditation so this reassured me and I am glad I flew with them

Was feeling travel sick after arriving Abu Dhabi airport and while waiting for my next flight Starbucks staff were very helpful and called the medic for me and were very helpful Helped me recover within hour Lovely staff

Great little airline The direct flight from Lbeck to Bergen is perfect for me and my schedule will definitely use it more often in the future Even got snacks which I usually dont get on this distance Very pleased with the speed and efficiency

I used Olympic Air to fly from Athens to Paros and return The aircraft used was an immaculately clean ATR that despite its year of age seemed brand new It seems the airline is really focusing on maintaining the cabins pristine The cabin crew consisted of flight attendants on each leg groomed to perfection and showcasing exceptional customer service skills A very short flight of roughly and we were offered water and sweets This is quite the rarity these days and highly appreciated treated as a guest and not simply as just another passenger Flights departed with a slight delay due to the air traffic restrictions but made up most of the time lost during flight Bags arrived on time and very prompt I would definitely recommend this legendary brand and i am so happy to see it operating in such high standards even on such short flights

The island is lovely the residents are lovely The only down side is the poorly trained passport officials pretending to read passports and carry out security checks I have no idea where these people are found they need training or firing
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

A small airport with a modern purposebuilt terminal with direct raillink from the city With only one flight to serve on a Sunday afternoon service all round should have been and was excellent Plenty of seating although that in the bar was a bit utilitarian

Apart from a minute delay outbound it is hard to fault my SydneyAdelaide return trip Yes its a no frills carrier but most everything worked efficiently and I was impressed by how smiling and happy all the staff were

A small but pleasant airport On arrival customs officer friendly and smiling Luggage delivered quickly and duty free shops in the arrival lounge On departure staff pleasant including the security check Just be aware that the domestic terminal is very small and offer very few seating possibilities before check in

Best domestic airline on the globe Nothing else need be said but I will Thailand not famous and more infamous for service quality but this little gem of an airline ticks every box and its exceptional quality is unequalled in the industry for any airline let alone a budget one

Nice and smart airport Short taxi time to both ends of the runway User Friendly airport with cafe stuff shop resturant bar and more Nice and open area There are often much turbulence when taking off from Rwy Towards East because of the upper winds from the small mountains after the Rwy A Take off from rwy is my favorite Right over the sea and after a few minutes you are right over Trondheim city There are a very nice Airport hotel a few houndred meters from the Airport You have two options to get into Trondhem city Buss or Train same price and same travel time Aprox a half hour

My route was GUASALLAX and I like the attention and polite service of the flight attendants During the flight GUASAL operated by E we had candies and the departure and arrival to SAL was on time The service from SAL LAX operated by A and we departed on time The crew were very nice We got our dinner and a movie before the purser shut off the lights to let us sleep and they offered blankets For passengers that didnt sleep the crew offered beverages

What a fantastic little airport after leaving Paris CDG behind and all its filth it was such a welcome sight to arrive in a clean modern organized airport What a shame that more airlines dont fly into Pau The staff in the airport were also extremely helpful and polite Much nicer airport than Toulouse which is not far away

Last year I flew from Saint John Airport on my way back to Toronto Although the airport is quite small but the service is fast and very friendly Check in staff at Air Canada counter was very friendly and even the security staff were courteous to all passengers As soon as boarding was announced we embarked the aircraft followed by a short walk as there are no air bridges used at this airport

Our flight from Dusseldorf to Paris came in late Boarding went fast and according to our onward tickets in Premium Economy we had SkyPriority status Airportstaff in Dsseldorf was great professional and well informed about the connecting time in CDG The flight was without any specials Friendly crewmembers and a nice plane I havent expected a snack on this short flight but CoffeeTea and a Croissant served right after take off Seats on this plane offering enough legspace A good flight with HOP

I had arrived two weeks ago had cruises then returned to airport for return to UK Plane had a technical fault so going nowhere for hrs The check in immigration security shop staff cleaners handling agents were brilliant So helpful and cheerful food pretty good as well All in all an experience that they helped to make easier and I appreciate that very much thank you Grantley Adams Airport Barbados

SINRDN Return A new ATR with two flight attendants For a hr flight a packed towel plus a bottle of water was given out Although the attendants werent very enthusiastic the crew members in the flight deck kept us up to date with information

As a well travelled Belgian who has been to countries and used over different airlines world wide I can tell Uzbekistan Airways really satifisfied me despite the negative reviews I have read over here and other websites Due to the fact that the online checkin wasnt possible not on the website nor on their app we had to be early at the airport to make sure we were seated next to each other From the moment my girlfriend and I entered the air vessel we were welcomed with a smile and notice some Spanish extra cabin crew members to the staff of the flight HY as well as the Uzbeki who also served us in English Our seats on the left side were spacious the meal was suprisingly very varied and rich of side dishes such as extra fruit dessert some burek sauces such as ketchup olive oil and mustard We were served many times with drinks during the flight The cabin crew were very available very caring and had a really nice level of customer service This air vessel had the problem of non working screen entertainments Keep that in mind if you are taking a hour flight or longer Also some of the locals dont really care about queueing correctly as entering the plane as well as embarking the plane even we noticed them being a bit rude towards the airplane staff Also I have to confirm the entire staff showed the safety flight procedures so they value the safety on board If the screens would have been worked I would give a

Surprisingly good experience Cabin staff were unbelievably attentive and helpful Food and beverages were excellent for airline food Boarding and deboarding were well organized Only downside was business configuration was and flat bed was not as comfortable as on other airlines

Chisinau airport is the only international airport of Moldova and sometimes seems to be out of proportion with the growing traffic But anyway despite its small size after the latest restructuration it became a very efficient and easy to fly from The ground staff are very productive and manages the traffic with a great dexterity The number of shops and food choices remains low but its not really an airport of transit The main flaw of Chisinau airport is access to and from the airport without real shuttle service provided There is a minibus marshrutka route to the railway station but it doesnt service all night long and you often need to require a taxi very cheap Airport is very clean and staff is very professional

I cant express enough how grateful I am for the exceptional help I received from Hilary the gate check agent at Spirit Airlines I was in a complete panic after losing my cell phone at the airport With no way to contact my family and let them know when Id be arriving I was extremely stressed and worried that theyd be concerned about me Hillary noticed my distress and went above and beyond by offering to let me use her personal phone to send a quick text to my family Her kindness thoughtfulness and willingness to help me in a moment of crisis made all the difference Thanks to her I was able to let my family know when to pick me up and I could finally breathe a sigh of relief Never did find my phone but there was a silver lining Hillary truly saved the day for me and I cant thank her enough for her generosity Spirit Airlines is lucky to have such a compassionate and dedicated employee Thank you Hillary for turning a stressful situation into a manageable one You have no idea how much your help meant to me

A nicely laidout airy and spacious airport with excellent facilities and courteous staff a proper Estonian showpiece With TLL only km from the city centre taxi fares are very reasonable Security was efficient and from a UK perspective refreshingly unofficious

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

Auckland to Shanghai via Chengdu The food was very good from a Chinese perspective The service was impressive The crew members were nice and passionate Also for transit in Chengdu the passenger is able to claim yuan voucher free hour baggage storage free transit commendation in Chengdu Based on this price you cannot ask more Thank you Sichuan Airlines for the wonderful memory

Very satisfactory flights Adequate leg room with blocked off seats Rapid checkin and security Good three course hot meals both ways Swiss had subcontracted to Baltic outbound and Helvetic for the return with little noticeable change in service

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

Flew in and out and had no problems despite the fact the airport is partly under reconstruction On arrival our plane parked close to the terminal and bags soon arrived on the single very small belt Car Hire has moved across the road and is a short walk away Plenty of buses and taxis were there to meet passengers Departure checkin was quick the lounge has enough seats for flights and there are adequate cafes and shops to keep most people content This is a small rural airport which works well and gives a flying experience like it used to be in the old days

This is a small yet spacious airport with two terminal piers jutting out in a Y shape There were ample seating space plug points to charge your phones and also an enclosed section with desks and chairs to do any work on your computer Large glass windows afforded views of the runways and let sunlight stream in Bathrooms clean TSA security was thorough Check in counters are opened a couple of hours before a flight and I found the staff friendly Car rental booths are in the baggage conveyor belt section and long term parking is just outside the terminal as are the parking lots for rental cars minimal walking required Very easy and fast entry and exit intoout of terminal Driving directions to airport were clearly marked Only a couple of shopsstores for food and drinks A selection of Wisconsin beer was available in the restaurant but not my favorite Leinenkugel Overall a very pleasant airport

VeronaTimisoaraChisinau The flight from Verona departed almost hours late resulting in hours late arrival at the final destination The company didnt provide sufficient information as to the causes of delay Voucher provided for food and drinks doesnt get you much in Verona airport I should commend them for holding the flight TimisoaraChisinau on the tarmac until a number of connecting passengers flying from all over Italy made it to Timisoara Onboard the service was good Offered hot meal alcoholic drinks and good attitude from flight attendants despite the stress and extended working hours caused by the delay Service on the TimisoaraChisinau leg also good Overall three stars Two stars for handling the delay and stars for service attitude and the fact that they did get us to the final destination on the same day despite a long delay

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

Airport is easy to reach by metro train and taxi Check in area and departure area have been perfectly clean In the check in area only few shops and restaurant available departure area have more choice but I did not use them as I used the lounge Check in went fast and efficient same for security check Staff was professional

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

Rode Intersky from SalzburgZurich As it was a short flight I wasnt expecting much I expected wrong Usually airlines with a fleet this small or flights this short wouldnt have as a excellent service as this airline Outstanding selection of drinks and more than two selections of free snacks The flight attendants were kind and the takeoff and landing were smooth as if the plane were a jet and not a prop Would definitely fly them again

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

We boarded on time but we had hour delay due to traffic at ATH get too hot so crew open doors again and served water Plane was nice and clean Crew were very friendly We landed with half an hour delay Nice inflight service for hm flight

This was my first time on EVA Air and I must say that it was a highly impressive experience Yes it was pricey flying premium economy but at this will be the only way to fly when traveling to Asia from here on out unless traveling business I found the premium economy cabin to be more than satisfactory The seats of course were not lie flat but they still had enough pitch to be comfortable And the one thing that stood out were the cushions in seating There was enough padding that I wasnt even remotely uncomfortable throughout the entire flight I arrived in Taipei from LAX comfortable and refreshed The service was good and the food though not Michelinrated was still perfectly fine I would fly them again While some may say its not different enough from coach to make it worth the money when youre it makes a big difference Ive flown economy to Asia and never again

I have used the comfortable Cr Colombo Airport in Genoa at least times in the last years Small comfortable no crowd no queue security check is not the standard paranoia of the EU just lazy smiles Friendly staff excellent shop excellent coffee shop fantastic quality of espresso good grappa and beer reasonably priced And not to forget it is comfortable to rent a car and drive anywhere in the Ligurian Coast easy car return the Airport is before Genova on the road One of my favorite airports

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings

The Plaza Business Lounge at Brisbane Airport was comfortable enough with a range of food and drinks but no tonic for a GT There were very few toilets in the lounge though On board the A the seat was comfortable and the service was friendly and responsive My vegetarian meals were good but breakfast was served far too early interrupting sleep The plane for the connecting service to Sapporo was an unreconstructed A with oldstyle business class seating but comfortable enough for a hour flight The service and vegetarian food out of Taipei were both excellent Overall China Airlines is a good way to travel between Australia and Japan at a reasonable price

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame
Tu Moscow St Petersburg Creature comforts not up to modern aircraft standards but superb real experience Food quite good and service good Do it before the Tus become a thing of the past

Because LH flights from FDHCGN are now to FRA only and at inconvenient times followed by connections to CGN by train I elected to fly InterSky instead Very clean aircraft and professional service throughout But for an Economy one way ticket price of they could surely provide at least a free cup of coffee Poor value everything else fine

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

I fly in and out of here regularly and am very impressed For a small airport TSA is efficient and does not do a lot of unnecessary screening just to have something to do as at other small airports The gate crews work very hard to get you out ontime and luggage retrieval is easy Rental car offices are next to baggage claim and other than Budget are extremely helpful There is a coffee shop upstairs as well as a barrestaurant everyone is friendly here and pricing is reasonable Two minutes from I The place seems pleasantly ignorant of airport hassles that have descended upon much of the industry
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

Im a Connecticut resident and use Bradley a halfdozen times a year Terminal A is perfectly serviceable nothing fancy but it does the trick Luckily most carriers use it Terminal B which I understand will be closed at the end of cannot be demolished fast enough It is an eyesore with next to no services I guess its only advantage is for people who wonder what air travel used to be like in the s and s They can see firsthand in Terminal B I wish BDL had service to longer haul hubs like DEN and SLC but I guess there isnt enough demand Nonetheless Im perfectly happy using the airport Its smaller size means fewer delays quicker deplaning and some breathing room

Clean plane totally indifferent crew but what is absolutely amazing is that on such a long flight the flight attendants did not distribute a single drop of water to passengers except to those will to pay for overpriced items not even the cheapest low cost airlineand this was not a low cost would do better

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

nd largest airport in Philippines has terminals T is for international flights Checkin Level has main banks of Checkin counters AD at the back is the Departures area firstly Passport Control with manned counters and then Security Scanning both of which were quickly achieved Main Departures has the usual array of shops and duty free shops and cafes Some views of the gates and airfield There is lounge which covers most of the carriers premium customers its tired but has a reasonable selection of food on offer and seats with view of the apron Airport busy but did not feel overcrowded

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

Domestic Terminal is older than the International Terminal and was clearly the airport in the past Only few in and out on domestic flights The planes are parked on the apron and usually passengers walk to and from Arrivals is through the single gate to the Baggage Spur not a circular belt so things can pile up if there is a lot of luggage There are toilets before the Arrivals Hall The whole terminal is a single story with Arrivals at one end and Departures at the other end There are no facilities in the Departure Lounge after Security Within the terminal there are a couple of shops selling snacks and souvenirs and a Money Changing booth The whole experience is pretty good not many flights and a generally relaxed friendly attitude You would not believe you were in the Capital City
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers

I cant remember when the last time I was here but nevertheless it was a pleasant surprise to use the airport again Many places to have food and the atmosphere was pleasant Just one thing that I disliked was the toilet in the common area It was really smelly and should be dealt with immediately

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

Excellent security Left my laptops by mistake at security and went to my plane I noticed once in the plane While I couldnt deboard the staff and pilot called security and they were found and brought to lost and found A friend picked them up days later

Travelled again with SunExpresss for a short break to AYT I dont understand the negative reviews as they are totally at odds with every experience I have had with this airline The cabin crew both out and back were fantastic Very friendly polite well groomed and nothing was too much trouble I would not hesitate to travel with them again

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard
Seattle to Dallas Great flight and spacious cabin Had a connection from Vancouver Staff went above and beyond First class meal was very delicious and the crew was extremely nice

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal

Bennett at the TSA first check point was so incredibly sweet to our son and his attitude was great Im sure everyone that works for the TSA feels this way on the inside but he was clearly showing it to us on the outside Keeper
