Mumbai Airport never fails to impress me from the dedicated drop off options or the overall efficiency It is my favourite major airport to travel from I am more impressed with arrival facilities but even departure is as good as it gets Only fundamental issue is its very overcrowded

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

The security staff were incredibly slow and seemed to be more interested in personal chats than getting customers through the security process as quickly as possible Why not be more proactive you will get less tension with customers shorter queues and a better job satisfaction You dont need to be unfriendly and impersonal

The improvements I mentioned in were completed on schedule and have given this airport a new and modern feel Unfortunately the upper level is no longer a viewing deck area However a new restaurant with a view of the airfield was installed on the ground floor Facilities are top class considering the size of the airport A brand new baggage retrieval area was added to the airport The layout of the airport works well Staff are still just as friendly

Pleasant and easy check in Perfectly organized boarding Clean and new aircraft Spacious seat distance however seat width not as wide as other carrier on this route Pleasant crew Very good food which however was served a bit late At arrival fast border control and bag arrived rather soon however priority sticker did not give the bag priority delivery

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

It makes my day to be served by caring thoughtful polite and lovely stewardess that hard to come by as far as SQ is concerned serving own homeland A great applaud to Natalie For the moment we step into the plane and settle down this lady greet us with broad smile I am so grateful of her coming to my rescue to help me ease my gastric by going the extra mile to get me biscuits and hot drinks when they are busy out of their normal routine and SOP Caring enough to come by to check on me that Im well When we ask for drinks that help to soothe my daughter vomiting other staff just cant help and said they cant do anything Here come our hero Natalie whom with her sincere thoughtfulness and care to fetch my daughter a hot peppermint tea which is not serve in economy class Hopefully the next round I will meet her again She deserve to be the one wearing green uniform Well done Natalie You are a role model for rest to follow

LimaCusco and three other internal flights within Peru All flights on time and quality of aircraft pilots as in landing and take offs was exceptional Aircraft were almost new As all were clean including the toilets which cannot always be taken for granted on an aircraft that is subjected to multiple take offs and landings during the day FAs very professional A very good experience

Dusseldorf to Paris CDG return on Embraer E jets The plane was very clean x configuration as standard with extremely wide seats I am cm on pounds and the seats were wide and long enough for my legs There was enough leg space including space for luggage below the seat Some people had trouble finding space for their luggage overhead but that is a problem on regional jets Shortly after takeoff the first round of drinks was served water and coffee without charge On the next run through about minutes later we got pretzels and salted peanuts Overall I am impressed by HOP and would recommend it Great staff outstanding service and a very pleasurable seating experience make it the perfect option for short trips

Friedrichshafen Hamburg It was one of my best experiences on a regional flightairline Aircraft was clean The crew CheckIn to cabin crew was very polite as well as highly professional Flight attendant made clearly understandable announcementssafety demos The only downside is that Intersky asks passengers to pay prohibitive expensive prices for onboard drinkssnacks But since they consider themselves as a low cost airline truly providing LCC price level it was no surprise and everybody is free not to buy anything

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh
Madrid to Toulouse Once again a punctual and comfortable flight Good legroom on time departure and arrival On flight entertainment was however not working you have to pay for anything on board

Our flight arrived very late and the hotel shuttle stopped running Bryce was very kind to help us find transportation to our hotel He went above and beyond his job to make sure we arrived safely I was very satisfied

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

Flew with Alitalia on both arrival and departure used jetbridge which was a plus It is compact and functional There is train service to city center Its quite convenient Security line moved quite efficiently during my Saturday morning departure The space is quite small on airside Seats are located at the gate where boarding passengers would walk pastline up while you wait Bari will need to expand the airport very soon

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

Outstanding Customer Service from Air China Jakarta Airport Ground Staff On October nd I arrived from Sydney to Jakarta Qantas planning to board within hours on Air China CA to Beijing then to Madrid and Sao Paulo Due to Qantas airplane problems the Qantas flight arrived hours late leaving me with only hours to board Air China Unfortunately Qantas refused to give any assistance to facilitate the very short time for check in Talking to the Indonesia immigration agent he called Air China ground staff who sent an agent with a mission to help meI did not have a Visa on Arrival no boarding card and a checked luggage at Qantas The agent did everything to make me board the Air China flight talked many times to the immigration officers called Air China office to send a letter to the immigration and ran times to the Air China counter to try to solve all bureaucratic issues The agent and other Air China agents issued all documentation needed and ran with me and my luggage through Jakarta terminal be able to catch the flight Boarding the Air China flight CA in such a short time was a small miracle that was possible because of the competence and excellent service of Jakartas Air China ground staff

The flight attendants are top notch service is gracious and consistent Little things like coming by often to take trash asking your preferences clearly and sincere friendliness that I think is sadly lacking in some airlines these days I dont know how they manage to do it but the eggs are truly good Also this is the only airline in which I was served a dish I tried to recreate once I got home a corn salad with red onions and feta Delicious They do not serve typical Korean food but all I ask of airline food in economy is that the food not be disgusting Air Premias dishes can actually be described as good The legroom in economy is by far the biggest selling point of this airline Even though their entertainment options are severely limited I am completely happy with economy on Air Premia
Wonderful Right size efficient super clean reliable in all weather conditions and wonderful ergonomics

Islamabad to Manchester Very prompt check in for Shaheen Air No hassle Boarding very professional and well organised Friendly cabin staff Clean very aircraft Good quality food served lunch Asian style and evening dinner European style and plenty of cold drinks coffee tea Little treats like chocolates also served during flight Food served on time and promptly This flight had free Wifi which worked well Generally very happy with Shaheen Air I would definitely recommend and I would fly again with them
A smallish airport with limited facilities but clean and comfortable

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The check in was fast and the staff friendly The departure arrival were punctual and the aircraft made an average good maintained impression The seat distance was sufficiently good Despite the short flight there was a small bite and water Overall a good experience

Never had any problems flying in and out of John WayneOrange County Airport Its clean security is quick and efficient and has that laid back atmosphere that is OC Its very convenient even when it comes to flying internationally you can get almost anywhere in the world with no more than one stopover At times Ill fly out of LAX if Im not in the mood for that stopover but OC always offers a pleasant alternative for convenience and efficiency Because of its curfew a lot of planes depart first thing in the morning so getting there early is advised But overall a great airport
On time departure Excellent value and they gave a meal on a hour flight We arrived mins early Staff was professional Bags delivered in a normal amount of time

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

For departures Algiers new airport is fairly spacious functional and the staff is friendly I might have been lucky but I found the police controls and security to go fairly quickly Shops are limited but I found them sufficient also they are open very early and close late The choice of restaurants is limited to for each hall and they are of the same provider They offer reasonable selections of light eating and drinking On arrivals I find it inadequate to have to walk down stairs after coming off the plane I did not see an elevator available The wait for the luggage is too long I was told it was due to the luggage scanner being undersized for the traffic One important deficiency is the absence of English signs they are all in French and Arabic only A shame for a brand new International airport Over all I was satisfied mainly due to efficiency at departure and the feeling of space which is lacking too often in aging European airports

Landed H from CPT and out in mins as no baggage Long walk as aircraft parked far Very nice and clean airport Really like the wide choice of outdoor restaurants in the garden Pup and go vehicles move fast Police and security officials visible
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Once again American Eagle operated by Republic Airways delivered a reliable safe and comfortable flight from Washington DCA to Philadelphia Republic continues to uphold American Airlines commitment to excellence providing a seamless experience despite minor operational challenges Our departure was delayed due to traffic changes at DCA following recent tragic events but the crew handled the situation with professionalism and care Their dedication to passenger comfort and safety was evident throughout the flight ensuring a smooth and reassuring journey While delays are never ideal the priority is always arriving safelyand thats exactly what happened Kudos to Republic Airways and the outstanding crew for their continued commitment to quality service

Kuala Namu International Airport is it is the second largest airport after SoekarnoHatta International Airport but the first airport which has a direct rail link to Medan city the capital of North Sumatra Kuala Namu is the most comfortable and the most modern airport in Indonesia

I was down with flu and surprised when I checked in and cleared passport that the airport did not have any pharmacies or clinics inside the airport This is the first time in a long history of travel that an airport doesnt have these facilities Very disappointed

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

Praslin to Mahe Over zealous security screening at Praslin when they noticed we had packed a small pack of batteries in our hold baggage Had to take out every item of clothing until they were found and no time to repack On check in we thought we had prepaid for excess baggage via our travel agent only to be told it had not gone through Staff could see that we had completed the process but still charged us the airport price rather than the online price Staff completely unhelpful and appeared to take great pleasure in making things as difficult as possible Would not give us any assistance of any contact details Currently taking up the issue with their customer services and the office of their CEO Flight cramped and noisy recommend ear plugs and very warm Plus side it was shorter than most bus journey I normally take No assistance offered by ground crew getting on or off the plane with flimsy hand rail and low doorway

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great

Zurich to Dresden via their hub in Dusseldorf Both flights on As Checked in in ZRH without any hassle or feeling entering a lowcost carrier Gate bridging in airports convenient and saved time Flights were both precise on timing and arrival Luggage inscribed transferred and delivered within Minutes on final destination Transit in Dusseldorf smooth Payable catering service onboard rendered several interesting options from printed menu leaflets The airline was better than most reviews indicate I must render them credit at least out of If I had access to their lounges in ZRH and DUS the trip would have been perfected Not cheap but reliable no faults and could fly them again

Bradleys new A terminal is fantastic Finally we can show pride in our states airport and hopefully swing travelers to Hartford rather then Boston or New York As said before the old B terminal thats serves American and Indepence is really worn down Signs of TWA and Pan Am still are posted throughout the terminal which is more or less one giant hallway Security is quick and all the checkins are well light and clean New parking garage makes getting to terminal A even easier Just need to do up B and we can be a worldclass airport

Our flight from Murica to Bournemouth was cancelled and the holiday was a disaster but the staff at Bournemouth were so helpful they kept me up to date with information they sorted all the car parking out and made sure we all made it home without any major issues The thing was no matter how many people say about the drop off fee of so what for a local airport min drive parking min walk to the building nice and calm and relaxing food was amazing now they have costa so what else would you need

Arrived at the airport and one of the customer service agents was very helpful He helped me with picking up my luggage connecting to WiFi and was very friendly His name was Houssem Thank you so much for all the hard work

Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

What a lovely place The tiniest airport an aerodrome actually I have been to People are lovely they take care of you There is a bar free wifi if it doesnt work in some areas ask for the airlines it is kept clean The only thing is getting there taxi only as far as I know

Manston is an excellent small airport The staff immigration customs and police are friendly but still professional Checkin was handled well Security was a little laborious but was thorough and in no way objectionable There is a small shop and a barcafeteria which considering the short amount of time needed to check in is all that is required A great option for those traveling to or from the south east corner of England I hope the route to Amsterdam is successful as it is so much more pleasant than flying from one of the big London airports Heathrow in particular I have heard that a rail link will be coming

Funchal to Porto Santo This minutes flight is a true experience Aero Vip carries out the public service obligation connection between Funchal and the smaller Porto Santo airport located on the island with the same name The outbound flight was on a vintage Jetstream turboprop airliner with the return flight being on a slightly older Jetstream In both cases the safety briefing was carried out by the first officer himself as the plane does not have any FA on board The outbound flight left right on time and touched down in PXO just minutes later The plane on the way back arrived late and we left PXO with some minutes of delay again reaching our destination in slight over minutes The planes interiors are quite worn out but overall the planes gave me the impression of being in a good mechanical shape If you take this flight to reach the beaches in Porto Santo as was my case the whole flight is a really fun and unique retroexperience for aviation enthusiasts which unfortunately comes with a hefty price tag EUR return It needs to be said however that the rates are much cheaper for residents who need this flight as a means to ensure territorial continuity

Taupo is a tiny regional airport servicing the central North Island of New Zealand When I say tiny I mean tiny arrivals departures check in security lounge and facilities are all in one room Its serviced by the regional arm of Air New Zealand and is a a great option for getting into the Heart of Lords of the Rings country Theres rarely any queuing the staff are very friendly helpful and polite Bags are delivered just a few minutes after stepping off the plane Food and drink options are limited Theres a cafe but it seems to closed more often than open

Overall quite satisfied with this flight The service of the flight attendants was very good very attentive and thoughtful which made me feel their attentiveness and warmth The cabin seats were a bit hard the entertainment system was partially out of order the movie selection was relatively small the route was long and there werent enough movies to watch I am quite satisfied with everything else and would recommend this airline to my friends

Oldest airport that is still in use but great The mother of all airports has an impressive architecture huge size and is very close to the city Unfortunately SN Brussels airlines is the only largest airline flying there together with some local airlines Unfortunately they want to close it in the next years but the building will not be destroyed

I had my period during the departure and didnt have sanitary paper with me My departure was from Terminal and after entering it there was no place where I could get it It is important that such things as sanitarny paper or diaper for babies are available to buy on an airport It should be available in the toilet or in one of the shops I had to ask several women which were also waiting for a plane whether they have sanitary paper It was uncomfortable I found sanitary paper cause one of the women had it but I could be less fortunate

Durbans new airport King Shaka International was opened for the World Cup It was designed as a stateofthe art regional airport for Durban KwaZuluNatal region The is plenty of space for stopping in the dropoff zone with direct access to the terminal There are seperate checkin islands for BA SAA and Emirates The departure concourse is spacious with enough seating for waiting passengers In the arrivals hall there is a food court with a Piazza some shops a Woolworths banks and post office Also a tourist information office After security there is plenty of space Unfortunately some lounges were closed due to renovations but this is only temporary The domestic terminal has plenty of space so a quiet corner for reading or working is not a problem If more international arrivals departures materialise then the current departure gates could prove to be a bit underdimensioned in the future

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

A small but efficiently operating airport Arrival was smooth and fast even when there was an additional covid document check There are enough small shops and food and beverages available Transportation is best done by train which will cost only euro
Great service safety standard met Comfy seat and nice snacks The staffs in all aspects are very kind and very helpful Sad it will merge with Thai Airways

Not a bad little airport Plenty of space and seating if you need to wait a while But like all most Chinese airports the departure shops are terrible and expensive Bring your own snacks drinks or something to read Nothing to see there but it is comfortable enough

Easy access by bus or taxi Two terminals International on the right Domestic on the left as you face them but only metres apart Signs in English as well as Russian although all announcements are in Russian as you would expect How many of the staff speak English may be a good question one who does is the AviaNova manager Easy layout to navigate in domestic terminal although there is not much space for the checkin queues so they snake around the room However the staff for my flight anyway were very efficient and the queue moved quickly Security check was quick and easy Airside has an expensive cafe and coffee shop as well as a newsstand and gift shop Plenty of comfortable seating WiFi is available good signal but every site I tried came up with Security Certificate not issued by Trusted Source so theres possibly some bug in their software I didnt do any more than just log in Bussed to plane only complaint as with so many of these airports is that you go upstairs to a departure lounge and then have to walk back down for the bus

Chicago OHare to Savannah and return October Have used Savannah HHI International for many years when flying to Hilton Head Island SC A really very pleasant little airport serving mostly Delta and United Express internal flights Friendly check in staff quick luggage retrieval and absolutely the best Car Rental desks just yards along the same floor from Luggage Retrieval with the cars park right outside the Terminal This is a relatively small International Airport but there is a pleasant courtyard with a couple of shops and eating choices with lots of tables and chairs and a great information desk Once through security there is a surprising range of nice eating choices BUT of course they may not necessarily be open for a late night departure Have used many USA Airports over the years but this and RenoSparks in Nevada is the gem would unhesitatingly recommend

Brussels to Milan Malpensa With only euros including drink and snack this flight was a real bargain CityJet flies this route on behalf of Brussels Airlines with a rare plane in the west the Russian built Sukhoi Superjet This turned out to be a rather silent seating plane with a good legroom The nice crew the punctual departure and a truly beautiful view of the Swiss alps made this flight a very nice one

Heho to Yangon Another very good flight same ATR aircraft no seat numbers given but all very easy boarding Plenty of space seating and inflight snacks given with coffee or Tea One member of crew not happy but not the end of the world At I had no problem with the seat space in fact better than many European airlines

Vancouver to Phoenix We sat on the tarmac waiting and waiting for passengers to make their connection The flight attendant already announced that everyone was on board and the captain comes up and says we are waiting for more passengers What is fair To give us an on time arrival or wait for passengers and get everyone delayed No brainer

Our flight attendant Julie was very friendly attending to the needs of not only first class but coach too She remembered drinks and kept our thirst quenched She was always busy and helpful Always giving a beautiful smile to each customer She is a perfect representative for Sky West and should be be commended for a job well done

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

Juan Santamara International Airport has gotten much better over the years Clean and modern The arrival process customs and immigration are as smooth as they can be Departures are easy too they could do better with the Exit Tax process long lines and no where to fill out the forms I understand some airlines will start allowing you to pay in advance which is excellent The food inside the terminal is ridiculously expensive I paid for a fast food breakfast sandwich I still dont understand why they have to check each carryon bag again at the gate when we were just screened and xrayed going through security It just slows the boarding process down

A postmodern airport with many good restaurants and very spacious and comfortable environment Inside the departure area you have an amazing view of the aircrafts The seats are very ergonomic and delightful All the airports areas are very clean and hygienic On the other hand there are not many signals explaining the directions for each of the airports areas and facilities
The staff are very professional Providing the best services in such a short flight Keep on the good work guys Food are nice seats are comfortable

What a great little airport Friendly staff in all areas and in my opinion unique system to me anyway of scanning the hold luggage whilst youre with it before its loaded onto the aircraft Domestic departure lounge is small but plenty of seating available

Was a very pleasant flight the crew was very helpful at all times I was an unaccompanied minor and throughout the journey the crew helped me with all the procedures the flight was very comfortable Would definitely use Ethiopian Airlines whenever Im traveling and would recommend it to friends and family Most of all Ms Leli was the best

Good small airport The staff is not friendly at all First nobody smile in that airport and when i pass the gate they dont greeting at the search point and passport point One guy he just pointing me by hand what to do and chewing gum in your face

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there

Very Crowded check in and long security lines However once past security it was a very clean and nice airport Not enough seats in the gate area however Just know where you are going and leave plenty of time before your flight

Hong Kong to Xian Being the second time travelling with Cathay Dragon my impression towards this airline is greatly improved In my flight to Xian except for my IFE that failed to show the flight map everything just went right and nothing special happens the cabin crew also provided good service to us However as things went wrong in the return flight back from Xian to Hong Kong the excellence of the Cathay staff is well demonstrated As the Hong Kong Airport Authority restricted flights from landing in Hong Kong that day after we entered the cabin with the door closed we were still not sure whether we can fly The cabin crew reacted professionally to answer many enquiries from passengers meals were served on ground and we could just wait for further notifications from the pilot Finally the flight was delayed to the next day we were then forced to leave the cabin and went back to the airport the only thing that made me discontented is that there was no any compensation from the airline though the airport restriction issue is not the problem of the airline In the delayed flight next day we saw the same crew and they also showed how professional they are After knowing that it is the birthday of one of our friends they even provided snacks and gifts to us Their quality of service was just awesome and left us very deep impression It is really an unforgettable experience travelling with Cathay Dragon and it is definitely a yes if I have a chance to travel with them once more

Flew internal flights in Burma with this local airline Surprisingly new plane pretty much on time and with very pleasant crews Also served a good snack gave out towels although flights were only about minutes Was a bit reticent about using them but very pleasantly surprised

The best airport in the Philippines Brand new free wifi seamless arrival and departure and plenty of excellent food choices The connection between international and domestic is by foot and very short Connecting flights is so easy

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards

A fine small airport great personal service clean well decorated easy parking simple and efficient signage has a luxury feel befitting the Palm Beach Clientele Food selection adequate and reasonable Parking is a breeze Always many security personnel and queue times very short A pleasure to travel to or from

A supposedly international city airport and in the huge transit area the managers dont even manage to install a few water fountains for cool refreshing water for tired and thirsty travellers especially those with children What an appalling omission It is a shame really as in most other respects the airport is very pleasant

Lovely experience through check in and security at around am this morning th July The chap at Tui desk was friendly professional and helpful All four members of staff at security were great Helpful friendly and professional Lovely atmosphere At the caf a lovely women served me Smile on her face Finally going through to boarding gate yet again a friendly cheerful and helpful lady checked me in am by this stage Its a small airport The shop and caf are small Im not here to shop or sit drinking Im here to have an ideally stress free start to my holiday The staff make this place Thank you

This was the most amusing flight I have ever flown as I got to share some laughs with not only fellow passengers but with a hostess Anyway I was seated in row row was an exit row so I was invited to sit there since it was empty and was willingable to assist in case of an emergency Te leg room is excellent and I measure cm The staff were professional and courteous Bags came out quickly We were given water upon boarding then a chocolate bar then a croissant filled with chocolate sauce worth the calories and finally a small drink

Cochabamba is a very small international airport some flights of Boliviano de Aviacion arrive from Buenos Aires Sao Paulo and seaonsally to Madrid It has enough space for the flights and people who use this terminal One of the most interesting things about this airport is its food court has plenty of choices and types of food and best of all if you are traveling on low budget there is a public transport service that will take you straight to town for almost nothing cents If traveling for tourism or business there is no other choice to get to the center of Bolivia Wifi runs great and its totally free

My son and I flew them in June from Copenhagen to Podgorica It was an older F aircraft but quite comfortable In fact we commented on how far the seats reclined The flight attendants were nice and the cockpit crew did a nice job getting us there safely We departed on time and arrived on time No complaints
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage
Its not crowded Its very new and clean airport Sign and directions are easy to follow Before my departure time I really enjoy spending time Ankara airport Esenboga

I pass thru Miri airport at least once a month now that I work here It is nice and clean and all counter staff courteous and efficient do visit the lounge as they accept paying walk in customers Also a recent addition that is quiet welcome are the massage chairs

Flew Mahan Air economy class from Dubai to Tehran IKA with Mahan Air A felt safe the aircraft was clean and comfortable Cabin crew service was friendly and efficient Quality of food and beverages non alocholic were of good standard Would recommend this airline to everyone

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

Definitely deserves Nice staff and beautiful sight I loved how they just fit I didnt like that there are two gates and you have to wait a while for the second one too Usually there is only one The bathrooms were clean and had great terminal seating
Singapore to Tioman Island We found the check in staff very welcoming friendly and helpful The flight in the dash was what real flying is all about Again the crew were very friendly

DSA to BOJ Balkan Holidays airlines have got better and better prices onboard are expensive and prices are not in seirling Leg room is great and the newer aeroplanes are comfortable for hours Cabin crew helpful and friendly

Es una aerolnea fantstica el personal es muy amable el precio muy asequible Me gustara que hubiera vuelos a ms lugares A Gran Canaria solamente hay dos vuelos a la semana desde mi lugar de residencia estara mejor que hubiera mas Its a fantastic airline the staff is very friendly and the prices are very affordable I wish there were flights to more places There are only two flights a week to Gran Canaria from where I live more would be better

Used Kilimanjaro as our entry point for Tanzanias northern safari circuit KLM was the only flight arrival at the time the airport though small had the fresh feel of yester years relaxed airports walking to arrival area ushered by ground staff No soulless airbridges and automatic sliding doors leading to empty spaces The whole ambience was relaxed Immigration was quick and efficient they had a green and red channel when tried to walk through green channel were asked politely to go through red were asked a few cursory questions and waved through total time from disembarkation from the airplane to the waiting car less than minutes The charm of this airport is that it is not like the other mega airports small and fresh

The airport is pretty clean Though its small its pretty cute like a park or resort This uniqueness suits the vacation vibe of the beautiful island of Koh Samui Different types of seating areas are available there are a few shops diners and a caf Checkin and immigration were both very efficient A courtesy corner full of snacks and drinks is available for free to all passengers However I wasnt able to connect to the airport WiFi

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free

On time departure from Larnaca to Leipzig Very friendly crew I was surprised that of them including first officer was from Greece and Cyprus Very nice and colorful aircraft that makes your day Wind in Leipzig was not calm it was about kts Perfect landing

The airport is mid being rebuilt arrivals still in progress but departures all complete Departures was very quick no checkin or security queue it was a Tuesday but our plane was fairly full Great clean toilets friendly staff the only major fail is despite it all being brand new there is nowhere near enough seats expect to be sitting on the floors also not much food on offer if you cannot eat wheatbased food groups

Port Elizabeth airport is small and friendly Best thing about it is that it is so close to the main seafront area you can be on the beach about minutes after leaving the airport if you want Slight disadvantage once you are on the beach is that planes go right over your head Also very close to CBD and the pleasant suburb of Walmer PE known as the Friendly City and the airport gives it a good introduction

Pensacola isnt a fancy airport but its fine functional and beautiful Even the exterior architecture greets travelers in a way that reminds them of the waves and big skies of Florida This is also a better alternative in my opinion to flying out of other Gulf Coast airports such as Mobile Tallahassee and GulfportBiloxi Pickup and dropoff are a breeze Checkin is hasslefree Security is a breeze and even more so with TSA PreCheck Dining and shopping options arent ample but do get the job done nicely remember PNS is a small airport Boarding the flight is easy Pensacola is just a very modern efficient airport one that reminds me a lot of other smaller airports like Louisville however no small airports in this country set the world standard like Wellington and Christchurch both in New Zealand do

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport

A small but very nice airport just km from the city center The distances are short checkin hassle free and handling staff very friendly I was very happy to hear international traffic had been approved about a year ago Nowadays there are international flights to Brussels and Copenhagen I really support the development of this airport because of the proximity to the city center the short distances and a problem free handling

Brand new airport On the positive side for Chinese standards it certainly is welldesigned and wellconnected Bright and clean checkin area Good choice of restaurants and cafes both before and after security controls As to the negatives the security controls are quite inefficient and slow the airline lounges are all quite poor and certain gates from upward are very far up to min walking

I am a big fan of this airport It has only four or five checkin desks and lots of plants and pine furniture in the small departure hall It feels quite homely The staff at check in and at the small cafe have always been pleasant when I have flown from here I have also flown from Vasteras when the weather conditions have been dreadful very cold and heavy snow and everything at the airport and the shuttle bus from Stockholm have functioned with typical Swedish efficiency

Iconic scheduled flight to TenzingHillary Airport in the Himalayas Boarding at Kathmandu was very prompt The flight itself is an experience Fairly strict baggage weight restrictions due to the small size of the aircraft and very short landing runway Surprisingly given the tiny size of aircraft there was still a member of cabin crew onboard giving safety instructions and handing out sweets during the flight The cockpit was openly accessible and viewable from the cabin giving stunning views of the mountains and the landing sequence

Launceston Airport has seen a large redevelopment program completed over the period At the northern end of the terminal are checkin counters for Qantaslink Jetstar Virgin Blue and Tiger Airways which has created more room than before Southern end of the terminal has two baggage carousels added with car rental counters opposite for Avis Budget Europcar Hertz Thrifty Red Spot New upgraded retail outlets are provided in the central section of the terminal which are Newslink Long Bar and Hudsons Coffee This central area has been expanded with a greater amount of room making it easier when more than one flight is in at the same time New security area directs passengers downstairs to new roomy departure lounges which are now at the lower level Windows at the central section and the departure lounges give visitors and passengers great views of the mountains east of the airport This redevelopment has made Launceston Airport a lot more user friendly than previously

Excellent airport Well organized Airlines and security staff are friendly and professional Good customer service The airport building is very clean and modern Good parking indoor and outdoor next to the terminal Easy to go around In conclusion a place were its pleasant to go

Domestic h flight from Ulaanbaatar to Dalandzadgad in South Mongolia on Hunnu Air in July Checkin and security clearance at the old ULN Chengis Khan Airport reasonably swift Departure and arrival on time Very pleasantly appointed ATR in good state of repair Friendly flight attendants Coffee water snacks All announcements in Mongolian and Russian I guess Cabin crew also speaks no English

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

Nice and clean airport As an avgeek I love watching planes and there are so many big windows next to restaurants to watch planes Security wasnt long The checkin staff were really nice On arrival Immigration was really quick and baggage claim was surprisingly quick Very quick and free wifi

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

I fly weekly for work and Gerald R Ford Intl Airport in Grand Rapids is one of my two homebase airports Its served by American Delta United Southwest and Allegiant and has nonstop flights to twentysomething destinations I primarily fly American and mostly take flights that connect through Chicago OHare or DallasFort Worth GRR is a larger regional airport with two concourses of gates each but not a large airport by any means I can park in the garage walk in clear security TSA PreCheck and walk to my gate within minutes of driving into the garage I love that kind of convenience Employees are friendly and helpful pretty much across the board at the airline counters security and at the gates GRR recently finished a fairly large renovation in late They now have one central security checkpoint and a central area with new shopping and dining including a local brewpub Starbucks and a Michiganthemed souvenir shop There are also new lounge areas childrens play area and a business center not to mention new large restrooms In general GRR operates on time which is key for me Most delays Ive experienced have come from aircraft delayed at their originating airport mostly OHare Im basically comfortable relying on this airport for my weekly business travel needs

Yahukimo to Jayapura Flight was about an hour late quite normal in this remote place Plane was comfortable enough with reclining seats and even a box of tea provided unlike on the sole competitors flights on this route

Ryanair flight operated by Lauda Europe was on time Legroom wasnt great but was only just slightly worse than the same route with Austrian Airlines The crew were awesome a special shoutout to the female crew member who managed the iceinthecup situation for me I would happily fly this airline again its about the same as Austrian Airlines except you dont get a free small chocolate Recommended

Only good thing about Bangalore airport terminal is it is beautiful and clean No other facilities available like other airports It does not have much food stalls and shopping area near GATES Moreover toilet are very far from gate location Less seating areas

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

It always a good experience to fly from to Nuremberg airport because you have short ways It is connected with the metroline U so you are in minutes at the city centre You can eat some local stuff The staff is friendly and helpful The most important to the end WIFI is free

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention
Kaohsiung International airport are one of the best airport to entry Taiwan Now with all the transportation by subway which can easy get from Kaohsiung down town to Kaohsiung airport in mins

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

BudapestVenice Marco Polo Malev put me on this Moldavian Airlines flight without warning of a code share Proved to be a fairly pleasant flight in the end Food consisted of a chocolate bar and a glass of Hungarian red wine On the way back the flight was a little late arriving and they clearly rushed everyone on without having time to clean up The connection between Malev and Moldavian airlines is confusing The pilot thanked us for flying with Malev but the stewardesses were in Moldavian uniforms and the plane was clearly Moldavian

Zhuliany airport is located close to the main business district of Kiev Very small and cosy it is pleasant to fly to and from there on international destinations as everything is done very fast However the airport is not made for international travellers who dont speak Russian or Ukrainian The airport has a bad connection to transit system but taxi fares are attractive and solve the problem if your driver as of January asks you more than to go to the city center then he is abusing you Security and passport check staff are professional and polite The domestic terminal is much more simple and has no service at all for passengers

Staff all very helpful in particular a lady from the special assistance team She went above and beyond what a lovely lady who clearly is very devoted to her job role We would choose to fly from Eindhoven airport again as our experience was so smooth and professionally handled Thank you such a small thing to say I hope this gets back to the whole team

Upon arrival at MRV discovered a new arrivals hall since my last visit in October last year Baggage very quick into hall Outside a pleasant array of kiosks should you need anything food wise Departures hall is spotless and some nice Caucasian shops to spend your Rubles in Security quick and easy and departure lounge has a nice cafe and a few more shops A pleasant experience before the hassle of Domodedevo

NurSultan to Almaty return I bought the tickets on the companys website Initially I planned to travel with just a hand baggage but the day before the flight I managed to add a baggage on the website for tg The flights were excellent Flight attendants sold buy onboard drinks and snacks Arrival was just on time The ticket price turned out to be cheaper even than the Talgo train

We found Banjul airport very efficient and friendly As we were on foot from the main road we were expecting a long walk to the terminal but we shouldnt have worried as within m of the airport entrance we were asked if we would like a lift in a chauffeur driven car taking the security supervisor to work We gratefully accepted and on reaching the terminal he insisted on helping us check in quickly as we had no hold baggage Boarding cards in hand we rapidly went through security and mins later were sitting in the pleasant open air departure area and ordering a couple of beers and a sandwich Service indeed and for the most part delivered with a smile

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit

My adult daughter had just returned from her connection in Las Vegas to Baltimore Airport in route to her final home destination in Maryland My daughter had difficulty locating her car and had gotten on the wrong airport bus Now normally this is frustrating for anyone but my daughter is autistic so trying to problem solve while in a heightened emotional state is a big struggle for her Morgan is higher functioning and prides herself on how independent she is but after a night of flying across country and running to connection flights she was feeling defeated and concerned about finding her vehicle as the sun was going down A bus driver named Chris on bus was her guardian angel He went out of his way to get her to the correct bus before it got dark when the main office confirmed they were too swamped to assist He even had to deal with an angry traveler yelling at him for taking the extra time of getting Morgan to the correct bus connection although Morgan said he was very efficient and quickly navigated her to the correct destination Thank you Chris your kindness is noticed and the world is a better place because of people like you

From and to Singapore on Silk Air This is a functional airport which in the Philippines is high praise Security checks are numerous and slow as everywhere in the Philippines but because of the small number of international passengers moves quite quickly The same can be said for checkin baggage claim and immigration Toilet facilities are sufficient and clean On the downside for those who need shops there is only one very small cafe before immigration and a kiosk selling very basic items in the gate area All in all a good facility in the Philippines

I have flown Atlantic Airways numerous times between the Faroe Islands and Copenhagen The flight attendants are some of the best around and they consistently go out of their way to ensure that passengers have a good experience The new Airbus is more comfortable than the older planes The airlines offers free alcohol and above average coffee Food however is below average

The flight was a bit late departing from Gaya but I wondered if we would even fly given the dense fog The flight was beautiful scenic in a half empty cabin with cleanest and beautiful interior The crew distributed snacks and drinks quickly and we could enjoy our view Everything was really nice and their flight magazine is informative of the country and sites A really beautiful experience

Great experience Early check in possible and done quickly staff super friendly Security fast and lets you go faster with a baby Nice tax free zone that you can actually enjoy as the check in and security is done quickly At least two amazing playgrounds for children great cafes everything clean

Glacier Park International Airport FCA in Montana USA is the best small regional airport I have visited After a very long journey from Sydney we were cleared very fast What impressed us was the security guard who stands on arrival exit door greeted us with a big smile and sad welcome to Montana On our return flights we were checked in very fast cleared very fast with smiles by TSA what a difference after LAXTSA The terminal and toliets are very clean

The renewed Helsinki Airport is probably one of the best in the world at the moment The airport itself is not only beautifully designed but it works like a dream The departure lobby is equipped with multiple automatic bag drop stations with staff to help you with them The security was fast and smooth with the new machines The airside of the terminal is very clean and easy to find where to head to The variety of shops and restaurants is great too The passport control is quick with both robotic and manual checkpoints
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Mannheim to Berlin Great experience flying like in the past good service no queues customers first I can recommend

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped

The airport is wellorganized secure and clean with nearly all services available The crew at Air Mauritius is extremely professional and they go above and above to execute their jobs in a courteous and professional manner Nishi the travel consultantpassenger service is amazing in terms of customer service and taking care of passengers with a smile and enthusiasm
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point

It was my first time in Yemen and flying Felix Airways The flight was only min but it was enjoyable The staff were friendly and the plane was in a good shape in addition to a comfortable seat and a nice route

Not Verified I loved this airport I have travelled to NY many times before always into JFK Now that I have discovered the wonderful Norwegian Airlines I arrived and departed NY via Stewart International It is a relatively small airport but efficient and confident There is no masses of hurrying crowds which are the tension you get at large international airports The airport is surrounded by greenery when you leave the terminal there is a brief walk across to pick up rental car taxis or the shuttle bus so relaxing For the journey home everything was relaxed fast and efficient As I mentioned it is a small airport the bar caf shop and duty free is in a small area Some people might want more but I found it more than enough All hands are on deck in the airport to get everyone on their way home Great little airport and great flights and price by Norwegian Airlines
Small but good airport the usual Japanese quality clean efficient good staff Places to shop and eat and have lots of charging spots Its so convenient to reach from the city center
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Nice to Rome was only CAD total compared to other airlines charging close to per person for the same route We did expect to be a baggage fee as they charge you Euros per kg over kg but pleasantly surprised to only be charged an additional Euros total Plane clean staff were very nice The reason everyone lines up hour before the flight we didnt figure this out until too late is because seating is not assigned That being said our seats were fine and flight was great Only complaint was that the flight was hours late in arriving In their defence they had emailed our home email address a day or so before to notify us but we didnt have access to our home email so didnt find out until we arrived at the airport

One of my party fell ill on arrival at the airport an airport attendant was absolutely fantastic she immediately got a wheelchair Helped check in luggage and seen us through check in and security and seen us on the flight safely She could not have done more

Seattle to Edmonton returning Bombardier Q plane small but with comfortable seating even for a sixfooter as I am Great cabin crew and nice free drinks An inflight snack might have been nice but overall a pleasant experience
This is a really nice airport the arrival and departure terminal are separate which is very convenient The airport hotel was amazing

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time
This quick and easy flight was made so enjoyable by the inflight quiz that Air New Zealand have on their shorthaul flights Nice inflight snacks and great crew

I fly weekly for business and flew in and out of GreenvilleSpartanburg for the last quarter of and a bit of Its a small airport with only one runway and one long concourse with arbitrary A and B separation The major airlines serve GSP but flights are limited I mostly flew on American which only seems to connect via Charlotte an mile flight First being so close to a major hub like CLT caused almost weekly delays as my flight was often held on the tarmac by CLT airtraffic control so we could fit into the traffic pattern I never actually missed my connections in Charlotte but did have several walkjogs across the airport to reach my gate while the final groups were boarding But GSP itself is nicely maintained with superfriendly staff They offered TSA PreCheck when I flew in and out I got to know the Avis rentalcar staff by name and theyd give me free upgrades Best of all if you use GSP you have to order a tuna melt from the snack counter on the lower level outside security They mix the tuna salad from scratch in front of you and make the besttasting tuna melt Ive ever eaten

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon

A late night flight pm delayed by almost minutes is not the most pleasant beginning to the journey especially given the horrible Encalm Lounge in Delhi dirty crowded rubbish food However the onboard experience was amazing the A has lieflat seats with large IFE screens which is a treat since I could sleep comfortably for over an hour in a less than hour flight The cabin crew were prompt helpful and very attentive Upto food choices and a pretty good spread The IFE screens were great and the entertainment catalog is good enough for a short domestic flight but would be a bit boring for a hour or above flight However baggage claim experience was not the best despite the baggage being priority tagged it arrived after of the copassengers in the flight had received their bags and when you are running over an hour late it was a bit frustrating

Flew Waterford to Birmingham on th January Nice little airport staff very friendly Small cafe before departure excellent coffee and light snacks Security and boarding very well handled An enjoyable experience
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

Bahrains new airport has given me a satisfying experience as I found the place really simple big enough and neat I must say that it seemed also like a planespotters paradise since they have these huge glass windows that gives an almost unobstructed view by gate area and also a rooftop experience from The Terrace In my point of view the only downside is the limited Internet and when you have not enough money to spend for food Im also glad that the playroom at the bottom of their huge central LED screen is free for everyone to enjoy and wheelchair accessible as well which is absolutely a big plus Also the airport didnt seem too crowded and I hope it stays that way

Nanjing to Kunming on a new B As I was sitting in in seat F had a lot of legroom Cabin crew was excellent I was served a tasty dish on the hour flight For the return flight the ground staff Ticketing Desk in Kunming was outstanding

I flew in January with Edelweiss from Zurich to Cape Town with my friend Everything was excellent from the very beginning The crew was very nice and helpful answered all my questions accurately and professionally On the way from Cape Town we transferred to another flight in Zurich to Budapest The crew informed us about the ground gate the time of departure and all the necessary information needed for the transfer The food was fine the whole flight went quickly and I was very satisfied I will definitely choose this company for future flights The aircraft was clean tidy and everything met my expectations The toilets were also in great condition and clean The crew at the airport was very nice and helpful
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

Manado airport is one of the best in Indonesia It has a small delay rate and has a very good view from the waiting room The airport terminal faces east of Manado and oversees the beautiful nature and mountain ranges with the planes takingoff and landing
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes

The Airport is clean and well put together Food options have increased after adding KFC and TGI Fridays alongside Burger King The guy at the checkin counter gave us a hard time because he kept enquiring about our Singapore Visas even though for Bahrainis going to Singapore there is a Visa on Arrival and I kept telling him that Id been to Singapore times already and Id never had to apply for a predeparture Visa but he kept asking his colleagues about it The staff at the Pearl Lounge were friendly and I loved the free Evian Bottles

Competent and efficient flights Delay in Geneva handled well captain came to boarding gate to explain Comfort seats had good leg room even on a A sandwich and drink served on each flight of just over an hour

Dane County Regional is a cute little airport lying on the outskirts of Madison and it has had some of the best services I have ever experienced at any airport The airport is incredibly clean and attractive on the inside and the outside This includes nice modern architecture on the outside and mosaic flooring and stained glass handling lights It may not have as many stores as other airports but there is a store for nearly all travel needs such as a Cafe a restaurant a travel store and a Wisconsin Gear store I also noted that there were multiple stores under construction There are hardly any delays and MSN connects to nearly all large nearby airports which provides excellent connection availability The best part was the incredibly fast Wifi and charger ports in the waiting area
Plane clean and on time Ran out of water after row economy Its a short flight so bring back water in seat pockets of you cant cope No coffee tea or drinks for anyone

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end

I enjoyed lengthy stop overs here on a recent flight to BKK in Biz class with Gulf Air The airport is amazing clean and transit was smooth The lounge was fantastic and food and drinks were excellent Staff throughout the airport were amenable and friendly Overall it is a much less stress free and agreeable experience in comparison to transit through Doha or Dubai

Flew Larnaca to Manchester on the th July Excellent flight arrived in Manchester early after a perfect flight All crew pleasant and attentive Food on board was very good also the in flight entertainment Have flown Cobalt several times and will continue to do so when travelling to Cyprus
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel

Graz is an excellent small airport which has expanded in the last few years and now sees scheduled flights to as far as Luxor as well as German and Austrian destinations plus the UK with Ryanair They have the best answer yet seen to long security queues they immediately open another scanner when the queues build up again yet another sometyhing some of the bigger airports would do well to emulate A good restaurant is available although once passing through security snacks and drinks are all that is available They also prove that Priority Boarding can work with buses being used with Priority Boarding passengers be directed to one bus which goes to the aircraft first Only when those people have boarded do any other buses leave for the plane The train service has improved greatly over the last couple of years although still sparse on Sundays with at least an hourly service into Graz Staff always seem to be very friendly as well based on around a dozen trips through there in the last two years

HELOSL Checkin was rude and dismissive but otherwise the flight had very nice crew and the plane was spotless clean as well BOB meal is cheaper on Blue than on SAS due to the currency and I found the quality to be rather reasonable as well Ontime departure and arrival in Oslo Ticket price was great as usual

Business classenjoyed a drink of champagne and some refreshments upon taking a seat and theres plenty of room to stretch out Particularly on their trips from Dubai An amazing collection of Englishlanguage movies spanning every possible genre

I expected the worst but to my surprise its one of the smoothest flight I have ever hard Everything was good other than the seats that needs a mattress to make them comfortable for sleeping The staff were good I will fly it anytime I prioritise feeling safe

Genoa airport compares extremely well with our huge overcrowded and understaffed London airports It is nice and small with lovely shops and good cafes There are no long queues at check in or security and staff are friendly and helpful A pleasure to visit

Convenient location only mins from the Mosque Excellent modern facilities Nice simple elegant layout with steelwork reflecting date palm trees Convenient location of cafetarias toilets and prayer rooms Friendly staff and security personnel Clean and tidy Ample seating facilities

I returned this week from Tyumen to Munich Another B this time with vintage business cabin and seats As I was alone in the section I missed the Europeanstyle seats that would have allowed me to completely lie down instead of sitting with a recline Crew were smiling and helping with more polyglot aptitudes than during my preceding flight Excellent tasty lunch with Sardinian I checked red wine Takeoff and landing right on time I shall not hesitate to fly with UTair again

Portlands airport feels slightly dated not run down by any means but still pleasant and functional enough A lot of construction taking place at this time in the checkin area I guess in an effort to modernize the airport and expand passenger capacity The terminals themselves again are a little dated but still nice enough and functional TSA PreCheck operates smoothly here even where there are a lot of PreCheckers in line Personnel whether theyre working at checkin for TSA in a restaurant or at the boarding gate are usually super bubbly but still professional helpful and polite PDX is neither stellar nor bad its aboveaverage but with a lot of potential And its better than SeaTac

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

The airport is pretty clean Though its small its pretty cute like a park or resort This uniqueness suits the vacation vibe of the beautiful island of Koh Samui Different types of seating areas are available there are a few shops diners and a caf Checkin and immigration were both very efficient A courtesy corner full of snacks and drinks is available for free to all passengers However I wasnt able to connect to the airport WiFi

JAL economy class is outstanding The seats are the widest in the business if a bit hard and the food was healthy and tasty Flight attendants were polite and attentive My only complaint is that the offerings on the inflight entertainment service were subpar it was hard to find a movie that rose above mediocre
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money
Havana Cayo Coco return A one hour flight with an old ATR turboprop Seats surprisingly comfortable and we were offered a free drink plus candy onboard Nothing special but we arrived on time
