The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

I would like to express my extreme gratitude to staff who managed to retrieve some personal items belonging to my son I which we left onboard plane on flight in from New York early last Wednesday morning Due to their quick actions we managed to reclaim these items from the plane before it headed out to Heathrow on next flight They were extremely efficient very friendly two great ambassadors for Shannon airport We are very grateful to them both for their assistance in turning what could have been a holiday disaster into a very pleasant experience with Shannon airport They both deserve special recognition for their excellent customer skills

Arrived at the airport and one of the customer service agents was very helpful He helped me with picking up my luggage connecting to WiFi and was very friendly His name was Houssem Thank you so much for all the hard work

When I landed in Anchorage late at night the first thing I noticed was how busy the terminal was I was really hungry after a long hour flight from LAX so the first thing I did was grab something to eat from Cinnabon one of many restaurants at this airport Baggage claim experience was smooth Taxi was readily available outside for transportation to hotel While returning back I had a very smooth checkin and security experience If you enjoy watching beautiful scenery and planes Anchorage will not disappoint As you walk around the terminal you will notice many photo opportunities both inside and outside the terminal

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience

Long Beach is a great little airport It has the most efficient TSA checkpoint I have ever seen with the longest line ever being about three minutes and I fly through here quite often While the south concourse is the only gate area I have used I am sure the airport is the same throughout the terminal The staff is great and friendly and you can chat with everyone The gate numbering can be a bit confusing but so long as you dont immediately exit the terminal to the left you should be fine They even give you an umbrella when it rains to walk onto the plane

I have been flying from Mangalore International Airport domestically for a very long time Ill be honest the checkin baggage claim or the security is just literally the same like any other airport with less people The airport is calm and clean Restrooms are provided The only drawback is there is no source of recreation and entertainment here We have a couple of eateries but very very very limited WiFi is provided But when we speak about shopping Dont depend on Mangalore Airport it has nothing Trust me nothing The last time I visited there was a food stall at the ground floor and an umbrellaraincoat shop and a metal item store at the first floor That is it No clothes no alcohol no McDonalds etc But all in all its a good airport I mean its catering for the needs of Mangalorians Arrival also went very smooth

This is a good smaller airport to fly in and out of The terminal is new and it shows Also staff are friendly and helpful This terminal is also well located as it is actually on the outskirts of the city not outside of the city In addition it is served by local transit However there is one accessibility issue While the lanes for commercial providers are covered and wide there is only a lane uncovered pickup area on the arrivals level for private vehicles This results in congestion during heavier arrival times

Departure from Louisville was excellent the First Class checkin was efficient and fast with great service from the American Eagle ground staff Security was quick about ten minutes to line up and go through the security they are using the new body scanners now which improve and speed up the process The TSA staff as polite and very professional and ensure that your time with them is minimal as well as ensuring standards are kept After security the Lounge is good with excellent views over the runways aircraft Boarding areas are clean and airy with plenty of seating for passengers

Nice surprise as an Italian I appreciated a lot the food which could be bought on board Pasta alla Norma Red wine Valpolicella Professional and friendly staff tasting and authentically Italian food Proud as Italian to feel these kind of attentions to flyers Strongly suggested

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

IND is one of our two main options along with CVG when flying Both are excellent Traveling from Indy this week reminded me why I like it In morning and afternoon there are multiple good choices and most are reasonably priced in comparison to many other world airports crowds are nowhere near some airports so it is easy to move around TSA has always been friendly and efficient unlike some airports restrooms are generally cleaner than many other airports We do wish there were a couple of direct flights options to Europe but for flying domestically we like IND
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time

There are substantial and ongoing improvements to Freetown Airport They have been rebuilding the terminal building around the old structure for the last few months Departure and arrival procedures are now quite painless compared with the hot and basic conditions before The check in area is large and clean and I did not have to queue for long They could still do with increasing the air conditioning in that area though Security is good and immigration is using new computers and biometric systems The departure lounge is now quite big and comfortable There are a few well stocked duty free shops The original restaurant is still available as well as a new one upstairs The new one is not well signposted Overall a big improvement FNA now compares favourably with other airports in Africa

The obligatory show of your boarding pass on boarding the plane Dont expect duty free air conditioned waiting areas business lounges or facilities smiles hello thank you goodbye catering information desk assistance even from airline representatives or toilet facilities and you wont be left disappointed But once outside the Worlds Worst Airport you will meet the most pleasant courteous and honest people that I have ever personally encountered Welcome to the real Sudan

Nice clean and quiet little airport with good cafeteria Also the departure area has free Internet if you need to check your email before boarding I thought that was a nice touch We flew out of Plymouth on an Air Southwest flight and their staff are wonderful The only downside for us was an overzealous security officer That aside Plymouth has a lovely little airport and a super airline in Air Southwest will certainly fly with them again

Conakry is in no way a modern airport even quite old But its management is stunning I have been through this airport a great number of times over the years and am always impressed by its efficiency especially arrivals In minutes you get through immigration and then at the luggage carousel something Ive never seen in the possibly airports I know luggage trolleys are already positioned in front of the carousel so very convenient Unfortunately to leave the airport is somewhat difficult especially for elder people as you have to push you trolley on a pretty steep ramp before exiting the airport Also departure area needs to be modernized

There are two options for getting from Dar es Salaam to Zanzibar a twohour ferry journey or a minute flight The main airlines flying this route are Auric Air and Air Tanzania Ordering the ticket via Opodo was easy and the airline operates from Terminal a small building about km from the main terminals Checkin was efficient and the waiting room had several powerful air conditioning units You could even buy food and drink Tickets were checked and we were walked across to the Cessna It had three seats in each row and although tight it was not uncomfortable It only had a pilot and we flew at about feet giving us a clear view of the sea and then the island It ended with a very smooth landing close to the terminal

We were on a chartered flight taking a group of very special kids to Lourdes in France Team were so friendly and welcoming Lovely comfy accommodation clean and spacious Lovely touch was a special package snack for our VIPs Thank you Titan

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

A small airport serving the capital Its a bit of a chaotic place long queues staff arent the friendliest and generally messy The terminal itself is clean tho and seating is comfortable As its the only major airport in the country this it what they can offer Taxi trip to the center is lek
Nepal Airlines is a cheap option for direct flights from Nepal with good service Nepal Airlines improved its service over time The cabin crew were professional and meal served was good

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

Really good experience Security was busy but extremely efficient I was travelling with far too many laptops locked in security bags long story which obviously raised eyebrows Everything got searched lots of questions asked but so friendly and professional that it was really no hassle Couldve been awful but was actually as pleasant as it could have been Great burger surprise at Carls once airside Seating around the gates is a bit uncomfortable but its there and theres enough of it The gate itself was efficiently managed and theres room without a horrible crush All in all a good experience and one Id be happy to repeat
This airport is small Traffic is quite convenient and the number of stores is small The airport is very clean and tidy and the waiter is polite

Absolute and stunning perfection in everything Crew are the best wonderful and polite people who are there to make your journey a great part of your day Please treat your crew nicely they are literally one of the best and I fly a lot times a month

The airport has basic facilities and I think it works when it has little traffic The staff are nice and friendly There are very limited options if you want to eat something at the airport After the security there are only two cafes without good meal options The seating at the gates is limited Most of the gates are located upstairs with limited space Considering the fact that passengers arrive and depart from the same gates they sometimes get very crowded

Thessaloniki to Athens I was pleasantly surprised by the service on this short flight approx min Service was quick good selection of drinks and small candies and biscuits Friendly staff aircraft was clean The crew are ready to assist the passengers I will be happy to fly them again

As much as people complain I found entering Pearson to be a breeze The whole process of disembarking walking and clearing immigration went quickly and I was through within minutes most of that walking and enjoying a coffee while I waited for my bus The staff were courteous and pleasant On my departure once again seamless with efficient customs officials Terminal has improved the seating and I was impressed As always the beer is overpriced but tell me an airport where it isnt The PA announcements were very clear a bonus compared to a good number of airports I have been through Maybe it was just the day but the complimentary WiFi kept kicking out after minutes or so Overall no complaints

Barra is an amazing airport its tiny shed like and has few facilities The most people there at one time will only be approx as the flights are operated by little twin otters What makes Barra great is the runway its the beach The approach and landing experience are a must Also once youve got off and collect your bag from a shelter in the car park youve got a maximum of metres to walk to your car taxi or bus they meet every flight and are a good way to get around the islands

A pleasant airport Our flight arrived at and even though we had to do a COVID test at the airport we completed all the formalities and left the airport within minutes On departure the flight was at and at this time there were a reasonable number of international flights also departing however the check in and security checks were quite quick After security there is a large duty free shop as well as some smaller shops and foodbeverage outlets The terminal was clean and tidy Obviously the airport is not yet operating at full capacity but our experience was fine Only letdown was the poor WiFi

Myself and family travel via Liverpool Airport two to three times a year It remains our first choice since we began using it ten years ago where previously we tended to travel via Manchester Liverpool is smaller than most international airports but this has its benefits less crowds less queuing and easy access The staff throughout the airport are friendly and ready to help The signage is easy to read and well proportioned Lifts are available Liverpool recognises the Sunflower scheme Our experience has been security is strict but quick and friendly to get through Prices are typical airport prices for a small bottle of water reasonable I suppose when considering the ridiculous prices airports are allowed to charge where ever you go I can only presume it is down to airport owners and the high rents they charge The only shops I ever see that are really busy are the food beverage and drinks outlets Again our experience has been food is fresh and well prepared The one downside are probably the toilet facilities a bit smelly and like most airports today no free drop off zone Why airports in the name of security are allowed to charge astronomical prices for parking I have never understood Captive audience I suppose All in all I would give Liverpool Airport stars out of Freshen up the loos be the first actually run an airport for the passengers benefit in pricing and parking and you get a

Ive used within China different airlines Air China Spring Airlines Shenzen Airlines and Kunpeng Airlines Clearly the best one was Kunpeng Airlines Although the flight had a delay of hours bad weather at the airport from which the airplane came information at the airport was good boarding really fast after the airplane arrived Nevertheless it was clean inside and the crew was very friendly As it was a short flight only minutes I expected less or no service onboard Was surprised that they offer a drink and a small meal The airplane itself seems to be a new one

Went on holiday in May flights where changed by TUI so we ended up flying with Titan Airways I must say they were fabulous beautiful planes and the staff were friendly and great with my little girl who is years Would love to fly with them again

Apias airport has been upgraded and presents a warm pacific feeling The immigrationcustoms staff should be taught to smile though especially after tourists are sold on the idea of a friendly pacific paradise proudly operated by the friendliest people on earth

This is a small but tidy and well run airport that I suspect will increase in demand in near future Everything is laid out well there are modest food and drink facilities clean toilets and small offices for several car hire firms Hertz Europcar Sol etc An excellent starting point for exploring northern Spain Currently Ryanair flies there twice a day from Stansted and I believe Liverpool Good overall

I am flying FDHDUS regularly and I am fully satisfied with this airline Due to the smaller sizes of their aircrafts the flight takes some time about hr min but service onboard is excellent Good regional snacks and plenty of drinks are served during the flight Ground handling in FDH is very quick and efficient Prices are high but still recommendable

One of the best flights I have been on between Oslo and Billund I didnt know that this kind of service still exsisted Excellent food and service I know it cost a bit more but it is well spent money I do recommend this airline which operates flights on behalf of British Airways

Nice airport corresponding to the Chinese standard no frills but essentials are there If you fly international no need to arrive early as the checkin counter is opened just one hour before flight time If you arrive early it is difficult to find a seat Not very friendly immigration people but nice lounge with good wifi connection and unlimited Internet access Plenty of outlets to satisfy the western appetite Starbucks KFC etc

Richmond is a medium size airport that has recently been extensively renovated My experience flying in and out was very pleasant RIC is a human sized airport so it is easy to get around Baggage recovery was fast and painless with our checked bags appearing only about five minutes after we had arrived at the carousel The rental car desks are conveniently sited and the rental car garage is a two minute walk from the terminal Our total time from landing to driving off in a rental car was less than thirty minutes The airport is well connected to the adjacent Interstate highway so the airport is easy to get into and out of On departure checkin and security was quick and painless There is a restaurant in the secure area offering a view of the ramp a pleasant thing for the travelling aircraft buff Overall I was very impressed with Richmond airport and would use it again anytime
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

Our flight was on time checkin was smooth The staff on board were friendly I highly recommend this airline despite several negative reviews I think it is much better than many European low cost airlines Il nostro volo stato puntuale il checkin stato veloce Il personale a bordo stato cordiale Consiglio vivamente questa compagnia aereanonostante le diverse recensioni negative penso sia molto meglio di molte low cost europee

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

Durbans new airport King Shaka International was opened for the World Cup It was designed as a stateofthe art regional airport for Durban KwaZuluNatal region The is plenty of space for stopping in the dropoff zone with direct access to the terminal There are seperate checkin islands for BA SAA and Emirates The departure concourse is spacious with enough seating for waiting passengers In the arrivals hall there is a food court with a Piazza some shops a Woolworths banks and post office Also a tourist information office After security there is plenty of space Unfortunately some lounges were closed due to renovations but this is only temporary The domestic terminal has plenty of space so a quiet corner for reading or working is not a problem If more international arrivals departures materialise then the current departure gates could prove to be a bit underdimensioned in the future

Easy to access by train Plenty of shops and eateries even convenience store Lots of toy machines Clean and enjoyable to wait for our departure Signs are clear You can enjoy lunch while watching the airplanes take off Weve got our last minute omiyage shopping like handkerchiefs japan only cute snacks and satisfying lunch

Monday th April what an absolute disgrace hours to get through security after being told minutes lifts out of order another reserved for staff when you escaped the great long queues conveyor belts working out of very little staff available On return hour wait for luggage an absolute disgrace A final comment I will never use Birmingham again and yet only minutes from home and have used this airports many many times and many times had problems but no more East Midlands much better

Very slow running late on our arrival and departure nearly missed connecting flight back home because of slow progress at Male airport Lovely Maldives you are amazing but please step up your services and speed at the airport

Tulsa is a nice small to medium sized airport It now has free wifi available throughout the airport Only or so airlines fly out of the airport and it seems quite a few flights have been cut the past years or so The lines for TSA are rarely bad anymore I have been through security in less than mins after arriving at airport Obviously there are times when it is busier New seats at gates have plug ins available and this is a very nice touch

I thought this airport was lovely Outside are the cobbled roads and tram link into center In the main airport terminal the facilities are excellent They have a truly amazing viewing deck with information about the space programme and aircraft using the airport Security was quick efficient and friendly and boarding immediate to the aircraft I feel Bremen airport gives passengers the proper respect they deserve even when travelling a budget airline

I fly this airport several times per year The name and location sounds like a bigger adventure than it actually is The airport is small so boarding an A is already something that keeps everybody busy However there are not that many flights ground staff are friendly and helpful

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step
I found very good customer service by each and every worker at the airport whom we dealt with Wifi facilities were excellent with no interruptions Overall it passes the required tests

Three trips between CCS and BLA I found Conviasa to be clean modern friendly and welcoming My Spanish is functional but quite basic and when I struggled there was usually multilingual staff even on the short hop from Caracas to Barcelona and back Luggage allowance on this flight is a generous kg and a free drink is provided despite the flight time being only minutes Seats comfortable with more room than I was expecting All in all Conviasa offer a superior albeit slightly more expensive service on this short route than do their competitors Avior

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

Very efficient and pleasant airport Check in was quick and used the executive lounge I have used many but this was excellent One of the very best Food and drinks of good choice and a high standard Served to you rather than self service Comfortable and lovely friendly staff who couldnt do enough for you

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National

Just had to leave this review on th May returned from Rhodes and my flight was delayed two hours Just after midnight left baggage reclaim to go to my car I had a flat battery and was unable to get into my car It was exceptionally cold and all I was wearing was shorts and a tee shirt I returned to the terminal where I met the staff at the parking desk At this time the terminal was empty and they were locking up The staff came out and helped me gain entry to my car but I had a two hour wait for the Green Flag breakdown The staff waited with me almost an hour and had to go home leaving me alone in the car park freezing cold but not before he returned to his office made me a hot cup of tea and brought it to me in my car A beautiful act of kindness and one I will never forget

Rarotonga to Aitutaki The flight with Air Rarotonga was a pleasurable experience spotless clean aircraft with much space for legs an excellent and friendly service coffee was served on that short flight on the small plane and even the small airlines brochure and a daily newspaper was offered to read by passengers I was impressed by the overall quality of the service

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime

The airport is fine and clean food was good and getting through the security was fine However the so call dutyfree store is another matter everything was way over priced For example the Local Rum Appleton years old was over USD That is very expensive to pay that kind of money in Jamaica for local rum on a dutyfree when you can buy the same in Ontario Canada one of the higher liquor tax jurisdictions for under USD All of the products on the dutyfree were way overpriced You can get the same rums in the USA at the supermarkets for less from the dutyfree store of Montego bay airport I purchase a Cuban Havana Club year old in Havana on December for USD

I fly from Amsterdam to Norwich and back regularly The airport is always a breeze Check in never has a queue security never has a queue You can arrive minutes before a flight and its never a trouble Staff are nice and friendly There isnt a massive selection of things to do airside but you wouldnt expect there to be The development fee is bizarre but certainly not unique to Norwich Go to a small airport get a small airport experience Norwich appears well run and is always a pleasure to fly through If you want a big airport experience go to a big airport Ill happily take shorter waiting times and friendlier service and stick with Norwich
Special appreciation to the cabin crew Sonika I was super impressed with her fluency in announcements all three different languages and it was just amazing to hear her out

Tel Aviv to Minsk Amazing flight no delays we boarded quickly clean aircraft really comfy seats and the food was great choice between sausages and beef and we got a waffle cherries bread with the the meal Staff was really nice no complaints

Love Ryanair efficiency Does what is says on the packet nothing pretentious Crew were great and even managed to go down with aisle with the trolley on a minute flight My th flight with them just wish they flew to Frankfurt theyd get all my euro business

Airport is away from city and not good public transport available better to use cab Not too busy most of times so not long queue at entry check in and security mostly min to complete all formality Limited food options needs more there is one lounge but one of the smallest and least food options i found in India only suggested if having complementary lounge access Shopping options is also very limited only recommend tea shop if didnt got time to buy tea in city which is famous for Toilets needs to be more clean Shortage of sitting space on both floors Free Wifi only for min This airport need proper maintenance now

My experience was very smooth no flight changes or surprises in the departure flight In the arrival flight there was a security threat in Beirut Airport resulting in flight delays for ALL airlines The way Ajet dealt with the situation was outstanding and professional Given the unintended delays we missed the next flight Without even asking and as soon as we arrived to their desk they fixed the flight for the next day and offered us free transport hotel and meals The air and ground crew is very nice and helpful The only setback is in communicating with the Airport employees in English Until this improves communicate with a smile and nice attitude and youll get what you want eventually

Lufthansa operated by Germanwings from Barcelona to Berlin Tegel and back Both fights on time with very quick boarding and ground service First flight was a year old A plane was very clean and comfortable The return flight on a year old A despite the old age of the aircraft it was very clean comfortable and showed signs of great maintenance service You cold only tell that it was that old becouse it was considerably louder but the journey was very enjoyable The snacks are not very good but I can forgive that on a h min flight Great comfort in the seats with more legroom Great value for money and going to try Eurowings

Arrival was great I was at passport control within minutes of landing On the way back it was another story I couldnt do the online check in and I found out at the airport that its not provided when you fly from Bergerac You have to queue with everybody in order to get your boarding pass even if you only have hand luggage Ground personnel very slow until the call was made to invite people for boarding They then suddenly were very quick The toilets arent provided with coat or handbag hangers which I find not practical

Felt like flying in the old days Flew this one hour flight from Kerman to Tehran in a packed sold out flight operating by an old Airbus A which was refurbished immaculately and very clean The flight attendants were nicely dressed and friendly It was rather hot at Kerman and I was surprised to find a cold bottle of water on seat back pocket for every passenger on this massive jet They a light dinner free of charge Over all it was the best domestic flight I have ever taken

It is clean quick and efficient passport control Landed at was driving off at My return leg was the same desks open for the flights that were going to London around the same time with CTA Very cheap cigarettes and alcohol airport staff are friendly and helpful The chap that said announcements were not made in English is wrong all flights are announced in Turkish and English You can hardly miss your flight as there are only gates A small airport with only around flights coming and going in one week but very efficient

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one

Excellent service Nothing to complain Theyve served an excellent food during the h long flight and was delicious All the flight attendants were polite and worried about the cleanliness and support all the passengers aboard There arent delays and the luggage have arrived perfectly fine A Grade

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by

Morning flight Kiev Odessa a new clean Embraer It was a very pleasant flight with free candies and beverages served by smiling crew Departed on time and arrived early Check in in Kiev quick and easy The atmosphere and attitude quite relaxed and pleasant

It is a nice and small airport but it is in compliance with the city and the air movement in the region The most negative point is the few stores and food options There are checkin machines and circulation is relatively fast

This was a lovely flight from Hobart to the Gold Coast on Tigerair Boarding was orderly We walked to the plane and boarded through the rear I had row to myself in the second last row I will travel with them again

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time The staff were friendly and professional The seat was very comfortable The meal was tasty with a very good wine Although the flight was short I would have preferred a more substantial meal Otherwise a very pleasant start to my vacation

The flights are frequently delayed but its a small price to pay for clean aircraft ample seat pitch kind crew and the lowest fares My flight from Melbourne to Kuala Lumpur was on an A with plenty of legroom and good meals Online checkin yields a good seat for me and their use of KLIA T makes for an easy and relaxing journey
I am not sure when you went to the airport in maracaibo but things have change a lot Prices are not as bad and there is lots of choices to eat and drink very reasonable

Rotterdam airport is small but very easy to get to as I live only min away People are very friendly and helpful I travel on average x per year sometimes more normally I only have hand luggage and have only once encountered extra checks and body search I find check in and arrivals no problem and never had to wait very long I do think it could use a few more shops and especially as I fly early morning it would be nice to have some kind of breakfast that is not too expensive

A relatively large regional airport for a small town However Darwin is the state capital of Northern Territory We checked in for the flight went through security and then waited for the flight to depart There were no hassles or problems Everything went smoothly

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available
Its not crowded Its very new and clean airport Sign and directions are easy to follow Before my departure time I really enjoy spending time Ankara airport Esenboga

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the flight departed on time The staff were friendly and efficient The seat was comfortable too Only tea coffee and water is available free of charge which is no big deal given its such a short flight

Functioning but nonair conditioned air bridge to terminal Terminal building is easy to navigate and path clearly leads after heading down escalator to baggage pickup Baggage arrives after minimal waiting time of minutes Many people in terminal besides passengers and employees Mainly porters Everyone appears to know everyone else so I guess that security is not an issue Inside and outside terminal many drivers call out offering lifts in carsvans heading to Gorontalo city as airport is to hour from regional capital Fares are negotiable but is the norm Bules may pay more Toilets ATMs and lower end eating facilities as well as souvenir stalls are easily accessible Forget having a drink

I use this little airport for flights between northern England and SE Asia via AMS on KLM I find it a very convenient feeder airport to the AMS hub and the small size of the terminal ensures that arrivals are swift and painless Im on the road within mins of hitting the tarmac in most cases Staff are generally friendly and helpful By contrast nearby NCL which used to be very quick and efficient is much more hassle with some of the most miserable ground staff in Europe

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

Small simple and clean everything you want in an airport Love coming home to this beautiful airport Pros extremely clean efficient great signage short wait times never any traffic to and from and never any plane traffic Cons no lounges not a lot of shopping very limited food choices things close early a bit far outside city centre parking can be pricey

The service has improved markedly However visa on arrival takes close to an hour with three queues paperwork payment and then entry stamp The is clearly an effort to improve things and departure was swift and smooth Hassle free We had an issue with the airport barrier which failed to work as someone walked under it and the lady did not acknowledge us when this happened and just moved onto the next queue without any explanation We had to get annoyed to be acknowledged The guard then came out with a gun and said we now had to wait till the end How is that good service If you want tourists to visit please change your attitude and show courtesy and give efficient service Remember that visitors expect good service Generally at the airport a good experience and much improved on previous visits Nice airport and service showed an improvement It would help if immigration officers smiled a bit more and tried to speed up a little Staff at the airport were trained to give good service with a smile Hope to see things improving on the next visit

Gatwick to Preveza return with Small Planet Airlines Our flights both ways could not have been any smoother and the experience was faultless I didnt try the food so unable to comment but all the staff were friendly and attentive Would use again

Im impressed with all the improvements made at Dammam Airport Its easily my favorite airport to fly inout of in Saudi Arabia because of its compact size array of services retail and food and beverage outlets Its website and WiFi connectivity are also quite good and easy to use
Good airport nice shops and the seating is comfortable great restaurants very respectful staff and flights always on time

This airport has a extremely large number of visitors Ground transport and flow to and from are fine Concessions facilities and restaurants are far and few between sit down bar restaurant for many gates waiting lines everywhere all facilities both male and female have long lines Very far behind the times would rather fly to any other airport in they area

Although Westchester County Airport is awfully small compared to JFK or Bradley it is amazing It has car rentals an actual baggage carousel five airlines going in and out of there local planes accepted too and even have gates This is so much better than some small airports Ive been to

Visited Uganda on and departed on Both arrival and departure experiences were smooth Arrival hall is rather large There is mandatory health screening before one can proceed to visapassport control Obtaining a visa is relatively easy Present valid passport and make payment Baggage claim appeared to be a rather large area with perhaps carousels At departure level the lighting seems rather deem There is the mandatory screening of bags before you can enter and check in for the flight The staff is very friendly The facilities are clean and the departure hall appears small given the amenities gift shops dining and duty free The Karibuni Lounge is excellent It puts to shame US airline lounges in the USA with its food offerings and amenities Bathrooms are cleaned frequently by an attendant Overall no issues with EBB airport Immigration control staff are very friendly The only drawback to this airport is that passengers have to be dropped off in the parking area and then make their way around the roadway to the departure level

Greatly improved airport with better immigration facilities on arrival fast track lane for business passengers on departure entrance into departure hall entrance to immigration much faster retrieval of luggage and more smiling people The departure zone after security has been revamped and is now more frendly too

Beijing to Weihai with Shandong Airlines Comfortable clean and modern plane with ample leg room far more generous than Etihad and the other premium airlines I have experienced Some delay due to air traffic congestion however bags promptly delivered on arrival Water provided by friendly and attentive crew for the short flight

Everything that has been written here is still true including the mystery unannounced departure fee US one time Sudanese pounds another made more interesting because Sudan is transitioning between dinars and pounds Flights do leave in the middle of the night because the middle of the day is unbearably warm and they do leave late so patience and flexible travel schedule is a must Bureaucracy is still in full effect with multiple Xrays and searches Courtesy is in rare supply And yes Sudanese do not queue for anything You just shove and elbow and get to the front of the crowd any way you can Even for no reason the mob getting in the front door resembled a rugby scrum but once inside there were no big crowds and thus no reason to push and shove rather than just wait in line its just the way theyve always done it I had the chance to leave via the new International Terminal that opened this month and was pleasantly surprised Air conditioned spacious ceilings numerous clean restrooms watersnacks for sale plenty of seats in the departure lounge actual flatscreen TVs showing when flights are scheduled to take off It is dare I say closer to what other international airports are like than it has ever been That being said if you have reason to travel to Sudan than you probably already know to expect the unexpected

I flew into this airport on Islay island from Glasgow on a Loganair flight in the morning and returned almost a week later This is a rural airport close by the sea and is extraordinarily easy to use The SAAB aircraft was parked close to the small terminal building we picked up our bags that had been unloaded on the tarmac and walked in The walls were decorated with posters of the many distilleries for which Islay is justly famed There were also individual displays of whisky bottles and other items from these distilleries A small cafe provided a good range of snacks and also some souvenirs for last moment purchases There were ample spaces to sit A short conveyor belt brought in checked luggage quickly Across the check in counters are kiosks for the local car hires I had a car to be picked up The agent had all the paperwork ready The car was parked just outside I was out of the airport grounds driving on the left in less than minutes after landing On my departure I parked my rental car across the terminal building and slipped the keys into a slot in the kiosk The check in counters were staffed by Logan Air personnel in their uniforms that sported the easily recognized tartan plaids Security check was very thorough including patting The waiting area after security check had a rest room and was enclosed by glass which offered panoramic views The aircraft was just outside and we walked to to it It was a very relaxed experience with a high degree of friendliness and efficiency The airport is situated midway between the islands two larger communities Bowmore and Port Ellen

Such a fantastic flight Our flight attendant Jay was incredible His demeanour was cheerful and friendly and I truly wish every attendant was like him From the moment you got on the plane he had a positive energy and was respectful and helpful of all the guests Love United and kudos for such a great team

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

Flew NIKI from Valencia to Vienna Quick boarding and ontime departure Cabin was clean and the flight was smooth and relaxed Cabin crew provided drinks and a very good cheese sandwich Later they provided us another round of water and coffee Seats a little bit narrower than other airlines Paid for a return ticket for flying with a very good airline

Portlands airport feels slightly dated not run down by any means but still pleasant and functional enough A lot of construction taking place at this time in the checkin area I guess in an effort to modernize the airport and expand passenger capacity The terminals themselves again are a little dated but still nice enough and functional TSA PreCheck operates smoothly here even where there are a lot of PreCheckers in line Personnel whether theyre working at checkin for TSA in a restaurant or at the boarding gate are usually super bubbly but still professional helpful and polite PDX is neither stellar nor bad its aboveaverage but with a lot of potential And its better than SeaTac

I frequently travel through this airport and would note a couple of problems in an otherwise nice facility First Ive arrived on another airline and been unable to get help in the transit lounge from Air Ivoire even though they are my next flight You have to get somebody to take you to the front desk through a little back hallway and tip them Second if you go through the passport desk they have plain clothed policemen without badges who demand your passport in the luggage area without identifying themselves The restaurant in the departure area is much nicer than the one outside the ticket area where you check in

Very small old fashioned terminal nothing wrong with that as check in was a breeze All luggage checked and weighed together then put onto a trolley No computers everything written out including boarding cards Once checked in usual hand luggage screening and off into the small departure lounge Rows of plastic seat along with a few little shops selling the usual goodies from Myanmar and snacks A very good caf with great coffees and teas Usual badge so the staff know which flight you are on All very relaxed and you can watch the flights taking off and landing Toilets worth a miss

This airport is head and shoulders above any other airport I have been to and Ive been through a few Every person I interacted with form check in to security to service staff were all over the top friendly with great senses of humor The security line is the fastest I have ever seen I have never waited in a line here even during the holidays maybe minutes max The gates are clean and modern tons of outlets and different seating arrangements lots of space for only having gates Loads of parking for an airport of this size I was able to park my car like meters from departures and left it there for a week I know how infuriating flying can be especially when things go wrong but it goes a long way when people are so friendly This is my favorite airport and I go out of my way to fly out of here please give these people the recognition they deserve

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

At Guadalajara airport the main hallway is completely renovated but its still very crowded during morning hours as this is the busiest time and lines can be long Staff are helpful and friendly There are or VIP lounges I have used the Aeromexico Salon Premier which is brand new and the BanamexCiti Salon Beyond which is the best for me Many restaurants many stores and duty free

ITO is absolutely lovely I flew in HNLITO and out ITOOGG Outdoor type airport and probably the most easytouse airport I have ever had the pleasure of using Very tropical theme Car rentals are right across the street from curbside pickup Checking in is very easy for those using Island Air There is a restaurant in the middle that gets very busy during breakfast so get there early if you dont want to stand in a line that goes out the door

The queue for the border was moving quite fast the border guards were working fast The toilets in the baggage reclaim area was clean although there was a queue to them one of the two urinals wasnt working The toilet would be better if they were bigger albeit they were quite clean

Bahrain Airport is very nice not compare with Kuwait airport that was so awful Bahrain is clean with nice little sofas and comfortable armchairs The staff at the restaurant and the cleaners are courteous and friendly It was a nice experience
It was perfect I love everything about thr airport It was quick and has good staff Good food and its modern Just love it but I dont like the national airlines like TAME

Its pretty good for a budget airline As long as you have followed predeparture guidelines packed properly and have your passport valid visa and PNR number checkin is easy even if it takes a while for people in front of you to repack their bags as they were NOT prepared or were taking chances with their baggage allowance The rest of the flight was uneventful the crew cabin and seating were efficient beyond what you would expect from a budget airline

Islip to Baltimore with SWA A hidden gem in the NY area for local flights terminal is clean and spacious with good facilities all round A much better option than the scrum at JFK or LGA particularly if you are out of the city and have a rental car

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

A small airport with all the benefits of that short distances quick security not too crowded Its also quite quick to get into the city Limited flights compared to Belfast International or Dublin but when I have the option Id choose this over the others The business lounge is also very well maintained and spacious plus good food and drink options

This airport is highly recommended Many of the reviews below are pre which is when the facility completed a full upgrade of terminal and gates I would discard any pre reviews as irrelevant to the current condition Long Beach Airport is a welldesigned and pleasant experience compared with LAX and to a degree John Wayne Its a smaller but more efficient facility with competitively priced parking within an easy walk of your gate The TSA Security Checkpoint is relatively fast compared with other airports The facility boasts two outdoor seating areas for two of its restaurants a comparative luxury in this age of airport design being little more than shopping malls with airline gates The central area between the two terminals is an outdoor seating area allowing for a retreat from the madness at the gates One of the unique aspects of LGB is the lack of jetways Walking out onto the tarmac to board a plane is a fun and different experience which adds significantly to the charm of this facility Long Beach doesnt have the cold and sterile feel of most modern airports and that is a welcome aspect of flying here There are a number of restauranteating choices available though the shopping is a relatively weak area In general Long Beach is easily my favorite American airport and is qualitatively far better than the vast majority of facilities I use

Chisinau airport is the only international airport of Moldova and sometimes seems to be out of proportion with the growing traffic But anyway despite its small size after the latest restructuration it became a very efficient and easy to fly from The ground staff are very productive and manages the traffic with a great dexterity The number of shops and food choices remains low but its not really an airport of transit The main flaw of Chisinau airport is access to and from the airport without real shuttle service provided There is a minibus marshrutka route to the railway station but it doesnt service all night long and you often need to require a taxi very cheap Airport is very clean and staff is very professional

First time I have ever used this airline Service was impeccable on the plane Business class configuration Pyjamas given The bed is fully flat with a mattress and duvet comfortable The food quality was excellent with options of light meals when you want Breakfast was a delight The plane was fairly empty in business class but service was attentive Movies good selection not the best but good noisecancelling Headphones The Flight was on time into Brussels The lounge option is a bit weak in Shanghai the view lounge is used in Brussels Overall will use again
Lots of seating Not enough electric plugs or charge points WiFi was hopeless it didnt work Tannoy too loud Staff seem nice enough Appeared clean

I fly out of Winnipeg many times Although its not the best in terms of stores and flight choice it is very spacious bright and traveler friendly Its one of the nicest airports Ive traveled through Massive glass windows give a wonderful view of the planes and surrounding area Check in is usually quick and easy although the self serve machines are useless Lots of parking and room to drop off as well Security is quick and simple dropping you in the middle of the terminal Moving around isnt hard either since it only takes mins to walk the entire terminal length The only issue I have with this airport is that there isnt many food and store options The food court has a Pizza place and sandwich store along with the necessary Tim Hortons in the airport They sell some snacks at the usual travel stores though quite expensive Wifi and staff are great along with bag claimcustoms being quick to get through Overall great airport

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use

Super nice and wonderful airport It has so many destinations and the time slots for the destinations are awesome The airport and airline staff are super friendly and helpful This is a great gateway to arrive and depart in and out of Taiwan The queue for security is never too crowded Best airport in the world

We misplaced our passport which was very stressful However Ashley and Phil at the Canberra airport made sure that we still made it onto other flights back to New Zealand Their service was outstanding they were both so helpful nothing was a hassle which helped to alleviate a very stressful situation for us We cant thank them enough

Kefalonia Airport has a new hall which is big enough for passangers waiting The queing went fine although there are not many desks The toilets were new and clean Coffee and sweat breads are in the hall In de waiting area is a small shop Personnel was very kind and helpful

The checkin process at Nagoya Centrair Airport was a smooth and pleasant one with kind staff assisting you if needed However the checkin counters opens only exactly hours before departure Apart from check in there is an amazing skydeck for aircraft photographers like me to photograph planes free of charge Also there are many food options to choose ranging from Japanese cuisine to Western cuisineThe central security screening was smooth and quick and I cleared security within minutes The airside had a lot of duty free shops vending machines to buy drinks and a clear view of the apron and runway Overall it was a very pleasant experience and I am happy to fly out of Nagoya Centrair Airport

My brother and I and Flew for the first time everyone was very helpful they even put us in the sky lounge which consists of a buffet and drinks They did no extra charge and they helped out through the whole time without necessarily babying us Thank you for the experience

After reading some of the less stellar reviews online and being unable to reach any English speaking staff on the phone who could verify the incabin luggage dimensions I was naturally apprehensive about the flight from Tel Aviv to Nice on Monday September To my pleasant surprise the entire flight experience was excellent The plane was clearly in great shape a relatively new aircraft with leather seating and spotless interior The departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule The fact the departure from Ben Gurion airport was using a shuttle bus and not a jetway reminds me to warn any future passengers during any unlikely but possible inclement weather to dress accordingly or bring an umbrella for the extended exposure to the elements while trying to board an outdoors staircase Other than that I thought the whole experience was most pleasant and I would have no qualms about flying Israir again

Very small Airport on the Northern German Island of Sylt During Summer Season served by Lufthansa and Air Berlin with flights to major German Cities Only a handful checkin Counters and during busy hours on weekends which means or planes within a couple of hours long lines Upon Arrival only one Baggage Belt and Baggage Claim Area crowded But due to the small size of the airport and short distances from the planes to the Baggage Claim Area baggage arrives very fast Staff very friendly and efficient waiting lounge can get very crowded during peak hours Small shops and one nice CafeRestaurant Short distance to Parking Area Delivery service by Rental Car Companys No public Transport Overall a different but nice experience And flying to Sylt gives You a great chance to visit the island even from Southern Germany for only a few days

Small minimal facilities not much to do while you wait Staff are friendly and efficient The day we arrived there was live music playing in the customs area nice touch We walked out of the terminal to be greeted immediately by our tour arranger

Harry Bauer lounge at Port Vila Airport is located airside after passing through Immigration and Customs We travelled Business Class on Air Vanuatu and were handed lounge invitations Its best kept secret that this lounge is also a pay as you go Lounge so anyone Economy Class passengers as well can actually access the lounge on paying a fee when the lounge is open before each departure I didnt ask what the fee was but did notice they accept credit cards by way of a credit card machine contrary to some reviews some years back stating they only accept cash The lounge is air conditioned very welcoming after walking through the nonair conditioned public waiting area There is a refrigerator with nonalcoholic drinkssodas as well as a selection of local beers Minimal snacks are on offer and comfortable seating with views out across the tarmac and runway A quiet haven to sit and relax before the flight There is sufficient seating for some or more people so not a small lounge but cosy enough Sure beats waiting in the public area where there is no air conditioning

Rigolet Labrador to Goose Bay Labrador on October on an Air Labrador twin Otter Aircraft has been well used over the years but provided a comfortable and quick way back to Goose Bay Bush flying copilot loaded and unloaded the bags seating well wherever there is an empty seat No complaints about the service and would not hesitate to fly with them again

Ted Stevens Anchorage Airport South domestic Terminal is a pleasure to navigate through Modern uncrowded spacious scenic with many wonderful Alaskan artifacts Seems that almost everyone photographs the giant stuffed moose upon arrival A nice variety of storeseven a McDonalds with a cent ice cream cone Comfortable and roomy observation deck Short walk to be connected to People Mover city bus Alaska Railroad and rental cars no need to ride shuttle bus The most complete and careful security check I have experienced

Experienced CMN last month arrival from Paris Orly with RAM and continuing to Muscat with Oman Air Had to retreive my luggage pass immigration and recheckin again All was very smooth and from the time the plane landed I was outside less than min later very impressive Agents were all polite and efficient The secret is like everywhere else Be patient respectful and polite and everything will be fine Will not hesitate to use this Airport again

Travelled late July Arriving from Edinburgh late afternoon found the airport quiet Standing at the back of a long line for passport control I thought we could in for a long wait But they virtually waved the entire plane load through in around minutes By which time the luggage had already arrived So we were out of the airport within minutes Ive never known anything like it On the way back there were several flights delayed due to a storm However everything still worked well for our flight and we departed on time Not a big airport but I was happy with my time there

This airport on Floridas East Coast is a beautiful little facility Upon deplaning I was greeted by a small but spacious and superbly appointed sixgate terminal which was quite welcoming The terminal is remarkably wellmaintained and is very userfriendly with nice short distances good signage and a few clean shops to pick up a magazine or a quick meal The personnel both Delta and the airport security were some of the most courteous airport employees that I have seen in a while with an genuine eagerness to serve The only downside to DAB is the relatively small number of airlines and flight choices prices are often higher than Orlando or Jacksonville and you will probably have to catch a connecting flight through a major hub to get to your destination And auto racing fans can catch a good view of Daytona International Speedway right across the street from the airport on landing if they are lucky

Arriving and departing from this regional airport is far less stressful than dealing with the airports in Cancun or Mexico City There are fewer passengers of course plus the airport is well organized and clean Checkin was fast and easy and security was well organized courteous and fast There are several places to enjoy a snack or meal before takeoff The waiting area is spacious and uncrowded and offers great views of planes landing and taking off Wifi was free and worked well

I flew with Boliviana de Aviacin from Cochabamba to Madrid with my wife and two children We flew on a B for the first shorthaul flight from Cochabamba to Santa Cruz and then on a A from Santa Cruz to Madrid Very friendly service on board Personal screens on each seat for the long flight They could make some progress on the food tthey serve though This being said we had two full meals dinner and breakfast unlike other airlines who only offer one free meal for the same hour flight Santa CruzMadrid We arrived to Madrid on time All in all a very pleasant experience with BoA
The airport staff was helpful polite and respectful There was a metro which helped me move around quickly Schedule boards everywhere Nice restaurants and coffee shops Not crowded at all

Excellent both coming and going Good selection of shops and restaurants Layout easy to navigate Well signposted in both Spanish and English Clean throughout Ample restroom facilities Best of all the passportcustoms control personnel both incoming and outgoing are courteous efficient and multilingual They smile I hope they can give US officers the basic lesson Corners of mouth go up not down

Despite a delay of about minutes overall it was a good flight Check in was easy the flight attendants were friendly and efficient and the plane was clean and comfortable The only free beverage was water which was no issue on such a short flight

Great airline punctual The cabin crew is very welcoming and provides excellent service Excellent flight tracking with announcements from the captain Great loyalty program with MegaVolotea Super compagnie ponctuel Le personnel naviguant est trs accueillant et propose un super service Bon suivi de vol avec des annonces micro du commandant de bord Super programme de fidlit avec megavolotea

SSHLXRSSH Dash Q A bit dubious as I had never heard of this Egyptian carrier and the name doesnt inspire a great deal of confidence but I was pleasantly surprised A new aircraft on this short minute flight comprehensive safety demo in English that was understandable Complimentary juice and a small snack provided I would not hesitate to use this airline again

Excellent small regional airport spotlessly clean with very friendly staff slight oddity that the baggage reclaim belts are in the arrivals hall but I was out within th mins of the plane touching down and you cant get much better than that

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

I enjoyed my flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time Staff were very pleasant and helpful Food was a small snack and soft drink which is fine on so short a flight Overall a very pleasant flight
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning

Tehran to Copenhagen Excellent value For money Traveling alone with a baby can be challenging but I found Check in and boarding procedures smooth and without delays The flight attendants were young and very nice to us A with smart and clean cabin Food and nonalcoholic beverages was plentiful as a hot breakfast was served at the beginning of flight and a cold refreshment before landing in Copenhagen This was a hour flight and I did not expect that Inflight entertainment could be improved This was a great flight and I would consider to fly with this airline again in the future

Impressed with this airport Quick and easy process for arrival and departure Yes we had to queue for passport control but they got through the lines reasonable quick The luggage had still not hit the belts so we would have queued anyway On departure the line again for both check in and passport control was quick The food courts were excellent and great choice at very reasonable prices for sw What I was more impressed weee the cleanliness of the toilets Having had the worst experience through Heraklion this was a complete surprise Well done Corfu Very clean and modern

Paphos to Sochi via Moscow Excellent company and the only one that Im using for travels to Russia Very reasonably priced tickets They are the only company which offers perks before you reach silver status which requires at least flights miles eg free luggage if you have done flights On that particular flight the crew was nice as always food was great for an economy ticket and the seats were comfortable Highly recommended and hopefully they will continue growing
My mother travelled alone in Air Asia on June The flight was very comfortable Services were good Ground staff was extremely helpful Sincere thanks to the ticketing staff

Chiang Mai to Khon Kaen with Kan Air A small but very efficient airline ATR very clean ground staff did a great job and the biggest surprise options between fish and chicken meal with rice for a minute flight with rounds of drinks I choose this airline as the fastest way to go from Korat airport closed to Chiang Mai via Khon Kaen to avoid a hour bus ride As for the price this was half than a bus ticket to Chiang Mai Excellent

Really nice facility The Olympic games in that city I am sure modernized the facility Nice waiting area at departure area to wait with friends before immigration Immigration was fast but was surprised by the friendliness and the I hope you had a nice stay in our area of the one person at immigration check with excellent english skills Nice Food selection and shops acceptable Over all a good experience

I first arrived in Damascus in Feb Since then I have been back and forth almost times a year since then I am an Englishman who met and married a Syrian girl in The airport in my view was more relaxed in the old days whereby you could check in and walk back into the loungecafe for tea etc with your friends and family

The airport is not as bad as some of the earlier reports suggest Having a local guide meet you and handle the formalities will help a lot Most people hand over their passports tickets and baggage to these people and allow them to sort out the problems

The checkin process at Nagoya Centrair Airport was a smooth and pleasant one with kind staff assisting you if needed However the checkin counters opens only exactly hours before departure Apart from check in there is an amazing skydeck for aircraft photographers like me to photograph planes free of charge Also there are many food options to choose ranging from Japanese cuisine to Western cuisineThe central security screening was smooth and quick and I cleared security within minutes The airside had a lot of duty free shops vending machines to buy drinks and a clear view of the apron and runway Overall it was a very pleasant experience and I am happy to fly out of Nagoya Centrair Airport

Flew Amsterdam Schiphol to Marseille via Strasbourg Hop has good service and comfort levels for a regional airliner Their inflight announcements in English need some work though On my flights I was on an Embrear which has an odd seating arrangement of The seats were comfortable and not cramped The flights were staffed by a single cabin manager but they handled the job of getting everyone onboard and serving a complementary drink with a snack on each leg well Their inflight announcements in English were completely incomprehensible however as were the recorded announcements in English as well Since I dont speak French I just hope they werent telling me anything important On one leg of my flight there was a brief delay but this was communicated in a timely manner

CVG is my home airport and I have always had a good experience compared with other large cities However I recently returned from a trip and had parked in Long Term parking Previously I had only to walk out the door and across the pick up lane to the well marked shuttle buses and ride to the long term parking Apparently they have revised the whole set up and there is zero accessible signage to direct you to a brand new pick up spot for the shuttle buses There should be a sign at the old spot telling of the new one signage in the actual terminal near where arriving customers will see it as they enter the luggage retrieval area arrows and signage that distinguishes the east and the west pick up areas are for different things eg the East is for Uber etc and the West is for parking shuttles note there is a sign for the bus shuttles in the west end only after you have walked about of the way there once in the line designated for different shuttles there needs to be signage that distinguishes which shuttle lot bus will be stopping where there are at different shuttles stopping in this lane and the bus itself needs to have signage eg long term parking This is such a huge oversight please correct it so you can maintain your excellent reputation

Ljubljana airport is very practical for passengers and all procedures are carried out quickly There are not many flights and passengers in the morning so the experience is even better The employees are professionally friendly but not much more very very few smiles In the dutyfree shop some Croatian products are offered as Slovenian ones which is probably an unintentional mistake The coffee at the bar is excellent The toilet which was otherwise clean smelled of nitrogen compounds probably due to insufficient or absent ventilation In the waiting room in front of the bridges to the plane at least some of the otherwise comfortable seats were torn It was also possible to see through the windows into neglected closed and abandoned rooms which they probably do not know what to do with The airport is a very important point of entry to my beloved country so even some seemingly trivial carelessness is out of place

Little Rock National Airport LIT is one of my favorite midsize airports It is on par with the Bob Hope Airport BUR and Ft LauderdaleHollywood International Airport FLL in that it is easy to get in and out of the airport complex the location is close to downtown and the presence of lowcost airlines keep overall ticket prices among the lowest in the country

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

For departures Algiers new airport is fairly spacious functional and the staff is friendly I might have been lucky but I found the police controls and security to go fairly quickly Shops are limited but I found them sufficient also they are open very early and close late The choice of restaurants is limited to for each hall and they are of the same provider They offer reasonable selections of light eating and drinking On arrivals I find it inadequate to have to walk down stairs after coming off the plane I did not see an elevator available The wait for the luggage is too long I was told it was due to the luggage scanner being undersized for the traffic One important deficiency is the absence of English signs they are all in French and Arabic only A shame for a brand new International airport Over all I was satisfied mainly due to efficiency at departure and the feeling of space which is lacking too often in aging European airports

There is a need for some chairs and a table to sit and reorganise after the security check This is especially important for people with knee other implants requiring putting on the shoes Cannot do this in standing position I kept the bag on the only one table and was putting on the shoes in standing position One security lady officer showed her displeasure and asked me to remove the bag from the table Not very helpful

Finally the new terminal is in operation Arrival and departure were a breeze no queues no trouble with signage nothing to complain about Toilets are clean overall facility is still under final touches of construction The terminal is too big for the amount of flights served so very few people there Pity they have no food and drink outlets landside yet and just a small stall with snacks airside Overall impression very good everything worked there and up to the international standards From plane to taxi in minutes from check in to plane in Good

Just wish to say that the check in and wheelchair assistance at Malpensa was really excellent and one of the best that I have experienced as a recent wheelchair traveller Staff were very helpful and efficient The only issue that I would raise is the state of the toilets
