Small airport but airport location wonderful Dont have boarding bridge Ground staff are very fast No need to wait for a long time to check in bags I got my bag on arrivals right after reaching the belt very fast Staff are friendly No shops inside airport taxi counters before arrival gate

Genoa airport compares extremely well with our huge overcrowded and understaffed London airports It is nice and small with lovely shops and good cafes There are no long queues at check in or security and staff are friendly and helpful A pleasure to visit

Terminal International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

Beijing Nanyuan to Hohhot China United is the only airline that uses Beijing Nanyuan a former military airport in the South of Beijing The airport is easy to get to and flights in and out of Nanyuan do not seem to be subject to delays as serious as those at Beijing Capital Theres also very little taxiing Checkin was quick easy but the checkin area is noisy and dilapidated Toilets at the airport werent great The flight was on a newish and the plane was clean Service was friendly and the bacon wrap for breakfast was actually very nice Takeoff and arrival were both on schedule Id use China United again just to avoid the delays at Beijing Capital
Kualanamu airport is very good Check in counters are good the waiting room is comfortable and clean But the toilets are not too clean but no problem The airport staff are good

Check in at San Andres had to be done at the airport since I had a bag to drop off the line was very long so I waited about minutes Since there are no drinks or snacks available for sale on the plane I bought some stuff at the airport to bring along on the plane Flight back to Bogota was quite smooth quiet and easy I flew back on the same plane that had brought me to San Andres Nothing to complain about Cheap option to San Andres and very efficient

Harry Bauer lounge at Port Vila Airport is located airside after passing through Immigration and Customs We travelled Business Class on Air Vanuatu and were handed lounge invitations Its best kept secret that this lounge is also a pay as you go Lounge so anyone Economy Class passengers as well can actually access the lounge on paying a fee when the lounge is open before each departure I didnt ask what the fee was but did notice they accept credit cards by way of a credit card machine contrary to some reviews some years back stating they only accept cash The lounge is air conditioned very welcoming after walking through the nonair conditioned public waiting area There is a refrigerator with nonalcoholic drinkssodas as well as a selection of local beers Minimal snacks are on offer and comfortable seating with views out across the tarmac and runway A quiet haven to sit and relax before the flight There is sufficient seating for some or more people so not a small lounge but cosy enough Sure beats waiting in the public area where there is no air conditioning
Another great flight Very consistent service consistent quality of food and comfortable aircraft The service on the flight was just spot on I would recommend them based on how consistent they are

A very pleasant flight There was an issue with the bag drop but I had some friendly assistance The plane left on time and the flight attendants were helpful and friendly The new plane was clean and comfortable A small snack was served which was fine on such a short flight I also appreciated the free beer

Wonderful customer service Great staff at the airport and on the plane Even better we needed to make changes to our flight and the customer service centre responded to a web enquiry within minutes at oclock at night on a Friday Simple and easy to deal with and a very comfortable clean aircraft

ANCFAIANC Economy Open Seating Check in was difficult The checkin agent did not understand how to read my ticket and almost seemed to blame me for the error Once on board however the flight attendants both on the outbound and return were very nice especially on the return flight a definite sense of humor Era offers low fares between Anchorage and Fairbanks and I will be flying with them again Its also nice not to have to go to security when flying on the smaller planes

Great experience Early check in possible and done quickly staff super friendly Security fast and lets you go faster with a baby Nice tax free zone that you can actually enjoy as the check in and security is done quickly At least two amazing playgrounds for children great cafes everything clean

Had a flight from Gatwick to Zakynthos with Grand Cru Airlines as Small Planet had an issue with one of there aircraft The staff were stunning and so friendly The aircraft was one of the best with very good comfy seating Thank you for getting our holiday off to a good start Would fly with Grand Cru Airlines any time

This review is about the new Siem Reap International Airport that began operations on October It was my first time at this airport and was taking the long hour trip by the post office bus Besides a big nice golden Buddha statue there is nothing decorative cultural paintings etc at this new airport Despite having an invitation to a lounge the lounge was not in operation yet There is only one coffee facility where people must queue up Only one Chinese restaurant was open but who to eat dim sum for breakfast The staff overall seemed distant and immigration staff only became friendly after I began speaking in Khmer I know that this is a new airport but maybe the airport authority can pick up some ideas from this review t was also very hot inside

I flew in on Lufthansas twice weekly flight via Samara no February st They are the only international carrier Apart from immigration refusing to acknowledge the computer generated form from the Russian Federations London Embassy which meant I had to fill one in by hand everything was fine I was in and out of the airport inside halfanhour

I flew with Shaheen Air on Jan from Dubai to Karachi Checkin was good Cabin crew friendly and smiling and before take off a drink was served and a newspaper After take off nice dinner was served with chicken Korma Zeera Rice Riata and Hot Tea

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

Business classenjoyed a drink of champagne and some refreshments upon taking a seat and theres plenty of room to stretch out Particularly on their trips from Dubai An amazing collection of Englishlanguage movies spanning every possible genre

Due to a mechanical fault the plane that landed was too small for all of the passengers So the ground staff at Nevsehir had to work really hard to deal with about people who could not fit The staff in this small office tried so hard to identify the most urgent passengers who had connecting flights then they prioritised everyone The staff were faced with passengers who all thought they were the most important person in the airport We did not have a connecting flight and were lower priority So the team arranged for about of us to be bussed to nearby Kayseri airport our flight was going to be hours later than expected So the ground staff refunded the cost of our flight not once but twice We were able to collect the money from a counter at the airport immediately then we were upgraded to Business class which meant we were able to sit in quiet and cool comfort while we waited Then on the flight we were very impressed with the food and service and priority baggage service I know the fault was not due to the ground staff but they really tried hard and were very successful at getting people through to their connecting flights and what they offered us really helped ease the pain of our delay I am really impressed with the people in that small office I wish I da their names to thank them personally I highly recommend flying with Turkish Airways after this experience
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

Jan From TLVVKOALA TSEVKOTLV All flights on B but the last flight to TLV onboard B Food is really pathetic Im usually not picky with airline food but this time all segments were awful in quantity and quality Flight attendant mostly nice and accommodating The flight from VKO to ALA was on a brand new B with IFE and WIFI so it was much fun all the rest segments were without IFE Seats are leather and quite comfortble Flights departed mostly on time despite deicing in every station but TLV Fare was good VKO airport new and welcoming All in all a good deal

CPHNRK and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Norrkping every half hour travel time is mins and costs SEK Beware that bus drivers do not accept cash any more the only option is the selfservice machine inside the terminal or to purchase a SMS ticket Checkin efficient and hasslefree online seat preselection is available Security staff very friendly Boarding area is limited to two gates and rather cramped do not go airside too early I recommend the airport restaurant which serves tasty and hearty Swedish meals

Passed through Toronto City Centre Airport on a recent trip from Chicago to Quebec It is a small airport so very easy to navigate We were through Canadian immigration very promptly and back through security for our onward flight without fuss The departure lounge was very comfortable with plenty of seats available All the immigration and airport staff that we encountered were friendly and helpful Overall a great introduction to Canada and one of the best airports that I have been too

NRT to TPE with JX on AUG and back with JX on AUG in Business Class for both legs I had always wanted to take a Starlux flight Before boarding at NRT I spent time in JAL Sakura lounge as Starlux doesnt have its own The inflight meal on the flight bound for TPE didnt satisfy my appetite Concretely speaking a grilled pork shoulder in sauce was tasteless I regretted not having preordered it Also champagne was served not so cold For my part I am not so interested in inflight entertainment On my return from Taipei prior to boarding I entered the Galactic lounge at Taoyuan airport T What surprised most was that they offered an a la carte menu on which I found an appetizing salmon steak and ordered it How tasty The dish served on the flight one similar to beef steak was totally different from the previous one It was superb The generous flow of chilled BOLLINGER champagne delighted me well Meticulous services offered by a Japanese flight attendant are worthy of a special mention Though this was a short haul or a hourandminute flight I could not help wishing it would be much longer Both flights were punctual

Best airline in Russia Very nice staff comfortable seats I dont ask much I mean this is coming from a girl who drives tanks good service and power supplies anything you can possibly ask for enough room for my single bag and even more room Great service good crew wonderful meals and so much more Ground service I was pushed around a lot but that isnt the staffs fault I dont remember turning on my inflight entertainment system I was too busy playing World of Tanks Blitz with the incredible WiFi

Nice new Airport I have been travel through his airport for last one year and it is very nice and good airport overall It is relatively new but still there is a lot things which can be improved like Air conditioning and bathroom cleanness etc

Was surprised how good it was Very nice and smiling crew bed quite comfortable good choice of drinks Did not really like the gluten free option as I got the same meal twice Ground service was a disaster

Birmingham to Zurich I am an incredibly nervous flyer and was flying at weeks pregnant so much more anxious than usual When I checked in the airline immediately clocked that I was pregnant and told me to come and queue up with priority customers even though I was flying economy When I did they showed me to a seat to sit in while I waited for the coach which was so helpful and kind On the plane the hostess noticed my anxiety during takeoff and throughout the flight they checked in with me constantly with such patience and kindness offering me a bottle of water to sip and calm my breathing down giving comforting reassurances at the slightest sign of turbulence and before we landed coming and offering a little cuddly toy plane for my unborn baby The genuinely caring nature of all the staff was absolutely superb and such an enormous comfort to a more vulnerable person I was so grateful and thoroughly impressed with every staff member involved at each step of the way

Staff all very helpful in particular a lady from the special assistance team She went above and beyond what a lovely lady who clearly is very devoted to her job role We would choose to fly from Eindhoven airport again as our experience was so smooth and professionally handled Thank you such a small thing to say I hope this gets back to the whole team

Outstanding views when arriving in on a fair weather day Pass through Airport in little time due to size of airport Friendly staff and facilities need to step up with any increase in flightpassenger numbers Sligo City is only miles form the airport or Euro taxi Journey Area beside airport is popular for running golf surfing and sea sports with international surf competitions held regularly

The airport is big upon my arrival I passed through the electronic gate and it did not take more than a minute to complete my entry procedures into the country and it was more than wonderful The treatment of the airport staff is wonderful we received our bags quickly and there was no delay Upon our departure the treatment was also professional friendly and fast from the staff and there was no delay in stamping passports security check or check in We tried two restaurants to eat at the airport and the food was very tasty travelling through Dubai Airport is a wonderful experience

One of the easiest airports to access both inbound and outbound that we have ever experienced Staff on the information desk in Terminal were extremely pleasant and helpful when we asked for assistance Public areas very clean and well kept Plenty of seating for passengers Great food outlets and some interesting local shops as well A real treat to travel through this southern California airport

Vancouver to Honolulu via Ottawa We had the pleasure of flying Omni after a very long delayed missed connection flight and they went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and comfortable The higher level of service is very evident in the crews demeanor and professionalism Penny and Ilya were particularly helpful and went out of their way to make our flight memorable Thank you to the entire team

Perfect experience After having read the reviews on Fastjet I was very nervous despite friends reinsurance that the airline had improved dramatically in recent years Well everything was perfect The ticket was very reasonably priced Checkin online and baggage drop off were easy The flight left on time and arrived minutes early The air hostess was charming The snacks though not fancy were good and our chairs were comfortable The baggage was on the carousel by the time we arrived Very happy customers

Clean efficient and friendly The Norwegians do these things very well There is everything you need at this airport cafe bar shop etc but without the hassle of larger airports I would recommend the region for any tourist and Trondheim is a very attractive city

Quite a small airport compared to the Dubai or Abu Dhabi International Airports Only half a dozen or airlines serve this airport On arrival myself and wife senior citizens were treated with compassion and helped by the airport customs and immigration staff No difficulties faced by us we found the airport quite peaceful neat and tidy I wish more flights were available to and from this Airport in UAE Travel to city center of Al Ain a charming city in the midst of the Arabian desert was also a pleasant experience with hardly any traffic problems

I flew from Kerry to go to Alicante ALC and back Parking is not far from the terminal When you go in the door the toilets cafe and checkin area are very close Internet was fast and easy to connect to Toilets were clean enough The caf has good food and there are two vending machines before you go into departures It is a short walk to departures and security is not that long There is two boarding gates with a small gift shop Boarding went through very quick and the flight arrived minutes early We arrived back after ten days and we were early again which was great There is only one baggage belt and it can get very crowded Very satisfied with the airport and the experience

This is my home airport Completely renewed a few years ago its now a very good and modern airport Near the city center just minutes by car Its a small airport but its probably the better choice to come to Sardinia Depending on winds you can have a fantastic view over the famous sardinian beaches from your airplane window In the summer sometimes you may find crowds at security checks There are just a few overpriced shops but this is common in italian airports Car rentals taxis and bus are easy available

Domestic terminal is easy to use not much going on and no crowds or wait times It has sufficient seating capabilities but restaurant and shopping options are fairly limited But it serves its purpose is reasonably clean and convenient

Airport is clean has good shops great seating area and has clear signs However the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that in the entire terminal you could literally i counted just find a total of five power outlets that should really be something to be improved so watch out for that

We found Munich Airport to be an excellent airport very well laid out with two level gate system that seems to work very efficiently Very easy to follow signage good seating Check in and baggage drop off was well managed by friendly staff at Singapore Airlines service desks Gates and boarding in designated assigned groups seemed to work quite well Well presented airport

CPHNRK and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Norrkping every half hour travel time is mins and costs SEK Beware that bus drivers do not accept cash any more the only option is the selfservice machine inside the terminal or to purchase a SMS ticket Checkin efficient and hasslefree online seat preselection is available Security staff very friendly Boarding area is limited to two gates and rather cramped do not go airside too early I recommend the airport restaurant which serves tasty and hearty Swedish meals

I love Air North and use them whenever its convenient between Kelowna and Vancouver Very reasonable fares which includes two checked bags and advance seat selection for Always on time friendly staff and I love the vintage s Its like what flying was like decades ago much nicer and more relaxed

This is a small new and very well designed airport There is only one runway so there is never too much traffic The business lounge is excellent clean and there is always food and drink and the service is excellent

We travelled through Monastir Airport and found it to be pretty good for a small airport The queues coming in were fairly smooth and on the way out of the country everything went smoothly as well Facilities are perhaps a little limited but its only a small airport comparatively and at least it was clean

Matecaa to Enrique Olaya Herrera Medellin with Easyfly The flight was a little delayed but not too much They have a nice staff the flight was very quiet and comfortable They bring a little catering but the flight just takes minutes so its a really nice detail the plane was clean the price is very atractive I have the best opinion about this airline

The current airport consists of two buildings The first houses the security scanners and the second an open air thatched building the manual check in Very pleasant for small groups A new terminal is being constructed and should be ready in a few years Like most things in Lamu this is a simple functional relaxed airport From the terminal you walk meters to the fast boats for the minute ride to Lamu Town or to Shela Beach
Overall the airline offered a clean cabin efficient crew almost friendly good seat spacing and ontime service Pretty good for a budget airline

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

I agree that it is a small tidy airport with close proximity to the city It is great that the tram is literally as you walk out the front doors with a frequent service to the city Bremen is such a great little city

The Airport is actually very nice and there are many comfy sofa beds It has a good amount of shops and places to eat and it has a clean and comfy atmosphere The airline Gulf Air was a nightmare but the airport was very good Recommended to transit through

Berlin Schnefeld to Tel Aviv Fast and efficient check in flight on time very friendly crew Clean plane seat comfort in Economy Plus good Compared to Ups competitors on this route Up has the best flight schedule Have flown Up repeatedly in Economy Plus and never disappointed

Only good thing about Bangalore airport terminal is it is beautiful and clean No other facilities available like other airports It does not have much food stalls and shopping area near GATES Moreover toilet are very far from gate location Less seating areas

I flew Motor Sich this past July from Kyiv to Odesa and it was a great experience It was on one of their AN s and to my surprise the seats were the most comfortable economy seats I have flown not to mention the most room Also when checking in my bag was a few kilos overweight and they let me check it with no extra charge Would definitely fly Motor Sich again

The airport of Yangon was very clean with good airconditioning the queue for the visa was not long so it was fast the belt with the bags was easy to find Good impression when you arrive Has also a really good conection with bus to the city center
Flew LUGFLR via GVA and back Excellent airline Flights on time FA very friendly and service excellent Would fly with Etihad Regional again

LX from Vienna to Zurich operated by Helvetic Airways The flight was completely full but boarding was expertly handled by the crew and went very smoothly The EE is a small aircraft and space in the overhead bins is limited The crew assisted passengers with finding a place for their carryon luggage and in the end all luggage could be stored somewhere Also the crew were very friendly and courteous As this was a very short flight a small snack was served which was excellent All in all a very comfortable short flight on a small aircraft with an excellent crew

Went to OVD on a day trip from BCN in mid June to visit family in nearby Castrillon I seen the airport evolve for the last thirty years into a very nice compact and efficient operation Everything is laid out in a logical sequence You arrive into a small checkin area as there are still less than a half dozen or so carriers that use it go through a quick and orderly screening area and up to the gates There are various shops to include a regional Asturias gift shop stores transportation outlets and the such Public areas are clean and not crowded by any means There is the typical cafe with lots of room and reasonable pricing We found taxis right outside the terminal along with two bays for ALSA busses running to both Oviedo and Gijon Be advised that the trip to the provincial cities of Oviedo Gijon and Aviles all take about a half hour or so to get to All in all a very nice userfriendly airport

Small simple and clean everything you want in an airport Love coming home to this beautiful airport Pros extremely clean efficient great signage short wait times never any traffic to and from and never any plane traffic Cons no lounges not a lot of shopping very limited food choices things close early a bit far outside city centre parking can be pricey

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

Windhoek to Frankfurt After having read reviews I was prepared for bad service and problems during the flight but luckily everything was fine and I am quite happy with the overall experience The aircraft is spacious and clean seats are comfortable and have a pillow and a blanket for each passenger The crew was very friendly and not so good cop bad cop The food was quite good however it might have been better maybe a dessert could be added Big selection of drinks but only one type of juice orange On the long overnight flight dinner and breakfast have been offered During the flight the crew also offered water The entertainment system is still not working it seems to be a persistent problem that the airline is not willing to solve

I am very grateful to Royal Brunei Airlines for helping me facilitate my lastminute return to Brunei My husband and I were supposed to return to Brunei on November th but because my sister passed away on the morning of November th we had to return to Brunei immediately At first there were no available slots for a return flight but one of the RB KUL crew Mohad did everything he could to help me get back to Brunel I am very thankful and deeply appreciate his assistance If it werent for his support I wouldnt have had the chance to be there in time for my sisters burial Good job RBA and keep up the great work

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

Excellent flights from Gran Canaria to Tenerife North with this super regional airline Well maintained clean aircraft both ways Short flights of around mins with friendly cabin crew Newspapers brought round before take off During the flight served glass of water with a chocolate biscuit followed by a sweet Just enough time to collect everything in before landing Check in easy with no queing at both LPA and TFN Luggage delivered on belt within mins of entering baggage reclaimat both airports Thank you Binter Canarias for excellent service

Not the best but for a smaller city it does the job if you have an early morning flight you can only get there by cab or someone dropping you off The transit that is available at the airport at the day time can be very crowded and infrequent One positive thing is that the airport staff is very friendly and helpful

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

Small airport yet very efficient Dont come too early as there is not much to do Queuing is almost nonexistent staff checkin and security are very friendly There is a restaurant with view on the tarmac and a small airport shop before the security Arrival is very fast to minutes including bagage reclaim There is a bus stop right before the terminal taking you to AntwerpenBerchem train station a major train station with fast connection to Brussels or anywhere in Belgium Very close to the city center Highly recomended for users who like fast airports

Parking in front of the aiport and you can almost board your plane Small short ways no waiting times at security and passport control quiet since our flight was the only one departing ridiculous airport prices and good seating Weeze is the prototype of a convenient regional airport though I dont know how it would be in summer and I like it very much Equally easy when returning One minus I think the parking fee is too high

We were running late due to heavy unpredicted traffic in Ayodhya It was a surprise to see even the airport route was blocked We drive to airport and called Akasa Airlines and they helped us to wait for few min Many thanks to ground staff where they waited for us and helped us to get in faster Akasa accommodated my request and waited for me for boarding Really appreciated the efforts

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Nice and efficient airport Security and passport controls are quick and smooth and makes the airport easy to travel to and from Good connections for transfers to other airport in Norway or Europe Easy access to Trondheim with airport train buses or taxi Brand new Radisson SAS hotel adjacent to terminal A

Paphos to Sochi via Moscow Excellent company and the only one that Im using for travels to Russia Very reasonably priced tickets They are the only company which offers perks before you reach silver status which requires at least flights miles eg free luggage if you have done flights On that particular flight the crew was nice as always food was great for an economy ticket and the seats were comfortable Highly recommended and hopefully they will continue growing

As an Arkansas native I have flown in and out of LRN several times LR National is exceptionally clean and easy to navigate For an airport with only gates there is plenty to do nice places to eat and even a museum The airport just underwent a million overhaul which gives it a nice modern flare It has also recently added a threelevel parking garage which is reasonably priced and has easy access to the terminal LRN is now undergoing construction on their baggage claim area to make it more user friendly although a little burdensome in the meantime and there is also some landscape work being done to the main entrance to get ready for the opening of the Clinton Presidential Center in November Easy transportation to city downtown is only mi from LIT Also cheaper fares than nearby MEM
From Prague to Saint Petersburg great service nice food professional group price of the ticket was higher than competitors but worth it highly recommended

Vistara stands out as a premium fullservice carrier offering a superior travel experience that consistently impresses From checkin to landing the attention to detail and customer focus is evident making it one of the best choices for both domestic and international travel in India The cabin crew is exceptionally professional courteous and attentive ensuring passengers feel comfortable throughout the journey The seating arrangement especially in Premium Economy and Business Class provides ample legroom and ergonomic comfort ideal for long flights The inflight entertainment options are diverse catering to various preferences and the complimentary meals are thoughtfully curated offering both quality and variety Punctuality is another area where Vistara excels with flights often departing and arriving on time Additionally the checkin process is seamless and the airline staff are welltrained to handle queries efficiently The partnership with Singapore Airlines also adds a layer of credibility and enhances the overall experience That said Vistaras ticket prices can be slightly higher than budget carriers but the services provided justify the cost For those who value comfort reliability and excellent service Vistara is worth every penny Its an airline that truly redefines air travel in India with its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction
We loved Lynx It was Super affordable planes were on time and no delays We dont eat on planes anyway so who cares Will definitely be flying again

Expecting the worst but a great surprise It was a new building and super clean Great welcome by the airport staff and especially the Passport Control proud of their airport and their country and genuinely do their best to make it a painless process On departure the check in staff were efficient cheerful and helpful A very pleasant little cafe for snacks and once again through to more smiling passport control

At Brussels airport the check in service was smooth they even accepted my luggage although it was kg overweight The boarding was quick due to the small plane The trip was around hours I prefer bigger airplanes for longer flights as these smaller planes tend to rock a bit more and the legroom isnt the best either The flight attendants were polite and nice The landing at Tallinn was smooth managed to clear customs very easily

Los Angeles to Cusco via Lima We were pleasantly surprised when Lan Airlines delivered our luggage hour from the airport the day after we landed American Airlines in the US didnt tell us sbout collecting our luggage in Lima before flying to Cusco must go through Customs so it never arrived in Cusco Lan Airlines Personnel were very helpful to fill the forms out and to deliver was unexpected Thanks for helping make our trip great

Brasilia airport is probably the best Brazilian airport The shoppingeating area is good and with a great variety The information desk is good and people friendly not to mention the architecture that is beautiful The bad things about the airport are Transportation Buses not as frequent as they should be No metro or train Boarding area once you pass Security the airport is too crowded and not having the same amenities as the preboarding area make the journey less comfortable Too small for the traffic it has Drop offPick Up passengers There is a lack of enforcing the laws and people park in the drop off areas making it difficult to approach sometimes

A lowcost airline and they enforce bag weights and sizes and number of bags very closely Despite that if you buy early its a good value for travel in and around Kazakhstan Purchase bags early as they charge a lot at airport My flight however was fine arrived on time with no issues Overall satisfied for what I paid

Minsk to Zaporizhzhia with Motor sich airlinesThe itinerary showed Antonov as operating the flight but in reality the flight was operated by Antonov a year old Soviet Aircraft However Motor Sich airline did not pre advise of aircraft change h flight Big mistake in choosing seats in the first rows they are right by the engines and the noise is deafening Leg room is very tight unlike seats in rows have better keg room for some reason Window shades are cotton curtains a real weird bird a great privilege to fly such an old bird A nice cabin crew provided friendly service and had perfect English She served a ham and cheese Sandwich with some sweets hot teacoffee and water Cabin was very warm too but thats a general issue in Russia in the winter they just like to roast in the cabins A well worth aviation experience

airport Aircraft was a newer Dreamliner B filled to last seat Was in the middle of a midsection in the back surrounded by passengers all over However the seats are spacious and can recline cm I felt comfortable and slept quite well Food was served on large trays and main course was very delicious spicy seafood with plenty of support like heavy salad desert cheese and chocolate I could choose my favourite meal despite being on of the last being served Got an extra portion on request On this hour night flight the two meal rounds were valued and sufficed Drinks plenty including Moroccan wines and beers Staff are Moroccan males are professional hardworking focused and pragmatic They may appear being blunt but on firm requests they act well They relocate seats up to last Minute and beyond to accommodate passengers wishes allowing couples and families to sit together Amenity kit hearsets pillows blankets provided to all IFA promised a lot with big screens and options However it was not working properly for approx half of the cabin it froze again and again or ran into endless loops In Casablanca RAM kept their announced promises of providing a smooth STPC hotel meals and transport for longhours transit passenger Passed immigration without hurdles I was put up in the fine star Zenith hotel and got two meals within a hours stay Back to airport accessed the RAMs Zenith Lounge which is spacious fine sufficient catering and tarmac views in two floors Upper floor has a manned bar while the lower have barista and meal catering Lively and exotic a surprisingly good lounge are easily outweighed by other perks the airline provides Ticket not expensive First time with RAM pleasantly surprised cant really fault them fully recommended

High marks for YOW Transited from USA to international There is no sterile transit area One has to enter Canada and then go through security again but the process was fast I was number at passport control Service personnel uniformly nice and helpful Reasonable number of shops and eateries for a small airport Well done Ottawa

I wanted to fly by Air NZ After finding out the Perth route was now going to be flying with WAMOS Air I researched I nearly canceled with all the negative star reviews Wamos Air is the best airline I have ever flown service was fantastic and the seats comfortable Everyone was given a blanket and pillow the food good for airline food You could get extra drinks and food if wanted and periodically they would come around with water On return to Perth it was the same The plane was not dated The lady next to me on returning was quite ill and the cabin crew couldnt do enough for her They even reseated me so I wouldnt be concerned and they could access that traveller in case of added complications
I visited Victoria BC two weeks ago and for a small international airport I enjoyed the experience Security was quick the facilities were good and checkin was quick I recommend this airport

Pricequality is unbeatable Airplane was on the same standard as most European Airlines and Food and service as well Regarding the transfer in Shenzhen it works perfectly It is a huge modern international Airport I was advised that I could enjoy my time outside the aiport as Austria is one of EU countries that are now Visa free Went to the city with public transport and visited the KK Mall and St Regis Highly recommended Plane was empty that was nice as well

Lovely and clean little country airport offering frequent flights to BNE Short and long term parking in front of the terminal is free Restroom facilities very clean and in good working condition Airport has gates but they are pretty separate doors right next to each other leading on to the tarmac no air bridges Security staff well mannered and friendly Free Wifi in the terminal Only one fast food type of restaurant with very average food and rather expensive prices Seating in the terminal is rather uncomfortable hard metal type of seats so suggest you buy a coffee or chocolate bar and find a seat at the fast food restaurant Overall a very friendly and efficient environment

A rather small airport serving Firenze I used the airport in the winter season so imagine it during the busy summer season Theres bus boarding only and max small gates It has a abundance of dutyfree shops and food beverages counters Prices are reasonable Staff is friendly and efficiently working

You know its a shame that this beautiful airport cannot supply enough helpful staff to assist with directing you to the right place in order to make your connecting flight If only there were those who could advise you what you need to do when you DO have a boarding pass in your possession and that you must take a bus to another part of the terminal to board your connecting flight The whole experience almost tainted the start and end to a brilliant holiday

Loved it Takes no more than minutes from entering to get to the gate When you depart minutes It was like heaven compared to Toronto where there are long lines lots of computers and where it takes so long to get to the gate and where you dread the lineups getting off the plane for the same reason It is convenient it is quick clean and has a Tim Hortons
The cabin crew was amazing I forgot my earphones near the boarding gate and they found and delivered back to me The flight was LX on March nd Thanks again for a delightful trip

A very small airport but well run It has stands which are all a few steps from the terminal building It is no where near Oslo miles south approx hours away The terminal building is a single storey with Checkin Desks on one side arrivals in the middle with belt and Security Scanning on the other side On the Land Side there is a cafshop supplying hot and cold snacks and other things and a seating area It is very small so everything is within easy reach but if more than plane is in at a time it could get busy Outside there is lots of car parking and car rental options along with transport to the local railway station for trains to various points including Oslo If you are visiting Oslo City Centre think carefully before using this airport if you want to access the locality it is a small friendly place

This airport is very small for the number of passengers and airlines it is serving Everywhere seemed to be crowded and felt cramped I thought they needed more space for better facilities and customer service Transferring from the train coming from London to the terminal and between terminals was very easy and well signage The prayer room is available and wellmaintained and the toilets are clean Not a pleasant experience for shopping and dining as there are too many people in a cramped space

Victoria Falls boasts a nice new terminal building that is uncluttered and pleasant I arrived for a flight to Addis Ababa and was immediately impressed with the pleasant surroundings of the terminal and its air conditioned comfort Check in procedures were swiftly handled and passengers then move on to clear security and immigration which are straight forward save for the fact that one has to deal with the nuisance of removing his shoes at security Following security one takes an elevator up to the departure level where there a number of shops very expensive shops and food outlets All of these were clean and presentable Restroom facilities were wellmaintained and clean Boarding was accomplished via an air bridge directly into the plane Surprisingly Victoria Falls International Airport is very straight forward and easy to negotiate Staff are friendly and helpful I feel that anyone traveling through Victoria Falls airport will have no difficulties or issues

A very friendly team of staff overall at Memphis Airport Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

A nice airport except for the parking charges Its highway robbery I was charged for days of parking in the Short Term Parking lot Evidently the word Short Term Parking means a short walk to terminal and not the length of time you plan to leave your vehicle there I would encourage everyone not to park your vehicles at the airport for any length of time Otherwise you will be robbed by the airport I know I will never do it again Shame one you FWA

Flew this airline from Nadi to Honiara and have to give credit it is pretty good The legroom is abundant the crew are efficient with the service Although the airline could benefit from seats with power outlets wifi and IFE Other than that I cannot really fault the airline Gets you across from point a to point b the flight was on time as well

This is a nice little airport as previously stated and one minor comment which persons using it for the first time should appreciate is that there is no ATM or machine for buying tickets for the connecting buses into Stockholm although the information desk is helpful and do accept most credit cards They will try to assist in anyway possible So be prepared

A great airport only one hour from New York City that is still a secret A major stop for SouthWest it is a welcome relief from the congestion at La Guardia or worse JFK Nice new buildings with convenient parking for locals or access to a train station with links to all of long island and NYC

From Gothenburg Sweden to Stockholm Sweden and back the same day A min flight Id developed a fear of flying from avoiding flying for years Before boarding I talked to the staff about this and they were very nice Very nice and considerate Perfect takeoffs and landings My advice for those in a similar situation would be tell the staff Dont rush be in plenty of time and tell the staff I had a very pleasant flight they served coffee tea or water with a small brownie Hot miniature towels afterwards Very attentive and polite Highly recommended

On arrival the airport was very clean There was water fountains and music It was very peaceful When we departed checkin was so easy and security was simple There were lots of shops and dutyfree Overall One of the best airports in the world

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

I was pleasantly surprised by my flight with Sri Lankan airlines from Delhi to Sydney via Colombo All the flights were within minutes of on time and the staff I dealt with were very helpful and courteous The lounges in Delhi and Columbo were very good with a range of food and comfortable seating The lounge staff in Colombo were particularly friendly Boarding was done in an orderly fashion with business class and elites boarding first On arrival at Colombo a remote stand was used and business class was taken in a separate bus from economy passengers There is no additional security at Colombo so you walk into the terminal and transfers can be very quick The seat on the A was a recliner seat which was surprisingly confortable with a pillow and blanket and I fell asleep for an hour or so of the hour flight The staff on this flight were exceptional quickly dealing with refilling glasses and removing completed food courses The food was excellent and the servings were quite large The A seats are fairly standard business class with a small cubby hole for your feet They are not that new but they are confortable enough There is no mattress topper or pyjamas provided but the pillow is quite comfortable and the blanket is very warm Usual amenities are provided toothpaste and brush eye mask socks moisturisers and lip balm In flight entertainment has a large range of TV and movies to watch Obviously many South Asian content but also lots of Western content The hard product does need an update but it still works quite well Staff vary flight to flight but from this flight I would highly recommend them I have also travelled from Melbourne to Delhi with Sri Lankan and the service was just as good on that occassion

Definitely deserves Nice staff and beautiful sight I loved how they just fit I didnt like that there are two gates and you have to wait a while for the second one too Usually there is only one The bathrooms were clean and had great terminal seating

Great medium sized airport Travel fairly frequent from Hannover mainly from Terminal B to the UK The three terminals are very similar Good city centre connection with SBahn Fast checkin to gate usually same for arrival to out of door

This airport has undergone a transition from ugly duckling to something of a beautiful swan Spacious beautifully furnished comfortable are just some of the words that come to mind There is plenty of signage and even passengers on discount airlines are treated as if they are appreciated Although it doesnt have a butterfly garden I would compare this in ambiance to Singapore Changi on a much smaller scale of course Burmese charm is everywhere The CIP lounges are spacious well stocked well staffed and offer a good selection of local and international snacks I wish every airport in Asia was more like this one

No traffic problems getting there The long term car park is but mtrs from the main entrance The check in is mtrs from the gate The security checks are a breeze especially when those passengers approaching the scanners have remembered to remove the required articlestheir scanners are the most sensitive of any I have ever encountered There is a very nice restaurant area cum bar The area is generally clean and well kept The security staff should appear more friendly accepting that they have a very important job to do

This airport is consistently name among the best small airports in the USA Shops and eateries that were shuttered because of Covid have now reopened The airport is in the process of adding more amenities and concessions The newly renovated bathrooms are amazing Theyre brightly lit and significant improvement over the preexisting bathrooms Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes The distances from the security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly

Considering the standard for Brazilian Airports the Capitals is very modern Good options for shopping and eating and even some cinema theaters As it is one of the hubs of the country the traffic in intense most of the time There is a lack of good transportation options for the city There is no subway station the buses are rare and uncomfortable and the taxis are quite expensive

Flew Monarch from Alicante to Gatwick on the ZB on the th May on board A GZBAK Seated in row seats were very comfortable and leg room generous Cabin crew really helpful and also very cheerful Flight left on time and also arrived promptly despite a missed approach initially into LGW Overall a great flight experience and far more superior product to some of the other UK based low cost and charter airlines My only criticism and something I was not happy with was that Monarch do not appear to apply a crew rule in the cockpit at all times

It is clean quick and efficient passport control Landed at was driving off at My return leg was the same desks open for the flights that were going to London around the same time with CTA Very cheap cigarettes and alcohol airport staff are friendly and helpful The chap that said announcements were not made in English is wrong all flights are announced in Turkish and English You can hardly miss your flight as there are only gates A small airport with only around flights coming and going in one week but very efficient

I had a wonderful flight experience with Eastern Airlines Aircraft was clean well maintained and most importantly comfortable and on time The staff was well trained and very friendly professional We need an alternative passenger airline I think everyone agrees with that Lets think of Eastern Airlines for our travel needs when they begin destination and set route service

Our flight from Auckland was late leaving due to bad weather We arrived at the REX counter in Melbourne flustered and tired The check in for baggage had just closed but Thomas came to our rescue He checked if our baggage could still be checked in escorted us through security down to the REX gate arriving with minutes to spare before the flight was called With out Thomas we would never have made it he went over and beyond to ensure we were able to make the flight Thomas is a credit to himself and REX The cabin crew had no idea we were weary travellers We were greeted warmly and genuinely thankful to have made the flight for home To the REX staff thank you This is why we always fly REX

This airport is small so whilst access is good facilities are very limited Airside there are only vending machine so if you want anything to eat or drink best use the bar Landside Do not carry tins eg Duck Confit Pate etc that are greater than g in hand luggage they will be confiscated at security

I really like this airport it is small and not complicated It is really clean and they have a small but nice section for kids to play Just wish there were more restaurant for the US side There are usually no delays The airport is a bit far from downtown so a bit expensive in taxi but hey they have Uber and lot of parking space

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime

Des Moines KDSM is an all round great airport It is a very easy airport to navigate in and it doesnt take long to get through security at all It always seems to be clean and free wifi is always a plus While there seems to be a lack of shopping and food choices there are a few that all seem to be good places of business Terminal seating is in the process of being expanded as it doesnt hold the demand all of the time Its a great airport to depart and arrive to It isnt very big but will get you where you need to go

Excellent services as usual by Singapore Airlines from Darwin to Singapore on March even though I was fasting and unable to eat my foods they didnt forget to give me a box of dry foods and drinks to break my fasting Thanks a lot to the cabin crews Flight from Singapore to BKK SQ on March was great too Always excellent service

Quick flight with good service and friendly staff Checkin was efficient Aircraft was clean and welcoming Only negative was the arrival at a station where bussing brought us back to the terminal rather than an airbridge

I read lots of bad reviews about this company and was quite nervous to fly with them To my surprise and relief both flights went really well The checkin was quick and problem free everything very efficient Staff very helpful and friendly Both flights left on time Would highly recommend it as a budget airline

Koh Samui is a real unique airport almost everything is openair As they dont have any air bridges all passengers will be carried by little unique trolleys from and to the planes They do have a roof on most parts of the airport but no walls a very airy experience and a fine contrast to the usual

Very good Clean minimalistic and very nice Its quite a small airport so its impossible to get lost very well constructed and new The only drawback is the duty free very little choice and what there is is expensive
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided

SINNARSapporoNARSIN trips for last two years Sapporo NewChitose impressed me Comfortable massage chairs located around airport dining options fair but still better than others small and somewhat ageing but still cosy Checkin fast for domestic Glad to go there again

Late flight out on New Years day I love this small airport its quick to get though and friendly A surprisingly well stocked duty free shop with a good choice A small cafe before boarding I imagine its how airports were years ago and is a pleasure to travel through

Multistop from Munich via Kiev to Istanbul Then back to Munich after some days of holiday in Kiev Perfect flight times all flights landing ahead schedule Great service on the ground and on board Relaxing lounges UIA highly recommended

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

We travelled through Monastir Airport and found it to be pretty good for a small airport The queues coming in were fairly smooth and on the way out of the country everything went smoothly as well Facilities are perhaps a little limited but its only a small airport comparatively and at least it was clean

No real problem with the airport As with most chinese airports its rather recent with pretty efficient baggage claim Its also relatively close to the city ab km which means there are cheap and crowded regular buses and taxi will cost you maybe yuan But what I really love is the waiting area outside

Yangon to Mandalay Lounge photo and In flight meal photo are added We can access Lounge at Yangon International Airport for all Business Class traveler variety of Breakfast Lounge is located at the rd floor of Yangon International Airport Terminal for domestic In flight meal is great but simple because it is just a hour short flight

Thessaloniki to Athens Very nice and comfortable journey Flight was almost full Used the website to checkin and a mobile phone boarding pass was sent making it really easy Crew was friendly and helpful Candy small snack and drink offered in this domestic Greek flight Luggage was included in the price and although I did not have any it made the cabin have much more space for peoples handluggage Timely and orderly departure and arrival Very good experience I recommend them on this route

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the flight departed on time The staff were friendly and efficient The seat was comfortable too Only tea coffee and water is available free of charge which is no big deal given its such a short flight

Copenhagen to Vagar in the Faroe Islands with Atlantic Airways RC A aircraft Friendly checkin received baggage tag and headed to the gate Flight boarded in an organized fashion and flight attendants greeted each passenger as you entered the cabin Nice colors and comfortable seats Lots of legroom actually was very surprised Ontime take off and hours to the Faroe islands soda water and coffee serviced complimentary but purchased wine and food was reasonably priced Inflight entertainment was just the flightmap but had my DVDs to watch Landed a few minutes late in crazy wind and rain but the landing was good Parked farthest possible on the tarmac from the entrance to the terminal so we all got wet but that is how it is there Bags off in a reasonable amount of time Oveall a very good flight and for the price a good deal

I recently flew in Singapore airlines Everything about the airline is premium Check in experience the gate allotted to them time performance crew Flying in A was itself unique experience Seating comfort could have been better though otherwise its a out of

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

Gatwick to St Petersburg I was slightly apprehensive about travelling with Rossiya Airlines but need not have been This was full flight from Gatwick to St Petersburg on an A The plane had seen better days but was clean When I checked in I asked for an aisle seat and was denied one Boarding was very quick and I soon found myself in a rather uncomfortable seat for the just over min flight The cabin crew were very nice people and efficient The service included a complimentary sandwich and drink which was appreciated I plan to visit Russia again in August and will gladly use this airline The friendly staff won me over Disembarkation was via a bus transfer to the main terminal

I was a little nervous to fly after reading some of these reviews but my ticket was already purchased so I went for it Best flying experience Ive ever experienced Both the Pendleton airport and Portland airport were easy to find and they both werent in the major airports so didnt have to deal with TSA or people Check in was simple and from check in to boarding was quick Take off and landing for both flights were great best Ive experienced and little to no turbulence Im wondering if the negative reviews were for flights taken during the months with crazy weather which would make sense as to why it would be scary so Ill probably stick to boutique air during the months with good weather My flight home got delayed a couple hours but it honestly wasnt a big deal and they called and texted hours prior to inform me Overall best experience and Ill definitely be utilizing boutique air more Definitely recommend

What a wonderful feeling entering the Bermuda airport Friendly thoughtful staff and the wonderful band playing Bermuda is Another World were quite the contrast to American and Canadian airport experiences My wife and I just returned from a wonderful stay in Bermuda if possible tell the band that their beautiful music is still in our heads a week later
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties

A long but pleasant flight Cabin crew were kind and friendly gave me snacks when I walked to back of the plane to stretch my legs Food was good The only hiccup was the website has glitches on some of the pages for online checkin when accessed from mobile phone I had to use iPad to find a workaround in the end hour call centre hotline based in Brunei was very useful and answered the call with no queue You dont get that efficiency from many carriers these days

I never thought I would find myself reviewing a TSA department but I felt compelled to after my recent positive experience My family and I were unexpectedly transiting through Newark on June We had several mishaps happen beyond our control after an extended travel day hours The TSA department at Newark airport in particular a man named Fontaine helped greatly alleviate our stress and help expedite us through the security line and airport correcting the mistakes of our airline workers I cannot begin to tell you how appreciative I am for their help empathy and services

I had to fly from Alicante with a fractured leg The staff and facilities were absolutely amazing Please can you teach Edinburgh Airport how to facilitate and treat disabled passengers Thank you so much Alicante

This was the busiest I had ever seen Sydney Airport but things ran smoothly the staff were very efficient getting everyone through security and was very impressed to how friendly the security staff were that is really appreciated I was also impressed when my flight with Air New Zealand was ready to board they called the Business class passengers first and policed it by checking everyones boarding pass which is good as one pays a lot more money for Business Class so should have the privilege When departing Auckland it wasnt policed hence so many more people were in the line An impressive airport overall

One of the smaller airports by Chinese standards but a very positive experience for the passenger Good signage short distances to walk from plane to baggage carousel and a mere minute wait for luggage to be on the belt Good public transport to greater Qingdao region including resorts area by the sea Beware of taxi touts go to the official taxi line where you get a taxi from a dispatcher who registers the ride and also hands out a complaint info card just in case When departing from Qingadao dont come to the airport too early Checkin also for international flights is min before scheduled takeoff and there is not much to do in this airport Just some shops and two socalled coffee shops with a limited choice of snacks Found out too late about a VIPlounge which is hidden in a corner to the far right of the international departure lounge Access charge is yuan but had no time to use it Friendly airport staff quick security check plenty seating at gates one restaurant one coffee shop and one airline lounge airside duty free and souvenirs Facilities clean and well maintained All in all a very positive impression

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

I flew in on Lufthansas twice weekly flight via Samara no February st They are the only international carrier Apart from immigration refusing to acknowledge the computer generated form from the Russian Federations London Embassy which meant I had to fill one in by hand everything was fine I was in and out of the airport inside halfanhour

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

I take Horizon often between Seattle and Portland after arriving from the UK and always find staff very helpful My last connection was late from LHR due to weather and holding separate tickets was a worry however Horizon staff did all they could to rush me through and I made the original connection Ground staff friendly and nice crew Flight down was operated by a CRJ its a quieter cabin and seems faster not sure it is though but the cabin feels smaller and return flight by Q was much more comfortable Cabin crew nice and you still get a free drinks service on a min shuttle great touch

Quiet new airport opened in Check in was efficient Distance to Alona Beach only a few minutes Therefore very comfortable for people staying at the beach There are only few food stalls available Overall a fast and efficient airport

Recent Improvements have made this small airport quite reasonable There are a few dining and shopping options and the area is fairly large and pleasant They still play terrible elevator music Free internet is a bonus The airport is conveniently located to the city but there is no public transportation available Parking is day bit it is often difficult to find a spot
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems

I flew in one of Sky Expresss ATR aircraft from Kythira to Athens The ground staff at Kythira airport and flight attendants were very friendly and professional The aircraft was old but clean and comfortable enough Boarding was completed on time and the door closed That the takeoff was delayed by an hour was not the airlines fault A clearly annoyed pilot explained that there was some sort of lightning air traffic control strike at least that is what the other passengers told me because the explanation given by the clearly annoyed pilot was given only in Greek Otherwise the flight was perfectly enjoyable and I have no complaints about the airline Inflight service on the minute flight consisted of a predeparture sweet a bottle of water and a small biscuit

Corruption and extortion are alive and well at this airport Both myself and four colleagues in the following days were asked for our passports and then dollars to return them from officials at this airport It has been a while since this last happened to me in any country at any airport but this place stands out Who would want to visit this place for business or vacation Never again

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers

It was an easy online check in Due to other company flight delays I was short on time to drop my bag in When I arrived it was too late for me to print my bag tag Ricky at LAX directed me to an operator who printed my tag and checked my bag in Flight was also great Service when needed but nice and quiet during the night to sleep I recommend Delta Air Lines

This is a nice and modern airport at the moment they are expanding the airport so there is a lot of building going on but in the departure area you will not notice this very much The Airport has got free Wifi and a small restaurant with shop on the land side Airside you will find a small shop with prepacked sandwiches and hot dogs and other small stuff a small duty free shop is also around but not very cheap There is no Lounge to be found at the moment but after the expansion is completed there will be one available around May Checkin procedures are fast and the waiting area after checkin is fine with a view on the tarmac All in all a nice modern but small airport with expensive restaurants and shop

I upgraded from Economy to Economy Sleeper on this hour flight This gives you a row of three standard economy seats to yourself in a separate and quieter segment of the cabin between economy and business You also get a mattress pillow and duvet the idea being that you can sleep across the three seats This does not really work because If you try to lie flat your feet stick out into the aisle If you prop yourself up sitting with your back to the window the inner arm rest sticks into your back The mattress which is meant to be attached via straps to the seats slides off easily when you move If there is turbulence and you have to fasten your seat belt it is not possible to do this while lying horizontally across the seats Standard economy seats lack the depth needed lie down comfortably across them You cannot watch a programme on the entertainment system in a horizontal position I tried for a while to find a comfortable position but gave up in the end and just sat in my reclined seat Its a nice idea and was worth a try but it does not deliver It was quite a costly upgrade too and the airline would be better served converting that midsection into proper premium economy with more comfortable and spacious seats Of the rows on each side of the cabin only two were occupied which perhaps reflects the point I am making about value for money The service throughout was excellent and my review and ratings refer specifically to the Economy Sleeper offer

Living in South Florida and used to departing from and connecting through massive airports GRR was a breeze Now the new parkingbuilding is fully functional and beautiful it is all in a natural colour of brown The checkin area itself is nothing to admire and very basic Than you walkup to a shortramp and there you are Steps away from all the terminals This area does have a small foodcourts with the basic pizzaburger fare It also has floortoceiling windows bringing in plenty of natural light GRR had a major problem its airfare were outrageously expensive even the discounted ones However after lowcost Allegiant started servicing Grand Rapids tickets prices dropped dramatically even last minute ones This can only bring more business to West Michigan

Piarco to Grenada A nofrills airline though efficient Staff at check in at arrivaldeparture were polite very helpful and efficient I experienced difficulty in accessing and using the online check in service though this proved to be no obstacle at the check in desk The aircraft while obviously wellused and aging somewhat allowed reasonable legroom Im and was comfortable enough to doze through the flight

Terminal is the area I am reviewing this trip We used the short stay car park as you can walk undercover into the terminal Very easy although not the cheapest option Finding the Aer Lingus checkin was simple and as we stood in line the single checkin operator asked for passengers for Belfast to come forward first which was great The airline uses T for short hops to Belfast and Dublin the main activity for long haul is in T Security was very quiet and efficient for those of us who understand and stick to the rules One family was annoyed at having to surrender much of their liquids and cosmetics because they did not know the rules My partners bag was sidetracked for search Apparently her paperback novel attracted their attention Mine thankfully did not so go figure Once through we ran the gauntlet of the Duty Free maze and found our way to the Aspire Lounge included with the economyflex ticket Boarding was simple with the ATR aircraft having only seats Returning the aircraft was parked very remotely for some reason and we were bussed to the terminal at times I thought we were on an executive allareas tour By the time we got there the bags were on the belt and we were away

I love Air North and use them whenever its convenient between Kelowna and Vancouver Very reasonable fares which includes two checked bags and advance seat selection for Always on time friendly staff and I love the vintage s Its like what flying was like decades ago much nicer and more relaxed

Hong Kong to Kolkata An excellent flight where I was doted on by two very amiable and helpful cabin crew members It helped that I was one of just two passengers in the business class section which had seats in two rows of x A menu card was provided and my selection was tasty and filling A good complement of drinks and spirits was on offer However they have not changed their dessert a small cup of Haagen Daz ice cream in at least years It is always served solid frozen I passed on it and had some port wine instead The flight departed on time from a satellite terminal which was reached by a short bus ride from the main terminal Arrival was on schedule Indian government landing cards required of foreigners were provided on board The seats are traditional business class recliners and were reasonably comfortable Boarding was smooth intermixed with main cabin travelers through a jet way Ipads with a small selection of films and shows were provided soon after take off It was difficult to slot them into the metal clasps on the back of the seat in front of you you needed to hold on to the ipad to watch your program Magazines and newspapers on offer Lots of storage space overhead Leg space could be a tad extra once you recline fully your toes juts on the bottom of the front seat Announcements were made in clear English and for a very thoughtful touch also in Bengali the language of the destination city Cathay Dragon had a duty free catalog and three of my four selections were available for purchase This is one aspect of travel I very much enjoy as it lets me pick up last minute gifts

I enjoyed my flight Check in was easy and the plane left on time Staff were very pleasant and helpful Food was a small snack and soft drink which is fine on so short a flight Overall a very pleasant flight

Great employees service schedules but I have stopped flying with Horizon because they are now using Turbo Prop planes Q Its slower has more noise and vibration and most of all they cannot fly at altitudes where the ride is smooth This is compared to the full size jets that Southwest flies on the same routes as Horizon I used to have the credit card had Frequent flyer status and earned oodles of miles Those days are gone

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

This is a small airport Single terminal concept Security was quick and since my flight was to Sao Paulo it is internal and there is no passport check All the gates are in a single long corridor Distances to walk are short The shops and cafes directly face the gates so you can drink a coffee and see when your gate is boarding The free WIFI was excellent Good stress free experience airport
