Just wish to say that the check in and wheelchair assistance at Malpensa was really excellent and one of the best that I have experienced as a recent wheelchair traveller Staff were very helpful and efficient The only issue that I would raise is the state of the toilets

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable
Flight RGNTVYMGZ on an old ATR Plane very worn from the inside and outside Cabin crew very friendly and efficient Small snacks and drinks offered on each sector Recommended

This is a small but tidy and well run airport that I suspect will increase in demand in near future Everything is laid out well there are modest food and drink facilities clean toilets and small offices for several car hire firms Hertz Europcar Sol etc An excellent starting point for exploring northern Spain Currently Ryanair flies there twice a day from Stansted and I believe Liverpool Good overall

Positive departure experience at Seville airport on Oct for a domestic flight After reading previous reviews I was wary of flying out of this airport but our experience was perfectly good Before the security checkpoint we found a pleasant caf for lunch Going through security was quick and easy Restrooms were clean and a cleaning person was busy at work keeping them so A push button rating system for the condition of the restroom was outside the door so perhaps Aena has received the message from prior reviews and is trying to do better No complaints at all about this airport

Went to Dubai for business with my wife and got a flight to Al Maktoum International DWC Brand new airport parts of it still in construction Much easier than DXB to go through has less shops though Not much variety for eating but enough for duty free Airport staff much more attentive that at DXB this to be expected though considering the traffic volume is much less than DXB Only downside is that it is far away from downtown Dubai if got business there I would give a high score as it is a brand new airport and facilities are improving all the time A pleasant experience overall

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

Departure experience was relatively smooth an early morning flight on Ryanair so airport was very quiet Security was well managed clear markings on the floor to encourage social distancing However there was no coffee shop open so nowhere to buy a drink or a bite to eat Arriving back was very quick there were a number of staff members on hand to organise passengers no queue at passport control and bags were out within minutes however this was to be expected due to a very quiet flight and an empty airport Overall whilst the airport appeared clean we did not see any staff members cleaning while we were there with no hand sanitising stations available to passengers

Its a LCC and as such they do a great job Check in was smooth Without major hassles The flight departed on time only to be held up by the tower for half an hour due to traffic The seat was comfortable They did something strange for a LCC They fed all of us a free meal It wasnt the best meal But it was a hot chicken Meal And also due to some social media content They gave everyone on board a free gift of a tshirt Im sure that was a once off But all in all great flight experience Note no wifi and no screens But thats minor now days Because we all have Content

I had an early morning flight from Terminal to CKG Arrived early due to the scheduled shuttle from my hotel The security arrangements here are very tight but not overbearing CheckIn was simple enough while I virtually had to empty my carry on of all electronic items for separate scanning Once through I headed to the Hainan Airlines lounge but it only opened at am so I waited for minutes Then I had a wait until am until breakfast was served but it was plentiful and delicious My aircraft was at a distant stand so I had to board a bus but the boarding process was smooth and simple

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step

The airport is functional and adequate for a shortish stay But it is unbelievably expensive There is a simple measure for this Terminal Heathrow The Perfectionists Cafe Heston Blumenthal proud holder of a few Michelin stars food delivered by friendly waiter etc Burger San Jose airport Smashburger fast food burger in plastic tray And sadly that sums up too many experiences in Costa Rica I spend a lot of time here and the feeling that everything is horribly overpriced just grows and grows The airport is a good example of that feeling they are abusing their visitors

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

Flew Monarch from Alicante to Gatwick on the ZB on the th May on board A GZBAK Seated in row seats were very comfortable and leg room generous Cabin crew really helpful and also very cheerful Flight left on time and also arrived promptly despite a missed approach initially into LGW Overall a great flight experience and far more superior product to some of the other UK based low cost and charter airlines My only criticism and something I was not happy with was that Monarch do not appear to apply a crew rule in the cockpit at all times

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

As living in the north of The Netherlands Bremen airport is a good alternative for Amsterdam Recently flown from the new low cost Ryanair terminal Its basic clean and blue There is a multipurpose shop which sells everything from a to z at somewhat inflated prices and small coffee shop Seating is mostly in plastic chairs which you could find at your local dentist Reasonable but we had an early flight so it was not so crowded Would not like to be there when its get full There are also some paid internet terminals The airport is well situated from the city center and freeway from the parking garage you are within minutes in the main terminal building Bremen is still a great small airport but they need to get some other low cost airlines on board besides Ryanair

Flying Izmir to Ercan The International section is Very clean and modern Quick and efficient passenger service from checkin through passport control and all the way to boarding Its always a pleasure to use Izmir Adnan Menderes airport for arrivals and departures internationally The duty free shops are spacious and have many shopping options The toilets are clean and stocked I have no complaints always hasslefree flying out and through Izmir The WiFi is also a bonus very fast and user friendly to access

Cochabamba is a very small international airport some flights of Boliviano de Aviacion arrive from Buenos Aires Sao Paulo and seaonsally to Madrid It has enough space for the flights and people who use this terminal One of the most interesting things about this airport is its food court has plenty of choices and types of food and best of all if you are traveling on low budget there is a public transport service that will take you straight to town for almost nothing cents If traveling for tourism or business there is no other choice to get to the center of Bolivia Wifi runs great and its totally free

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available

Brisbane to Toowoomba and I was amazed at the service provided by this small regional airline Skytrans Airlines Even though the flight in a small propjet was only minutes duration we were given bottles of water and packets of potato crisps Returning the next day service was equally as good Would recommend this airline

A great small airport Staff pleasant even down to the security staff which makes a pleasant change from the usual boredrude staff in most airports Free internet in departures and from landing to leaving teh front door only mins A bus to the city would be good

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

Came to Dushanbe airport at around am for my very early flight to Istanbul The new terminal is small but functional and easy to go through Not plenty to do but the airside cafe is quite nice with good selection and the free wifi was actually quite fast Duty free shop has the typical selection you see everywhere and some local products Plenty of places to sit down unless more than or flights going at the same time its not a very busy airport

Great airport small and friendly Not too bothered about duty free shops its an airport for quick in and out like most should be flights seem to be moving to Alicante but lets support this little airport and its staff Car hire very easy
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

My flight had been delayed so I arrived later at the airport however checkin had closed as checkin times had not been amended The security team were really helpful in scanning my bike box and ensuring it got to the gate to be loaded on the plane The team were very friendly and supportive with a great result Thanks
A very nice small airport with all that is needed except a coffee shop if I remember correctly Access is easy and clear the terminal clean and there is free parking

Unexpectedly Good I wasnt really sure what to expect and feared a tricky experience but in fact Fiji Airways were excellent I paid for extra legroom on the first leg but even on the long routing from Nadi to Vancouver the standard economy seat had excellent legroom Ive been more cramped in Qatar economy than this especially their recent seat config So this was a real bonus Crew were good and friendly I guess the weaker points are the food which is pretty basic and entertainment Both flights were ahead of schedule Id definitely fly with them again

I have never experienced such patience ever since I started travelling I became late because as we got to the airport my year old son fell and injured himself and had to take care of him The two ladies working at the boarding gate that afternoon called me twice to check up and make sure we got onto that flight and waited until the last minute before they closed check in I was in awe of their patience and care for me as a passenger this has never happened to me before especially to go to the extent of calling me Genuinely grateful and can never thank them enough We need more of this kind of understanding with airlines Best flying experience ever

This airport is improving In recent days they had added more space and departure gates also arrival area and baggage belt Security checks is most of the time relatively smooth not so long queue clean toilets Need to improve food options and also lounge experience

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

BMAMMX one way The flight was comfortable with professional and friendly staff The free food and drinks served onboard were top quality The central location of Stockholm Bromma was very advantageous for our city break but checkin and boarding was a hassle Checkin closes minutes before departure which means that half the passengers were cramming at the check in desks in the last minute Free seating onboard the plane resulted in more cramming after the security because everyone wants a good seat It was a real circus In my opinion min checkin deadline instead of min and allocated seats instead of free seats would have been optimal

I had flights with this airline and found them to be very reliable st Maarten to Statia and St Maarten to Saba and back planes are very small but perfect for these minutes hop ground crew were friendly and even tagged my bags to Antigua on a codeshare with LIAT I was surprised they all arrived without major problems they are quick and professional sometimes slow sometimes not The prices are very high though The only worriesome moment I had with them was when one of the pilots shouted agressivily at the other just before engine started

First time from and to the new A terminal Didnt believe it but everything worked excellently No queues at checkin security passport control customs Bus gate had enough lift capacity so went down without wait On arrival baggage was on the belt in minutes and then in minutes off the airport Again no wait at immigration Food choices are fine both airside and landside Take into account this is just minutes some km from downtown Good choice and far superior to overcrowded Borispol with long queues dingy terminals and km from the city centre

TallinnAmsterdam is a short flight but crew were nice helpful and were able to understand at least languages they helped my Dutch Grandmother who speaks no English Amenities not normally provided but because flight was near empty they gave out snacks plus complementary tea and coffee They also allowed us to sit in vacant seats which was nice In general a nice trip and much more than was expected for basically a regional airline

Port Elizabeth airport is small and friendly Best thing about it is that it is so close to the main seafront area you can be on the beach about minutes after leaving the airport if you want Slight disadvantage once you are on the beach is that planes go right over your head Also very close to CBD and the pleasant suburb of Walmer PE known as the Friendly City and the airport gives it a good introduction

Small airport well organized and easy to get around The staff are not even remotely nice and not very fast at handling all the procedures The terminal is nice clean but lacking heavily on options to eat specially after going through security Not enough places to sit and waiting areas are small

Airport was new and very nice Immigration friendly and welcoming Nice first impression on Egypt upon arrival Washroom need to be cleaned regularly though Other than that its a very nice airport for travellers to Alexandria

Unexpectedly Good I wasnt really sure what to expect and feared a tricky experience but in fact Fiji Airways were excellent I paid for extra legroom on the first leg but even on the long routing from Nadi to Vancouver the standard economy seat had excellent legroom Ive been more cramped in Qatar economy than this especially their recent seat config So this was a real bonus Crew were good and friendly I guess the weaker points are the food which is pretty basic and entertainment Both flights were ahead of schedule Id definitely fly with them again

The meals were very good and the portions generous The crew were efficient and were on time both ways Seating assignments seemed ambiguous but my family of four ended up with one window seat on return to Vancouver from Amsterdam which was a nice surprise None of my children had any complaint throughout the two long journeys and that would be the measure of a pleasant flight experience by my standards I would fly with Martinair again in future

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

BOSMKE I have flown to and from Mitchell countless times I grew up in Milwaukee and moved back here in June I agree with other reviewers that it is a clean friendly wellrun airport What stuck in my mind was how swiftly and well the baggage is handled I flew Southwest and sat fairly far forward in the cabin walked directly to the baggage claim area and by the time I arrived my baggage was already on the carousel This is something of a record in all of the flights I have experienced over the past few years at the other end is Copenhagen Kastrup in July where I waited close to minutes for the baggage to arrive with my own valise arriving some minutes later There is also a rapid bus to downtown with the stop now just outside the baggage claim area now that renovations of that area are completed There are also a couple of good Bartolotta restaurants on the concourses Piccolo Pizzeria and Nonna Bartolottas which I have enjoyed on previous departures All in all Mitchell is an excellent airport Now all they need is more nonstop flights

The airport is clean very functional and not too big to the point it becomes customer unfriendly As expected most products available to buy are well overpriced Passport control and security was a breeze

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job
Friendly of the staff a new huge mall had been opening Mall del Soll This is the modern and fully functional airport with the biggest mall of the country and four hotels between stars

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

Dusseldorf to Paris CDG return on Embraer E jets The plane was very clean x configuration as standard with extremely wide seats I am cm on pounds and the seats were wide and long enough for my legs There was enough leg space including space for luggage below the seat Some people had trouble finding space for their luggage overhead but that is a problem on regional jets Shortly after takeoff the first round of drinks was served water and coffee without charge On the next run through about minutes later we got pretzels and salted peanuts Overall I am impressed by HOP and would recommend it Great staff outstanding service and a very pleasurable seating experience make it the perfect option for short trips

I arrived in Lilongwe for a work training we were facilitating and spent one night in Lilongwe and proceeded to Blantyre the following Monday afternoon When I arrived at Crossroads hotel where would stay until the coming Saturday morning I realized I did not have my passport wallet with forex and most importantly my passport and an older one I immediately alerted the hotel and the driver said he would check By the time I got to my room there was a message from Victor the Airport Manager who tried calling on watsap so I immediately responded He assured me they had everything and the next morning I went to collect it Sure enough every last note was still there I waited for a security officer to confirm that nothing was missing and signed off The honesty kindness and sheer humanity displayed was so moving I am deeply grateful to Angel for her assistance and the Airport Manager You guys are really incredible
Excellent flight left on time and arrived on time Amritsar to Kullu Small aircraft which was about full Great price no complaints from me and would happily fly with them again

Good transport connection via BAB Moderate parkingrates close to the terminals CheckIn only minutes prior to departure Short distances More than daily flights major Star Alliance hubs MUC and FRA and direct flights to holiday destinations Daily lowcost flights to London STN Vienna Rome FMO is a good choice for travellers in northern NRW western Niedersachsen and eastern Holland who want to start their journeys business travel as welll as holiday travel relaxed and in a friendly atmosphere
TFNGMZ return on ATR Very good minute flights Served cup of water and chocolate bar Great views of a snow capped Mt Teide on left going and right returning

This is a nice little airport as previously stated and one minor comment which persons using it for the first time should appreciate is that there is no ATM or machine for buying tickets for the connecting buses into Stockholm although the information desk is helpful and do accept most credit cards They will try to assist in anyway possible So be prepared

I was surprised with the cleanliness and efficiency of the airport in Guayaquil Really modern and easy to navigate I liked the zen garden at the domestic arrivals which really was a nice touch Toilets were clean Passport control very organised and staff are polite also duty free staff were very helpful Nice WiFi and view of the runway watching planes goes by Happy using it

Basically a well designed terminal that requires upgrading Immigration and visa on arrival procedures are quick as foreign passport holders go to separate counters both for arrival and departure Luggage delivery is fast but then you will have to queue for at least minutes as every piece of luggage has to go through the only screening machine in the customs hall No taxi or airport shuttle is available and you will have to rely on touts or on military staff very friendly to help you find a vehicle to take you to town unless you have prearranged transport with your hotel Departure hall is not airconditionned and was infested by mosquitoes out of duty free shops were closed and the single airline lounge has been closed for a long time One positive point all areas including toilets are kept very clean

The airport is big upon my arrival I passed through the electronic gate and it did not take more than a minute to complete my entry procedures into the country and it was more than wonderful The treatment of the airport staff is wonderful we received our bags quickly and there was no delay Upon our departure the treatment was also professional friendly and fast from the staff and there was no delay in stamping passports security check or check in We tried two restaurants to eat at the airport and the food was very tasty travelling through Dubai Airport is a wonderful experience

Koh Samui is usually an excellent airport the tropical ambience laid back staff garden setting and impressive views of the planes make this a quirky experience The recent floods and mass cancellations have regrettably brought this airport to its knees however Under normal conditions I thoroughly recommend this establishment

On October th we flew from Vienna to Karpathos which turned out to be the last passenger flight with this Airline to this destination due to the sad development The crew worked flawless as ever and was extremely friendly despite the fact that they are not quite sure about their professional future Not a single mention came up about that but you could see and sense their feelings We are exceedingly angry about the fact that many thousand passengers loose their money and some thousand well working employess lose their job Many many thanks and good luck for the crew and all the other employees of ABNiki

The toilets are the cleanest I have seen Im years The customs was quick and efficient I travel every year to Curaao and was a pleasure to see that they are much better than Schiphol Las Americas American airports European airports

Pretty new terminal opened about a year and half ago Its an improvement on the old terminal Not many flights and of them from Ryanair Basic regional airport that does the job not huge lines to check in or pass security Dont go through security unless your flight its about to depart since in the air side there is only a little barcafeteria and two vending machines not too many seat if there are two flights at the same time In the land side good bar and resto Bad Bus connection to the city and expensive taxi service EUR to centre So overall small nice airport that allows you to show up h before your flight departs without risk of missing the plane

Flew this route again last weekend Menzies the handling agent at EDI very helpful bag drop and boarding a breeze Where SunExpress excel is with their cabin crew who were helpful friendly and professional Also very well groomed Bugra and Ismet were excellent and an asset to the company I wouldnt hesitate to travel with them again and recommend
Departed on october to Paris Orly abd back on October Airport very clean opened early in the morning Check In and Security Checks are easy early in the morning

A small airport with a modern purposebuilt terminal with direct raillink from the city With only one flight to serve on a Sunday afternoon service all round should have been and was excellent Plenty of seating although that in the bar was a bit utilitarian

All flights were on time and comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and welcoming On board snacks to buy were good value Seat pitch good average Last year we few with this company from Madrid to Malta and return Both flights very good

Hobart Airport is much more user friendly now though the terminals have not been connected so Jetstar passengers are still relegated to the old botched international venture built for the old Ansett The new catering in domestic is good but It is shameful that there is no WiFi intenet access anywhere It would cost a few hundred dollars at the most for the Tasmanian Government to give free WiFi access at Hobart Airport and so reinforce the image it is trying to give as a progressive State It is doubtful that a private company will ever do it and Tasmania would top all the other states in lateral thinking if it did it for free

Dulles Airport is located in Virginia and bit far from Washington DC Very large and wellmaintained airport very clean Few sitting places Immigration process takes long time Boarding bridge works as bus to the airport terminal Taxi and bus services are there

A small pleasant and friendly airport All the staff are really nice and now even the younger staff at security are very friendly which wasnt typical before the pandemic The procedures are very fast However during peak times there is absolutely not enough space around the caf and dutyfree shops in the Schengen section even after the recent terminal upgrade I really miss the newspaper stand in this area I would especially like to praise the staff at Little Slovenia in the NonSchengen section Its truly a small oasis of kindness and wellbeing

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

Manston is an excellent small airport The staff immigration customs and police are friendly but still professional Checkin was handled well Security was a little laborious but was thorough and in no way objectionable There is a small shop and a barcafeteria which considering the short amount of time needed to check in is all that is required A great option for those traveling to or from the south east corner of England I hope the route to Amsterdam is successful as it is so much more pleasant than flying from one of the big London airports Heathrow in particular I have heard that a rail link will be coming

AmsterdamCancun bought Comfort Class seats The cabin attendants were friendly food served was a little less good it wasnt bad just average The legroom in Comfort Class was good and other benefits are the complimentary alcoholic beverages and personal media player that you get So overall a satisfying flight

Often use these airport as it is my local Very small and very nice Celebrating its th year of commercial services this year Restaurant is conveniently placed close to checkins and staff are young and very helpful Everything is very smooth and thanks to its small nature very quick to get from checkin through security and to the gate No long lines However if a normal Ryanair on a flight is boarding for London usually the waiting area becomes extremely busy with no seats left forcing people to sit on ground and on windowsills Toilets are also not exactly very clean but still at standard Overall excellent airport

Dundee Airport is very small but has a modern terminal building Facilities are not suprisingly rather limited but the checkin is very quick and easy Free parking is available The only route is the Scot Airways service to London City Airport which operates several times daily The only negative aspect is the lack of public transport links but a taxi ride to the city centre takes only five minutes The main AberdeenGlasgow railway passes the airport the lack of a station is annoying Compared to the long queues and delays at larger airports the tiny Dundee Airport is a delight to use and a useful alternative to Edinburgh or Aberdeen airports The view of the city and the River Tay on takeofflanding is stunning

Just recently MacArthur Airport here in the middle of Long Island recieved a makeover The makeover included a big new concourse added terminals and new concessions Its beautiful It is a big relief to see the airport go from old and small to new and bigger The new concourse was built and is now primarily owned by Southwest Airlines The layout of the airport is very simple and easy to navigate As soon as you walk in the main entrance you can either make a right to get to the checkin counters or make a left to get to the carousels and pickup a friend that just arrived Security is fairly fast There are a number of concession stands as well as souvenir shops located before after the security checkpoint The following airlines service MacArthur Airport some of the airlines may use a codeshare partner for some flights Southwest Airlines Delta Connection Continental Express US Airways express Brand new concourse terminals concessions

Saint Marie to Antananarivo What an absolute pleasure flying with this new airline Madagasikara Airways Finally competition to Air Madagascar with prices half the price of the national airline reliable ontime departure convenient schedules and complimentary drink and snacks onboard with an extremely friendly cabin attendant who made announcements in languages Planes are serviced in South Africa Sad to see that despite all this the plane was only half full hopefully more will hear of it as it really deserves to succeed

GRX is a small regional airport Boarding and disembarking aircraft is usually very quick due to the limited aircraft movements Passenger facilities are limited waiting areas are small no lounges minimal eating outlets and taxis are hard to come by which is surprising for an airport However some of the nicest security screening staff that I have ever come across always smiling and patient with passengers UK and US staff can really learn something here

I arrived at T Terminal Hongqiao Used the Sky Priority Customer Service Lovely helpful staff who helped me with my oversized baggage I was stressed about it and the team helped me without a problem Then even showed me clearly were to go as well as showing me were Sky Priority Lounge was I couldnt be more grateful for their good service

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

This airport is probably one of the best I have been to Every employee I encountered was friendly and eager to help The airport itself was clean and efficient I flew in and out of this airport at busy times of the week and did not experience any problems When I landed I went through baggage claim quickly and was waiting for my friend in a matter of minutes When I was flying out I had the same experience I said goodbye to my friend and five minutes later I was at the gate What a pleasure compared to flying out of Orlando and there is free wifi

This is a good airline with more legroom than most for economy and I have taken it a few times already this year but I am considering switching to United from now on The inflight entertainment is sparse And even the little that they have is almost useless to nonKoreans because they do not have subtitles Somewhat related to above United now has Starlink giving me not only entertainment options from my laptop but the ability for me to be online I like the extra legroom of Air Premia but fast and free unlimited internet service is very compelling

New airport building with good facilities Minimal airport food facilities and retail outlets other than jewellery Good facilities for vehicles to pick up at ground level and drop off at first floor level Excellent toilet facilities and very clean throughout with good air conditioning Construction of second runway in progress together with airport buildings to cater for expected increase in tourism Downside was that there was no wifi facilities other than those offered by fast food franchises

This is a fairly good airport Nice and clean easy to get around This airport is also very small and therefore has less wait time thus you can probably get away with arriving only hour prior to departure and still make your flight On the other hand there is not very many options to eat or shop

I travel frequently both internationally and domestically and St Louis Airport provided one of the smoothest travel experiences I have had to date Staff were efficient and seemed to actually care about their jobs food and beverage options were plentiful and the terminal was easy to navigate The security process was also extremely efficient and wellstaffed The only negative thing I have to say about this airport is that the seating areas at the gates could have been cleaner as chairs had dirt and particles of who knows what all over and in between them However not all of the seating was like this and it didnt bother me as there were many cafes and bars to hang out in Overall one of the better airports I have been through and I have been through countless Great job STL

Mainly domestic airport serving the Brazilian side of Iguassu Falls Busy airport with a air bridges and some remote stands Shopping opportunities as you walk from the gate to Baggage Reclaim Baggage Reclaim is on the ground level and has main baggage carousels Domestic arrival so no Customs or Passport Checks Small and busy Arrivals area with parking directly opposite Small but efficient airport

Superb This is by far the best business class product within Europe The meal was one of the best Ive eaten Cabin crew delightful Wine servings enormous and just nothing to correct in the product It is a shame that no other European airline comes close to this standard

Cabin was clean Personal screen was big enough and a lot of entertainment programs were available Seat was very comfortable My personal area was spacious Tullys Coffee was offered with tasty chocolate Flight attendants provided quick and responsive service Everything was excellent

It was first time at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport it was is one of the nicest and biggest airports I have come through in the USA anywhere in the world This multi level airport has many boarding bridges There are many shops and restaurants The staff were friendly and welcoming The airport is welldecorated and wellmaintained and easy to get in or out Public areas are a huge clean and bright

Saskatoon airport is small and simple to get around The signs pointing to the right place are just perfect Renovations were being done at this time but it was still super easy to be there and get to my flight on time

Excellent airport I agree completely with the last two reviews I would say to Alastair Finch that he should not worry the airport seems to be holding its own Having flown from Doncaster recently I was expecting a far better level of service from the UKs newest airport but all I found were closed shops and poor customer service Access from the A and M is excellent meaning it can be reached within minutes from all of the nearby population centres Customer service is second to none and one can be off the plane and through to the car in minutes The only thing lacking is the range of direct destinations but it seems that is more to do with the economy than the competition Certainly the KLM service is a godsend and far better than travelling to Heathrow or Manchester for direct flights I would highly recommend people from the Humber region and Lincolnshire to give this place a try if they havent already Given the choice I would sooner travel from Humberside over Leeds Doncaster and East Midlands any day despite living closer to Doncaster
Not Verified Courteous and friendly staff Flight left early by about minutes when it was confirmed all planning to fly were on board Crew was great Seating was great

I have no complaints whatsoever about the new airport in Wichita Lobby is wide and bright with helpful staff at the information desk There is a wonderful exhibition on the aviation history of Wichita on the second floor Go to the airport early so that you can read all the displays Not a wide assortment of food choices but good enough Car rental area is well organized and staff is welltrained A most pleasant experience there The signage for getting to the city center and on the highways could be better but I think that is the responsibility of the city not the airport A very pleasant airport to use

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

First time from and to the new A terminal Didnt believe it but everything worked excellently No queues at checkin security passport control customs Bus gate had enough lift capacity so went down without wait On arrival baggage was on the belt in minutes and then in minutes off the airport Again no wait at immigration Food choices are fine both airside and landside Take into account this is just minutes some km from downtown Good choice and far superior to overcrowded Borispol with long queues dingy terminals and km from the city centre

Traveling through Murtala International airport in Lagos Nigeria is an experience Staff are generally friendly and smiled a lot My documents were repeatedly checked I counted ten checkpoints altogether At five of them I was asked if I would hand over some money They weirdest situation was that the customs officer asked how much money I carry and then after hearing the honest as he was a customs officer answer asked me if I would give him some of it The airport is quite run down and processes are not streamlined Boarding was rather chaotic with passengers placed on different coloured seats after the boarding passes were scanned

Delightful little airport with helpful staff unique concepts of design and little corners of comfort everywhere There are games for children Caf was like a living room and I enjoyed my experience in this sparkling clean airport

A very nice airy terminal that seems modern enough Free WIFI and free parking Everything within walking distance Most people travel domestic to Copenhagen but a rising number of international routes eg AALAMS makes for a lot of possibilities Checkin is very quick and so is Security All in all a nice experience
Hanoi to Hong Kong There are new business class seats on the plane very pleasant and comfortable The food is good the choice is standard Stewardesses good and pleasant service

A short but enjoyable flight Staff were friendly and helpful Check in was easy and the plane left on time A small snack was provided which is fine on so short a flight They also offered free beer and wine which was a nice surprise

This airport is well organized and easy to navigate its become one of my favorite airports in the world On this trip JFKSFOTPE I flew into and also left from Terminal One recently renovated attractive and spacious It also contains quite a few spaces for relaxation plus many restaurants and shops On arrival my bag arrived before I did On departure I checked in at the Interational Terminal which is connected to Terminal One Going through security at International was fast and easy The only negative was that several of the restaurants in Terminal One were closed in the evening

Much nicer than the concrete block that was YWG open and bright Staff were friendly checkin a breeze and clearing security has never been a problem for me Despite being an International Airport it is small even if you have to walk the furthest distance Gates you can be out of the Airport in minutes if not waiting for checked baggage International travel out of YWG is quite limited so the International secure side is small MAYBE gates with just a couple Restaurants including the required Tim Hortons kiosk Others have complained of the lack of moving sidewalk but dont let that concern you as I said the longest walk is less than minutes from gate to exit so a moving sidewalk would actually be pointless While shopping and Restaurants are an improvement over the old Airport they are still very limited when compared to most other International Airports YWG serves its purpose but it wont wow you

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

The improvements I mentioned in were completed on schedule and have given this airport a new and modern feel Unfortunately the upper level is no longer a viewing deck area However a new restaurant with a view of the airfield was installed on the ground floor Facilities are top class considering the size of the airport A brand new baggage retrieval area was added to the airport The layout of the airport works well Staff are still just as friendly

Port Macquarie Small airport that serves its purpose It only gets flights from Sydney The arrivals gate is a gate much like one would find around a pool to keep kids out and the departures lounge is comfortable and air conditioned a new addon as a result of changing security laws All the staff friendly and personable possibly because they dont get many people through in a a day Whilst the number of people in the terminal was comfortable around my flight times it wouldnt go astray for the owners to speed up on expanding the airport facilities as it was getting a bit on the crowded side as there is only one taxiway connecting the apron to the runway Theres also a nice viewing area for all members of the public outside near the arrivals gate where all planes can be seen arriving and departing

I fly through San Javier about times a year and generally it works fine My only complaint is the boarding process Because there are no seperate gate lounges people queue in the departure hall All pretty chaotic especially if one has paid for priority boarding as it means fighting through crowds to get to the front and in the process putting up with mindless comments from people who dont seem to understand the concept of priority boarding The ground staff do nothing to help

Living in South Florida and used to departing from and connecting through massive airports GRR was a breeze Now the new parkingbuilding is fully functional and beautiful it is all in a natural colour of brown The checkin area itself is nothing to admire and very basic Than you walkup to a shortramp and there you are Steps away from all the terminals This area does have a small foodcourts with the basic pizzaburger fare It also has floortoceiling windows bringing in plenty of natural light GRR had a major problem its airfare were outrageously expensive even the discounted ones However after lowcost Allegiant started servicing Grand Rapids tickets prices dropped dramatically even last minute ones This can only bring more business to West Michigan

Because I arrived by train I spent a long time at the airport before taking the plane I appreciated being able to wait while working on the platform on the first floor Its quiet holds along the wall On the other hand the layout is more than basic and it would deserve to landscape this place and make it more comfortable and with more outlets associated with the tables It is not at all pretty to see Everything is well signposted to access the boarding gates toilets checkin counters Real improvement to be made after security for catering and accessible power outlets Indeed the choice of food is more than summary at the only restaurant in place Only breadbased food and very rare more than mediocre salads Plots with sockets on the boarding floor are extremely rare and many people jostle to Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

I have flown in and out of this airport on several occasions although I dont live in Kentucky I mean it is a small airport serving a small city so dont go expecting any big city amenities other than just a couple of sitdown restaurants a Dunkin Donuts and a small store But it is surprisingly spacious extremely clean and very modern Signage is clear staff and security are friendly the terminals are small and manageable and there is even complex and beautiful artwork on the floor in security honoring the regions thoroughbred horse racing heritage Lastly where else can you park in the parking garage that is only around feet from the terminal The ease simplicity and friendliness of this airport makes it one of my favorite airports in the world and Ive been all over North America and Europe
Despite the poor reviews I kind of had to use Safi on the Dubai to Kabul route I was pleasantly surprised that we got reasonably new As with normal leg room and the planes were dead on time

Great service overall Timely departure after very organized boarding procedure Aircraft clean and well air conditioned for boarding Staff very friendly and professional Good meal service with table cloth tableware and drinks in glasses Good infos from cockpit Would surely fly Thai Smile again
Nice clean but crazy expensive food USD for a Cappuccino for a Bnh M Besides that its a nice airport with all facilities you can expect

CPHHurghadaCPH Flew this airline as part of a charter flightholiday in the Red Sea Both flights I enjoyed immensely Credit for this goes to the cabin crew and their ability to generate such a happy atmosphere in cabin The food quality served was by far the best I have put my teeth into for economy class in more than years of flying around the world On top of this the plane was literally an all new A I had paid a little extra for a few extra centimetres of leg space thumbs up arrival on time at both ends

Vintage airport that has been updated and serves lots of people on domestic flights The energy level is high and the view of the runways and operating area is excellent Fun place to arrive or depart with plenty to see and no end to the peoplewatching opportunities Pretty efficient as well

Kolkata to Colombo Average aircraft no IFE available Legroom is less but seat width is satisfactory Crew was quite active throughout the hour flight Announcements were clear and audible Restrooms were clean but only the rear restroom was allowed for the economy class passengers Boarding was smooth Food served was scanty but then it was a flight at am so no one was really hungry

Great little airport Everything in one location baggage belts next to car hire desks and you walk out into the car park and collect your car Will be my preferred choice now rather than coming in via LAX or SAN and facing a hour drive

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia

This is possibly one of the nicest airports Ive flown through Staff were amiable the terminals were clean and wellmaintained and everything was wellmarked Security was a breeze and the baggage claim system is both swift and efficient compared to other airports

At last Pakistan has an airport worthy of being a Capital City airport Very well designed with excellent drop off points Excellent flow of passengers although I do wonder if the queues would be very long at busy times as its a single double door entry All the checks and security are now excellent with polite and attentive staff and a great spaced out airport Toilets clean and well serviced Signs plentiful and useful Needs more commercial shops and food facilities but otherwise I loved it
Makassar to Singapore Crowded flight Long checkin queue and time The takeoff is smooth Great service a good meal The flight attendant is great

Only used this airport in transit tofrom FrankfurtQingdao so this is a comment on the transit facilities Speedy visa check and immigration service quick security check and throughout friendly English speaking staff Excellent signage to transit space which features plenty of seating souvenir and duty free shop coffee bar and small childrens play area In transit one is issued a transit card which has explicit instructions on how to proceed

Frankfurt to Sao Paulo with TAM Airlines Service was attentive friendly and acceptable for economy class Food is as good or less good as with other airlines Seat is standard and what you get for economy The IFE is rather slow and not as quickly responding as for example in the of LAN Overall a good and pricewise interesting way to travel to South America Luggage was damaged upon return at FRA but ground staff not interested in being friendly or understanding

ITO is absolutely lovely I flew in HNLITO and out ITOOGG Outdoor type airport and probably the most easytouse airport I have ever had the pleasure of using Very tropical theme Car rentals are right across the street from curbside pickup Checking in is very easy for those using Island Air There is a restaurant in the middle that gets very busy during breakfast so get there early if you dont want to stand in a line that goes out the door

Clark Airport is now our favorite way into or out of the Philippines We flew in on Asiana and weeks later departed on Emirates Both arrival and departure were smooth experiences Immigration luggage claim and customs were fast and efficient and we were meeting our family in just a few minutes Departing the security and checkin were fast and efficient and the staff were professional efficient and pleasant Queues were short and the gates were all just an escalator ride and a few steps away The gate area was spacious clean and comfortable Rest rooms were clean and in good condition Food offerings were quite adequate for a small airport and reasonably priced no lie WiFi worked fine Not a lot of shops but hey were flying not malling The only concern is that it was difficult to get an adequate cell phone signal at the gate area Some other passengers were having this problem as well though I did manage to make my call after a couple of tries The VIP lounge takes walkins for p pretty reasonable But the main advantage of this airport is location you dont have to fight Manila traffic like you do going to or from NAIA If your destination is anywhere north of downtown Manila this can easily save you the better part of a day Its not big or glamorous but who cares Its clean comfortable and very convenient Id definitely recommend this airport for any traveller and especially for families

Its big enough for the number of people it serves on a weekday although Id imagine it would get pretty crowded when the larger Virgin planes come in from Melbourne on weekends The staff are friendly the facilities adequate for a regional airport of this size the queues managable and its clean It just feels like its missing something Despite it being refurbished within the last decade or so it feels like it needs a bit of a touch upand the constant use of that sickly blue colour everywhere doesnt necessarily help the situation So yes it is a nice airport in regional NSW that serves its purpose and the needs of the people but I just get the feeling that with a bit of money put in new floorings lick of paint open up the departure lounge a bit more provide wifi it could be have a certain wow factor reserved for NSW regional airports like Newcastle Albury and Dubbo which have been thrust forward into the st Century

Reykjavik to Akureyri I have never been on a friendlier serviced aircraft than this Absolutely wonderful flight only minutes and quite a unique experience on a propeller plane Absolutely love the onboard travel journal where you can read other passengers adventures and write your own in very sweet Would love to fly with them again next time Im in Iceland

Airlink do so much right and so many other carriers in the region can learn from them Reliably on time on time across all their flights into Joburg for example great convenient connections through OR Tambo Johannesburg for regional Southern Africa departures onto domestic SA ones generous baggage allowance kg per passenger from Lusaka to SA ever smiling welcoming cabin crew and checkin staff on sectors without exception coupled with tasty cold meals on intl sectors and good South African wines and juices on all really help them to stand out alongside now even a loyalty rewards program Keep doing what you do Airlink we are so grateful and you will be rewarded with custom

Manageable and friendly this feels like an airport from the s Coming in and going out immigration facilities are fairly efficient Going out after immigration there are a few shops a barcafe and a sitting area The layout is semiopen and you can watch the planes land not that many do this is an airport with very few international flights daily You go through another security when heading to your gate where you can have your last beer before leaving the country Overall a good reflection of the country unpretentious clean friendly and relatively efficient

It has everything you need for a small convenient airport One of my carry on bags flew off the top of my Jeep on the way to the airport I found a nice selection of ones to replace it in the shop and the food in the restaurant was very good all the service there was great I had my service dog the security was educated on what documents was needed to prove he was a real service dog The added bonus was they have a small Pet rest area What a gem instead of fighting all the Skyharbor hubbub

Small airport arrival was smooth half hour queue at immigration but bags waiting for uson departure ten minutes from check in to be sat at the gate on comfortable seats and soft carpetairport is very clean and did not come across any rude staffin fact they were very polite

Went to OVD on a day trip from BCN in mid June to visit family in nearby Castrillon I seen the airport evolve for the last thirty years into a very nice compact and efficient operation Everything is laid out in a logical sequence You arrive into a small checkin area as there are still less than a half dozen or so carriers that use it go through a quick and orderly screening area and up to the gates There are various shops to include a regional Asturias gift shop stores transportation outlets and the such Public areas are clean and not crowded by any means There is the typical cafe with lots of room and reasonable pricing We found taxis right outside the terminal along with two bays for ALSA busses running to both Oviedo and Gijon Be advised that the trip to the provincial cities of Oviedo Gijon and Aviles all take about a half hour or so to get to All in all a very nice userfriendly airport

CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

My wife and I flew from Buenos Aires to Miami this January The airplanes appeared to be old with no entertainment flat panels no earphone outlets and no USB charging outlets The seats were old fashion leather wide and comfortable with spacious leg rooms and reclineable backward to almost degrees all of these made the flights very comfortable Meals served were rather good with frequent service of beverages of limited types free wine was included with meals Our experience was far better than most reviewers whose reviews we read

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

This airport is very nice clean and efficient The staff at the airport are also very kind and welcoming I remember I was a little late to my flight and only had around half an hour to the flight from the checkin area They really got me in and out very fast and I had around minutes to spare Very thankful for that

I want to thank to all the staff at this airport for helping me find my luggage which was lost because of Zrich airport The medicine of my mom were in that suitcase and all your team helped me a lot to locate and find it as soon as possible Very warm hearted people and extreme professionals They didnt skip any official procedure so that they kept the security conditions but did their best to help me Unfortunately I do not remember their names but I hope this message will find them and make them feel appreciated Thank you wish you all the best and God bless you

Overall quite satisfied with this flight The service of the flight attendants was very good very attentive and thoughtful which made me feel their attentiveness and warmth The cabin seats were a bit hard the entertainment system was partially out of order the movie selection was relatively small the route was long and there werent enough movies to watch I am quite satisfied with everything else and would recommend this airline to my friends

Hermosillo International Airport is the main airport in Sonora State Mexico First time there and found the airport to be quite functional wellorganised clean and efficient Arrival and departure were hasslefree personnel was courteous good wifi signal which is a rarity in most airports It seemed to me that the airport is undergoing renewal if so once completed it will be more pleasant to use it

Always a pleasure to fly with Swiss safety comes first with them then the comfort On my flight back to Switzerland from Bucharest I had such a nice experience thanks to Paul who attended the business class passengers I felt like I am flying first Class because of his service

A very easy airport to use Arriving on an evening Ryanair flight deplaning was quick passport control almost friendly and the airport bus was immediately outside to speed us to town for only Return was just as easy the security staff were friendly plenty of seating in both the main airport and the gate area No WIFI but one rarely gets everything
No boarding bridges But views are very nice Not much wait for luggage The ground service is good

Comfortable and clean provincial airport Didnt use any facilities other than the toilets which were clean and tidy Only real criticism is lack of seats at the gates I was on a full A flight to Brisbane and there were only seats for about passengers There is also no segregation of incoming and outgoing passengers the former have to weave their way through those people waiting to board Passengers seated in the rear half of the cabin were requested to go down stairs across the tarmac then up stairs to the rear door of the aircraft However by the time I reached the front of the queue the outside doors had been locked so I had to fight my way through the whole length of the aircraft cabin

Paris to Reunion Air Austral is a fairly good airline The seat layout of the Airbus A was xx The leg room was not too bad Inflight entertainment was good and worked well Cabin service was average but generally fine The flight was on time

As a resident of Chattanooga I have used this airport on several occasions With just gates it seems to be a bit undersized for a city of However speaking from an architectural perspective it has more character than most airports I have flown through and is very clean besides There is virtually no chance of getting lost owing to the small size and simple layout The security checkpoint is neither intimidating nor cumbersome but the agents are thorough and will search your bags if needed CHA recently added a daily direct flight to DallasFort Worth and will soon follow up with direct service to Houston and Orlando Other cities with direct service to and from CHA include Atlanta Chicago Charlotte Washington DC Cincinnati and Memphis CHA really is a connected airport and getting moreso all the time apparently

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National
It is not big The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean and not crowded

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

Zaporizhia airport Ukraine is probably the most original and exotic airport I flew to and from The airport serves a million people city and is unbelievabely small It did not see any main restructuration and reconstruction since the middle of soviet era and this airport is a real step back in times but it will change by I have nothing bad to say about this airport because it is impossible to compare with european standards The terminal consist in a small building where everything is included into a very small space It deserves a visit Landing in Zaporizhia is landing in the s You walk to the terminal from the aircraft then you pick up your lugguage straight on the tractor no conveyor For checkin you also bring you baggage straight to the tractor because there is no conveyor as well Then there is a very small cafe and a unique passport control and you arrive in a waiting room that youve never seen before To go to the plane you walk down outside stairs and walk to your aircraft again A very interesting experience

Very nice small airport easy check in with friendly staff Plenty of seating in the airport with small selection of shops and restaurants and bars Parking for cars very close to terminal and with plenty of spaces Easy access to main roads when you leave the airport Baggage reclaim very quick A pleasure to arrive at this airport

Nice atmosphere friendly staff and excellent hospitality The staff was courteous and welcoming the food was good and hot and there are drinks to choose from The lounges are good the service provided was great and checking in is simple Early landings and timely flights

Tehran to Paris CDG with Iran Air Their new and well maintained aircraft are being being used on this route so I had a pleasant experience with them Food was amazing cabin crew were very professional and the flight was extremely smooth

One of the nicest and cleanest airports Ive experienced Thoughtful touches are everywhere from the piano in the food court to bags for wet umbrellas to a cart of peanuts and pretzels from Delta identical to what they give out in flight at the baggage claim Bathrooms are spotless And clocks throughout the airport

Tehran to Paris CDG with Iran Air Their new and well maintained aircraft are being being used on this route so I had a pleasant experience with them Food was amazing cabin crew were very professional and the flight was extremely smooth

This airline is world class and knows how to treat its customers with professionalism and respect Hands down the best airline Ive traveled with and Ive traveled a lot If their standards remain top notch Ill be a customer for life

One needs more than arriving hours before takeoff time for international flights I would suggest Queues are terrible everywhere checkin taxes immigration And why taxes cant be paid by card On arrival migration services seem more efficient search me and luggage is delivered efficiently It is a pity not to be able to get money from an ATM in the international space only local cards seem to work On departure when you pass migration you get into a renewed part of the airport with plenty of space totally different from the departure area which is crowed Duty free shops are nice as well as the food offer Some dont like the patterns on the floor of the departure area but its one of the charms of Maiqueta airport Another one is the takeoff and landing especially at daytime I always enjoy the landscape

Bragana to Cascais with Aero VIP Seven Air provides the services The pilot was very nice and made sure everyone was comfortable and explained there would be some turbulence which was normal Flight arrived minutes late

The airport is small yet very well organized There is every service available that a person would require even for a long wait restaurant ATMs banks PO as far as airport seats go I was able to sleep on these in more comfort than others Ive been through many airports and can honestly say that Im impressed

The airport is very small with just about million passengers a year The few checkin desks are enough service is fast no queues travel agencys most big car rental companys have a desk and restaurants and visitors terrace with a nice view are available
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

Small Domestic Terminal in Male Fast and efficient no Food or Drink facilities Quick boarding by bus New ATR with comfortable seat pitch Short Minute flight very friendly Maldivian Crew Water Juice and Fruits offered Smooth Landing in Dhaalu Bags delivred in minutes Perfect short and comfortable flight

Shenyang airport traffic is not very convenient only airport buses and trams especially few flights no subway After entering the terminal the design is more atmospheric Except for China Southern Airlines other airlines can only check in minutes in advance which is not good In addition there are few automatic checkin machines so the queue at the manual checkin place is serious Security is fast and funny There are a lot of rest areas and mobile phone charging areas after security check WiFi is fast The fly in the ointment is that there are a few restaurants In addition there are many turntables at the baggage claim area and the luggage will arrive soon The guidance signs are perfect

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

ADDAMM via Sanaa Overnight in Sanaa where Yemenia provide hotel and breakfast Pleasant flight attendants and acceptable food A good flight and a lot cheaper than competitors I had to change this flight and put it forward by one week which was no problem and didnt cost anything to change

It was my first time in Yemen and flying Felix Airways The flight was only min but it was enjoyable The staff were friendly and the plane was in a good shape in addition to a comfortable seat and a nice route
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

Great little airport incredibly close in to the city centre minutes by metro from the Domestic Terminal to the central station and the international terminal is spacious with comfortable seating by the gates and good value shopping The only downside is the tedious minute bus transfer to get there from the Domestic Terminal

I flew with Shaheen Air on Jan from Dubai to Karachi Checkin was good Cabin crew friendly and smiling and before take off a drink was served and a newspaper After take off nice dinner was served with chicken Korma Zeera Rice Riata and Hot Tea

Tambor to San Jos Regional airline Flight with Cessna clean and flight was on time Very basic airport but the staff were eager to operate it efficient They operate from San Jos domestic terminal which is basic but does the job They are trustworthy and I would recommend them

Koh Samui is a real unique airport almost everything is openair As they dont have any air bridges all passengers will be carried by little unique trolleys from and to the planes They do have a roof on most parts of the airport but no walls a very airy experience and a fine contrast to the usual

The airport is well laid out the gates are simply marked and the staff are extremely helpful There is an information desk to the left of the entrance which will direct you where you need to go Considering this was my first flight and after having a head injury they allowed my parents to go through security with me to guide me through the process Security was slower than I have come to realize is usual and very confusing however once on the other side there were many shopping options and also a great deal of eating options There was suitable seating and the boards with times of departures were readily available The bathrooms were a little messy however

Great regional airport Friendly people and some little shops It is nice and clean everything goes fast I have never waited more than minutes The flights to Munich and Frankfurt gives opportunities to travel from there and the flights to Antalya and other vacation destinations are great too

Flew Amsterdam to Belfast International on Easyjet EZY and I found the overall experience to be very good There was a slight delay in take off due to ATC however not a a major issue The onboard cabin crew lead by Clark were excellent and very customer oriented Great flight on Easyjet

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience
Great airport Easy to park easy to get to terminal and fast security Beats almost every other larger airport I have been to Not much to do but you wont be there long anyway

What a lovely little airport Check in staff very helpful top security must say and very good information desk Pity about the facilitiess and layout of the airport despite the levy charge Fast punctual service and with a smile
I really rate Rex airlines On time both ways Helpful staff Free snack and comfy seats All for return Very pleased with the experience would choose to fly with Rex again

Seattle to Edmonton returning Bombardier Q plane small but with comfortable seating even for a sixfooter as I am Great cabin crew and nice free drinks An inflight snack might have been nice but overall a pleasant experience

Paris to Cape Town Flew Joon for the first time in July it was the last leg of a very long flight from Memphis to Cape Town There were some ups and downs with JoonThe flight was delayed by hours mechanical when boarding everyone lined up and they let on some passengers and then the line didnt move for minutes As far as inflight Wifi did not work that was the only issue FA and staff were really good Everyone was super friendly and helpful I had an economy Duo Seat and there was plenty of room The entertainment system worked very well Bring your own earbudsheadset the ones they give you are not very good As far as the food goes it was not really any better or any worse than what I have had on KLM or Delta long haul flights The A flew so smooth on of my favorites

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far
