Used Kilimanjaro as our entry point for Tanzanias northern safari circuit KLM was the only flight arrival at the time the airport though small had the fresh feel of yester years relaxed airports walking to arrival area ushered by ground staff No soulless airbridges and automatic sliding doors leading to empty spaces The whole ambience was relaxed Immigration was quick and efficient they had a green and red channel when tried to walk through green channel were asked politely to go through red were asked a few cursory questions and waved through total time from disembarkation from the airplane to the waiting car less than minutes The charm of this airport is that it is not like the other mega airports small and fresh

Im a Connecticut resident and use Bradley a halfdozen times a year Terminal A is perfectly serviceable nothing fancy but it does the trick Luckily most carriers use it Terminal B which I understand will be closed at the end of cannot be demolished fast enough It is an eyesore with next to no services I guess its only advantage is for people who wonder what air travel used to be like in the s and s They can see firsthand in Terminal B I wish BDL had service to longer haul hubs like DEN and SLC but I guess there isnt enough demand Nonetheless Im perfectly happy using the airport Its smaller size means fewer delays quicker deplaning and some breathing room

Being a frequent traveler to Ancona Airport I have expectations that are met every time Since this airport is so tiny checkin and security are a breeze The single terminal is fairly clean and peaceful The Italian shops have what you expect The only problem I have with this airport is that you cant get coffee in the terminal This isnt much of a problem though because you can simply get it outside There isnt anything wrong with this airport but its not extraordinary It is very relaxed and is a good airport

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center
We had a challenge with checking due to a third party error Even so Sarah was super kind and efficient She made us feel at ease and resolved the issues we had promptly Thanks again

I wanted to acknowledge the entire ground staff including the Security who helped us a great deal to arrange boarding the aircraft We reached airport just min before scheduled departure and the checkin was closed After requests since we as a family had to take onward flight from Delhi the ground staff went out of their way to help us

The best airline I have tried till now The best pilots they are very competent The service is good Delicious food Im proud to be Lebanese and to have such a company The tickets are expensive but its worth it

Winnipeg to Abbotsford I flew with Swoop for the first time and I absolutely loved it There were no delays and Winnipeg airport was not busy The signs were easy to follow Airport crew were very friendly

Visited Uganda on and departed on Both arrival and departure experiences were smooth Arrival hall is rather large There is mandatory health screening before one can proceed to visapassport control Obtaining a visa is relatively easy Present valid passport and make payment Baggage claim appeared to be a rather large area with perhaps carousels At departure level the lighting seems rather deem There is the mandatory screening of bags before you can enter and check in for the flight The staff is very friendly The facilities are clean and the departure hall appears small given the amenities gift shops dining and duty free The Karibuni Lounge is excellent It puts to shame US airline lounges in the USA with its food offerings and amenities Bathrooms are cleaned frequently by an attendant Overall no issues with EBB airport Immigration control staff are very friendly The only drawback to this airport is that passengers have to be dropped off in the parking area and then make their way around the roadway to the departure level

Two LAN Colombia return flights inside Colombia from Bogot to Cartagena and then Bogot to Pereira One was shortly delayed because of the bad weather conditions in Pereira heavy rainfall and another one because a passenger decided in the last minute not to fly In both cases the cockpit keeped us informed and apologized for both delays Being a domestic flight there were only complementary drinks served and because the flight to Pereira was very short like minutes not everybody got something but a good manage from the crew Checkin using their App is piece of cake There was entertainment using their new App via WiFi on one of their flights and it did work without problems Overall a very good experience

Boarded by bus on an distant location AN on a very good condition crew was young people friendly and eager to help passengers to place carryons to the bins Legroom was tight I was lucky my next seat was left empty and the flight was barer able We departed on time min after departure they served coffee no free and hours within the flight they served lunch from Buy on board Menu Flight was full and almost all passengers transferring to North American destinations

I wanted to acknowledge the entire ground staff including the Security who helped us a great deal to arrange boarding the aircraft We reached airport just min before scheduled departure and the checkin was closed After requests since we as a family had to take onward flight from Delhi the ground staff went out of their way to help us
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

For a small beachside city developed as a getaway destination for North Americans this little modern airport did not disappoint me Getting through security was a breeze very friendly TSA and compared to other airports Ive been to navigating is easy enough If you are someone who goes to the airport not just to fly but to shop mountains of stuff this airport might not be for you granted it has somewhere between and gates total and there is no gargantuan walkway of dutyfree shops to be found The terminal is very modern and clean For some reason despite being first in line for takeoff it did take us about min to get off of the ground Lots of general aviation so this might be a regular thing Bottom line would I fly here Absolutely This airport is all about convenience and efficiency

Hong Kong to Xian Being the second time travelling with Cathay Dragon my impression towards this airline is greatly improved In my flight to Xian except for my IFE that failed to show the flight map everything just went right and nothing special happens the cabin crew also provided good service to us However as things went wrong in the return flight back from Xian to Hong Kong the excellence of the Cathay staff is well demonstrated As the Hong Kong Airport Authority restricted flights from landing in Hong Kong that day after we entered the cabin with the door closed we were still not sure whether we can fly The cabin crew reacted professionally to answer many enquiries from passengers meals were served on ground and we could just wait for further notifications from the pilot Finally the flight was delayed to the next day we were then forced to leave the cabin and went back to the airport the only thing that made me discontented is that there was no any compensation from the airline though the airport restriction issue is not the problem of the airline In the delayed flight next day we saw the same crew and they also showed how professional they are After knowing that it is the birthday of one of our friends they even provided snacks and gifts to us Their quality of service was just awesome and left us very deep impression It is really an unforgettable experience travelling with Cathay Dragon and it is definitely a yes if I have a chance to travel with them once more

Beijing to Pyongyang The aircraft was clean cabin crew friendly and the flight on time You get the Pyongyang Times to read aboard I flew for the first time this type of a Tupolev and found not much difference to some other aircraft The food was acceptable The selections of beverages could be better

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops
This is a really nice airport the arrival and departure terminal are separate which is very convenient The airport hotel was amazing

There are terminals terminal A for most domestic flights Garuda Indonesia Lion Air Wings Air Citilink and terminal B for international flights and other domestic flights Sriwijaya Air NAM Air Air Asia and Express Air Terminal B is smaller than Terminal A but the facilities are quite good The security staff and ground staff are good There are some shops that sell food and drink with reasonable prices There are also some toilets and ATM for the passengers Some minor issues are the lack of electrical socket for charging your gadget The seat in the waiting room is adequate in quality and quantity There are some traditional Javanese ornament in the airport

There are a lot of negative reviews for this airlines but for a budget airline what do these reviewers expect Premium airline service They have obviously never flown on EasyJet or Ryanair to make a comparison Flew to Turkey from Manchester and was quite impressed by their checkin service and legroom on the plane Recommend to anyone

Arriving late at night from Brisbane on a delayed flight we were quickly off the plane and through customs without a long delay for baggage but remember PGK for a visitors visa Security is fairly tight due to the general problems of PNG and only passengers with tickets are allowed into the terminals The domestic terminal is somewhat more crowded and more confusing with limited facilities but is relatively clean Returning from outside POM you may well find that there is no international baggage transfer you need to walk the three hundred or so metres between the terminals with your baggage but it is a covered walkway with lots of security staff everywhere After checkin there is then a wait with few available chairs until customs is opened about an hour before the flight Once through things go fairly smoothly though there is not much airside apart from the small Air Niugini lounge which is pleasant enough For the size of Port Moresby a reasonable enough experience though more seating would be good

The airport is good and surprisingly large for a city of this population due to large number of tourists Most depart on Terminal S South note the terminal as the other terminal is far away Check in and security were smooth and fast There are adequate facilities for shopping or a drink The airport as well as Alaska Airlines have a good record of on time departure A good airport though there is not many lounges

Departure from Louisville was excellent the First Class checkin was efficient and fast with great service from the American Eagle ground staff Security was quick about ten minutes to line up and go through the security they are using the new body scanners now which improve and speed up the process The TSA staff as polite and very professional and ensure that your time with them is minimal as well as ensuring standards are kept After security the Lounge is good with excellent views over the runways aircraft Boarding areas are clean and airy with plenty of seating for passengers

We arrived from Rome with Ryanair bussed quickly to the terminal which is new bright and clean Luggage arrived almost in a blink of an eye Easy navigation to the exit with a stop in a clean toilet several ATMs very convenient mins from the moment we landed to the car pick up Highly recommended airport nice experience

AMSAAL and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Aalborg every minutes weekdays but only hourly during the weekend travel time is mins and costs DKK Checkin efficient and hasslefree using selfservice kiosks Free Internet computers are available landside a nice touch Security staff very friendly Boarding area is rather cramped with limited seating do not go airside too early
Not as big as Airports in Beijing and Shanghai that it is hard to navigate It is very efficiently run and very clean It is the best midsize international airport in China
Nice and very effective Airport With an Business Class Ticket your within Minutes at the Lounge The Security Check also Works smooth Great experience

The security person that checked me was so rude I went through the body scanner and it beeped which it was not a surprise it was always happens to me for some reason and she shouted for me to take my shoes off and go again through it Then during the search done by hand she even lifted my top up without even asking resulting in me being almost half naked in front of everyone I would not recommend this airport at all as I never had such a bad experience in any airports I have been to The pros are that the food is generally good there and there are lots of shops so if you have time to kill it is a good airport for that

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

Ive seen many negative reviews about Sri Lankan airlines However my trip was so good Even though it was a hour flight they provided drinks and a snack which doesnt happen in North America The service was professional too I hope they will grow

Easy to park easy to whiz through security super friendly clean good services I got there a bit late for check in and people let me skip the line So nice Security was extra careful to check bins so I did not leave anything behind in my rush My airline pages me to board

I concur with the comment below Confins is underused But there is a big plus Conexao Aeroporto buses that take you to the city centre are punctual and efficient Things have changed since and there should be more improvements in the future

I want to express my sincere thanks to Jin Air staff in Osaka I had a flight from Osaka to Seoul in May and had not completed the Keta for this reason I could not board However the checkin staff did everything possible to help me complete the documentation Despite not having completed it on time I missed my flight even so the staff offered me an available seat on the next flight I really value this collaboration I hope the staff is notified about this Thank you so much

It was my first time to fly with Asiana Airline Service is world class check in counter staff are super friendly Flight crew are very friendly excellent service always there on call you press button and the air hostess is there Always smiling Food was beyond and above the first class standard I flew Sydney to New York via Incheon Seoul all flights had the same standard Desk crew in JFK New York was just as friendly I give Asiana Airline for punctuality on time arrival and departure I give them for flight crew I give them for food quality

Great airport for small aircraft Twin OtterCessna used primarily for safari transfers Courteous and friendly staffsecurity as well as satisfactory washrooms and a nice snack bar Wilson airport is a welcome change from the chaos of Jomo Kenyatta Note due to its small size there is no souvenir or duty free shopping
I just experienced Asiana Airlines Business class food delicious flight attendants good service I give stars because flight is delay minutes and does not have wiFi

Karachi to Gwadar Travelled with this airline after I had travelled on a short a domestic flight early September Flight in general was smooth and scenic Ground staff were also pleasant and helpful I see some betterment in overall operations particularly in terms of punctuality

While I found the Jacksonville airport to be very clean with exceptionally friendly professional employees my review is regarding one in particular His name is Alejandro a wheelchair provider for people departing and arriving at the airport I first met him on October when I arrived at JAX He was prompt friendly and a very nice person Well when I left JAX I ran into Alejandro again and he recognized me after a week and all the people hed met He was so pleasant I have required wheelchair assistance when traveling for over years and Alejandro is hands down the best

Sam Ratulangi Aiport is a small international airport at Manado in the northern tip of Celebes Island Sulawesi Island Indonesia I was using this airport as the entry for my trip to Manado I surprised to see a relative small airport in Indonesia which currently only serves few international flights to Malaysia Singapore and The Philippines as a worldclass airport with its modern facilities efficient and friendly staffs and spacious lounges the VIP lounge is great and very comfortable place to spend some times before the flight It deserves more international flights in the future since some international destinations in the past such as Taiwan had been terminated

Yesterday I had a pleasant experience from Horizon two airline employees on the Horizon air turboprop that I flew from Missoula to Seatac I had a very short connection time to board an Alaska air flight to Charleston SC I flew this same itinerary MSO to SeaTac to CHS last year and because of airport construction and a long distance between two terminals I nearly missed my flight With this in mind I told the flight attendant named Kyle that I would need someone to help me get to the right terminal in time to make the flight I was quite anxious about it Kyle told me that the first officer agreed to escort me to the terminal as she had a three hour layover She not only made a smooth and soft landing with the plane but she also walked with me all the way to the plane I was to board Please let first officer Emilee know that she went above and beyond her job description She is a lovely person and goes out of her way to increase her customers comfort level I consider it a blessing to have walked beside first officer Emilee
Their airport is pragmatic on the right size to be passenger friendly and with all major needs served like SIM cards and ATMs available Beware of overpriced rides to the city center or your hotel
Overall the airline offered a clean cabin efficient crew almost friendly good seat spacing and ontime service Pretty good for a budget airline
LuganoAgno is a little airport maybe the smallest in Switzerland but I think its the most efficient Its commercial says Youll be in the air in minutes and its the truth I think its a great airport

Rio de Janiero to Curitiba via Sao Paulo Really good experience really smooth inflight entertainment and free food and drink the cabin crew were really friendly This really beats European customer service the leg room is still the same but just the service outweighs it for me

Skopje is a small airport but quite spacious you can see that there are not many people flying international But there are some coffee shops burger king and car rentals The only shuttle bus goes every hour The toilets could be cleaner they were dirty even when there weere almost no people

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

This is a fairly good airport Nice and clean easy to get around This airport is also very small and therefore has less wait time thus you can probably get away with arriving only hour prior to departure and still make your flight On the other hand there is not very many options to eat or shop

Travelled again with SunExpresss for a short break to AYT I dont understand the negative reviews as they are totally at odds with every experience I have had with this airline The cabin crew both out and back were fantastic Very friendly polite well groomed and nothing was too much trouble I would not hesitate to travel with them again

My jewel among low cost airlines Courteous efficient and highly safety oriented cabin crew Very enjoyable flying experience thru out Every time the washroom had been used the crew checked it for cleanliness Great public announcements

TAR Aerolineas is a new regional Mexican carrier which operates several routes in Mexico Flew a domestic route roundtrip and found the service to be topnotch Aircraft brand new and clean punctual departures and arrivals attentive ground and cabin personnel excellent value for money Would choose them again when my travel plans take me to Mexico

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

Checkingin for a seat flight without any other flights at the same time was never going to be busy Checkin staff who was also baggage handler flight dispatcher and Im sure other things was very friendly and efficient The small terminal had good restroom facilities car hire drinks and food dispensing machine Surprisingly large number of security personnel for a tiny airport I counted at least security staff Nice experience

The wheelchair assistance at Mumbai Airport was exceptional From the moment my parents landed on an early morning flight they received excellent support through immigration and luggage collection ensuring a smooth and hasslefree process A special thanks to the young gentleman whose name I unfortunately cant recall for his kind assurance and attentive care Truly appreciated the respectful and seamless experience Highly recommend their service

Massive improvement in airport and staff Very clean public facilities are well maintained Staff are a bit friendlier now and fewer queues on departure and arrival securityimmigration clearance due to having extra staff on counters Just need a few more shops in the terminal

Brasilia airport is clean and always improving the facilities The architecture is uptodate The airport is well located and you can reach it by bus but no train or subway It has an good commercial area close to the gates The airport facilities are in good condition and are well maintained
Everything was very good We used the lounge in the airport The services were great

My wife and I flew from Buenos Aires to Miami this January The airplanes appeared to be old with no entertainment flat panels no earphone outlets and no USB charging outlets The seats were old fashion leather wide and comfortable with spacious leg rooms and reclineable backward to almost degrees all of these made the flights very comfortable Meals served were rather good with frequent service of beverages of limited types free wine was included with meals Our experience was far better than most reviewers whose reviews we read

Flew STNBIO BIOSTN modern stylish terminal architecture some way outside Bilbao but perhaps the nearest bit of flat land to be found amongst all those hills No problems on arrival speedy passport check and luggage quickly up on the belt Same when leaving fact luggage drop and security control Airport is clean staff friendly and helpful Minor gripes no free wifi no post office to buy stamps souvenir shop did not have any postcards food and drink airside expensive lifts seem to have a mind of their own not enough seats on the groundside Bilbao well worth a visit even for a day but certainly a weekend
Airport is quite small and toilets are not so clean Not much to do while waiting for your flight but for a short wait the experience is not that bad

Flying from LHR to BKK Went through additional security checkpoint smoothly No big queues New clean and pleasant terminal All information were given very clear Hope to have such terminals more often in Europe Glad to be here again

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

Beijing to Macau Air Macau is the only one carrier operating daily flights from Beijing to Macau The aircraft they use on this route is A The flight attendants can speak English well but the service do not have any shining spot Dinner is provided on this flight which tastes not too bad Although the plane delayed for min to get airborne due to traffic of Beijing Airport the flight made landing min earlier than estimated which surprised me

Clean efficient and friendly The Norwegians do these things very well There is everything you need at this airport cafe bar shop etc but without the hassle of larger airports I would recommend the region for any tourist and Trondheim is a very attractive city

Little Rock National Airport LIT is one of my favorite midsize airports It is on par with the Bob Hope Airport BUR and Ft LauderdaleHollywood International Airport FLL in that it is easy to get in and out of the airport complex the location is close to downtown and the presence of lowcost airlines keep overall ticket prices among the lowest in the country

Really excellent airport I flew to and from Palma De Mallorca airport for a weeks holiday There was absolutely no queues But it was am so it was expected But even when I arrived at about pm the queues were short and went very fast Definitely a great experience No delays or inconvenience except for most of the shops being closed on departure but as stated earlier it was in the morning Highly recommend

Arrived via DME from LHR and MAN with S airlines and same route return Probably the fastest ever transit through an airport I have ever experienced even if it is only a small provincial one Had to return the day after I arrived and with the assistance of friendly helpful staff collected my late luggage All in all a great little airport if a basic one

Ottawa is my home airport and given the population that it serves its very convenient It is not very large so it may not have some of the amenities larger airports will have showers multiple lounges etc but its fast clean and provides an acceptable amount of food choices Whenever possible I like to clear customs in this airport vs doing so in Toronto or Montreal

Return journey Clean modern aircraft comfortable seat tasty food and drying and great cabin crew On the way back ground staff checked our bags through to EDI on BA even though we did not have the journey on a single ticket Impressive and enjoyable journey and I would happily use them again

Flight TF Gothenburg Stockholm Bromma Attentive professional FAs comfortable seats papers for free good in flight magazine on time clean plane smooth boarding and disembarkation clear safety announcements good sound system Best of all a small meal for free with coffeeteasoda and a chocolate candy

Although capacity has been enhanced and facilities are relatively better overall cleanliness and passenger comfort eg Efficiency of air conditioning is still far from satisfactory I live in Pune and would want this airport to be one of the best in the true sense Customer experience must be top class at such an important airport There is a lot of room for improvement

Airport was much better than expected In the general area are a few food options incl coffee shop icecream bar and a few fast food choices They even have a small duty free We were in the TAAG lounge called the Pearl lounge Clean comfortable with basic drinks food Staff are very friendly Did not see showers Internet is available but weak Other than internet this lounge is better than many US lounges I have visited I was expecting something much worse

We use the BA lounges here to avoid the horrendous crowds everywhere in the terminals This airport needs at least two more terminals to offer the space and experience many of its rivals offer When we landed at Terminal we had another interminable wait for our luggage Not a great experience again Id recommend it only because it is better than the other London airports

Small airport which was about minutes on bus to the city center Facilities was good and clean Baggage claim was fast and thoughtful as at many other Japanese airports Signs and directions were also clearly noted in English

Great little airport Everything in one location baggage belts next to car hire desks and you walk out into the car park and collect your car Will be my preferred choice now rather than coming in via LAX or SAN and facing a hour drive
Lots of seating Not enough electric plugs or charge points WiFi was hopeless it didnt work Tannoy too loud Staff seem nice enough Appeared clean

Recently flew to and from Roissy CDG to Biarritz International in the Basque country in south west France for the first time The airport itself is small but there is a good bus service which will take you into the city centre pretty quickly On arrival on the HRS AF flight from CDG this flight seemed to coincide with a number of other flights from the UK which made the baggage arrivals area chaotic In addition the toilet facilities landside need some upgrading and definitely could do with the cleaners visiting there on a more frequent basis especially midafternoon which seems to be the peak time for the airport The rubbish bin in the gents toilet was overflowing when I was there which left a poor initial impression The airport does have an excellent tourism booth with very helpful staff however In addition from the airport one can get onto the nearby motorway very quickly and the care hire agencies also had very helpful staff at the airport especially Europcar On departing Biarritz back to Paris however I discovered that the departures area has only one very small cafe so passengers may not want to enter this area too quickly as the wait could be long and somewhat boring In summary the airport is convenient but it falls well short of the new fresher and modern design of nearby Pau airport which is excellent

Surprisingly good experience Cabin staff were unbelievably attentive and helpful Food and beverages were excellent for airline food Boarding and deboarding were well organized Only downside was business configuration was and flat bed was not as comfortable as on other airlines

Since Zhulyany Airport had opened the new Terminal I have flown times from there Everything was nice clean and efficient and friendly service I really can recommend this airport to be used for a visit in Kiev

While it is beyond the reach of New York City taxis ISP is five minutes away from Ronkonkoma railroad station in turn a hm train ride to Penn Station This may seem very inconvenient for Newyorkers used to La Guardia airoport but it isnt so bad if compared with JFK The airport is small and efficient There are little or no delays on the ground This field is used primarily by Southwest as its gateway to New York Southwest partner ATA is another visitor while some legacy carriers only offer regional service to their respective hubs or focus cities For those passengers who dont like turboprops be advised that Piedmont Airlines operates from this field with DHCs for Us Airways express while Colgate uses tiny Beechcrafts on flights for Usair express and Continental I find those tiny planes charming but many passengers complain Overall a very pleasant passenger oriented airport

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in
The airport is cool clean well ventilation and beautiful The navigation sign is clear help the customer easily navigate inside the airport The staff are considerate and thoughtful

Efficient checkin Very simple and small meal for a hour flight with a stop over of another BrusselsMarsa Alam Unbearably limited legroom If you are over m impossible to sit Had to sit with my legs in the isle or stand Seats only recline cm so it feels you sit upright

I had an excellent experience at Taoyuan Airport Very impressed with the smooth and efficient baggage handling process The staff were incredibly helpful offering assistance with moving my luggage at the baggage carousel It made the entire process much easier and stressfree Really appreciated the level of customer care and attention to detail in ensuring that everything went smoothly Im highly satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend it
Little and very nice airport Clean well organized with helpful staff The way it should be All in all a good arrival and starting point for any trip

A lovely little airport Ample parking right in front I was happy because I could find a seat in the waiting area no small matter Toulouse is closer to the area where we vacation but the trip peagemajor highway makes travel easy and fast and the national and local roads are good too
TSA worker screaming at everyone She removed purse shoes and jacket from the bin where I was told to place them She threw each item on the belt individually Never stopped hollering

Although Westchester County Airport is awfully small compared to JFK or Bradley it is amazing It has car rentals an actual baggage carousel five airlines going in and out of there local planes accepted too and even have gates This is so much better than some small airports Ive been to

Excellent small airport clean spacious good restaurant airline lounges collectively available to a great many airlines Arrival was to jetway Departure was by bus to plane from gate E the gates uses buses to go to aircraft The departure flight needed deicing since the aircraft was not parked at a gate it could be deiced in place before taxiing Frequent reliable bus service tofrom city Security personnel on departure efficient and courteous Time in security line minutes

I recently had the opportunity to fly with Batik Air Malaysia and my experience was a mix of satisfaction and simplicity Batik Air is known for providing basic services without the frills and it certainly lived up to that reputation The seating arrangements on the plane were comfortable but dont expect any luxurious features The seats were standard with enough legroom for a short to mediumhaul flight However the absence of inflight entertainment and limited amenities made the journey quite straightforward For those who prioritize a nofuss travel experience this may be a positive aspect One notable issue was the apparent lack of thoroughness in the cabin crews safety checks during the landing phase It was concerning to observe that the crew did not seem as attentive as one would expect in ensuring that all passengers were securely seated and that all items were stowed away properly The usual announcements and visual checks were noticeably absent creating a sense of unease among passengers Safety is paramount in air travel and any oversight during critical phases of the flight such as landing is a cause for concern It is imperative that the cabin crew conducts meticulous checks to guarantee the wellbeing of passengers This lack of attention to detail on Batik Air raises questions about the airlines commitment to ensuring a safe travel experience
Detroit Metro is always clean convenient and well maintained Staff is usually pleasant and helpful We travel through DTW about times per year and we have always had a positive experience

Used Entebbe airport yesterday to fly to DaresSalaam and was pleasantly surprised Terminal is very small but clean staff are friendly and welcoming and the facilities are fine to while away a couple of hours One of the best airports Ive used in the East Africa region and wish all border control staff could be as pleasant

Its for T international arrivals Newly operated T pleasant experience no rush hardly min for immigration still under construction no eatingforex options within the terminal whatever available is outside the terminal Bag arrived on time hardly min to exit with baggage Clean toilets and facilities
The airport is very small however the staff provided a very good service We went through the airport very quickly

As with many small airports travelling to and from Altenburg is a pleasure The terminal is about as big as a DriveThrough burger restaurant and there is free parking within m of the building This airport is an excellent option for passengers travelling to or from the southern part of the former East Germany or to the north of Bavaria I live in Bamberg and the drive is much shorter and more pleasant than to the next nearest Ryanair airport at Frankfurt Hahn On the downside if you arrive early the Duty Free shop is very small and the restaurant is basic but the staff are friendly

Flydubai provides a pleasant and comfortable travel experience from Dubai to Kerala I am feet tall so I had plenty of leg room The food was tasty and sufficient and the service was good The positive experience is made better by effective boarding

Very good airport clean little queue times wifi works well and there are many options for eating One thing that I liked very much about this airport is that on the third floor there are many food options This airport is not very big but its space is very well used

Small airport dealing mostly with flights within Canada and USA Security was quick and easy no language problems either and we were through into the departure lounge which only has a shop and cafe but does have good free wifi to give you something to do while you wait A good experience

If in a group have someone get off the plane asap get right through and head for the Cambio Exchange counter Otherwise you may be queued up for a while The rates are fair There is a small drinks stand down an alleyway between Arrivals Departures Assuming you were smart enough to bring back some CUC or got a small amount in the airport the beers pop are cold cheap Still only for a Crystal or Buccanero but oddly enough its Peso for a Tucola Cheaper than on the bus if offered Back in March there was extensive work being done to bring more AC to the upper level and close in the open outside balcony on the upper level I guess the crowding factor made them notice The duty free is the best deal in town Not being computerized for checkin does have its drawbacks when it comes to seat selection etc Especially when HOG is a stop on the way and others have already boarded Found no difference between Cubana SkyService its the airport running the show The Customs Immigration staff always seem to be polite but not too friendly after all they do have a job to do protecting Cuba Once we left and nobody wanted my cigar documents another time they were all over the boxes A few pleasantries en Espanol goes a long way Be a gracious tourist and learn some of the lingo Note that liquids in carryons is not the concern as in most other countries Full bottles of rum No problem Bottles of lotion No problem And this is for goods packed before Security screening not after like with duty free stuff

My first experience on Uniteds ER was spectacular The ground crew was good and helped me board the flight according to standard procedures The seating was pretty good even though it was Economy Class I was sitting in Economy Plus the same seating as Economy Class but with more legroom The cabin crew were all friendly people even though we had moderate turbulence that made everyone anxious However my only issue is that the food did not meet todays standard for Economy Class The entree portion was too small and they didnt notify the mobile app for a lastminute change I thought I would have a chicken entree because I had reviewed it via Uniteds mobile app But instead when I was onboard I had beef which confused me Therefore I recommend that United improve its Economy Class meal service to provide nicer better portioned and more options for all customers

Second busiest airport in Finland after Helsinki now really quiet thanks to covid Terminal is reasonably big and has jet bridges so you dont need to go outside while boarding unless its a small turboprop like we had which cannot use jet bridges There are couple of shops a bar and a cafe and just like most other airports in Finland there are rocking chairs where to relax and even a piano anyone can play Checkin security and baggage claim went smoothly and fast since there were only a few passengers Airport is well connected to the city by buses and taxi

CHA is a compact but efficient airport serving a metropolitan market of about residents In the past it has suffered from proximity to major airports in Nashville and Atlanta but today airlines service Chattanooga with a rather rapidly growing number of destinations The airport is very clean with free WiFi throughout and parking and security is superior Low fare airlines have joined the legacy carriers so there is quite a nice selection of flights and fares Sure saves time and headaches of leaving from larger airports

This is the first time in over years that I have used Norwich airport So easy and quick with friendly staff WH Smiths was as normal for airports overpriced however Flour and Bean cafe was reasonablealso Plenty of seating in departures Security was so fast and I was from checkin to departure in under minutes I am used to Stansted and Heathrow where it takes an hour from checkin to gate The airport was clean and had a free cold water dispenser Overall impressed and I estimate saved me hours overgoing from London The only let down is the limited amount of shops though you expect that with the size of the airport dutyfree was cheaper than London and destination airport

Arriving into Landvetter was fine had to get a bus to the other side of the airport to go through immigration As I was on a nonschengen flight we had to go through immigration This part is quite small with European check desk and two noneu that are hidden in the corner and there are no signs to show that the noneu passport holder check is on the side Waited in the wrong queue for a few minutes till I had to ask and the immigration office put me right Immigration was quick with very friendly staff on arrival and departure Im the baggage reclaim you can see the bags come out from the conveyed overhead which is cool On departure airport queue times were quick with security very quick as well Gates has a small eating area with minimal seating and lack of plug sockets and as you have gone through immigration you cant leave this part Plenty of food and shopping options very modern clean airport that is nice to travel through

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

I was on a trip from Korla which is in the northwest of China to Sydney Australia taking transition stops at Urumqi and Guangzhou The transition experience at Urumqi was smooth and impressive The staff were very friendly and helpful They respond quickly to the customers needs and patiently explain procedures to follow I will definitely to recommend friends to take transition stops at Urumqi Airport in future

A small little provincial airport can be a touch uncomfortable in hot weather as the large glass windows absorb the sun as you wait in the departure area One small cafe serving reasonable food and drink Check in quick and car hire points convenient to main entrance Good main road access to the town of Rodez and Tarn and Tarn et Garonne etc

arrivals and one departure Arrival is one part and departure is the other Super efficient clean and pleasant Taxis out front Departure area maybe could use more seating Interesting there was a ping pong table there and it was quite popular It has a relaxing feel about it Probably one of the nicest airports anywhere Arrival has a store where you can buy a bus card and load it for say or days travel
Excellent service very cheerful and professional cabin crew Delicious catering punctual Honestly EgyptAir deserves a much better rating Keep up the excellent work

Modern airport surprisingly efficient compared with some other internal Russian airports Arrival facilities good baggage on the conveyor without a long wait On departure check in facilities were good security efficient and the Skyteam business lounge was of a high standard with free Internet connection although all drinks etc had to be paid for

Nice little airport There is a kiosk selling food and drinks Terminal is open to the elements but seating is provided outside Just prior to boarding the friendly security staff check your belongings in a separate air conditioned building where you wait until boarding Buses wait outside the terminal to take you to the jetty for transfer by ferry to Thursday Island

I was surprised with the cleanliness and efficiency of the airport in Guayaquil Really modern and easy to navigate I liked the zen garden at the domestic arrivals which really was a nice touch Toilets were clean Passport control very organised and staff are polite also duty free staff were very helpful Nice WiFi and view of the runway watching planes goes by Happy using it

Nice surprise as an Italian I appreciated a lot the food which could be bought on board Pasta alla Norma Red wine Valpolicella Professional and friendly staff tasting and authentically Italian food Proud as Italian to feel these kind of attentions to flyers Strongly suggested

The staff are very friendly The queue times for checkin and security are almost always very short or non existent making for a very smooth fast and pleasant experience all the way to boarding For such a small airport there are also a good amount of amenities ample seating and it is always clean
I live here and fly regularly New terminals are open airy and plenty of seating Limited but appropriate shopping Nice caferestaurant selection for a small airport Security swift and courteous

This is my home airport Completely renewed a few years ago its now a very good and modern airport Near the city center just minutes by car Its a small airport but its probably the better choice to come to Sardinia Depending on winds you can have a fantastic view over the famous sardinian beaches from your airplane window In the summer sometimes you may find crowds at security checks There are just a few overpriced shops but this is common in italian airports Car rentals taxis and bus are easy available

The airport terminal was built from scratch beside the old building currently closed It has a huge skylight from end to end making good use of natural light that reaches all floors through an atrium Many sculptures are integrated in the project which gives it an interesting touch Facilities are good enough The local delicacies stores are surely to be visited Totally sets itself apart from most Brazilian airports whose problems usually begin at finding a parking spot and extend through all possible aspects up to the boarding ramps

Brilliant Airline Very pleasantly surprised I recently flew with Oman Air on two sectors One was very short haul and one was mid range Both flights were nice The crew were polite and helpful the food was very good and the IFE was quite impressive The planes were clean and comfortable The prices were very competitive

I would like to convey my heartfelt thanks to Sharon and Gayithri who were on duty at the information counter at Seletar Airport Singapore on the eve of CNY reunion evening They both have gone out of their way above and beyond their normal duties in helping me to get a taxi My flight arrived at pm I tried to get a ride to no avail I decided to wait it out at the airport cafeteria after which I thought to try again this time at the taxi stand When I exited the building however the taxi stand seemed empty The police security on duty suggested I ask for help at the information counter by arrivals and I did that Sharon and her colleague persisted and helped me to get a taxi all the way from pm until I finally got into the taxi just short of pm which by the way stopped right in front of the arrival entrance so that I didnt have to walk far I am most grateful and wish to commend Sharon and Gayithri for their exemplary service I will always remember especially Sharon for her kindness and the personal service extended to me a foreigner who had just arrived Singapore and had turned to her for help

JNZDLC Flight departed and arrived on schedule Aircraft was newish MA clean and tidy Cabin announcements in English as well as Chinese but no cabin service only hour flight so acceptable especially given price of ticket RMB Aircraft named Modern Ark apt as modernised Chinese version of old Antinov design Overall perfectly acceptable

TIPATH A very comfortable flight on leather seats on new CRJ Breakfast well served with a generous portion Service went smoothly and efficiently crew were English speaking Plane interior clean Flight left on time and seemingly no worries about cent for cent baggage weight checking All in all a very pleasant experience

Had a great flight from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines A brief winter maintenance delay ensured a safe departure and while we experienced mild turbulence leaving Philadelphia and again upon arrival in Washington the pilots handled it smoothly Due to the conditions inflight service was not possible but safety remained the priority The Main Cabin Extra seats made for a much more comfortable experience and with a flight time of under minutes we arrived quickly and safely Republic continues to deliver a reliable and professional service for the American Airlines group

Used this airport frequently this last year last time September It is a very nice airport small manageable Cleanliness this time was improved compared to last time facilities are good True checkin area is rather small but with enough time before departure I could just wander to the counter and checkin straight away There are rumours that some international airlines might consider direct flights to and from Iloilo I wish nothing more than that just to bypass Manilas terminal

KigaliParis th Dec on one of their A aircrafts Checked in online smooth but is unnecessary and does neither add value nor gain time I chose an entire seatrow for free due to my Gold Status with Rwandairs Dream Miles Program Marburg declarations forms have to be filled prior to enter the airport Checkin slow minutes per pax but they managed to checkin luggage onwards with other airline Dream lounge in Kigali is a pleasure with panorama windows over town Catering options varied a bit sparse the best hot snacks appear not to reach the lounge easily only on firm request I suspect that they are consumed by lounge staff have seen indications hereof Wines are subpar No sparkling wine offered Flight on time full on time Seafood meal preordered and given Generous catering They gave me on early request an entire row onboard for better sleep Blankets earset and pillows given Very affordable ticket USD tr purchased months before departure Extremely good value for money Miles given

It always a good experience to fly from to Nuremberg airport because you have short ways It is connected with the metroline U so you are in minutes at the city centre You can eat some local stuff The staff is friendly and helpful The most important to the end WIFI is free

Vancouver to Phoenix We sat on the tarmac waiting and waiting for passengers to make their connection The flight attendant already announced that everyone was on board and the captain comes up and says we are waiting for more passengers What is fair To give us an on time arrival or wait for passengers and get everyone delayed No brainer

Amsterdam to Paramaribo Surinam Airways has good service unfortunately the A had some maintenance so they leased an A from Wamos Air but they have the service from Surinam Airways The food was amazing with hot meals The crew was very friendly but the airplane from Wamos Air wasnt so good no IFE for a our flight you can download the app for movies no power outlets just a standard seat with table Overall the service was good but the aircraft not

I flew with Rex on flights recently between Lismore Sydney and Wagga and return All flights were on time comfortable and the service was very good I particularly wanted to commend flight attendant Georgia on the Wagga Sydney flight She exuded a genuinely warm personality in every aspect of her work from the friendly smile and pleasant voice to the competent service
Very easy to reach and easy to move around inside terminal Clear signs polite and friendly staff Plenty of seats by gate

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec
It is located in the city center and easily accessible by buses and MRT The size is not big Signposts are clear Employees are friendly and helpful The ambience is clean

After reading some of the less stellar reviews online and being unable to reach any English speaking staff on the phone who could verify the incabin luggage dimensions I was naturally apprehensive about the flight from Tel Aviv to Nice on Monday September To my pleasant surprise the entire flight experience was excellent The plane was clearly in great shape a relatively new aircraft with leather seating and spotless interior The departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule The fact the departure from Ben Gurion airport was using a shuttle bus and not a jetway reminds me to warn any future passengers during any unlikely but possible inclement weather to dress accordingly or bring an umbrella for the extended exposure to the elements while trying to board an outdoors staircase Other than that I thought the whole experience was most pleasant and I would have no qualms about flying Israir again

My family and I were amongst passengers on the first ever Gold Coast Melbourne REX flight We had one of the best flying experiences ever Despite the technical issue which was sorted out quickly the crew remained polite and attentive The passengers kept informed and updated excellent service on board Big heartfelt thanks to all flight attendants Tup Lucinda Jordan Tanya Nicole and others You have made us feel so welcomed and comfortable Special thanks to the pilot this was the softest take off flight and landing ever With endless compliments we highly recommend REX airlines to everyone

Shenyang airport traffic is not very convenient only airport buses and trams especially few flights no subway After entering the terminal the design is more atmospheric Except for China Southern Airlines other airlines can only check in minutes in advance which is not good In addition there are few automatic checkin machines so the queue at the manual checkin place is serious Security is fast and funny There are a lot of rest areas and mobile phone charging areas after security check WiFi is fast The fly in the ointment is that there are a few restaurants In addition there are many turntables at the baggage claim area and the luggage will arrive soon The guidance signs are perfect

Just had to leave this review on th May returned from Rhodes and my flight was delayed two hours Just after midnight left baggage reclaim to go to my car I had a flat battery and was unable to get into my car It was exceptionally cold and all I was wearing was shorts and a tee shirt I returned to the terminal where I met the staff at the parking desk At this time the terminal was empty and they were locking up The staff came out and helped me gain entry to my car but I had a two hour wait for the Green Flag breakdown The staff waited with me almost an hour and had to go home leaving me alone in the car park freezing cold but not before he returned to his office made me a hot cup of tea and brought it to me in my car A beautiful act of kindness and one I will never forget

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated

I recently flew with Swiss Air on the Bucharest to Zurich route in an Airbus A Despite the overall comfort of the aircraft and the friendliness of the cabin crew the cabin temperature was much too low and could not be adjusted despite our requests The crew was kind and suggested we wear warmer clothes assuring us that the situation would improve over time Unfortunately the temperature remained consistently low throughout the flight making the journey less comfortable than we would have liked Nevertheless the aircraft was modern and clean and the staff provided prompt and friendly service If it werent for the temperature issue I would have had a very pleasant experience If the temperature cannot be adjusted immediately the company could provide passengers with additional blankets to offer them thermal comfort Overall my flight experience with Swiss Air was good but the temperature issue left a negative impression

London City to Berlin British Airways subsidiary BA CityFlyer really exceeded my expectations for such a short flight London City is a great alternative to London Heathrow as flight prices are similar and it is much more convenient and less crowded as it is in the city centre and is a smaller airport The checkin and bag drop were all selfservice but could be done easily and quickly with staff present to assist We boarded the aircraft very orderly in different boarding groups The seats on the aircraft an Embraer E were wide and comfortable with more than enough legroom for economy class especially for an hour flight The cabin was arranged in a layout so it was pretty spacious Service provided by the crew was excellent and they provided a packet of chips and a drink Overall the flight was very enjoyable and we arrived in Berlin on time

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

Nice airport but needs modification I have been travelling through this Airport for some time and it is not the best but it is being upgraded and work is going on right now so hopefully it will be a very nice and beautiful Air port with a lot of new facilities Airport need better management in dealing with multiple flights and improving the cleanliness
Great airport not many flights so no hassle From check in to take off minutes Car parking also free
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

An excellent regional airport with good updated facilities including its super cafe which will provide you with coffee and toast for that early morning departure From car park to check in takes just a couple of minutes and baggage return the same Air Southwest staff from check in flight deck and cabin crew are exemplary As a regular traveller with them I recognise so many friendly faces I find flying with them and from Plymouth a pleasure

Very small Airport on the Northern German Island of Sylt During Summer Season served by Lufthansa and Air Berlin with flights to major German Cities Only a handful checkin Counters and during busy hours on weekends which means or planes within a couple of hours long lines Upon Arrival only one Baggage Belt and Baggage Claim Area crowded But due to the small size of the airport and short distances from the planes to the Baggage Claim Area baggage arrives very fast Staff very friendly and efficient waiting lounge can get very crowded during peak hours Small shops and one nice CafeRestaurant Short distance to Parking Area Delivery service by Rental Car Companys No public Transport Overall a different but nice experience And flying to Sylt gives You a great chance to visit the island even from Southern Germany for only a few days

Ive been through this airport several times and I must say its incredibly clean and sparkling and definitely puts Gatwick to shame The people of Tunisia are very friendly which adds to the overall positive experience However I have a concern regarding the pricing While all airports tend to charge fees the prices here seem a bit exorbitant I wonder why this is the case Additionally I have a personal issue with the height of the walkway that crosses about meters up I understand this might not be a problem for most but it would be great if the sides of the walkway could be covered for those of us who arent fond of heights Other than these few points its an excellent airport with great service

Pleasant but rather oldfashioned airport Most of the traffic is domestic and the terminal copes well with this A good range of shopsrefreshments in the departure lounge area which is well organised You are very close to the aircraft including the runway so it does not feel claustrophobic My only gripe would be the totally constant announcements of both arriving and departing traffic needed because the information on the boards was unreliable No airbidges so you walk to the planes but this did make for speedy boarding We had prearranged transport so I cannot comment on local transportation but it does have a train station which is rarity in Indonesia
Kualanamu airport is very good Check in counters are good the waiting room is comfortable and clean But the toilets are not too clean but no problem The airport staff are good

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates
This is a smashing little airport friendly well laid out and very well run Because of its location very attractive to fly in and out of too always a big shock returning to Gatwick Good ice cream too

Birmingham to Zurich I am an incredibly nervous flyer and was flying at weeks pregnant so much more anxious than usual When I checked in the airline immediately clocked that I was pregnant and told me to come and queue up with priority customers even though I was flying economy When I did they showed me to a seat to sit in while I waited for the coach which was so helpful and kind On the plane the hostess noticed my anxiety during takeoff and throughout the flight they checked in with me constantly with such patience and kindness offering me a bottle of water to sip and calm my breathing down giving comforting reassurances at the slightest sign of turbulence and before we landed coming and offering a little cuddly toy plane for my unborn baby The genuinely caring nature of all the staff was absolutely superb and such an enormous comfort to a more vulnerable person I was so grateful and thoroughly impressed with every staff member involved at each step of the way

This is a quite modern airport and serves the country well after that being said I felt the airport is terribly connected to the other parts of the island and it makes you rely heavily on taxis or hotel transfers On arrival they will ask you for the Mauritius all in one form if you do not have it they will send you to the end of the line so that you can fill it online the airport provides free wifi for that then they will ask for hotel accommodation and return tickets make sure you have then handy or this will delay you and everyone else standing in line The staff seem to be friendly specially if you speak French Bathrooms were clean and after immigration and security on departure there are plenty of food options including global fast food giants I would say that I enjoyed my time while using this airport

nd largest airport in Philippines has terminals T is for international flights Checkin Level has main banks of Checkin counters AD at the back is the Departures area firstly Passport Control with manned counters and then Security Scanning both of which were quickly achieved Main Departures has the usual array of shops and duty free shops and cafes Some views of the gates and airfield There is lounge which covers most of the carriers premium customers its tired but has a reasonable selection of food on offer and seats with view of the apron Airport busy but did not feel overcrowded

Recently used Saskatoon Airport and found it to be a generally pleasant experience Quick security clearance is a plus as are the airport greeters who proved friendly and helpful Aside from the din created by a blaring TV set in the WestJet departure area YXE is a fine airport to use

I used this airport twice over the last two weeks Given the few international flights the international section was uncrowded Immigration was quick and hassle free Security check too was smooth no need to take off shoes or belts or jackets or pull out toiletries The business class lounge is used by all the airlines and it is a quiet place with a buffet of Indian and Bengali foods and a tended bar Limited number of shops and even limited number of eating places There is a duty free liquor shop just after exiting customs and before exiting the airport with a good selection of whiskeys at prices markedly cheaper than in the city All in all a functional airport that is easy to use with only essential facilities

We had great experiences with Coastal on separate flights within Tanzania Our planes generally had passengers on board plus pilot and copilot For peace of mind we were permitted to check that our bags were in the cargo hold of the plane before boarding I was nervous about flying on such a small aircraft but all flights were smoother than expected and relatively short in duration We experienced excellent customer service via emails when arranging for our XL bags due to equipment for photography and diving and the staff member was able to answer our questions about transfer from the Dar Es Salaam domestic to international terminal Note Its a minute drive and there is a Coastal shuttle that runs between them Only a couple of minor flaws The air conditioning did not appear to be working on one of the planes while we were on the ground so it was very hot One of our flights inexplicably was delayed about minutes but fortunately it did not affect our itinerary in the least Overall I was very happy we chose Coastal Aviation for our interTanzanian flights and would not hesitate to fly with them again

The main airport of Armenia has been completely rebuilt and the old Soviet style one is no longer operating The new terminal is clean and modern dutyfree shopping is in abundance As most fights arrive at midnight border control takes at least min During covid times all boarding passes need to be printed so take extra time in mind Taxis easily overcharge dram should be more than enough Overall a good experience
Parking in front of terminal is not free anymore However the first minutes still are Distance to the center of Plovdiv is about km Plovdiv taxis are reasonably priced

Duesseldorf Timisoara return This airline has been a pleasant surprise The Saab was comfortable seats very good and legspace excellent Food on board was among the best Ive seen The return from Timisoara was operated by an Air Nostrum CRJ Checkin counter at Timisoara opened only minutes before scheduled departure but checkin smooth Cabin crew was Carpatair staff and they deserve a compliment On both flights they were friendly helpful and competent
Excellent flight Water served during the flight Landed ahead of schedule staff was polite and friendly

I miss my Malaysia Airlines flight and all flight is closed and do not allow to purchase However AirAsia is so kind to let me get a ticket even though the counter is closed after listening to my ordeal in the airport Thank you AirAsia for making my trip possible Appreciate the guy that help me too rush to get his name Thank you

Great airport Good duty free Good fb outlets Just one question why do you clean all washrooms at the same time leaving just handicapped ones opened And to find a vacant one you need to pass several kms to find it

Small Domestic Terminal in Male Fast and efficient no Food or Drink facilities Quick boarding by bus New ATR with comfortable seat pitch Short Minute flight very friendly Maldivian Crew Water Juice and Fruits offered Smooth Landing in Dhaalu Bags delivred in minutes Perfect short and comfortable flight

Landvetter airport is a rather small one well organized and neat Security checks have seldom long queuing and are generally fast Lots of toilets are available very clean with taps to fillin bottles with water So do not hesitate to pass security with an empty bottle Shopping options are limited as the airport is small but the choice is more than correct This airport seems well managed

Recently flew to and from Roissy CDG to Biarritz International in the Basque country in south west France for the first time The airport itself is small but there is a good bus service which will take you into the city centre pretty quickly On arrival on the HRS AF flight from CDG this flight seemed to coincide with a number of other flights from the UK which made the baggage arrivals area chaotic In addition the toilet facilities landside need some upgrading and definitely could do with the cleaners visiting there on a more frequent basis especially midafternoon which seems to be the peak time for the airport The rubbish bin in the gents toilet was overflowing when I was there which left a poor initial impression The airport does have an excellent tourism booth with very helpful staff however In addition from the airport one can get onto the nearby motorway very quickly and the care hire agencies also had very helpful staff at the airport especially Europcar On departing Biarritz back to Paris however I discovered that the departures area has only one very small cafe so passengers may not want to enter this area too quickly as the wait could be long and somewhat boring In summary the airport is convenient but it falls well short of the new fresher and modern design of nearby Pau airport which is excellent
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport

Since the new modern terminal was inaugurated traveling to Pristina has become more convenient and a more pleasant experience than before All needed facilities are here in a minimum amount of space But it feels very fresh and airy though The new terminal really is great and pretty much everything has improved since the old terminal isnt used anymore

A modest little airport in Sabah Arrived on a domestiic flight from KL so no formalities Leaving again domestically to Kota Kinabalu was a breeze with very fast efficient checkin bag scan etc The airport is clean light airy and efficient by modern standards a joy to use

Qingdao to Hong Kong return in Business Class Impressive experience I did not expected such outstanding service on a hours flight Comfortable xx seat arrangement large seats even if they cannot become a flat bad but this is not required on such flight large video screen with wide selection of movies also very recent Full meal with several courses served both ways very good food and wine with continuous refills of drinks very kind and efficient cabin crew Surprisingly service on this flight was better than on the following Hong Kong San Francisco flight with Cathay Pacific I was expecting the opposite Flight from Qingdao left minutes late which is the rule for every flight leaving from Qingdao airport is far too small for the present traffic volume but arrived Hong Kong in time Flight back perfectly on schedule and no issues with luggage

Airport was much better than expected In the general area are a few food options incl coffee shop icecream bar and a few fast food choices They even have a small duty free We were in the TAAG lounge called the Pearl lounge Clean comfortable with basic drinks food Staff are very friendly Did not see showers Internet is available but weak Other than internet this lounge is better than many US lounges I have visited I was expecting something much worse
Parking in front of terminal is not free anymore However the first minutes still are Distance to the center of Plovdiv is about km Plovdiv taxis are reasonably priced
Loved this airport was friendly decor like someone said is s hawaiian Very comfy armchairs only thing missing was a bar Car hire easy to find and Hilo just down the road

I flew from Blantyre airport a number of years ago and was struck by just how quaint the whole set up was It is a very basic airport not far off the common tin shack analogy that comes with most African airports There is very little to do and there is just a bar to distract you The best thing about Blantyre airport is the Duty Free shop A selection so limited it is almost refreshing Malawi Gin Whisky JW Cane spirit macadamia nuts coffee and nick nacks I bought to W light bulbs that had been turned into paraffin lamps Wonderful

Air New Zealand short haul is brilliant The crew service was brilliant There was also a quiz on the plane for the whole flight Very quick flight time after the plane was late coming in from the previous destination Brilliant quick flight

It was an amazing service The cabin crew was very helpful The seat had a small TV but there was lots of film and games for children to play The breakfast was the best thing I really loved it The seat was very comfortable and they gave us a blanket but no pillow because I was in economy The check in desk at LHR was very good but at Beirut airport it was average Overall I would give it a

Auckland to Shanghai via Chengdu The food was very good from a Chinese perspective The service was impressive The crew members were nice and passionate Also for transit in Chengdu the passenger is able to claim yuan voucher free hour baggage storage free transit commendation in Chengdu Based on this price you cannot ask more Thank you Sichuan Airlines for the wonderful memory
Tried Premium Economy class and I was surprised about the seat quality and onboard meals This class also included amenity kit which I appreciate Cabin crew nicely handle my yo child

Because of the items in the news about delays and queues we were quite worried about going to Bilbao airport We did have to wait a few minutes at passport control but not too long The airport is a new building very light and modern we didnt have to use any steps at all which was brilliant On our return journey we purchased food and drinks in the cafe they were nicely prepared and the area was very clean and tidy All in all a very good experience and the area can be proud of the facilities

It is a privilege to be able to travel via GMP in Seoul Not because the airport is extraordinary but because it is within the city of Seoul and much closer then the island of Incheon GMP can be be reached by metro It is a domestic and an international airport the international connections are through towards Asian destinations GMP has the Advantages and the disadvantages of an old city airport easy to reach more efficient security procedures but old facilities like lounges

The airport is mid being rebuilt arrivals still in progress but departures all complete Departures was very quick no checkin or security queue it was a Tuesday but our plane was fairly full Great clean toilets friendly staff the only major fail is despite it all being brand new there is nowhere near enough seats expect to be sitting on the floors also not much food on offer if you cannot eat wheatbased food groups

Super easy to navigate this tiny welcoming airport parking garage fees are reasonable car rental is close by drop off and pickup is efficient airport management does actually care facilities are clean food is sparse but there and it is secure Top notch tiny regional airport

This airport has terminals one for USA flights and one for non USA flights Not big airport Inside is very clean and staff are very helpful However there are long waiting times at immigration and customs Customs has no scanner machines so they have to open all bags for checks Needed almost hours to finish immigration and customs When departing it is very quick Inside the airport there are only a few shops
