We travelled to Dubrovnik out of season so unsure what it would be like during the summer season when it is significantly busier What we did experience was a very clean modern stateoftheart airport that has been built and designed to an excellent standard It feels premium and polished not something I expected if I am honest before setting of on our holiday Arrival was very simple walked off plane on to a beautiful bright glass airbridge and into modern terminal structure made of glass and metal Immigration was quick and efficient not overly friendly but not antagonistic either We were airside probably within minutes from leaving the plane There is only one shuttle that goes to the city and it meets each flight leaving half an hour after each flights arrival and the cost was reasonable On Departure the checkin hall is bright and airy and the checkin staff for BA were friendly and helpful Security was a breeze and staff seemed generally fine we were the only flight taking off that evening though so it was very quiet The departure area was clean and well organised there isnt a lot of shopping opportunities or much to do but it is a small airport so that wasnt expected Do be aware of the extortionate prices charged by cafs for water you can buy it cheaper in some of the dutyfree shops at more reasonable cost Also only minutes of free wifi stingy and charging for more in this day and age is deeply odd These niggles aside however overall quite impressed
The set of counters of Cathay Dragon was a bit out of order since every counter was excessively full due to the great number of passengers Business Class and Marco Polo Club and Oneworld Members

Arrival from and departure to Shanghai I hadnt been to Tianjin for years its now one of those standard new Asian airports all sweeping steel and glass and marble Its easy to navigate and checkin and security are quick and efficient Theres cheap Internet access airside landside too but it was down and reasonable food options on both airside and landside Theres lots of room and seating and airport as a whole and the toilets are clean A metered taxi to or from the city is around RMB My only criticism would be the flight announcements they have one of those computers that says Fliight xxx from xxx to xxx is now checking in at gate xxx I dont know why these computers have the From xxx bit in China youre in Tianjin or wherever so its pretty obvious where the flight is from The computer couldnt pronounce Tianjin which made this even more irritating youd have thought they could find a computer that could pronounce the name of their own airport But otherwise it was lovely

In May the new international airport terminal was opened in Fez It is an enormous improvement and upgrade on the previous terminal with a much more spacious and aesthetically pleasing environment In departures security can sometimes be a little slow but there is a clear and effective process which is greatly improved as compared to the old terminal Border checks on both arrivals and departures are much more efficient and swift There is a lounge available as well as pleasant shops and cafes in both arrivals hall and departures An entirely upgraded and pleasant experience travelling tofrom Fez

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped
Good experience The flight assistants have been very kind and I arrived on time The cost of the ticket was really convenient I hope to fly again with them

Nice lay out I got to the airport in the morning I just had a bit of some confusion as it was my first flight The automated ticket booths were convenient and quick Security was a breeze No queue the security personnel were nice and polite I didnt feel intimidated The gates are lined up along the back of the building nicely The Tim Hortons was next to my gate Washrooms are clean They even provide you with sanitizing wipes and cleaner to wipe the seat The stalls are private with no big gaps in the stalls Theres tables with outlets to charge your phone Coming back it was alright The luggage carousels are at the main floor where the front doors are

Neos airline division of TUI Germany You can web checkin and you can change seat allocation without pay Plane arrived on time boarding and welcome was professional and crew was helping passengers with their carryons to be placed on bins New and clean aircraft service was great with two servings with tasty food and good variety of juices do not offer beverages but have wine coffee tea IFE is only drop screens to see the flight path and you can hear music from channels with earphones buy or your own

Small but perfectly adequate airport On arrival we were through the airport within minutes of touch down though dont forget the US tax taken at passport control On departure we found the airport was shut and locked with lights off until am for departures that started at however it is modern enough with self service check in quick but thorough security with plenty of space in a light and an airy atmosphere There are now screens for departure information as well as the usual unintelligible tannoy calls and the only downsides were the exorbitant prices for snacks and drinks Duty free was a bit better but not particularly cheap either US for a coffee was times the price in the Best Western Hotel across the road

Excellent small airport clean spacious good restaurant airline lounges collectively available to a great many airlines Arrival was to jetway Departure was by bus to plane from gate E the gates uses buses to go to aircraft The departure flight needed deicing since the aircraft was not parked at a gate it could be deiced in place before taxiing Frequent reliable bus service tofrom city Security personnel on departure efficient and courteous Time in security line minutes

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else
A small but full service airport Doesnt have some of the amenities of larger airports but you would not expect them Clean Great service Short wait times Highly recommended

Stockholm Tallinn Kiev and back Clean and nice Embraer on the first leg and a new CRJ on the second Overall a pleasant experience Transit at the small Lennart Meri ariport in Tallinn smooth and easy Staff rather dull but agreeable I would gladly fly with them again
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats are comfortable and can be reclined easily The food is delicious Flights departed on time

Durban to Cape Town with Comair This is a hour flight which was full The business class seats were the same as economy but with a little extra legroom and the middle seat was empty The FAs were mature and friendly There was a full bar service and light lunch was served The aircraft was clean left on time and arrived on time A relatively smooth flight unlike BA they serve refreshments and full bar service on this short haul domestic flight

An excellent Domestic terminal very large and clean The security screening upon entering the airport for a am departure was fast and thorough Plenty of check in counters and efficient agents manning them The food is very expensive but I dont buy at the airport so no problem A very nice airport all in all

Flight to Karachi from Multan The Airbus used for the journey was old and there wasnt any IFE present but the cabin had a nice ambience to it The flight attendents were very nice and pleasant The IFM was so so but you cant complain about it Take off and landing were was smooth I will definitely be flying with Shaheen International again

Special assistance staff went above and beyond to help us after huge road delays meant we were late arriving at the airport Cant thank them enough Airport itself was very clean easy to navigate lots of choice for food and drink Fantastic staff
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky

I fly this airport several times per year The name and location sounds like a bigger adventure than it actually is The airport is small so boarding an A is already something that keeps everybody busy However there are not that many flights ground staff are friendly and helpful

I had a great experience here Check in was quick and polite immigration and customs were very efficient and there was a good range of shops and restaurants I fly here quite often and it is nearly always a good experience

Its been decades since I last traveled through Nashville The transformation of this airport is amazing The international arrivals facility has Global Entry but no Mobile Passport Control Give yourself plenty of time at least hours to make connecting flights The lines care very long and the distances from the gates to Immigration and Customs are very long The terminal was very crowded however with wheelchair assist we were able to breeze through Immigration The only drawback is that one has to exit the secured area and go through TSA security all over again with very long lines Once youre through the security one is met with wide open very clean and brightly lit concourses with dining and shopping aplenty Restrooms were very clean The free airport WiFi was easy to connect to and very fast

Excellent airport having recently done a roundtrip from Dundee to Birmingham It is really convenient for those working in and around Dundee with reliable flights from both Flybe and Cityjet Air France If you need to get away from Dundee Birmingham and London are ideal for onward connections and you dont have the hassle of having to drive to Edinburgh pay for parking and the long check in times Here you can checkin mins prior to your flight
Short but pleasant flight on time Friendly crew cheap tickets clean plane and for a such a short flight a good snack was offered Boarding and deboarding fast

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

Return leg was an older model configured in Business about half full Actually the seating is better than the configuration as you have more feet room Food was really good especially the Salmon Cod and Prawn ceviche a true delight The bed was comfortable and the service attentive movie choice the same as going out days previous One criticism is that priority bags do not come out first I awaited mins for my bag to arrive and nearly missed my connection although arriving at and a departure on next flight at The second leg on older plane entertainment system not working at all Breakfast and service was good arrived on time and again no priority bags first This is one area they need to work on Hence Ground service only star
It is clean modern spacious and well designed The efficiency of security is high The WiFi connection is good Employees are helpful and polite

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home
A smallish airport with limited facilities but clean and comfortable

Manado airport is one of the best in Indonesia It has a small delay rate and has a very good view from the waiting room The airport terminal faces east of Manado and oversees the beautiful nature and mountain ranges with the planes takingoff and landing

Sawyer is a small airport in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan with flights to Detroit and Chicago provided by Delta and American respectively There is a small store selling Northern Michigan University paraphernalia some basic snacks and coffee The major car rental firms have desks in the terminal with the cars parked just outside The parking is excellent you walk out of the terminal into the parking lot Less than a minutes walk from the airport entrance to the security check area The terminal has excellent free wifi service courtesy Northern Michigan University Very friendly and efficient staff Taxi service is available to the city of Marquette about miles away

Larnaca to Athens This is registered as a Cypriot airline yet it seems that they are against the local language in that safety instructions are given only in english On this airline it is impossible to select a free seat only paid seats can be selected via web The aircraft was more than perfect clean but was not near jetways and bus was used for boarding In flight magazine price list and safety instructions were overused Nothing was offered during the flight if you want a drink you pay for it

Tenerife Norte to Gran Canaria Excellent airline clean and new plane They offer a chocolate snack and a glass of water and a candy just before landing all this in a minute flight There is even a wifi entertainment system on board The best airline I have used

Rex Airlines is a standout in terms of professionalism and helpfulness Their call centres are here in Australia staffed by knowledgeable and problem solving women sorry men I have just dealt with amazing women Rex is our airline of choice when it flies where we need to go It is hands down better than the other airlines based in Australia and is a reminder that an airline can work well and treat customers with personal and professional service

Quite a small airport compared to the Dubai or Abu Dhabi International Airports Only half a dozen or airlines serve this airport On arrival myself and wife senior citizens were treated with compassion and helped by the airport customs and immigration staff No difficulties faced by us we found the airport quite peaceful neat and tidy I wish more flights were available to and from this Airport in UAE Travel to city center of Al Ain a charming city in the midst of the Arabian desert was also a pleasant experience with hardly any traffic problems
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

The arrivals hall at the international terminal is clean and tidy but does not cope well with any more than large aircraft arriving at the same time It can take over an hour to clear customs and there is only one baggage conveyor The only ATM is after passport control and you will need PGK if you wish to purchase a visa so it pays to have your currency ready before you depart for POM The departure lounge is also very clean and tidy and customs and immigration are efficient However if you wish to do shopping there is only one very small duty free shop and an even smaller cafe after customs and security

Horizon Air from Seattle to Eugene roundtrip No complaints the crews were great planes clean and on time in both directions As with all of Horizon Air flights free beverages including wine and beer are provided The aircraft was perfect for the less than one hour flight to SeaTac quite fast actually The skies were clear and the view was perfect Nice job all the way around

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience

Beijing to Pyongyang The aircraft was clean cabin crew friendly and the flight on time You get the Pyongyang Times to read aboard I flew for the first time this type of a Tupolev and found not much difference to some other aircraft The food was acceptable The selections of beverages could be better

Contrary to all of the recent negative press about airports and their staff our experience flying and coming back in was seamless Given the pressure that all airport staff are under they are doing an amazing job and are doing it with a smile We travelled down to Newcastle from Scotland and stayed in the Premier Inn the night before I would have no hesitation in using this airport again Well done to all of the staff

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

I had a wonderful experience flying with Vistara Airlines recently and I cant praise their staff enough especially Ankush and Manisha From the moment I arrived at the airport they made the entire checkin process incredibly smooth and stressfree Ankush was welcoming and guided me through each step with such professionalism making sure I had all the information I needed His calm and friendly demeanor made a normally hectic process feel easy and seamless Manisha was equally attentive helping me with my questions and ensuring I felt comfortable with every detail of my journey Their teamwork and dedication truly reflect Vistaras commitment to exceptional service Not only did they make the checkin experience smooth but they also set a positive tone for the rest of my trip The flight was equally enjoyable with clean cabins comfortable seating and excellent inflight service Thank you Vistara and a special shoutout to Ankush and Manisha for going above and beyond to make my journey a pleasant one I highly recommend Vistara Airlines for their superb staff and topnotch service

Berne Airport Airport of the Capital of Switzerland is a regional airport with connections to Europes major cities Also connecting to the international hubs of Munich and Amsterdam CheckIn time only minutes prior to departure time Airport Authority is building a new terminal which will be opened by may Temporary terminal is in use until the opening of the new terminal Staff is very friendly The motto is to serve the passenger from leaving the taxi or public transport until boarding the aircraft

I flew fom Bergerac airport to Stansted today When i had cleared baggage body and passport check I went to the lounge to realise to my horror that I hadnt got my belt from the body check I spent minutes contemplating how I was shortly destined to be walking round London with my trousers falling down because I didnt have my belt on As we were summoned to the gate I was overjoyed to hear an announcement from Bergerac Airport or Ryanair saying that my belt had been found I am so happy I feel moved to thank and complement whichever staff or system meant that I was reunited with my belt Well done

Going to Washington Dulles Airport is easy when departing and arriving regardless of connectionsgood staff lounges and great AeroTrains and Mobile Lounges to connect different terminals They have good food in various terminals and airline lounges

Used Hamilton Airport as an alternative airport to Toronto A much smaller airport than Pearson a good thing resulting in much less walking and waiting and much easier to get in and out of A great option if youre visiting Southern Ontario or Niagara Falls if you want to avoid the Toronto traffic and is km from downtown Toronto Not the greatest airport for public transit links to Hamilton and Toronto and beyond likely due to the airports small size Airport was slightly built on the cheap has exterior siding and drop celling interiors reminding me of a bus terminal and has very limited foodshopping options Despite these minor complaints overall a good alternative to Pearson for direct flights and would use it again
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again

This company is horrific We had a cancelation of our flight back home and this airline refused to refund our money Fly Maya Island Air They are exceptional less expensive and very flexible The planes are also shady You will not regret flying Maya Island Air Have a wonderful and safe flight

I flew Brisbane to Honiara on the th April Flight Left early was only full and arrived minutes early Add kg of luggage good plentiful food and beer what more could you want Entertainment was poor but its only a hour flight so I survived Staff friendly which is much more than I can say about the BA Qantas staff on the Flights coming out from Ireland

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

Ive flown in and out of Pau several times Its a lovely airport with a pleasant smallness about it The only downside for me is that from the UK it is only served by Ryanair On principle I will no longer fly with them If any other UK carrier starts using Pau I will happily fly there again

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Both terminals are badly designed and difficult to get around Getting to baggage claim on a WestJet arrival means going up and down a flight of stairs or escalator about times The most ridiculous way to baggage claim I have ever seen No one to help at baggage carousels It is worth the drive to Buffalo Niagara International Airport if you are going to a US destination from Toronto That airport is clean easy to get around and very nice people working at airline counters TSA etc

Im very fond of this airline this was my fifth time flying on the BeirutLondon flight and there is a real consistency in terms of service food and comfort The plane is very new the seats spacious and the IFE is good Flight was ontime Crew were friendly and polite and the meal was satisfying there was a choice between mains Wine and beer was offered and I had no problem at all getting some additional topups during the hour flight A good flight on a very nice and littleknown airline

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

I have a been a frequent traveler of AustinBergstrom Airport AUSKAUS since the airport opened back in I have seen the airport grow and change over the years The changes over the years have been for the better Notable things about AustinBergstrom International AUS there are two terminals the main Barbara Jordan terminal where all the restaurants lounges and stores are and the South Terminal currently Allegiant and Frontier Airlines there is a family viewing area outside the airport for watching planes and having a picnic There are currently lounges AA UA DL and a Chase Sapphire Terrace there are many good places to eat including many local restaurants my favorite are Taco Deli Salt Lick BBQ Second Bar Kitchen Annies and Juiceland it takes about minutes to walk from one end of the terminal to the other along the way you will see lots of places to eat drink and shop Pros clean great dining bars and rest areas The Delta lounge is the nicest lounge in the airport Cons restaurants close early so if you arrive on a lateish flight you will not have food options

After reading several negative reviews on this page regarding LPA Gran Canaria airport I wish to make a defence I find the airport similar to many of the Spanish airports operated by Aena in that it handles the volume of passengers proportionately and professionally Bear in mind the vast majority of passengers passing through the airport are there for leisure purposes this has always been a difficult balancing act to please the foot traffic Knowledge and preplanning are the key to success Informative information can be found online about the airport for example httpsgrancanariaairportcom is just one example Especially in this day and age with covid and the uncertainly about travel with changing restrictions it is paramount that planning ahead to provide a heads up of potential problems and issues is a must

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Despite a delay of about minutes overall it was a good flight Check in was easy the flight attendants were friendly and efficient and the plane was clean and comfortable The only free beverage was water which was no issue on such a short flight

Free food and snacks provided Great wifi Nice comfortable chairs like a business lounge I was able to walk to my accommodation which Ive never done before Very easy access to Toronto with a short free ferry ride and then streetcar available on Bathurst St Very nice small airport

Tiny But stunning location Barra Aiport sits on the edge of a wide beach on the Scottish Island of Barra Twice a day once in winter flights from Glasgow and Benbencula land on one of the three runways But these are no ordinary tarmac runways These are marked out on the sand of the beach and only when the tide is out The flights are the only British Airways flights where the timetable is marked subject to tide The terminal a proper little toytown terminal complete with tiny terminal control tower big burly firemen and one checkin desk No compromise though on safety checks and procedures Be sure to be here in good time to watch the incoming Twin Otter fly in and land on the beach The tiny cafe sells lovely home made organic snacks and the whole experiences is a joy if you have only been used to the hustle and bustle and chaos of some large well known international terminals If a glorious sunny day checkin good and early and take time to stroll three hundred yards up over the dunes to see the other stunning beach close to this amazing little airport

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

Small international airport International flights limited to a few charters from China Arrival hall domestic has only one conveyor belt which did not work on the day I arrived so luggage were brought in very swiftly by handcart Taxi and shuttle bus available to city center km away Domestic departure hall is adequate and departure gates have sufficient seating a coffee shop and wifi

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more

Portland to Klamath Falls one way Flight was delayed about an hour due to the need to get a part for the aircraft from another plane Ground staff did their best to keep passengers in the loop Aircraft was clean enough but is clearly an old plane Onboard service was friendly and professional The single aisle row seems to be the most comfortable
Contrary to another review there are good facilities after passport control Including shops Bistro and cafe Very clean and definitely not a shed

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

Connected through this airport with Delta It seems slightly older and smaller than Narita Passing through security was quick and painless The place is clean and has an open and bright feeling There are standard airport shopping opportunities if you are interested The meal options seemed severely limited which would be my only real complaint however I believe it is a large complaint because airplane food is awful

Kaohsiung International Airport is great but small There are some shops and restaurants The biggest point is that the airport is clean quiet and efficient the directions are clear as well Besides this international airport are really near downtown Kaohsiung The subway system is partially done recently you can take the KMRT to any place in downtown

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

NRT to TPE with JX on AUG and back with JX on AUG in Business Class for both legs I had always wanted to take a Starlux flight Before boarding at NRT I spent time in JAL Sakura lounge as Starlux doesnt have its own The inflight meal on the flight bound for TPE didnt satisfy my appetite Concretely speaking a grilled pork shoulder in sauce was tasteless I regretted not having preordered it Also champagne was served not so cold For my part I am not so interested in inflight entertainment On my return from Taipei prior to boarding I entered the Galactic lounge at Taoyuan airport T What surprised most was that they offered an a la carte menu on which I found an appetizing salmon steak and ordered it How tasty The dish served on the flight one similar to beef steak was totally different from the previous one It was superb The generous flow of chilled BOLLINGER champagne delighted me well Meticulous services offered by a Japanese flight attendant are worthy of a special mention Though this was a short haul or a hourandminute flight I could not help wishing it would be much longer Both flights were punctual

Ive been through this airport several times and I must say its incredibly clean and sparkling and definitely puts Gatwick to shame The people of Tunisia are very friendly which adds to the overall positive experience However I have a concern regarding the pricing While all airports tend to charge fees the prices here seem a bit exorbitant I wonder why this is the case Additionally I have a personal issue with the height of the walkway that crosses about meters up I understand this might not be a problem for most but it would be great if the sides of the walkway could be covered for those of us who arent fond of heights Other than these few points its an excellent airport with great service

Friendly little country airport in Australia Quiet clean terminal building with enough space for passengers using the frequent Regional Express Airlines Saab services This airport is well positioned between the towns of Narrandera and Leeton and has easy access to the main road to these centres It also has rental car services Best of all it was quiet and peaceful so one could do some work while waiting for flights no blaring television in the corner as is often the case these days Pleasant airport checkin staff at Regional Express as well
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

Excellent airline Flights outbound and return were on time if not early Service and staff were helpful and friendly and the plane was very comfortable Definitely recommend them The only negatives the film choice was not great for an English speaker and there was if anything too much food served

I have flown from Sligo airport a few times in the past A very clean and well maintained airport and a pleasure to fly from Very freindly staff and parking very cheap and beside the terminal Security fast and efficient Cafe bar and toilets are open to left of check in area Sligo airport in a sense can now be called an international airport because of new flights to Manchester in the UK Expansion of the runway is in the pipeline and the airport hopes to have a new route to London in the future Aer Arann serves the airport with all flights a good airline with cheap return flights and usually always on time Always a taxi near by the main entrance and bus service available from strandhill town into Sligo city centre that is about miles away Road network is basic but acceptable Overall a pleasant airport

Small airport arrival was smooth half hour queue at immigration but bags waiting for uson departure ten minutes from check in to be sat at the gate on comfortable seats and soft carpetairport is very clean and did not come across any rude staffin fact they were very polite

Praslin to Mahe Over zealous security screening at Praslin when they noticed we had packed a small pack of batteries in our hold baggage Had to take out every item of clothing until they were found and no time to repack On check in we thought we had prepaid for excess baggage via our travel agent only to be told it had not gone through Staff could see that we had completed the process but still charged us the airport price rather than the online price Staff completely unhelpful and appeared to take great pleasure in making things as difficult as possible Would not give us any assistance of any contact details Currently taking up the issue with their customer services and the office of their CEO Flight cramped and noisy recommend ear plugs and very warm Plus side it was shorter than most bus journey I normally take No assistance offered by ground crew getting on or off the plane with flimsy hand rail and low doorway
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

A very easy and pleasant airport to use On arrival I was able to exit the terminal in less than five minutes In the arrival concourse is a staffed information booth a shop closed when I arrived at night and rental car booths Taxis waited outside I called a Uber Departure was likewise very easy I printed out my boarding passes from a machine The shop gifts snacks and reading materials was open University of Notre Dame paraphernalia was noticeable TSA security check was unhurried and polite After security there are a couple of good places to eat and drink The bathrooms were clean The concourse was airy with high ceiling and glass panes that allowed you to watch tarmac and runway activity The airport is about a minute drive from downtown South Bend

The airport has been and still under going renovations The issues with no food past security have been fixed The wait times are typically very short Security can become long on Monday mornings but typically it is very quick as well Walking distances to and from gates as well as to and from parkingcar rental are rather short There are no miles walks to gates or otherwise The biggest issue with the airport is the quality of staff at food outlets but that is not much different at a lot of airports Overall it is a very good midsize airport

Windhoek to Frankfurt After having read reviews I was prepared for bad service and problems during the flight but luckily everything was fine and I am quite happy with the overall experience The aircraft is spacious and clean seats are comfortable and have a pillow and a blanket for each passenger The crew was very friendly and not so good cop bad cop The food was quite good however it might have been better maybe a dessert could be added Big selection of drinks but only one type of juice orange On the long overnight flight dinner and breakfast have been offered During the flight the crew also offered water The entertainment system is still not working it seems to be a persistent problem that the airline is not willing to solve

Hamad International Airport is nice brand new airport Very spacious and clean Good wifi line and plenty of free desktop for internet Seats are everywhere and they are comfortable Charging points are available throughout this airport Many choices for food and shopping However I find that the price is rather high
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

On time departure from Larnaca to Leipzig Very friendly crew I was surprised that of them including first officer was from Greece and Cyprus Very nice and colorful aircraft that makes your day Wind in Leipzig was not calm it was about kts Perfect landing

Vistara stands out as a premium fullservice carrier offering a superior travel experience that consistently impresses From checkin to landing the attention to detail and customer focus is evident making it one of the best choices for both domestic and international travel in India The cabin crew is exceptionally professional courteous and attentive ensuring passengers feel comfortable throughout the journey The seating arrangement especially in Premium Economy and Business Class provides ample legroom and ergonomic comfort ideal for long flights The inflight entertainment options are diverse catering to various preferences and the complimentary meals are thoughtfully curated offering both quality and variety Punctuality is another area where Vistara excels with flights often departing and arriving on time Additionally the checkin process is seamless and the airline staff are welltrained to handle queries efficiently The partnership with Singapore Airlines also adds a layer of credibility and enhances the overall experience That said Vistaras ticket prices can be slightly higher than budget carriers but the services provided justify the cost For those who value comfort reliability and excellent service Vistara is worth every penny Its an airline that truly redefines air travel in India with its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction

Went through Cairo airport during my recent trip arriving from Emirates and leaving to the UK both in terminal Despite the long queues in departure being a bit of a hassle the coordinators were incredibly helpful They did their best to address any issues and kept things moving as smoothly as possible The terminal itself is pretty modern and clean the lounge is amazing and while it could use a few more amenities i would say it was an overall satisfying experience a solid out of

I arrived at Cape Town International Airport and had to wait for my baggage almost minutes This was a local flight from JNB to CPT This is not my first bad experience of the same nature in recent weeks

Super tiny Airport like a bus terminal in my town but it was a quite clean and cozy place Location is nice not far from city and you can get there from city center by local bus for about euro There were nice sofas inside and the toilet was neat and clean
I would like to thank Alessandra at the customer services desk for the phenomenal service and friendliness she has provided me at the airport She is an absolute gem

Cant fault this airport at all the staff are very friendly helpful I found the experience of arrival departure stress free Its nice clean one of the friendliest airports I have ever been to on my holidays abroad

Very nice small airport easy check in with friendly staff Plenty of seating in the airport with small selection of shops and restaurants and bars Parking for cars very close to terminal and with plenty of spaces Easy access to main roads when you leave the airport Baggage reclaim very quick A pleasure to arrive at this airport
New facilities in the national arrivalsdepartures concourse very nice modern terminal new roads from Quito recently finished so the trip to city is quicker and easier overall great airport

Small airport dating back to the early days of aviation when the thinking was that would be aerodromes in most towns Today BUR is convenient airport for those wishing to avoid LAX You pick up your bags from the baggage conveyor belt outside the terminal

Had a missing baggage when landing at Victoria Falls Airlinks staff was very helpful in tracing and rerouting this baggage to Nairobi where I was when they traced the baggage Awesome customer experience

The airport is different from how I last saw it Its been renovated and finally reached an international standard Theres a lovely restaurant on the th floor called Oea I had a wonderful meal there Theres also a quaint but useful duty free section A first class lounge can also be found close to the Duty Free section Air conditioning and spacious areas throughout makes this airport impressive and comfortable

The terminal offers an array of restaurants and shops which gives passengers a well rounded experience The security was smooth and quick with just only a few passengers waiting in line The airport has a very white theme which makes the interior very bright Staff at the airport are generally helpful and able to speak basic to intermediate level of English I had troubles connecting to the WiFi network I asked the airport staffs to help me out because they couldnt figure out the reason of not being able to connect the WiFi All in all Bahrain Airport is one of the nicest airports to travel in addition to Doha and Muscat Airports

This little airport is very nice and adapted to the demand and number of passengers There was only one cafe but with nice food and drinks Because of the small numbers of passengers traveling through that airport there was absolutely no waiting I would defenitly go there again

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Not the newest airplane but the cabin is clean and it is in the new configuration where you do not need to cross your neighbors if you stand up Food on this short route is classic Air stewardess always perfect as expected from Korean Air

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use

Honiara on the island of Guadalcanal is the capital of the Solomon Islands in the South West Pacific and the only international airport in the country The traffic flow into Solomon Islands is minimal about six or seven flights a week mainly filled with Australian government officials Asian businessmen and the odd tourist The terminal itself was built by the Japanese Government about It is not airconditioned and can be very warm and humid inside given that Honiara is in the middle of the tropics Due to water and plumbing problems the toilets can be unpleasant It is a good idea to check in two hours before hand as checkin queues can be long as departure time approaches Flights are often delayed but airport staff are unlikely to be able to tell you much one way of checking to see if your departure will be on time is to check the Brisbane Airport website to see if the flight left Brisbane for Honiara on time Customs and security is usually quick on departure but customs and immigration can be somewhat slower on arrival Forget duty free shopping on departure shop in Honiara town instead On arrival sometimes the duty free booth is open and if so it does offer good prices on alcohol All in all a hot humid experience which will not leave you feeling terribly comfortable On the plus side staff are usually helpful and cheerful and cleanliness has improved considerably over the last couple of years

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

Very impressed with HiSky The trip from JFK and back from OTP was on par with major airlines we had entertainment and good food I loved the breakfast Romanian sausages crenwurst The flight attendants were pleasant and helpful flight was on time each way It would be useful if they partnered with United or a US airline to connect flights Right now its a hassle to connect into JFK on two tickets

I recently slipped a disc and needed assistance at Gibraltar airport I cant say just how heartwarming it was to be met by the lovely Sam and guided through what can be a pretty stressful experience with genuine humanity and not a few laughs along the way Shes a real gem as were all other staff involved from check in to departure Another client asked what happened as we were raised into the transport and an attendant whod had a similar injury gave some really good supplementary advice as we disappeared I do a fair amount of travelling and that was a rare experience Thank you all
OPOMIR return Cabin crew friendly breakfast served it was nothing special but not bad for plane food There was no entertainment onboard but the planes were clean

I live in Dubai marina and this is a fantastic option to travel from Small quiet check in to boarding in minutes Its still in its infancy before being ramped up to being a hub but it is a joy to use compared to big busy DXB Bags are always office in minutes and you sail through immigration

Liked the airport of Edmonton Very efficient security and no big walking distances A nice bright design that make you feel comfortable Besides there are a lot of shopping and dining options here This Airport can be a role model how regional midsize airports should be

Flight slightly delayed but arrived slightly ahead of time by minutes Crew well presented and very professional Meal type and beverage selection an overkill for such a short flight Will fly Eswatini Air again

I enjoyed lengthy stop overs here on a recent flight to BKK in Biz class with Gulf Air The airport is amazing clean and transit was smooth The lounge was fantastic and food and drinks were excellent Staff throughout the airport were amenable and friendly Overall it is a much less stress free and agreeable experience in comparison to transit through Doha or Dubai

Air New Zealand representative named Leanne was very helpful when I needed help to check in my ft surfboard she was helpful when I needed help to print out my boarding pass exceptional patience and excellent customer skills

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

IND is one of our two main options along with CVG when flying Both are excellent Traveling from Indy this week reminded me why I like it In morning and afternoon there are multiple good choices and most are reasonably priced in comparison to many other world airports crowds are nowhere near some airports so it is easy to move around TSA has always been friendly and efficient unlike some airports restrooms are generally cleaner than many other airports We do wish there were a couple of direct flights options to Europe but for flying domestically we like IND
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

Great regional airport Friendly people and some little shops It is nice and clean everything goes fast I have never waited more than minutes The flights to Munich and Frankfurt gives opportunities to travel from there and the flights to Antalya and other vacation destinations are great too

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge

Yangon to Nyaung My wife and me flew three routes with Air KBZ over our holiday in Myanmar and we got outstanding service every time The cabin crew all have excellent presentation and are very courteous and attentive We had a cold snack tea and coffee all of which were very tasty on all flights Its unusual to be given cream cakes at am but they were very nice All aircraft used were very clean and in good condition and all flights departed and arrived exactly on time Air KBZ is way better than we expected
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided

Nice and clean airport As an avgeek I love watching planes and there are so many big windows next to restaurants to watch planes Security wasnt long The checkin staff were really nice On arrival Immigration was really quick and baggage claim was surprisingly quick Very quick and free wifi
Taipei Hualein TaiChung Both flights by ATR cabin was clean and comfortable Very friendly crew Drinks service on both flights
A quiet domestic airport with adequate facilities though passengers are open to the elements on boarding and disembarking from aircraft
The plane was in a good condition even for an old plane Both flights were on time On the minute flight there was no service Staff of the airline were professional and quick at check in No echeck in

Our outbound flight was delayed which caused us to miss our connecting flight to Toronto with another airline The delay was due to a late inbound flight This created a small issue in Montreal but the other airline was able to get us on a later flight The flight itself was uneventful Service on board was good flight attendants were fantastic and friendly

Modern and clean airport The transit is really strange like you have to get into China and leave China again Came from Beijing to Singapore via Shenzhen Convenient airport lot of shops reasonable price airports many eateries Western Chinese Easy to find your way to the gate Ground staff do not smile
Great airline Very friendly staff Flown with this airline around times and never had a bad experience only of my flights have Been delayed and none cancelled

Traveling through Murtala International airport in Lagos Nigeria is an experience Staff are generally friendly and smiled a lot My documents were repeatedly checked I counted ten checkpoints altogether At five of them I was asked if I would hand over some money They weirdest situation was that the customs officer asked how much money I carry and then after hearing the honest as he was a customs officer answer asked me if I would give him some of it The airport is quite run down and processes are not streamlined Boarding was rather chaotic with passengers placed on different coloured seats after the boarding passes were scanned

The airport staff are friendly and the waiting time is short very convenient because there are many transport choices to choose The seats are comfortable and there are the sky bridge let me see the airplanes

In the UK it is pretty difficult to get a fullservice airline offering direct flights to anywhere except Heathrow or Gatwick The socalled lowcost carriers dominate Having flown the competition we reluctantly tried Jet for our flights to and from Madeira In many ways Jet proved to be a long rung above the competition kg of checked luggage and kg of hand luggage plus a handbag or laptop bag are included as standard The seats are as you would expect on this type of airline minimalist The cabin crew were friendly and the drinks and food onboard appeared to be reasonably priced I cannot vouch for the quality of the hot or cold food as we did not try it Flights out and back were on time and boarding was smooth and efficient

It was really nice experience this was my first journey with Vistara I am feet height and still I was able to sit comfortably They provided food also after long time get food in Indian domestic flight was a good feel Every days we used to get in jet and kingfisher airlines It was a nice experience now waiting for my connecting flight to Dubai

Keflavk to Copenhagen This flight was operated on anew Aneo showcasing Icelandairs Saga Class the airlines Business Class product Although the flight was delayed by three hours an uncommon occurrence given Icelandairs excellent ontime performance access to the Saga Lounge at Keflavk ensured the wait was a comfortable one The flight itself was smooth and pleasant While the Saga Class seats are not lieflat they are wellcushioned and provide ample comfort for the short journey The onboard service was warm and efficient Overall no complaints Icelandairs Saga Class delivers the most comfortable option for travel between Iceland and Europe or the Nordics

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience

XIYCTUAUH Arrived from Xian on domestic flight in Terminal which was newly opened in Spring All very clean and tidy with clear signs in Mandarin and English Quite a long walk to Baggage Reclaim for the furthest gates but not unreasonable Toilets clean and plentiful with both squat and regular options For International Departures there are main dining options before Checkin either KFC or local Chinese food There are a few stores selling various local foods and some souvenirs CheckIn pretty good and Passport Control and Security all pretty smooth No requirement to remove belts or laptops for security scanning but do enforce the ml liquid rules from Europe In the International Departures no dining opportunities but a couple of coffeeshop options along with the usual array of Duty Free shops Most departures are from one of the airbridges Announcements made in both Chinese and English Toilets are clean

Round trip from Guatemala to Roatan via San Pedro Sula and Tegucigalpa respectively June For all hour flying segments service was exemplary lunch box on every flight with delicious sandwiches On the way back departing Roatan plane was intensively checked for an oil leakage threatening our connection at Tegucigalpa with passengers getting nervous about the situation but TACA agent in the waiting room was reassuring Even offered a free phone call to Guatemala The plane got fix and we landed just in time in Tegucigalpa with TACA personnel waiting for us at the door of the plane with umbrellas over the tarmac to get to the other plane When we landed in Guatemala all luggage arrived too Great service from all the involved staff at all the airports and flights
Short but pleasant flight on time Friendly crew cheap tickets clean plane and for a such a short flight a good snack was offered Boarding and deboarding fast

Flew Lublin to Heraklion Very comfortale trip without delays friendly helpful and professional crew good amtosphere on board everything fast and without problems I felt safe during the journey and I think that I will choose Small Planet for my next year holiday

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

Arrival from and departure to Shanghai I hadnt been to Tianjin for years its now one of those standard new Asian airports all sweeping steel and glass and marble Its easy to navigate and checkin and security are quick and efficient Theres cheap Internet access airside landside too but it was down and reasonable food options on both airside and landside Theres lots of room and seating and airport as a whole and the toilets are clean A metered taxi to or from the city is around RMB My only criticism would be the flight announcements they have one of those computers that says Fliight xxx from xxx to xxx is now checking in at gate xxx I dont know why these computers have the From xxx bit in China youre in Tianjin or wherever so its pretty obvious where the flight is from The computer couldnt pronounce Tianjin which made this even more irritating youd have thought they could find a computer that could pronounce the name of their own airport But otherwise it was lovely

As the previous reviewer noted Eilat airport terminal is in the centre of the city and surrounded by hotels I didnt believe the taxi driver for a few seconds when he dropped us there Once inside we got a thorough grilling by security and our bags swabbed throughout for explosives I think we got extra attention as foreigners but the female security official was very friendly and jovial much nicer that the humourless officials who you normally meet Checkin and hand baggage checks were quick and easy as the only flight was our seater Arkia departure There is a shopcafe on both landside and airside parts but we didnt get a chance to try either Overall it does the job well just be prepared for the security

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airways and had a fantastic experience The flight crew was attentive and professional ensuring everything ran smoothly from boarding to landing The aircraft was clean and comfortable and the service was prompt despite the short flight duration The pilot provided clear updates and the entire trip was seamless A great example of efficient and excellent regional service

Great service overall Timely departure after very organized boarding procedure Aircraft clean and well air conditioned for boarding Staff very friendly and professional Good meal service with table cloth tableware and drinks in glasses Good infos from cockpit Would surely fly Thai Smile again

China Eastern Airlines customer service has been improved dramatically since before the pandemic of COVID In economy class I feel well treated by cabin crew and everyone was so kind and well motivated I have ordered the vegetarian meal and I was not enjoyed the the cabin crew brought me nice food to replace Especially flight MU compared to MU I flew with this month the cabin crew did really fantastic job The only thing I was a bit disappointed is there is very limited option of inflight entertainment especially in A which was MU flight But overall both two aircrafts had fantastic leg space for a cm tall guy

The best airport in the Middle East and Europe Staff service is very good Checkin procedure was fast and efficient The airport amentities are quite good good cafes to eat something Segafredo for coffee Duty Free is really very big and the selection is quite large
Kuala Lumpur to Pangkor Island return This is the most pleasant way of flying for those who love airplanes

A wonderful little airport So impressed While it was busy at the peak of the holiday season everything moved quickly and efficiently The shops airside while small have a great selection of Spanish specialties like olive oil I hope the new airport that opens next year keeps up the same high standards

JNZDLC Flight departed and arrived on schedule Aircraft was newish MA clean and tidy Cabin announcements in English as well as Chinese but no cabin service only hour flight so acceptable especially given price of ticket RMB Aircraft named Modern Ark apt as modernised Chinese version of old Antinov design Overall perfectly acceptable
Fantastic airport I go in and out at least once a month Yesterday I timed my arrival and from walking off the plane to being outside at a taxi was seconds minute check in for departures

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

Flew on four separate legs within Myanmar and found them to be surprisingly good You dont normally expect catering on flights of under an hour but there was something on all segments Arrived in good time at Heho Airport for a flight to Yangon and they automatically put me on to an earlier departure There is a certain amount of third world amateurism about the boarding process but it all seemed to work
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

The onground experience was great very pleasant checkin experience the Adani lounge has a separate section for Vistara Frequent Fliers and Business Class which is quite nice The onboard experience is a bit soso the legroom in economy is fairly tight and feels less than Indigo They have cutdown on the quantity of food in meals visibly in economy class The IFE was good enough to keep oneself entertained and thankfully with the middle seat remaining empty the flight was quite comfortable

Ive lived in El Paso for two years now for school and I often use the airport to visit my hometown as well as other destinations The busiest Ive ever seen the airport from the time of walking through the doors checking baggage going through security and getting to my gate was about minutes Christmas vacation time Ive even got through in minutes Its a smaller airport with only one terminal thats ever used and about gates so from security to walk to your gate takes maybe minutes This isnt one of the airports youll need to devote hours in order to get through it Id say hour is fine because you never know even if it does only take minutes to get to your gate and maybe during busy holiday times or if youre going to have to check the whole family might even be hours for that

High marks for YOW Transited from USA to international There is no sterile transit area One has to enter Canada and then go through security again but the process was fast I was number at passport control Service personnel uniformly nice and helpful Reasonable number of shops and eateries for a small airport Well done Ottawa

If you dont need to go to Denver I recommend COS as the best option for going to Colorado Small but not too small clean efficient quick and centrally located to most points in Colorado Good quick car rentals I use it routinely to go to Pueblo and Denver Yes Denver as it can be more convenient and faster to get to a lot of places especially in south Denver Remember Denver airport is miles east and an expensive toll road from many points in Denver Also traffic is very congested in Denver but only moderately so in Colorado Springs Only problem I have is that most often but not always the cheaper fares are into and out of Denver

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

I have been flying with Volotea for years and have never had any problems I believe that the company is one of the best in existence This is due to all the staff and the company organization Sono anni che volo con Volotea non ho avuto mai problemi Ritengo che la compagnia sia una delle migliori tra quelle in essere Questo merito vs al personale tutto e allorganizzazione aziendale

We had some troubles getting to the airport and were so worried we were going to be late We arrived at the check in counter just a few minutes late but the Jin Air employees were so kind and accommodating They got us through security and to our gate and we made a flight we otherwise would have definitely missed Just so grateful Thank you

It was an easy online check in Due to other company flight delays I was short on time to drop my bag in When I arrived it was too late for me to print my bag tag Ricky at LAX directed me to an operator who printed my tag and checked my bag in Flight was also great Service when needed but nice and quiet during the night to sleep I recommend Delta Air Lines

Same plane on both DALDCA and DCAPVD Aircraft was very clean with the pleasant flight crew providing the usual no frills service IFE worked flawlessly There was a good selection of movies and live TV however there are no power ports to charge personal devices at the seats iPhones or iPads An added bonus on the connecting flight to PVD I got a whole row to myself which is a rarity nowadays

Naha airport has undergone some renovation and expansion it keeps improving each time I go there Being a small airport arrival is easy and luggage waiting time is not too long customs are also friendly and easy to pass through There is a major improvement in checkin areas for international flights and some domestic Used to be in a cramped little area now its a lot more spacious There is also a big improvement in food offering before immigration Once passed international immigration you will be left with very little choice I believe they are still undergoing some major facelifts for the departure gate areas maybe more stores will be added soon Overall this is a charming little regional airport which is easy to move around

Modern airport surprisingly efficient compared with some other internal Russian airports Arrival facilities good baggage on the conveyor without a long wait On departure check in facilities were good security efficient and the Skyteam business lounge was of a high standard with free Internet connection although all drinks etc had to be paid for

Its always a pleasure going through this airport It is clean spacious and easy to navigate Immigration and customs are always fast and efficient There are a good number of dutyfree shops although not as many food outlets

I chose this airline for the simple reason of its aircraft type Boarding was completed quickly for on time departure On board seat pitch was a little tight snack service box was offered water and a sweet coffee bun and a sales trolley after that Cabin was quite warm and no walk though by cabin crew offering water Cabin is showing it age for sure but still enjoyed my flight

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

Great restaurant upstairs that serves main course meals and happy to work in your time frame for your flight Modern building and brilliant to depart and arrive from if you live anywhere nearby Just make sure you check the kind of aircraft being used for your flight If you do NOT want to be on a small regional or propeller plane your choices are limited Nothing better than arriving at HPN and getting home locally in under minutes

The schedules are well respected and the staff is excellent Boarding and disembarkation are quick The plane is clean and the information is clear Les horaires sont bien respects et le personnel est parfait Lembarquement se fait rapidement ainsi que le dbarquement Lavion est propre et les informations sont claires

Apart from the fact that the crew at Incheon were a little rude everything was perfect For a low cost airline the seats were very comfy and the legroom was amazing I would definitely recommend this airline

I fly weekly for work and Gerald R Ford Intl Airport in Grand Rapids is one of my two homebase airports Its served by American Delta United Southwest and Allegiant and has nonstop flights to twentysomething destinations I primarily fly American and mostly take flights that connect through Chicago OHare or DallasFort Worth GRR is a larger regional airport with two concourses of gates each but not a large airport by any means I can park in the garage walk in clear security TSA PreCheck and walk to my gate within minutes of driving into the garage I love that kind of convenience Employees are friendly and helpful pretty much across the board at the airline counters security and at the gates GRR recently finished a fairly large renovation in late They now have one central security checkpoint and a central area with new shopping and dining including a local brewpub Starbucks and a Michiganthemed souvenir shop There are also new lounge areas childrens play area and a business center not to mention new large restrooms In general GRR operates on time which is key for me Most delays Ive experienced have come from aircraft delayed at their originating airport mostly OHare Im basically comfortable relying on this airport for my weekly business travel needs
Great airline Very friendly staff Flown with this airline around times and never had a bad experience only of my flights have Been delayed and none cancelled

I guess the main factor to consider when assessing TVM aiport is perspective Most visitors to the airport are NRI returning home Hence issues like good shopping and dining dont really matter to most As an NRI what I really want is fast processing whether it is arrival or departure This has historically been the major lament about Indian aiports In this regard TVM airport gets top marks It is easy to drive into and there is good parking space Ticketing security checks and immigration are fairly quick and the aiport staff do not hassle you as long as you have your valid documents ready it is better to have a printed ticket with you It is not a fancy airport although the buildings are modern and clean but I am very proud of it
