This airport is highly recommended Many of the reviews below are pre which is when the facility completed a full upgrade of terminal and gates I would discard any pre reviews as irrelevant to the current condition Long Beach Airport is a welldesigned and pleasant experience compared with LAX and to a degree John Wayne Its a smaller but more efficient facility with competitively priced parking within an easy walk of your gate The TSA Security Checkpoint is relatively fast compared with other airports The facility boasts two outdoor seating areas for two of its restaurants a comparative luxury in this age of airport design being little more than shopping malls with airline gates The central area between the two terminals is an outdoor seating area allowing for a retreat from the madness at the gates One of the unique aspects of LGB is the lack of jetways Walking out onto the tarmac to board a plane is a fun and different experience which adds significantly to the charm of this facility Long Beach doesnt have the cold and sterile feel of most modern airports and that is a welcome aspect of flying here There are a number of restauranteating choices available though the shopping is a relatively weak area In general Long Beach is easily my favorite American airport and is qualitatively far better than the vast majority of facilities I use

Considering that Mykonos is a small hilly island this little airport does well It is small so transit through from disembarkation to exit is really quick and not far to walk Arrived on connecting flight from Athens on Aegean at am Bags were out in around minutes Return flight back to Athens a week later Afternoon flight so busier as flights departing together Check in was busy big queues but efficient check in staff Small coffee sandwich counter and gift shop airside and small duty free shop toilet facilities and snack bar with hot drinks once passed passport control and security Its not the Business Lounge at Changi but it does the job for the short time people are there Good job

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

Hamad International Airport is nice brand new airport Very spacious and clean Good wifi line and plenty of free desktop for internet Seats are everywhere and they are comfortable Charging points are available throughout this airport Many choices for food and shopping However I find that the price is rather high

Billund is an excellent airport with good facilities practical layout and friendly and efficient staff My only gripe is the airport bus which is extortionate DKK to Aarhus and runs at often perplexing times that seem to have no correlation to when major flights are landing Ive travelled here every other month from various UK airports for about years and sometimes have to wait up to hours to get away As the airport is far from where most foreign travellers want to be unless they really like Lego you often have little option but to wait for the bus or pay even more for a taxi

On the way to Prague Bluebird chartered out to an AKL aeroplane which was cramped and the service terrible But on return on an actual Bluebird plane the flight was wonderful Clean roomy seats excellent service from the staff It was the same as flying a nondiscount airline but without the food The captain even came over a few times to announce places of interest we were flying over the staff were lovely and it was a great flight overall
The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

Extended and refurbished runway is so much improved New Terminal building constructed for Euro Cup is really nice and well designed With lots of space very clean and spacious When I arrived on the flight from Warsaw we were coached to the international arrivals where all or of us cleared passport control in under minutes Baggage was on a belt also in about min after we disembarked It was a pleasure to use such a lovely little airport and o much improved

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

Manageable and friendly this feels like an airport from the s Coming in and going out immigration facilities are fairly efficient Going out after immigration there are a few shops a barcafe and a sitting area The layout is semiopen and you can watch the planes land not that many do this is an airport with very few international flights daily You go through another security when heading to your gate where you can have your last beer before leaving the country Overall a good reflection of the country unpretentious clean friendly and relatively efficient

Genoa to Paris This was an Air France flight operated by local carrier CityJet Everything was done through the Air France website and I was able to upgrade to business class for around The business class seat was probably one of the smallest seat I ever flown however the service was fantastic and for a flight that lasted under two hours there is really nothing to complain about The airplane had four engines thing that I found quite interesting since it was very small aircraft I was served a full breakfast that was very nice and the presentation was five star I would fly this airline again without hesitation

Clark Airport is well secured and accommodating for passengers and there are plenty of seats provided in the predeparture terminal There are also small food stalls for the passengers who can fill their tummy while waiting their flight to depart

Small airport in the West of Ireland People and staff very friendly New bathrooms in lounge Food expensive Duty free was very big but there are no bargains for people travelling to US as items like perfumes are actually more expensive than sites in US We used to get bargains in duty free but not any more

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

Bozeman Yellowstone Airport is a rather small airport but its cabinlike design make it unique and special The concourse is easy to maneuver and the directional signs are very helpful and easy to read Security is usually a breeze on days with less travel Bozeman does have TSA PreCheck The seating areas are nice with stations for charging Internet Access is also free but it may not work on some devices The terminal is spotless and there are many little shops to have a coffee in as well as a Yellowstone Association store which offers indepth information about visiting Yellowstone National Park Grand Teton National Park and the surrounding areas

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

Da Nang to Da Lat The checkout process was smooth Although there was a minutes delay due to the late arrival of the airplane once we boarded everything went on well The legroom was not that cramped I found the crew service even better than Vietnam Airlines flight I flew to Da Nang several days before So I might fly this airline again on my future visit to Vietnam

Awesome experience The staff was so courteous Food was tasty Very good fellow travelers who made the experience even better Even at Dubai Airport the manager in charge at check in has always been very helpful and is actively monitoring the interactions of people with the check in desk staff Great experience

Uneventful flight with on time departure and arrival Usual Southwest nofrill service Clean aircraft and friendly flight crew In Flight Entertainment was easy to log on and watch live TV NFL football Unusual for this particular aircraft the overhead cabins were not as large as other aircraft

Pleasant smaller airport Parking is easy as is dealing with rental cars if necessary Ive used both Tucson and Phoenix Airports Phoenix had a direct flight and was less expensive for traveling between Boston and Tucson From now on Ill be using Tucson Airport due to the ease of access and human scale

Flew in and out of Rio Galeao airport in October Terminal was quite clean and quiet and quite a lot of shops but not too many which is neat The walking was a lot though and there were no conveyor belts to speed from the security to my gate all the way at the other end of the airport This is one of two points that could be improved The other one is is that some employes doing reaserch and statistics about client satisfaction were walking aroud the gates to get info No problem there But there are far too many I got interupted almost every minutes and I think that the airport cancould relax on that An otherwise great airport

The passenger terminal in Fargo has limited but all the essential services I used it for arriving and departing to hub cities for onward connections Taxi drivers were near the baggage belts soliciting fares On departure you check in on the main floor and take escalators one flight up To your left is a large enough gift shop with the usual items plus North Dakota State University memorabilia On the right is a food court with a few eateries including a Subway The security check was smooth Once on the airside there is a coffee shop and a kiosk of a shop a miniatiure version of the gift shop on the other side There are quite a few chairs and signage is good A very easy airport to use and quick to get out of and quick to get in

Completely pleasant airport Small very clean shopcaferestaurantprices much lower than in Borispol Easily accessible from center by taxi or trolleybus just plan enough time in traffic peaks of Kyiv and Close to very recommendable planemuseum in pedestrian distancemaybe mins to walk Customs working attentively but very polite Immigration takes usually more time mins in average than emigration but much more quickly than in Borispol The same about security Free wifi works properly and fast Have no post office in terminal but one across parking lot located left direction of entrance behind the power plant of the airport

Pleasant and easy check in Perfectly organized boarding Clean and new aircraft Spacious seat distance however seat width not as wide as other carrier on this route Pleasant crew Very good food which however was served a bit late At arrival fast border control and bag arrived rather soon however priority sticker did not give the bag priority delivery
Needed a wheel chair because of an injury people were so helpful and caring A special thank you to Damian who pushed my wheel chair So grateful Thank you

I have gone to this airport several times the past two years Beside my bad experience with sixt car rental I can not find any reason to complain Friendly and helpful staff check in and security done in minutes Small duty free and nice coffee shop Well functioning small airport

This was a third flight with this airline during a three week period of a SE Asia tour but Im reviewing this because of the element of positive surprise for a relatively short flight The flight was delayed but apologies were given around because of its double city service this scheduled flight was also used for a Hanoi service A smooth boarding process was also met by using more spacious premium economy seats with snack and hot drink service compared to just water as before Cabin staff were friendly and efficient

I had to cancel my travel plans from Dar Es Salaam to Arusha due to a medical emergency Coastal Aviation was very supportive understanding and efficient in processing my situation Much appreciated Great company

The international arrivals and departure section at Harare Zimbabwe airport is a revelation On arrival all the staff including Immigration and Customs were friendly and welcoming and this contributed to an excellent first impression and a speedy processing Possibly helped by having obtained visas before flying On departure check in was efficient and again the friendly staff were most helpful There is a full range of facilities airside and clean toilets At present there are not too many international flights but the experience was excellent

A great small airport Staff pleasant even down to the security staff which makes a pleasant change from the usual boredrude staff in most airports Free internet in departures and from landing to leaving teh front door only mins A bus to the city would be good

I thought this airport was lovely Outside are the cobbled roads and tram link into center In the main airport terminal the facilities are excellent They have a truly amazing viewing deck with information about the space programme and aircraft using the airport Security was quick efficient and friendly and boarding immediate to the aircraft I feel Bremen airport gives passengers the proper respect they deserve even when travelling a budget airline

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early

I have been in this airport many times over the last three years and it is by far the best airport I have experienced in Latin America It is clean and new and easy to get through with no long queues only a little when waiting in immigration after transatlantic flights Everything is very open and there is many different things to buy in taxfree

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

Thoroughly enjoyed our experience Friendly staff seats felt spacious Delicious meals Our inter island flights were great too loved being able to disembark through both doors Take note interisland flights have lower weight for carry on but checking a bag is free so it was just fine

Whilst small and basic its the perfect option for a frequent traveller No queues at check in or security Friendly staff even the security guys are nice No long walks to find your gate Arrive mins before departure travel stress free without the crowds and connect to the world via Schiphol Baggage claim takes minutes Would recommend this airport over flying via Manchester any day unless you enjoy arriving hrs early and shopping

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

Clean and efficient I was very impressed with Elmas airport Staff are friendly and the airport is very well connected to the city centre by bus The fare is only Only one negative point once youre past the international departures hall there are no shops only one small cafe near gate otherwise this is one of the best regional airports I have visited so far
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

Hong Kong Airport has not lost its lustre beauty elegance cleanliness And its employees are highly professional respectful and friendly Every time I travel through it I discover something new and this time I discovered the following A breathtaking and Epic view from the Sky Deck In late Hong Kong International Airport opened its new Sky Bridge a metrelong bridge built metres above the ground This is the worlds longest bridge over an active runway allowing even an Airbus A to pass underneath This bridge allows passengers and aviation lovers to enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the airports aircraft movement and watch aircraft take off land and pass beneath them an experience unparalleled at any other airport If you are travelling through Hong Kong Airport you must visit this bridge

A brand new airport opened for Dakar in called Blaise Diagne Its infinitely better than the old one mentioned in other reviews on this page which is no longer in use The new airport is clean and modern with helpful staff Once inside I felt like I was already in Europe I had no problems with security or checked baggage

Juan Santamara International Airport has gotten much better over the years Clean and modern The arrival process customs and immigration are as smooth as they can be Departures are easy too they could do better with the Exit Tax process long lines and no where to fill out the forms I understand some airlines will start allowing you to pay in advance which is excellent The food inside the terminal is ridiculously expensive I paid for a fast food breakfast sandwich I still dont understand why they have to check each carryon bag again at the gate when we were just screened and xrayed going through security It just slows the boarding process down

An enjoyable flight It left on time and check in was easy The seat was quite comfortable for a short flight The staff were very friendly and efficient The food was surprisingly good as well The flight offered refreshments twice In fact more food then my flight on QANTAS from Sydney to Cairns

Nice little airport which I use regularly Queues for passport control can be horrendous as has been said but staff are mostly friendly and facilities are good Plenty of places to eat and drink and you can use dinars in these though not in the Duty Free

Multistop from Munich via Kiev to Istanbul Then back to Munich after some days of holiday in Kiev Perfect flight times all flights landing ahead schedule Great service on the ground and on board Relaxing lounges UIA highly recommended

Nice little airport Size is adequate for the small number of flights a day Departures and arrivals are separate buildings so it is quick to checkin and collect baggage Departure hall is basically a pergola with a shop and a bar but its fine On arrival you get free trolleys which is a bonus

Quebec City airport is very clean and comfy Free and fast wifi with no submission or forms to fill or emails to wait for to validate the access The whole terminal is bright and welcoming The seats inside the departure terminal are new and very comfortable The checkin area is very well organised and neat The toilets are very clean On my arrival everything was easy and in the end the only little improvement this airport could make is for the luggage delivery time Apart from this very small detail this airport is just perfect

We have flown twice into Bermuda and each time were inout in under minutes For an island of just residents I am mightily impressed We really appreciated the smiling and welcoming airport staff along with the friendly curbside taxi operators The new terminal is quite impressive and the signage reflects what is commonly used in other international airports The duty free shops sadly offer no bargain prices In fact alcohol products are cheaper in Hamilton Yes the food offerings in the terminal are quite limited but they do attempt to reflect local culinary tastes While local favorites are mostly featured the prices are high but generally commensurate with elsewhere on the island In fact prices are definitely comparable to any of the NY area airports FACT CHECK Bermuda is an island that largely relies on marine shipments of imported food and supplies including oil and gas Closing Thought I have circled the globe and on reflection choose L F Wade airport as my preferred southern transit stop

This airport is improving In recent days they had added more space and departure gates also arrival area and baggage belt Security checks is most of the time relatively smooth not so long queue clean toilets Need to improve food options and also lounge experience

As a Bahraini Im really proud of this airport Very neat and clean facilities and very well organized with easy signage and boarding procedures Toilets are super clean and well attended Some cons I would give are a lack of food options and the service at check in counters can be a little slow Additionally I wish there was a Marhaba lounge that allowed access to nonAmex credit card holders as well Other than that bravo

New airport building with good facilities Minimal airport food facilities and retail outlets other than jewellery Good facilities for vehicles to pick up at ground level and drop off at first floor level Excellent toilet facilities and very clean throughout with good air conditioning Construction of second runway in progress together with airport buildings to cater for expected increase in tourism Downside was that there was no wifi facilities other than those offered by fast food franchises

Forl airport is very small The service before leave and after the arriving is very good and friendly The location is good also because is possible to join city like Rimini Bologna and Ravenna in a very few time Quite good the service for the disable people

I had just gotten to Khartoum from Dubai and I really had to use the washroom I went to the mens washroom and man oh man It smelled like people went there and forgot to flush I didnt use the washroom I ran back to my father because there was faeces on the floor of the toilet as well Outside I saw a janitor sitting in his chair comfortably and as I do not know how to speak Arabic I just decided to hold it instead of telling someone to clean up Other than this the airport was alright but not even close to ideal A month later my mother came via the same flight and airport and she had to wait hours at the luggage belt for her luggage to arrive

The airport is mostly new after months of renovation and expansion As usual now both domestic and intl passengers undergo passport control and customs either departing or arriving Make sure when departing to get your tourist permit and your passport stamped Immigration personnel were friendly but the lady at Customs wasnt I usually get immigration cleared at the land border point when coming from San Diego but the office at the border closes at night TIJ Immigration is so no worries for late nightearly morning flight Checkin is a bit messy though not slow with Volaris the largest tenant but otherwise smooth with other carriers If you fly Aeromexico well lets say Ive enjoyed better lounges than theirs at terminal A Better spend time at the terminals Starbucks Food is the airport biggest failure small gates too perhaps I believe with nothing other than the aforementioned cafe and some overpriced bad tasting and cramped restaurants Terminal B isnt any better at food its upside is a great local wine shop Free wifi available everywhere

First time flying with Jet they didnt disappoint We flew on a new A neo aircraft Crew were friendly efficient We got drinks services going but only coming home We paid for inflight meals both ways tea coffee or hot chocolate were included The food was very good hot Drinks were good value

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

Subang Airport to Redang The plane was a De Havilland Dash old but in good conditions The flight has been pleasant and crew did the best to offer us a pleasant flight water towels and a little snack The check in area in Subang and the all airport are very nice and clean the service has been very good They will replace their old planes soon with new ATR

I was traveling for work to and from Amsterdam to Samos I was seated on the first row with even for the B a lot of space for my legs Slept almost the whole time so for me this was a perfect flight Cabin crew were very professional
Madrid to Granada Excellent Efficient and attentive cabin crew Arrived and left on time New aircraft and comfortable seats Straightforward boarding and disembarking Highly recommended

Flew on four separate legs within Myanmar and found them to be surprisingly good You dont normally expect catering on flights of under an hour but there was something on all segments Arrived in good time at Heho Airport for a flight to Yangon and they automatically put me on to an earlier departure There is a certain amount of third world amateurism about the boarding process but it all seemed to work

Staff are very rude They checked me thoroughly and ask to open my bag and not to touch anything i was just standing there and they are also checking the other passengers coming after mins i ask the security if i can go and get my bag she said oh yes you can i forgot She made me wait for nothing They have an overpriced for their food inside the airport I will share this experience to my colleagues and other friends

I found this airport to be surprising good for a European airport Getting through the airport was smooth and the terminal was busy but not crowded The Marco Polo Lounge was again very pleasant one of the best I have been to in Europe it even has an outside terrace with views of the apron which is a rare treat My only complaint would be the strange approach to the use of airbridges there were so many available and yet slow and cumbersome bus boarding seems to be standard operating procedure at VCE strange

It is simply an airport and not trying to be a shopping mall or anything else Very quick passage through the airport if youre only dropping off bags TSA efficient but thorough bit of a crowd in the north portakabin as JetBlue DL and AS had simultaneous departures but as you can turn up so close to departure its not a long wait Restaurant upstairs is good as well though not cheap and it would be good to have more of the balcony given to noneaters maybe its busier midweek than on a Sunday afternoon

Tashkent Airport can be difficult to navigate Regulations are strictly enforced especially at departure Upon arrival I noticed that the people do not observe lines and not speaking Uzbek or Russian can be a disadvantage Make sure that you fill out and keep all official forms you receive There is one for each hotel you stay in and there are matching customs forms for arrival and departure you need to list valuables and cash and produce both forms when leaving the country Departure gate is a floor below the departure area There is now an escalator and carts are available for taking bags from the entrance gate to the escalator but only passengers may enter the departure gate Good luck if you have more than one or two bags There are no porters or at least not when I was there I had forgotten about the customs forms after I had to repeatedly insist to the airline representative that I was allowed to check in more than one bag and the customs official said I could not take my money out of the country without submitting both forms You will have to remove your shoes and socks and put on blue plastic booties before going through security The airport personnel were courteous and even friendly but it was clear that no exceptions would be made

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

Weve flown with Jetcom a few times and always been impressed This flight was similar Sure its not a scheduled flight like Air France or BA so dont expect it to be formal or upmarket Checking in at both airports is really easy and queues were managed well Plenty of staff around to help who were all friendly and helpful Fast and efficient despite some airport issues Boarding was also really easy and organised staff extremely friendly and creating conversation while waiting to board due to the abundance of staff without anything to do which is good for passengers I guess Onboard the seat was relatively comfortable and Extra Legroom was great Cabin crew extremely attentive and actually liked a conversation presented excellently and put a few peoples mind at rest who were nervous of travelling The plane was also quite clean for a holiday airline Id not buy any food though the toastie left a lot to be desired despite generic drinks being good I also love they offer Starbucks onboard Id highly recommend Jetcom and far better than other holiday airlines despite the fares not really being low anymore However Id still rather fly scheduled if possible but a great alternative

Such a fantastic flight Our flight attendant Jay was incredible His demeanour was cheerful and friendly and I truly wish every attendant was like him From the moment you got on the plane he had a positive energy and was respectful and helpful of all the guests Love United and kudos for such a great team

The airport is huge with clear signage direction and information It is well connected to the public transportation such as bus taxi Grab and the airport rail link leading to Phaya Thai Immigration is fast and convenient All nationalities are now using the auto gate for immigration at Departure Shopping and dining experience is quite nice with great choices of duty free items More greens might be needed to make the airport more ecofriendly I would suggest

Air North describes its class of service as Yukoner Economy which I thought probably referred to a concept of warmhearted hospitality and generosity This held true for my first flight in their but after flying in the HS Im wondering if the term is actually more about resilience in the face of harsh conditions Cramped conditions in the HS aside the service overall was pretty good staff were almost all friendly and efficient flights ran on schedule and reasonable food was provided No inflight entertainment system but at the time I flew the stunning everchanging landscape below was all the entertainment I could want

A modern and moderate sized airport for the capital of Finland Staff was friendly and helpful queuing times were very short due to modern handluggage scanners The terminal itself isnt very big but has an easy to follow layout There are a lot of dutyfree stores and foodcourts of course theyre all overpriced as one might expect Connection to town is offered by trainconnection All in all a good experience
Fast security checks great food court with wide selection of healthy and affordable meals and also fastfood Overall a great experience I can recommend this airport

Flew Larnaca to Manchester on the th July Excellent flight arrived in Manchester early after a perfect flight All crew pleasant and attentive Food on board was very good also the in flight entertainment Have flown Cobalt several times and will continue to do so when travelling to Cyprus

I have been flying from Mangalore International Airport domestically for a very long time Ill be honest the checkin baggage claim or the security is just literally the same like any other airport with less people The airport is calm and clean Restrooms are provided The only drawback is there is no source of recreation and entertainment here We have a couple of eateries but very very very limited WiFi is provided But when we speak about shopping Dont depend on Mangalore Airport it has nothing Trust me nothing The last time I visited there was a food stall at the ground floor and an umbrellaraincoat shop and a metal item store at the first floor That is it No clothes no alcohol no McDonalds etc But all in all its a good airport I mean its catering for the needs of Mangalorians Arrival also went very smooth

One of my party fell ill on arrival at the airport an airport attendant was absolutely fantastic she immediately got a wheelchair Helped check in luggage and seen us through check in and security and seen us on the flight safely She could not have done more

I had forgotten what the airport was like but it was great very small and compact no air bridges to aircraft just a quick walk across the airfield Immigration was very easy and efficient as international flights seem to land one at a time The luggage was swiftly off the aircraft and minutes you are in your taxi off to your Hotel Check in again was very quick we arrived very early and were first in the queue your taxi drops you off curbside and you walk about paces and the checkin is in front of you Immigration was very quick minutes and you are airside very limited space and a sad sight of a Burger King Fortunately we went upstairs to the BusinessFirst Lounge shared by most airlines it was empty when we arrived but filled very quickly good tea and coffee a bit limited offerings but ample really Called when the flight was boarding chaos downstairs but they were calling priority boarding and eventually all went as planned

Great little airport somewhat bizzare security arrangements which seem to depend on who you are or who you are with but really clean and with a nice cafe and seating while you wait the far side of passport control Duty Free expensive and poor selection
Wonderful Right size efficient super clean reliable in all weather conditions and wonderful ergonomics

Beautiful terminal and concourses in the new terminal Light and airy honestly the airport I would most enjoy waiting around in for a flight delay Also good food and shops and a general uplifting feeling Also the bus transit link back to Hong Kong was fast and efficient Going through security screening was a bit of a line but the check procedure was quick enough

Neos airline division of TUI Germany You can web checkin and you can change seat allocation without pay Plane arrived on time boarding and welcome was professional and crew was helping passengers with their carryons to be placed on bins New and clean aircraft service was great with two servings with tasty food and good variety of juices do not offer beverages but have wine coffee tea IFE is only drop screens to see the flight path and you can hear music from channels with earphones buy or your own
Arrived on full QF from Sydney on April Fantastic new airport that does credit to New Caledonia Clean modern and very quick from a full plane to bus transfer to Noumea

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

As a well travelled Belgian who has been to countries and used over different airlines world wide I can tell Uzbekistan Airways really satifisfied me despite the negative reviews I have read over here and other websites Due to the fact that the online checkin wasnt possible not on the website nor on their app we had to be early at the airport to make sure we were seated next to each other From the moment my girlfriend and I entered the air vessel we were welcomed with a smile and notice some Spanish extra cabin crew members to the staff of the flight HY as well as the Uzbeki who also served us in English Our seats on the left side were spacious the meal was suprisingly very varied and rich of side dishes such as extra fruit dessert some burek sauces such as ketchup olive oil and mustard We were served many times with drinks during the flight The cabin crew were very available very caring and had a really nice level of customer service This air vessel had the problem of non working screen entertainments Keep that in mind if you are taking a hour flight or longer Also some of the locals dont really care about queueing correctly as entering the plane as well as embarking the plane even we noticed them being a bit rude towards the airplane staff Also I have to confirm the entire staff showed the safety flight procedures so they value the safety on board If the screens would have been worked I would give a

Loved it Takes no more than minutes from entering to get to the gate When you depart minutes It was like heaven compared to Toronto where there are long lines lots of computers and where it takes so long to get to the gate and where you dread the lineups getting off the plane for the same reason It is convenient it is quick clean and has a Tim Hortons

Beijing to Xiamen I used Capital Airlines flight from Beijing to Xiamen and I felt that the flight attendants were in excellent service Although the meals is a sandwich the taste is quite good that my son ate three I ordered coffee my wife drank tea which is very traditional Chinese The plane arrived minutes late but it arrived on time which pleased me It is worth mentioning that in front of my pocket there is an tablet computer there are many videos and movies it is very convenient The only problem is that carbin crew sells souvenirs during the flight but its understandable that airlines want to make more money On the ground Hainan Airlines owns the T terminal in Beijing and the Capital Airlines is a subsidiary of Hainan airlines so it is also at t Boarding pass checked baggage boarding is very convenient the terminal is also very clean

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

I have flown into and out of the Colorado Springs twice a year since Each time check in has been efficient and pleasant the TSA agents have been very nice and observant the airport has been clean and refreshment options have been pretty good I was last there in October of and liked the fact that the piped in music in the waiting area was classic rock I have a high opinion of the COS airport and dont mind at all flying in and out of it
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice

Nice clean and efficient regional airport which I have used regularly over the years Never had queues at checkin Living in the Eastern part of Holland FMO the official abbreviation of MnsterOsnabrck is a good alternative for me to Amsterdam Provided that is you have a car public transport connections to the airport are not simple and not fast and you find a good and not too expensive flightespecially flights with connections in major hubs Frankfurt or Munich can be rather expensive
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes

For a small town scale Manado airport is pretty good Has several places for check in Several lounges equipped with internet access and good food The lounge area is quite spacious and has good service from Avsec This airport is set as the transit airport for Raja Ampat another greatest diving spot in indonesia located in Papua and also has an international direct flight like Singapore etc

Norman Rogers Airport CYGK in Kingston Ontario Canada is a small regional airport located about km east of Toronto and about the same distance west of Montreal Air Canada Jazz offers Dash and Beech service to Toronto times daily The return flight from Kingston to Toronto costs about if you have a connecting flight in Toronto Otherwise a flight from Kingston to Toronto costs a bit more Avoiding checkin in Toronto and the three hour drive to Toronto is worth the extra cost Kingston is a one building terminal and there is never anymore than pax to checkin for any flight Security is very thorough but is done efficiently and saves you the hassle of going through Toronto Pearson for security The terminal is one building and is currently undergoing renovations to improve service There are no restaurants in the terminal but there are a few vending machines AVIS does offer a car rental service but requires advance notice so a representative can meet the flight Overnight parking is only per hr period and is much cheaper than parking in Toronto The flight to Toronto takes min Baggage can be checked through to your destination from Kingston so there is no need to reclaim baggage in Toronto A nice little airport that makes a trip through Toronto Pearson a little more bearable

Great airport for small aircraft Twin OtterCessna used primarily for safari transfers Courteous and friendly staffsecurity as well as satisfactory washrooms and a nice snack bar Wilson airport is a welcome change from the chaos of Jomo Kenyatta Note due to its small size there is no souvenir or duty free shopping

Bremen is a small and convenient airport and my experience proved enjoyable Arriving with Air France I disembarked in the main terminal Very short walk to the baggage claim I picked my suitcase within ten minutes Tram line frequently connects the airport with the city centre every min during peak hours min otherwise travel time min A oneway ticket costs however beware that the machines accept neither credit cards nor bank notes greater than Easy departure with no queue at baggage dropin I breezed through security Bremen uses the fullbody scanner which makes the screening process much faster Security staff efficient and friendly Bright departure lounge but there might not be enough seating facilities if all gates are used at the same time Only issue Not enough toilets facilities either landside well hidden at the very end of the building or airside one toilet block only

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

I appreciate that this company is opening routes from Brest to cities like Strasbourg and Nice for example which is very useful both for my work and for visiting my family The fares offered are very attractive and the service is of a very good level I recommend this company Japprecie que cette compagnie ouvre des lignes au dpart de Brest vers des villes comme Strasbourg et Nice par exemple ce qui est tres utile aussi bien pour mon travail que pour rendre visite a ma famille Les tarifs proposs sont tres intressants et le service est de tres bon niveau Je recommande cette compagnie
I agree with the previous reviewers comments This is a great little airport An added bonus is that there is now a direct train link to Jerez centre as well as Cadiz and the surrounding cities

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

Very small airport with very limited facilities I am amazed that this is an international airport If you are stuck in this airport for a few hours there is nothing to do However check in and security a breeze and seems very organised
Another great flight Very consistent service consistent quality of food and comfortable aircraft The service on the flight was just spot on I would recommend them based on how consistent they are

The airport is mostly new after months of renovation and expansion As usual now both domestic and intl passengers undergo passport control and customs either departing or arriving Make sure when departing to get your tourist permit and your passport stamped Immigration personnel were friendly but the lady at Customs wasnt I usually get immigration cleared at the land border point when coming from San Diego but the office at the border closes at night TIJ Immigration is so no worries for late nightearly morning flight Checkin is a bit messy though not slow with Volaris the largest tenant but otherwise smooth with other carriers If you fly Aeromexico well lets say Ive enjoyed better lounges than theirs at terminal A Better spend time at the terminals Starbucks Food is the airport biggest failure small gates too perhaps I believe with nothing other than the aforementioned cafe and some overpriced bad tasting and cramped restaurants Terminal B isnt any better at food its upside is a great local wine shop Free wifi available everywhere

Cute little airport everything functions as it should No big lines its nice and clean and organized It was very easy getting into a shuttle after landing and getting to the hotel a great price too Im always a fan of getting to a new place and not having a chaotic mess of people trying to rip you off on transportation that was definitely not the case in Ko Samui

Great airport to travel from and return to No great distances to walk easy access to check in counters TSA actually seems to care and think rather than defaulting to lowest level of acceptable service ie Denver Early morning flights are great as the food court has great breakfast burritos and coffee The only problem seems to be the luggage getting from the plane back to you Once you have your bags the rest of the trip out is a breeze

The airport infrastructure is generally good and quite modern offering a clean and wellmaintained environment However one major drawback is the long walking distance between terminals and gates which can be tiring especially for elderly passengers or those with heavy luggage While the airport staff are polite and friendly they do not always demonstrate efficiency or resourcefulness when handling issues which can be frustrating for travellers in need of quick assistance Additionally one of the biggest concerns is the frequent long queues at immigration which can cause unnecessary delays particularly during peak hours This aspect of airport operations could be significantly improved by increasing the number of immigration officers implementing more automated systems or streamlining the process to enhance efficiency Overall while the airport offers a modern and comfortable environment there is still room for improvement in terms of staff efficiency and passenger flow management

Stockholm Bromma is a small airport Its very clean and the service was efficient Great proximity to the city centre Landing baggage collection and exit was super easy Taxi driver able to wait right by the carousel so there is no confusion about meeting places

Small but perfectly adequate airport On arrival we were through the airport within minutes of touch down though dont forget the US tax taken at passport control On departure we found the airport was shut and locked with lights off until am for departures that started at however it is modern enough with self service check in quick but thorough security with plenty of space in a light and an airy atmosphere There are now screens for departure information as well as the usual unintelligible tannoy calls and the only downsides were the exorbitant prices for snacks and drinks Duty free was a bit better but not particularly cheap either US for a coffee was times the price in the Best Western Hotel across the road

I travelled from Coventry to Naples this year and found the airport limited but satisfactory The checkin area reminded me of the old days with cardboard flight destination signs and this was an area that could be easily changed for the better The lines crossed each other to the destinations and did cause some friction between customers The car parking was an experience but again was satisfactory I do not understand why the local bus companies especially those going to Leamington Stratford do not call in On returning the baggage was certainly a LOT better than Birmingham so a plus there In the departure lounge there was a good choice of food and drink at great prices no rip off here Also a small point The newspapers were out and available from about Birmingham they are still under wraps at Good value and friendly Hope they get permission for the bigger one soon
The conveyer belt was not working ground staff are limited and quite unsupportive no canteen to eat food But the airport is very clean Newspaper stand and water filter is well in sight

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

As a regular user of Cork Airport I have always had a excellent opinion of its services Unfortunately this morning while dropping a friend off I experienced the lowest level of customer service I have in a long time My friend forgot his phone charger at home and after realising this I drove straight back to Cork Airport I was unable to contact my friend who had most likely gone through security On arriving at the airport with ample amount of time before flight departure I asked an employee of Aer Lingus Ryanair and another company I cannot remember could they please put a call out over the intercom to call my friend to the other side of security so I could pass the charger through There is apparently no connection between the intercom system on both sides of security As it was a Ryanair flight I asked this specific employee could he please contact a Ryanair colleague at the other side of security to make an announcement so my friend could please get his charger He couldnt do this Why he had no reason I asked was there any other way I could go about getting the charger to my friend He said he couldnt do anything but if I wanted to try asking security I could Of course he said security probably wouldnt be able to do anything for me I feel that from a customer service perspective both by Ryanair and by Cork Airport there is a complete sense of apathy and disregard for giving the highest level of customer service and simply trying to help your customers I know this is just a minor example but one would think in the service industry employees would try their best to help their customers

Richmond International is a new stylish and perfect sized airport on the outskirts of Richmond major air carriers serve RIC flying to over domestic and international destinations in the USA and Canada The airport is mediumsized and easy to find your way around The security lines are short and hasslefree The airport atrium has a large glass roof giving the airport interior a very open feel A restaurant in the atrium has a large window with a full view of the apron for all the plane spotters Travel into and out of RIC is always hasslefree and fun

An airport geared towards business travellers its in excellent condition and has very appealing decor feels like a hotel lounge There is also free WiFi which is welcome There are very few queues are the majority of travellers are going onwards to Heathrow and New York which made for a pleasant change with Transavia than flying through Eindhoven Very clean and security methodical However the food prices are extremely high even by airport standards But otherwise this is an excellent airport the most impressive Ive used

This is a small airport but the new passenger terminal is great Fast service helpful people and clean This is a good alternative of Brussels airport We like it and for sure if possible we will try again

Beijing to Pyongyang Comparing an intraEuropean flight of hours and this flight practically no differences clean aircraft nice stewardesses punctual simple food good and attentive service a normal standard

Always love to travel tofrom Kaohsiung airport very convenient to city center and Kaohsiung train station via metro small airport but got everything you need cafe restaurant duty free ground staffimmigrationsecurity always friendly and efficient Both China Airlines and EVA Air lounges are nice with plenty of food and drinks
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

I would like to express my gratitude to the airport staff for caring about my comfort and positive impressions of the company I would like to express special gratitude to the employee Annette for helping me resolve the issue with my luggage The flight was comfortable and in a safe atmosphere for me

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful

Ankara airport is lovely clean and a pleasure to be in It feels very new and modern and has a lot of glass to let natural light in Security is very fast and efficient and connecting to and from the city is fairly easy with a shuttle bus that costs TL Unfortunately like all Turkish airports to get free wifi you need a code sent to your mobile so if youre traveling and dont have a sim card that works then youre out of luck Otherwise its not a problem

At last a quiet clean and efficient airport Terminal F without the tiresome duty free The hourly Borispil Express train will drop you off near Terminal D and you need to catch a halfhourly shuttle bus to Terminal F mainly for LCC flights as its something like a m walk otherwise The number of flights is fairly small and seemingly mainly Ryanair Plenty of room to wait just a couple of refreshment options Straightforward passport control and security no queues Plenty of seats in the departure lounge easy access to gates good view of airport operations No duty free Hooray A couple of refreshment stands No air bridges but then LCCs dont use them anyway A very relaxing experience particularly in contrast to departing from a UK airport

Even though it is small this is one of my favourite airports Its a minute walk from the plane to the terminal baggage is normally on the belt as soon as you arrive in and the best part is the cafe not only is it cheap but they have excellent hot bacon rolls and the fresh cakes are excellent too If only public transport links were better though I have been told the National Express service to London will soon call at Kent International

A modest little airport in Sabah Arrived on a domestiic flight from KL so no formalities Leaving again domestically to Kota Kinabalu was a breeze with very fast efficient checkin bag scan etc The airport is clean light airy and efficient by modern standards a joy to use

I like that Recaro seats were used The seat was very soft and legroom was actually the most I have gotten thus far even for such a tiny plane like the A neo It was very well kept and modern and the cabin was spotlessly clean There was even a meal on the short flight of hours Excellent experience However there was no screens for IFE but there was a cool magazine that kept me entertained so yeah However there unfortunately was a karen or kevin or whatever you call it on our flight The crew were very professional

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

ChisinauBudapest roundtrip Both departures on time Served breakfast on the way out and lunch inbound Luggage transfer handled efficiently despite relatively short connection time in Budapest SAAB plane offers plenty of legroom and is not so noisy compared to other prop planes Friendly FAs and my favourite option for flights from Moldova to Europe

Very convenient to reach from anywhere I would call it a no frills airport If this airport is to compete as an International airport it has to invest money in renovation and updating of the building In general I am thankful for the close proximity of this airport

Domestic Terminal is older than the International Terminal and was clearly the airport in the past Only few in and out on domestic flights The planes are parked on the apron and usually passengers walk to and from Arrivals is through the single gate to the Baggage Spur not a circular belt so things can pile up if there is a lot of luggage There are toilets before the Arrivals Hall The whole terminal is a single story with Arrivals at one end and Departures at the other end There are no facilities in the Departure Lounge after Security Within the terminal there are a couple of shops selling snacks and souvenirs and a Money Changing booth The whole experience is pretty good not many flights and a generally relaxed friendly attitude You would not believe you were in the Capital City

Simply put the Little Rock Airport has to be the nicest smallersized airport that I have ever used It is very easy to access from downtown and elsewhere Everyone who I encountered there was extremely friendly The TSA folks were all nice and they did their best to move folks through the line as quickly as possible For an airport its size it has a great variety of restaurants

I must say that in my experience the staff at the security check are doing a great job I was flying back to Moscow from Yerevan on Tuesday th October The staff were very welcoming polite and helpful Moreover while passing the security check I realized that I lost my cross the thread on which it hung was torn and after passing the security check I informed the security staff about it They were very helpful and helped me find my lost cross

Thessaloniki to Athens Very nice and comfortable journey Flight was almost full Used the website to checkin and a mobile phone boarding pass was sent making it really easy Crew was friendly and helpful Candy small snack and drink offered in this domestic Greek flight Luggage was included in the price and although I did not have any it made the cabin have much more space for peoples handluggage Timely and orderly departure and arrival Very good experience I recommend them on this route
Our team fly weekly and we reckon Rex are the most reliable airline in Aus Boarding is easy flights are on time crew are great WiFi on all flights would seal the deal Yet to be disappointed

Phoenix is the easiest of all major US airport to get in and out of I picked Phoenix as my home based in part because I needed a reliable airport considering how often I fly and PHX does not disappoint The new terminal is really excellent and the improved lounge situation at Terminal is really appreciated

Sapporos New Chitose airport is very effective and user friendly facility Located somewhat far from Sapporo it is perfectly linked to the city and the region by rail Quick checkin quick baggage delivery good choice of food outlets landside but not a lot of things to do airside The train station is underground as almost everywhere in Japan All in all very good star

Nice flight on time Smooth check in Nice cafe after formalities at Windhoek Only minor complaint is that email ticket confirmation says you must print out that document which is or pages so I did for people These pages were NOT required at Windhoek check in

Very efficient and pleasant airport Check in was quick and used the executive lounge I have used many but this was excellent One of the very best Food and drinks of good choice and a high standard Served to you rather than self service Comfortable and lovely friendly staff who couldnt do enough for you

Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

Mainly domestic airport serving the Brazilian side of Iguassu Falls Busy airport with a air bridges and some remote stands Shopping opportunities as you walk from the gate to Baggage Reclaim Baggage Reclaim is on the ground level and has main baggage carousels Domestic arrival so no Customs or Passport Checks Small and busy Arrivals area with parking directly opposite Small but efficient airport

This is a nice airport people are friendly check in efficient It is a clean airport and it has a nice building with plants and water fonts Brasilia is a modern City and it is airport is like the city just fantastic

Arrival was easy and bags arrived quickly waived through health control and landside within minutes departing again no issues although the airport was busy with the evening departures there was plenty of security checkpoints open and plenty of staff each employee at the airport I encountered was helpful and friendly once through security there is a excellent Duty Free and several restaurantsbars along with a small selection of shops

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

Boarding on TLV was done on time but delayed to get permission to depart A was in a good condition and clean Stewardesses were professional and friendly Inflight service was beverages coffee water sandwich and granola bar On the return flight there was a minutes later departure schedule change they informed us with email days in advance

My recent experience of flying through Tuscon reminded me that in the contemporary climate flying through smaller American airports is generally a lot more pleasant than megaairports A case in point was the security screening I have some metal in my leg that occasionally triggers the metal detector and it happened while going through security at Tuscon The TSA person that dealt with me went through the standard procedure for dealing with this sort of thing this wasnt the first time for me but they also managed to be human about it in stark contrast to what Ive encountered at some other airports where the TSA person I was dealing with might as well have been a robot I would agree that the dining options at Tuscon arent the greatest but I was still able to get something satisfying to eat We even had some entertainment courtesy of the Arizona Air National Guard also at Tuscon airport who were doing training flights in their Fs and treated us to an impromptu airshow There is much to be said for flying through smaller airports In general the experience is faster and less stressful than their larger equivalents

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in

I was really happy for the service provided Although this was a budget airline it did not affect my experience The flight crew were amazing and the pilots the same The only advice or suggestion I would give is allow cabin to accept card payments because not everyone carries cash I would have loved to have purchased a beverage but unable to due to this reason Other than that the experience and all was great and couldnt have asked for anything better

Flew in from Baltimore on Southwest What a great little airport Easy to navigate spotless facilities fast wifi and good options for coffee and snacks A great alternative to Boston for access to Cape Cod

Flew to Dublin yesterday th October after catching train from Preston where I had been working for a few days to Squires Gate which is about a minute walk ADF was a bit of a disappointment but checkin and security a breeze Staff friendly and efficient Depatures lounge was a bit oldfashioned not necessarily a bad thing quite nostalgic really but was very clean and the cafe was good Aer Lingus as always a joy to travel with

Pros The flight attendants were kind and helped us with the wifi for minutes Very helpful mindful and demure The food was great I was not expecting that Legroom was wonderful Me being m there was easily lots of legroom Theseat was hard IFE sucked and dirty floors
Nice small friendly airport Good transport links to the city by bus which meets flights and plenty of taxis A few shops and cafes and very clean facilities

For international flights Lusaka now has a brand new airport and it is considerably better than the old airport which is now only used for domestic flights The new airport is spacious and currently clean and well maintained and well ventilated Check in is usually quite speedy Airside there are a few shops and cafes and currently a basic lounge though another is opening soon My only criticism is limited use of the airbridges but I was told that the airlines need to have a correct tow bar which some have and some do not hence some planes parking and passengers walking tofrom the terminal In rains you can be bussed Lots of immigration officers means it is quite quick to enter Zambia now

We had to return early from a holiday in Dubai and it was considerably cheaper to fly from Sharjah than from Dubai Sharjah is a relatively small airport but has a reasonable duty free area a food court with a number of very reasonably priced outlets and very friendly staff It was very clean and staff were constantly and vigilantly cleaning the public areas Unfortunately the check in desk for Pegasus was very slow and boarding was slow as well Nevertheless a stress free experience Would definitely use Sharjah again

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

This is a large airport that is undergoing runway expansion which is very visible on takeoff and landing For a midmorning flight the C concourse was very but not very crowded Seating at the gates can be a premium however we had no difficulty finding seating The connecting hall has all kinds of restaurants both fast food and sit down Airport WiFi is easy to connect and fast The bathrooms are impeccable There is an attendant on duty who is constantly cleaning the bathrooms after every use The attendant greets passengers saying welcome to the cleanest bathrooms in CLT Kudos to Airport management

One member of our party has special needs and requires the special assistance service The airport ground staff were exemplary We travel regularly The assistance kindness efficiency and responsiveness of all the ground staff we encountered was the best that we have experienced I would recommend Rhodes airport as an airport with staff that genuinely assist those with special and additional needs
Phenomenal airport the best I ever experienced in Europe or anywhere else Just the material definition of how an airport should be Well done Albania
Nice small friendly airport Good transport links to the city by bus which meets flights and plenty of taxis A few shops and cafes and very clean facilities

Its pretty good for a budget airline As long as you have followed predeparture guidelines packed properly and have your passport valid visa and PNR number checkin is easy even if it takes a while for people in front of you to repack their bags as they were NOT prepared or were taking chances with their baggage allowance The rest of the flight was uneventful the crew cabin and seating were efficient beyond what you would expect from a budget airline

Our outbound flight was delayed which caused us to miss our connecting flight to Toronto with another airline The delay was due to a late inbound flight This created a small issue in Montreal but the other airline was able to get us on a later flight The flight itself was uneventful Service on board was good flight attendants were fantastic and friendly

Frank Pais International Airport at Hologuin has two terminals one modern deals with international charter and scheduled services and the other older deals with flights to and from Havana My comments relate to the older national terminal The tone is set when passengers see the huge portrait of former President Fidel Castro on the airport terminal plus the slogan on the perimeter wall Socialism or Death This sets the tone for what is usually a pleasant visit to the city of Holguin Incoming passengers walk to the terminal where an excellently designed baggage conveyor promptly brings the luggage to be reclaimed The design of this conveyor requiring passengers simply to reach their suitcases off the belt is in contrast to those at much newer larger UK airports On arrival for your return flight check in is swift and simple and the waiting lounge has somewhat noisy Cuban TV playing loud music all the time
Nordavia has been renamed as Smartavia and reviews can be found on this new linkSmartavia Reviews

Guayaquil Airport is modern and clean but if you arrive on a domestic flight there is no transit You need to go out and do checkin and security Arrivals can be crowded and staff are not that friendly The one smile that I got was from the girl selling chocolates at the store inside

Very swift through check in and security was fairly smooth with around a minute wait so positive in these areas However the departure lounge facilities are woefully inadequate with twice a many people in the area than it was fit to hold There were a many people sitting lying on the floor as there were able to get seats to sit on Only a handful of restaurants which were bursting full with queues running out into the corridors People seemed to be waiting up to an hour just to get an order taken Other than the duty free shop there was little else available only a small WH Smith WH very limited food options and huge queues If they want to have this many passengers they need to make the facilities available for them Very poor and not that safe

Very friendly clean and organized Still in need of more modern technology but above all for being in a poor country it delivers a good service nice food court and souvenir shops although the latter are pricey It has something for everyone

Lovely airport and great shops for an airport of this size Paying a the counter for taxis removes the touts that descend on you in other places Food options are limited but then who would want to spend too long checking in too early and getting hungry when on such a lovely island

Mildura Airport is the rd busiest airport in Victoria Australia and is serviced by three airlines Virgin Australia QantasLink and of course Rex It has three gates a great bar really clean check in and the people are nice with the perfect amount of seats They do not have aerobridges obiously a really modern airport its just great

Flew SkyWork Airlines from Berlin to Bern You can eckeck in hrs before flight Both flights were on time Cabin was clean and legroom standard Service was friendly and they offer coffee and pie for lunch Airport was small but there was a bustrain connection to the town I would recommend them

TallinnAmsterdam is a short flight but crew were nice helpful and were able to understand at least languages they helped my Dutch Grandmother who speaks no English Amenities not normally provided but because flight was near empty they gave out snacks plus complementary tea and coffee They also allowed us to sit in vacant seats which was nice In general a nice trip and much more than was expected for basically a regional airline

Flew in to SavannahHilton Head International September and departed October Once again an absolute pleasure to use My wife and I use this airport frequently when we travel to Hilton Head Island South Carolina On arrival my wife goes straight to the car rental desks about yards from baggage reclaim and I get the baggage from the belt Baggage retrieval usually takes minutes or so and by this time the car rental formalities have just about been completed The cars are just outside the Terminal doors and in about minutes we are on the Interstate On departure checking in with United Express is a breeze after handing back the rental car and then there is a very pleasant courtyard with retail caf outlets before going through security Even through security there are a surprising number and variety of eating and drinking outlets with a few retail shops Usual caveat if you have a late departure they may not all be open If only all Airports were this charming and nice to use

In August Johannesburg to Maun and Kisane to Johannesburg Both flights were spot on time Service on board was fine with drinks and light snacks served for the roughly hour flight in each direction Aircrafts were in good shape and the seats comfortable for this type of trip Checkin in Joburg was easy and very quick Check in in Kisane was a breeze as the airport is tiny All in a good experience and a great way to enhance your Botswana experience
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge
