Strasbourg is a nice and convenient regional airport Baggage claim is quick The information desk is friendly and helpful A covered walkway links the terminal to the train station Travel to downtown Strasbourg costs oneway and takes mins while trains run frequently weekdays service is much more reduced during the weekend only one or two trains per hour Beware that the ticket machines accept coins or French credit cards only and that the airport station is called Entzheim Aeroport and not Strasbourg Aeroport Upon departure checkin and security screening are hasslefree For a longer wait there is a socalled relaxation area on the st floor above the information booth few people know about it although the area has comfortable seats working tables and power sockets On the downside there is no airconditioning there so that the area can be quite warm

Skopje is a small airport but quite spacious you can see that there are not many people flying international But there are some coffee shops burger king and car rentals The only shuttle bus goes every hour The toilets could be cleaner they were dirty even when there weere almost no people

Flew on th of February Checkin staff in Miami was the best I ever experienced Fast friendly efficient pleasant Travelled with pet in cabin all formalities were dealt with rapidly and in a friendly way Boarding rapidly inflight crew very friendly We got the feeling that the flight attendants had pride in their job Food offering very good however service could have started slightly earlier Flight left delayed due to late arrival of incoming flight snow storm in Toronto But as we got an email from Porter advising of the delay we were able to leave to the airport later All in all a nice experience

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

I live in Kampala and fly in and out of this airport regularly It is a rather small and quiet airport clean and modern after the refurbishment There is not much to do a few duty free shops overpriced craft shops and a restaurant Checkin area can be very crowded especially for BA KLM and Emirate flights For all other international flights it is sufficient to arrive at the airport hour before departure The best this airport has to offer is probably the lounge Clean extremely comfy sofas big TV screens friendly service hot showers internet access and an electronic massage chair

It is a very clean airport and very easy to move around Departures and arrivals are well defined and separate It is very safe and there are good shopping areas in the departures My experience at this airport is flights all without problems at the airport and the last flight was in January Nice views from airport we can see Desertas Islands and the sea sunrise and sunset

Flew Mahan Air economy class from Dubai to Tehran IKA with Mahan Air A felt safe the aircraft was clean and comfortable Cabin crew service was friendly and efficient Quality of food and beverages non alocholic were of good standard Would recommend this airline to everyone

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention

Rimini Airport is highly recommended as a way to access the Adriatic Riviera This smaller than average airport is located on the edge of Rimini MiraMare and is well connected to Rimini and the train stations by coach and a local tram service is not far away either The negative aspect is that the lack of clear signs inside the airport for ground transport could be very misleading for newly arrived passengers and lead the newly arrived into the hands of very expensive taxi drivers Rimini Airport has some nice shops and is well set out I highly recommend this airport

Titan Airways flew us back from Mytilene to Manchester Flight ZT as part of the repatriation after TC collapsed The flight was excellent particularly the stewardesses who were helpful efficient and courteous The plane was very clean with better leg room than Ive had before on a typical economy class carrier at anytime in the past outside of long haul flights The only gripe I had was the in flight entertainment it didnt work even though it said I was connected I got no connection to it at anytime of trying This is why its only a and not a star review
Fantastic Ample and clean restrooms Great restaurants Napping rooms available to rent Everyone was kind and assisted as needed They asked me if I needed help Super customer friendly service

On the th of October i arrived at the airport with a Uber rider Shortly after i left i noticed i left my phone in the uber who has driven off My flight was hour and minutes away from departure I tried asking for multiple people within the airport for help if they had the uber app to help me contact the driver as i would not be able to check in to the flight without my phone The kind police security gentleman by the name of Chris kindly helped me contact uber let me use his phone to call the uber driver and with only minutes left for depart kindly helped me through the security queue Honestly a life saver and I couldnt be more grateful for finding this man this day and i would like to once again thank you if you ever read this review

Nice lay out I got to the airport in the morning I just had a bit of some confusion as it was my first flight The automated ticket booths were convenient and quick Security was a breeze No queue the security personnel were nice and polite I didnt feel intimidated The gates are lined up along the back of the building nicely The Tim Hortons was next to my gate Washrooms are clean They even provide you with sanitizing wipes and cleaner to wipe the seat The stalls are private with no big gaps in the stalls Theres tables with outlets to charge your phone Coming back it was alright The luggage carousels are at the main floor where the front doors are

My husband suffers with neuropathy and towards the end of our holiday his feet were very painful which made walking difficult I did not arrange assistance at the airport and was concerned he was unable to do all the walking at the airport and worse still the amount of walking at Heathrow I enquired at the help desk and explained my predicament The staff were amazing and not only arranged assistance at Gibraltar but also contacted Heathrow on our behalf I cannot thank them enough for making our Journey an amazing experience at both airports which would have been a nightmare their kindness was was very much appreciated and I cannot thank them enough

Fantastic flight Despite a delay departing Narita due to weather I really enjoyed my flight on Air Calin The crew were fantastic very friendly and helpful Excellent onboard service great food a very comfortable seat and the cabin was clean I would fly them again

A very pleasant experience both arriving and leaving this airport the terminal is well designed with some good places to eat and purchase last minute items too There is a business lounge which is a great oasis to relax and catch up on business for a fee which offers drinks and food Baggage collection was fast and was on the reclaim by the time we had walked from the arrival gate to the reclaim The customer service and information is very good and professional as is TSA who all appear to go the extra mile to assist passengers departing

I use this little airport for flights between northern England and SE Asia via AMS on KLM I find it a very convenient feeder airport to the AMS hub and the small size of the terminal ensures that arrivals are swift and painless Im on the road within mins of hitting the tarmac in most cases Staff are generally friendly and helpful By contrast nearby NCL which used to be very quick and efficient is much more hassle with some of the most miserable ground staff in Europe

Freetown Lungi International Airport is a small airport terminal building It recieves very few flights the majority being international It has so positive attributes like no congestion speedy check in and checkout A hotel is conveniently located near it There is a duty free shop and restaurant There is also a VIP Lounge for the elite and other first class passengers Beware that the airport is very small It needs renovations and a series of expansions effort due to its small size The government is in the works of expanding it to accomodate the international passengers

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right
Not as big as Airports in Beijing and Shanghai that it is hard to navigate It is very efficiently run and very clean It is the best midsize international airport in China

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

Dont understand all negative reviews yes you can not compare this airport to a modern European or US one but short lines friendly people despite unfriendly behaving tourists enough seating to wait Smooth entry into the country expect to enter a country that is years back in time and you will enjoy your trip

Super tiny Airport like a bus terminal in my town but it was a quite clean and cozy place Location is nice not far from city and you can get there from city center by local bus for about euro There were nice sofas inside and the toilet was neat and clean

Gatwick to Larnaca Once you get on the plane all is well The customer service team on the ground not so great They claim they have no managers so the customer service advisors are their own managers Secondly to change your ticket they will only do this by arranging a call back and no other way If you ring to change your ticket they wont put you through to the team that deals with this but instead you need to wait for them to ring you back Very rigid and pretty appalling procedure if you ask me Customer service needs improving Lastly food on the plane could be better Compared to Aegean and British airways Cobalt business class food is economy plus

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements
Perfect and uneventful flight left in time boarding in BKK was done professionally and efficient Staff were polite and helpful Enough space in overhead lockers

Spotlessly clean airport Fantastic cakes in departure Travelling to and from Kiev for Champions League final from Liverpool via Venice and Lviv Very smooth transit through Lviv Airport both ways Cakes were more memorable than the game unfortunately

I would like to give a commendation to the staff of Cebu Pacific working at the Roxas City airport who helped my father recover his lost luggage which was mistakenly picked up by another passenger These people worked hard and I have also witnessed all the efforts they made to give all the help that we needed Thank you for your hard work and dedication You guys are awesome

Nice pleasant airport Checkin usually fast security queue depends on the number of flights departing at the same time Airport gives you everything you need for a quick departure and arrival Before security check one cafe on st floor that opens too late in the morning and closes too early in the evening After security check one cafe no shops Toilet cleanliness depend on the time of the day but worn out

Three trips between CCS and BLA I found Conviasa to be clean modern friendly and welcoming My Spanish is functional but quite basic and when I struggled there was usually multilingual staff even on the short hop from Caracas to Barcelona and back Luggage allowance on this flight is a generous kg and a free drink is provided despite the flight time being only minutes Seats comfortable with more room than I was expecting All in all Conviasa offer a superior albeit slightly more expensive service on this short route than do their competitors Avior
OPOMIR return Cabin crew friendly breakfast served it was nothing special but not bad for plane food There was no entertainment onboard but the planes were clean

Flying from LHR to BKK Went through additional security checkpoint smoothly No big queues New clean and pleasant terminal All information were given very clear Hope to have such terminals more often in Europe Glad to be here again

Bogota to Pereira After reading many bad reviews were prepared for anything Fortunately everything went well Our slightly overweight baggage was not an issue kgkg the ground staff was friendly Not knowing if they charge extra for not printing the ticket we did the check in ourselves but seeing many with an airline printed ticket I assume this is not an issue The flight left minutes earlier the cabin crew was friendly as well and during the short flight they even offered us a small free drink The plan was clean the captain friendly So overall a great experience Not much to complain about really

This is one of the main gateways to Lapland and nearby ski resorts and other outdoor activities Terminal has been recently expanded and refurbished but its still quite small for an international airport so during peak season in winter when there are plenty of charter flights from the UK and Central Europe they do run out of space sometimes However the place is cozy and they even have rocking chairs Outside peak season its very easy and fast go through security and checkin
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good
From Prague to Saint Petersburg great service nice food professional group price of the ticket was higher than competitors but worth it highly recommended

Very quiet and peaceful airport well equipped with benches places to sit and even lie down It is not a large airport so the catering facilities with shops are small but sufficient Very nicely designed areas where you can sit and experience Finnish nature For the first time I see an airport where you can relax physically and mentally It is also a bit cold it perfectly reflects the climate of Finland It does not heat up excessively and there is a delicate chorus which can be annoying at first but after some time you get used to it

So refreshing to be able to use Duerne instead of Brussels Less than minutes from plane to car this week and that included collecting a bag On return I checked in about minutes before the flight hardly any queue

Johannesburg to Lilongwe via Blantyre Very impressed with Malawian Airlines On time departures and arrivals excellent food served both outbound lunch chicken and return breakfast fried eggs lovely coffee and generous baggage allowance Crucially Ethiopan Airlines the part owner has timed the flight with an early morning departure from Malawi such that a large majority of passengers were connecting on our flight in Johannesburg onto regional Southern Africa routes and donestically within SA whereas SAA schedule from Lilongwe would require an overnight stay in Johannesburg clever scheduling Both flights nearly full No entertainment or music onboard

Gatwick to Puerto Vallarta We travelled in premium economy both directions and its worth the upgrade but only just Firstly the premium check in was fast the included lounge access was great The only part of the upgrade that doesnt work is the bags off first this didnt happen in both directions The food quality was acceptable drinks were free flowing The crew seemed to be experienced and happy which made for an enjoyable flight both ways

A quick efficient security check just inside the door then youre in a big lobby and go to a checkin counter which you must do at any rate for a flight out of Russia even if you printed a boarding pass online so dont bother There are plenty of shops and places to eat both before and after formal passport control and formal security each of which involved less than minutes queuing Quintessentially Russian the passport officer never smiled but he was efficient and in no way discourteous Restrooms are clean and wellmaintained I awaited boarding in a nice lounge but almost all the newspapers to read are in Russian which I cant read Ample seating area at gate My flight to Paris had boarding via a jetway

Hamilton International is a great little airport and very convenient for people trying to avoid the hustle and bustle of Pearson My family is located in southern Ontario and I always use this airport The only complaint I would have is the decision of management to serve no alcoholic beverages

Excellent flight more leg room than other airlines cabin stewardess who was excellent and tended to all passenger requirements served all passengers with complimentary food with drink which is unknown nowadays Good old fashioned service and customers do count Flight from Waterford VG th June

Just recently MacArthur Airport here in the middle of Long Island recieved a makeover The makeover included a big new concourse added terminals and new concessions Its beautiful It is a big relief to see the airport go from old and small to new and bigger The new concourse was built and is now primarily owned by Southwest Airlines The layout of the airport is very simple and easy to navigate As soon as you walk in the main entrance you can either make a right to get to the checkin counters or make a left to get to the carousels and pickup a friend that just arrived Security is fairly fast There are a number of concession stands as well as souvenir shops located before after the security checkpoint The following airlines service MacArthur Airport some of the airlines may use a codeshare partner for some flights Southwest Airlines Delta Connection Continental Express US Airways express Brand new concourse terminals concessions

Smooth flight and comfortable seat Premium economy still a good value on Finnair The cabin chief was competent as I got a problem with only one choice of meal Im platinum and I was upset to see the poorest service during the dinner on board he went to apologize so its good but when you pay euros you expect a better service concerning the food The flight attendants have to be more smiley
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

A short but enjoyable flight Staff were friendly and helpful Check in was easy and the plane left on time A small snack was provided which is fine on so short a flight They also offered free beer and wine which was a nice surprise

Nice and efficient airport Security and passport controls are quick and smooth and makes the airport easy to travel to and from Good connections for transfers to other airport in Norway or Europe Easy access to Trondheim with airport train buses or taxi Brand new Radisson SAS hotel adjacent to terminal A
Great airport Easy to park easy to get to terminal and fast security Beats almost every other larger airport I have been to Not much to do but you wont be there long anyway

Small clean efficient The departure terminal is well run theres a nice bar though the windows have been covered with some coloured adhesive plastic preventing from a view to the runway Everything is so simple and hassle free that one does not need to arrive hours before departure time Very nice indeed

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

Wow We were amazed at the transformation of this airport in the space of year since being taken over by a German company Previous check in desks removed and brand new ones on a different wall far more Check in was seamless and plenty check in desks A new security area which was quick and smooth apart from the aggressive female member of staff shouting at passengers and rolling her eyes brand new duty free area Such an improvement Heraklion airport in Crete could take some tips We were stesssed thinking about our return journey but the airport has vastly improved Arrival area is also spacious and easy All toilets in the airport have been renewed
Its easy to get around very friendly people and easy to get bags and leave Always a good experience and they have free wifi so never a problem with communication

Flew Solomon Airlines from Brisbane to Honiara We boarded to be greeted by smiling attendants The flight was not too full so we had seats to ourselves Leg room was quite good IFE was just a screen panel lowered from the ceiling watched a movie The meal was lunch we had the beef and it was delicious Staff came around to check if we needed any more drinks throughout the flight
Nice and very effective Airport With an Business Class Ticket your within Minutes at the Lounge The Security Check also Works smooth Great experience

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far

This airport is probably one of the best I have been to Every employee I encountered was friendly and eager to help The airport itself was clean and efficient I flew in and out of this airport at busy times of the week and did not experience any problems When I landed I went through baggage claim quickly and was waiting for my friend in a matter of minutes When I was flying out I had the same experience I said goodbye to my friend and five minutes later I was at the gate What a pleasure compared to flying out of Orlando and there is free wifi

Since there is no other airport that you can go through to get to this place I have to recommend it Staff were friendly and nice There were no long lines at departure I was taking AA flight in the afternoon and there were some people waiting for BA flight At arrival I went through immigrations and customs with no hassle Lady at immigration even said Welcome to St Kitts I never hear those pleasantries in the US I heard they are building a new terminal So I hope they could have more services at the new terminal
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

This is one of the nicest airports I have visited The staff are all helpful and cheerful The security system is quick and efficient and the seating areas are comfortable and spacious The woman playing piano in the area prior to security really sets the tone The whole expereince was professional polite and efficient

RGNSNW Quick boarding with allocated seating for minute flight in ATR to Ngapali Beach Good safety briefing before time take off and light snack and drink en route Pleasant FAs smooth flight and great landing over the surf and through the palm trees to this small exRAF WW strip on the Bay of Bengal Luggage is delivered by handcart to the entrance gatesexpect to pay kyat per piece

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

A quick visit to Rome from Prague on Ryanair The airport location close to the city is great with a painless connection via Airport Link Bus Train The entire trip easily purchased on the Trenitalia app for only to Termini The airport terminal itself is large enough to accommodate flights at the same time could be stretched to capacity with more traffic Boarding and disembarking on foot with some shops available Staff was curtuous so our departure was on time The proximity to Rome is a strong selling point when comparing to FCO

Nice Airport Well organised checkin for B and speedy transit through TSA roomy concourse and nice Buffalo wings There was a fire alarm while we were there which was dealt with with only minor disruption good views of the apron and active runway A good alternative to Toronto for Niagara

I have flown Porter on other occasions and have many good experiences I was supposed to travel with them in April but due to an accident I would not be able to with upcoming doctor and Physio appointments The customer service representative Erin was phenomenal She listened and asked questions as to address my issue with regards to my upcoming flight I am now able to have time to heal myself and take my flight at a later date Thank you Erin and Porter

Frank Pais International Airport at Hologuin has two terminals one modern deals with international charter and scheduled services and the other older deals with flights to and from Havana My comments relate to the older national terminal The tone is set when passengers see the huge portrait of former President Fidel Castro on the airport terminal plus the slogan on the perimeter wall Socialism or Death This sets the tone for what is usually a pleasant visit to the city of Holguin Incoming passengers walk to the terminal where an excellently designed baggage conveyor promptly brings the luggage to be reclaimed The design of this conveyor requiring passengers simply to reach their suitcases off the belt is in contrast to those at much newer larger UK airports On arrival for your return flight check in is swift and simple and the waiting lounge has somewhat noisy Cuban TV playing loud music all the time

Norfolk International Airport ORF in Norfolk Virginia is one of the best airports that I have flown into or out of in the past year The airport itself is set in the middle of a beautiful botanical gardens It is great to wonder through the grounds of the gardens if you have several hours to kill between connections The airport has a variety of resturants that are very reasonably priced and the food is excellent Access into and out of the airport is easy Parking is great with a well lighted attached parking garage The new arrivals terminal which was recently completed is huge and baggage retrieval and rental car pickup is a breeze The only thing lacking at this airport is direct access to the Interstate highway system After leaving the airport property you have to travel through a residentialcommercial neighborhood to gain access to the Interstate

We use the BA lounges here to avoid the horrendous crowds everywhere in the terminals This airport needs at least two more terminals to offer the space and experience many of its rivals offer When we landed at Terminal we had another interminable wait for our luggage Not a great experience again Id recommend it only because it is better than the other London airports

Very clean airport arrival and departure very well organized Lots of places to sit with a view of the runway in the departure hall The Billa supermarket located in the airport terminal is a good choice Transport fromto the airport very easy

This is a comparatively new airport in Tunisia and I have nothing but praise for it It is clean smart and well organised Check in and Security were quick and once through to airside a really good duty free shop and a bar Great views from the glass fronted terminal although the view of some aircraft can be obscured by the piers Everything ran smoothly and just a pleasure to travel through this airport

This is an efficient and wellequipped airport For travellers on AA beware that ground staff and security dont seem to communicate The security channel for US departures remained closed until beyond the scheduled time of departure with no explanation given The departure boards didnt show that there was a minute delay and instead left all boarding passengers to wait outside the secure area This seems to be a specific AA problem

This is a nice airport people are friendly check in efficient It is a clean airport and it has a nice building with plants and water fonts Brasilia is a modern City and it is airport is like the city just fantastic

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone

Having read reviews here I expected a nightmare but everything went very smoothly Terminal A seems to be new and very efficiently organised Staff friendly and helpful and lines short It was a quiet period so it might be different at Thanksgiving and other busy times
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD

On arrival the airport was very clean There was water fountains and music It was very peaceful When we departed checkin was so easy and security was simple There were lots of shops and dutyfree Overall One of the best airports in the world

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Flew Flybe on the Belfast to Amsterdam route and was pleasantly surprised on the CheckIn Boarding and inflight service The inflight service is just Tea Coffee Juice and some biscuits however the overall service was very good For such a small aircraft there were cabin crew onboard The overall ambience of the aircraft was very good and clean The cabin crew kept cleaning toilet after anyone had used it I was very happy with the flight and service

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

Very modest airport that clearly cannot handle a high volume of flights Check in is very modest and slow and people speak very basic English Undoubtedly we are facing a country that urgently needs tourism and foreign funds to improve the quality of its infrastructure Fortunately the new international airport in Phnom Penh will open in a few years and I hope they will be able to guarantee the cleanliness of the space a better quality of service increase the number of places where you can sit and also the spaces before boarding

I suddenly needed to use the special assistance service at Newcastle airport in order to go on holiday in May I had seen in the media the chaotic scenes at some uk airports and in addition the issues for passengers with disabilities I never expected Newcastle special assistance service to contradict the horror stories but it certainly did To put it simply they excelled and you should go on holiday via Newcastle with absolute confidence What an amazing service They have some of the most friendly helpful and professional staff who cannot do enough to help you and put you at ease They explain what is happening throughout the transit process in the airport To and from the aeroplane Through security to baggage collection even right through to getting in the taxis home They get you through

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic and it was another fantastic experience The E remains my favorite aircraft for regional travelspacious comfortable and perfect for short flights Despite the flight being only minutes the crew went above and beyond by offering beverage service which exceeded my expectations for such a short route As someone who travels this route twice a week I deeply appreciate the attentiveness of the regional air crew who consistently provide a level of care and attention that rivals the mainline carrier Excellent service all around

Tallinn is my favourite airport of all airports Ive been to Its so small lovely and there are never crowds flowing around There are about gates The Business Lounge is quiet and comfy and theres always enough food Its main difference is the low ceiling compared to other airports There arent many restaurants or shops but the Tax Free Shop has almost everything needed for your flight Staff very friendly and WiFi works well

I simply love Norwegian Its a no nonsense airline that has been incredibly reliable on of the legs that I have recently flown with them Seat pitch is sufficient pricing is fair and predictable and everything just works The service is fine and the onboard menu contains all you need for a few hours in the air I regard them much higher than most old airlines now saying this as a Lufthansa Senator

Its been seven years since I last flew on Lufthansa I was fortunate enough to fly on Lufthansa for the first time in seven years and the moment I got on that plane I felt good Because it was a short flight I didnt have to worry about anything But the best part was that I got a Milk Chocolate bar from Lindt and whats nice is that they have a Lufthansa logo on it what a finishing touch
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

Nice friendly airport Quick check in usually efficient security screening everybody keeps moving Gates are easy to findnavigate Short on food options nice bar after security near Gate Good coffeebagel bar near Gate The new airport is about finished Will be nice to see the improvements Eisenhower is the new airport name excellent choice

LX from Vienna to Zurich operated by Helvetic Airways The flight was completely full but boarding was expertly handled by the crew and went very smoothly The EE is a small aircraft and space in the overhead bins is limited The crew assisted passengers with finding a place for their carryon luggage and in the end all luggage could be stored somewhere Also the crew were very friendly and courteous As this was a very short flight a small snack was served which was excellent All in all a very comfortable short flight on a small aircraft with an excellent crew

I was meant to be flying with Wizz Air back from Athens until we were told it was operated by Titan Airways However it was a pleasant surprise to climb aboard a Titan aircraft The staff were extremely professional and incredibly helpful I would happily fly again with them

Dusseldorf to Berlin Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings EW Flight had a slight delay of minutes Flight was smooth and good Seat was fine with enough legroom Food and drinks for puchase crew was just average

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

My husband and I traveled to Yellowknife for a day The main reason was that we wanted to visit Buffalo Airways Canadian North were fantastic Both services on time and on the way back to Edmonton we were lucky enough to travel on a Combi which was fantastic The crew on the way home made us feel so welcome They were efficient and very pleasant Great breakfast on the way up and a good dinner on the way back If only they were a bit closer to our home in Australia We would be more than happy to travel with Canadian North any time A great experience

I flew with Air France from Vancouver to CDG onward to Seville on Feb and then return Madrid to Vancouver via CDG Paris on Feb rd Air France is now my definite top choice for Canada to Europe Their business class way exceeds Air Canada Turkish and any other European carrier Ive done around trips almost all in business Their food wine quality is restaurant quality very inventive extremely good On my Vancouver to Paris Feb th flight Agnes was my main flight attendant Her service was impeccable Similarly my return flight Paris to Vancouver was also very good flight attendants all excellent focused with very high levels of service The A is a beautiful cabin I got to sit in A coming back and that felt like a first class seat with extra room at bulk head pod sliding door I love how Air France sets up a little refreshment area during rest times Im Star Alliance generally but for Europe an Air France convert Take note Lufthansa you have a long way to catch up and although Ive had kind attendants and service on AC biz class the food wine quality does not compare to Air France Merci beaucoup Air France and mademoiselle Agnes for her kindness on my flight over and for the wonderful service I received Their lounges are a bit crowded but the quality is very good and again for fooddrink showers rest areas What a wonderful experience I hope to fly again with them soon

Previous comments on GPT are no longer true Often GPT is cheaper that New Orleans or any other nearby airport The presence of AirTran keeps fares very reasonable and service is pretty good in all directions The new terminal to be completed this year will be beautiful
This is a smashing little airport friendly well laid out and very well run Because of its location very attractive to fly in and out of too always a big shock returning to Gatwick Good ice cream too

ABQ is a nice concept but one that needs some improvements For starters If you have TSA PreCheck here youre golden Security is an efficient and friendly process If you dont have PreCheck then the service at least for a small airport can be quite noncommunicative abrasive and slow The puebloinspired architecture and interior design of the airport render it one of the most beautiful small airports in the USA and the postsecurity viewing area of the runway and mountains is the sort of thing that more airports in this country need However its not always easy to enjoy the design and the views when the tile and carpet flooring and seating throughout the airport are dirty and for a lack of better words dilapidated and outdated Speaking of seating there really isnt enough of it in my opinion The signage directing you to amenities services and locations throughout the airport is helpful but also outdated The dining and shopping options are fine for a small airport so no real complaints Some people complain about the rental car facility being separate from the terminal and requiring a shuttle bus but honestly the bus runs frequently and the ride is pretty short Everything is easily accessible from I and downtown Albuquerque With a little modernization and polishing ABQ has the potential be as good as new again

This is an excellent new airline everything was perfect from the checkin to boarding onboard experience meals video entertainment the flight and baggage retrieval All the staff were friendly and very helpful Will definitely choose this airline again At Chiang Mai the airline uses the Thai Airways lounge

As a frequent flyer on the Kuwait Airways I would recommend it on there large aircrafts such as Ber Aneo or A and specially on business class even though it is expensive but you will get a good quality service My rating would be on there business first and royal class And I have also uploaded a photo of Ber business seat

We had an enjoyable flight experience with AC Rouge The flight attendants on this crew worked very well together and demonstrated great cooperation and team work The crew was welcoming personable and professional In particular we enjoyed excellent service from Victoria and Heather

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English

Flew Amsterdam Schiphol to Marseille via Strasbourg Hop has good service and comfort levels for a regional airliner Their inflight announcements in English need some work though On my flights I was on an Embrear which has an odd seating arrangement of The seats were comfortable and not cramped The flights were staffed by a single cabin manager but they handled the job of getting everyone onboard and serving a complementary drink with a snack on each leg well Their inflight announcements in English were completely incomprehensible however as were the recorded announcements in English as well Since I dont speak French I just hope they werent telling me anything important On one leg of my flight there was a brief delay but this was communicated in a timely manner

Easy access by bus or taxi Two terminals International on the right Domestic on the left as you face them but only metres apart Signs in English as well as Russian although all announcements are in Russian as you would expect How many of the staff speak English may be a good question one who does is the AviaNova manager Easy layout to navigate in domestic terminal although there is not much space for the checkin queues so they snake around the room However the staff for my flight anyway were very efficient and the queue moved quickly Security check was quick and easy Airside has an expensive cafe and coffee shop as well as a newsstand and gift shop Plenty of comfortable seating WiFi is available good signal but every site I tried came up with Security Certificate not issued by Trusted Source so theres possibly some bug in their software I didnt do any more than just log in Bussed to plane only complaint as with so many of these airports is that you go upstairs to a departure lounge and then have to walk back down for the bus

Flew Ryanair last week to Tenerife Baggage drop was a breeze as was boarding Well organised The flight itself was excellent operated by a fantastic crew especially the cabin manager who was friendly polite and professional Wouldnt hesitate to use again

I arrived at the airport from London Heathrow and travelled via Beijing On arrival at Terminal it was nearing pm and I had been travelling for over hours I wanted to get a taxi to the hotel and go to bed However none of the ATMs in the terminal accepted any of my debit cards I have had trouble in the past in rural areas but never at an international airport I was told to go to terminal one which had international arrivals and try there Fortunately the shuttle bus was free and I go to terminal Only one of the ATMs there which also happened to be the last one I tried accepted my card with one other machine down At other Chinese airports Beijing and XiAn Xingang they have always had ATMs from the big four banks Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Bank of China China Construction Bank Agricultural Bank of China I have never had a problem getting cash from these banks I would also note that the underground station just outside terminal one has multiple big four ATMs and is an excellent way to travel into the city I finally got to my hotel at midnight I wrote to the Airport while in China but never received a response

A fine small airport great personal service clean well decorated easy parking simple and efficient signage has a luxury feel befitting the Palm Beach Clientele Food selection adequate and reasonable Parking is a breeze Always many security personnel and queue times very short A pleasure to travel to or from

One of the smallest airports Ive ever encountered Due to required visas for Laos there was a bit of a hold up at immigration but staff were thorough Luggage made it off the aircraft in an efficient manner so waiting times were minimal The whole arrivals area was so compact you could see the baggage hall from immigration and visa versa Interesting as the chaotic arrivals hall had all doors continually open and once you left the baggage collection area you could easily go back Our arrival was an evening one so most retail outlets were closed and inconveniently also the money exchange Not a bad little airport but renovation and refurbishment needed

I wasnt very impressed by the staff The two woman on duty did not appear to be helping visitors much Several of us didnt know which queue to join to go through passport control When I finally got there it was like questions They made me feel like a criminal Is this your first time in Cyprus Do you have house here Where were you in As if anyone can remember that I assured them it was my first visit to the island After some discussion between two if them they eventually stamped my passport and one of them slammed it down onto the counter I know they have to do their job but it wasnt very welcoming and they didnt have to be so rude

We were delayed for nights due to bad weather on the th and th January The staff at Mytilene Airport in Lesbos were excellent they kept a smile during a very difficult time for them We were given a voucher for food and drinks each time our flight was cancelled times in all and they sent us to very good hotels both nights In addition when we asked if they could extend our journey for the days that we had lost they did with no problems

KIR is a very small airport In terms of shopping and gastronomy not much is to be expected It can be found easily if you are in the area There are enough parking spaces and they are close to the terminal Terminal cleanliness is substandard especially the restrooms Terminal seating is barely sufficient if only flight is departing Flights can not be handled there is not enough space in the departure area In this case security is overwhelmed The queues extend to the outside of the airport building Airport staff becomes very aggressive and confrontational Under normal circumstances the staff are grumpy at best When flying from Kerry to Dublin Take the train from Killarney instead All in all it does not take much more time and the experience is much more pleasant

Linz is indeed a very small airport however it serves its purpose Facilities are limited and flying in at pm I found the few shops were almost all shut The hourly bus is excellent value for money at EUR compared to the I paid in London approx EUR and only takes minutes non stop to the city centre Beware there is only ONE medium sized duty free shop after passport control

Older Dash but comfortable and good leg room but very noisy Departed on time friendly sole flight attendant juice and water on offer and great views of the Atolls they were organised friendly and have pride in their brand and country cant ask for more than that A bit pricey but no competition I guess

ADDAMM via Sanaa Overnight in Sanaa where Yemenia provide hotel and breakfast Pleasant flight attendants and acceptable food A good flight and a lot cheaper than competitors I had to change this flight and put it forward by one week which was no problem and didnt cost anything to change

As the previous reviewer noted Eilat airport terminal is in the centre of the city and surrounded by hotels I didnt believe the taxi driver for a few seconds when he dropped us there Once inside we got a thorough grilling by security and our bags swabbed throughout for explosives I think we got extra attention as foreigners but the female security official was very friendly and jovial much nicer that the humourless officials who you normally meet Checkin and hand baggage checks were quick and easy as the only flight was our seater Arkia departure There is a shopcafe on both landside and airside parts but we didnt get a chance to try either Overall it does the job well just be prepared for the security

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport

LimaCusco and three other internal flights within Peru All flights on time and quality of aircraft pilots as in landing and take offs was exceptional Aircraft were almost new As all were clean including the toilets which cannot always be taken for granted on an aircraft that is subjected to multiple take offs and landings during the day FAs very professional A very good experience

The security staff at Aberdeen airport are not up to standard Many of them are aggressive and argumentative and their main aim is not to be friendly or courteous I have been fortunate enough to travel to many countries and I say without hesitation that the security staff at Aberdeen airport are either the most poorly trained that I have encountered or that they are paying no attention to the training they receive The management team needs to review the training of the security staff at Aberdeen airport urgently
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats are comfortable and can be reclined easily The food is delicious Flights departed on time

Checkin at Gatwick Airport was smooth and efficient The airline uses the No Lounge which is nothing special but with comfortable seating and is WiFi more than adequate Boarding was done quickly and the cabin crew was super diligent in helping each of the passengers find their seat and stow their baggage Although the business seats on this were not new they had ample storage space the flat bed was comfortable and everything worked The food was well presented but tasted a little bland and the cabin crew were extremely quick in removing trays when passengers had finished The WiFi on the aircraft was patchy at best and being Chinese quite a few sites seem to be blocked Running a VPN actually made it quicker with no blocked sites There were a few Western movies but the choice was limited Loos were spotless Overall I have no complaints and would happily fly with the airline again

Sawyer is a small airport in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan with flights to Detroit and Chicago provided by Delta and American respectively There is a small store selling Northern Michigan University paraphernalia some basic snacks and coffee The major car rental firms have desks in the terminal with the cars parked just outside The parking is excellent you walk out of the terminal into the parking lot Less than a minutes walk from the airport entrance to the security check area The terminal has excellent free wifi service courtesy Northern Michigan University Very friendly and efficient staff Taxi service is available to the city of Marquette about miles away

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

This is definitely one of the underrated airlines Quality airport and inflight service for quite a reasonable price Check in and boarding were smooth The pilot has maintained adequate communication with us and the cabin crews were very attentive and helpful The food was not superb but beyond average The cabin crews kept checking us from time to time to see if we need anything else which I asked one of the cabin crews for a refill for my cup and she was gladly to do so Seats are average for its class Inflight entertainment was great A good selection of shows to choose from for less than a hour flight If you want to get the most bang for your buck I think you can put Hong Kong Airline into the list
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

This is an extremely clean and well maintained airport They do updates regularly as needed Its very easy to get to and from Parking is pretty cheap compared to a bunch of other airports Ive been to but not super cheap Theyre already planning out the new rail connection to downtown that will be running by Currently there is a bus service as well as Uber and taxis if you dont have someone picking you up Lyft on its way to the city Its very easy to get around and if you come in from an international destination the customs is very quick What I do find bothersome is the lack of airport lounge in the US departures area The only lounges in the airport are Air Canada and Porter both on the domesticinternational departures area The food selection in the airport is pretty slim but you wont go hungry its just really limited in the US departures to one soso restaurant and a tim hortons Shopping is even more slim in all departures areas But does anyone really go shopping in an airport This airport is miles or kilometers ahead of those in a lot of US airports Ive been to despite all the drawbacks

ChisinauBudapest roundtrip Both departures on time Served breakfast on the way out and lunch inbound Luggage transfer handled efficiently despite relatively short connection time in Budapest SAAB plane offers plenty of legroom and is not so noisy compared to other prop planes Friendly FAs and my favourite option for flights from Moldova to Europe

I must say that in my experience the staff at the security check are doing a great job I was flying back to Moscow from Yerevan on Tuesday th October The staff were very welcoming polite and helpful Moreover while passing the security check I realized that I lost my cross the thread on which it hung was torn and after passing the security check I informed the security staff about it They were very helpful and helped me find my lost cross

I had pretty low expectations for this airline but fortunately things turned out well and PIA delivered for me The flight was on time and bags arrived in a timely manner While the meal served was not exactly delicious it was nice to know they at least served some food on this hour flight The seats were standard and flight attendants polite and respectful Would consider using again

Odessa to Kiev return Plane a rather old Boeing but for such short trips under hour is not a problem I was surprised to see that they offered sandwiches on both flights together with tea coffee and juices

Aalborg Lufthavn AAL is a smallish airport near the city of Aalborg There is not usually a lot of people leaving or arriving at any one time so there is hardly ever any time wasted standing in line for checkin or security checks brilliant A very friendly and inviting atmosphere overall

Frankfurt to Berlin our first flight was cancelled but they arranged me other flight Next day I use Air Berlin also this time their service was on time and good service and cabin crew they are very friendly and helpful I was very happy their service
We flew from Toronto to Paris Flight attendants were very helpful and welcoming We especially appreciated Emersons help He was great Ground crew were great too

The airport is small and modern It has both local and international flights Air France Arrivals are no problem and there is not far to walk from the aircraft to the airport exit There did not seem to be to many people bothering passengers Departures is also straight forward with modern checkin desks There are not many shops in the departure area and only one basic cafe There is adequate seating and the airconditioning works well Overall a very good experience compared with other African airports

I absolutely love the WilkesBarreScranton International Airport Small enough to accommodate us easily friendly staff and yet large enough for us to easily reach any destination We especially love the fact that they now have Breeze Airlines which will allow us to increase our travel from this airport Great move on both parts

Nice modern airport Efficiently run Arrived here on an international flight from ICN and was bussed to terminal despite most finger docks being empty Immigration was a breeze and luggate was efficiently delivered On outgoing domestic flight to SZX our flight Shandong airlines didnt appear at all on the departure screens but was correctly displayed at the gate Flight delayed and no announcements made Good selection of outlets Pleasant environment waiting for the plane big bright airy About minutes drive out of Qingdao

I flew into Douala on Swiss and departed on Virgin Nigeria Both experiences were quite pleasant I had only hand luggage and was in and out of the airport quite quickly When departing we waited at the gate which was quite calm and cool Yes its a bit manic as you walk out of the airport with people and noise everywhere but lots of places are like that If you know where you are going or have someone to meet you its fine

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job

I flew from Karachi to Toronto on PIA LR The seats very comfortable and the leg room was amazing Cabin crew was very friendly and kept on serving refreshments The food is delicious The best part is that it is the only non stop flight from Pakistan to Canada which is very convenient and saves a lot of time The only drawbacks are that the IFE doesnt work except for the flight map and there are no charging ports

Aircraft clean with immaculately presented and polite cabin attendants Seat comfortable with great leg room Flights on time Inflight entertainment consisted of North Korean military type music Food was a cold burger with a choice of water coffee tea or soft drink
Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

You might use Moscow Vnukovo when flying to cities within the CIS on regional airlines or catching a charter flight to Turkey Egypt etc The airport is located southwest of the city it takes about minutes and Roubles tofrom Yugo Zapadnaya metro station by minibus in normal traffic taxi drivers ask the usual extortionate rates as in Sheremetyevo The building is very small and displays a bizarre mixture of typical drab Soviet facilities and shiny renovated areas that you could almost call Scandinavian Arriving at about am on a redeye flight I was greeted by a pack of stray dogs roaming the street outside the terminal but then I was able to wait for the first bus into town while having an excellent cappuccino in the new cafe inside the arrival area with plenty of seats and cheerful service from the very friendly staff Immigration is the same as everywhere else in Russia even though this was the only place where I was asked to produce a copy of my invitation and health insurance On an afternoon visit the departure sector which is located on the same level as the arrivals was almost deserted Services on offer are scarce one exchange office with ridiculously short opening times one Atm one cafe a couple of windows selling airline tickets and providing general information in Russian exclusively Everywhere around the airport there are obvious signs of big renovation works going on Im really curious to see what comes out of it in the future All in all one of the most relaxed ways tofrom Moscow and Russia

I had a great experience flying with Cyprus Airways The flight was smooth and comfortable making the journey enjoyable I was impressed with the ground checkin team who were kind and supportive Thank you for the excellent service

Fantastic service from bag drop to landing and getting my baggage on the other end All staff played their role in providing the excellent customer service It was an early morning flight and it was really nice to start the day on the right track

The whole experience was very professional Flight was completely comfortable clean and the air crew were friendly and helpful The flight was on time and the in flight service was just excellent for such a short flight

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient
Brilliant Airport new clean clear spacious Shame so few airlines do fly into MVD

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good

We adults kids came here about a year ago YOWPUJ nothing bad but nothing good Very clean and a lot of Sunwing Workers are nice and there is a great viewing area for kids But the downside is long waiting times for everything Otherwise it was pretty good and we will be using it again on Mar for a flight to London UK then Warsaw Poland and back Will review it again then

Security was super helpful As we were passing through security someone stole my wifes Apple Watch from the box after we went through the Xray We immediately notice it was missing and reported it Security checked the cameras and found the thief Using the image from the cameras they tracked down the passenger and recuperated our watch All this within minutes Amazing

Horizon Air from Seattle to Eugene roundtrip No complaints the crews were great planes clean and on time in both directions As with all of Horizon Air flights free beverages including wine and beer are provided The aircraft was perfect for the less than one hour flight to SeaTac quite fast actually The skies were clear and the view was perfect Nice job all the way around

Excellent airline Flights outbound and return were on time if not early Service and staff were helpful and friendly and the plane was very comfortable Definitely recommend them The only negatives the film choice was not great for an English speaker and there was if anything too much food served

Johannesburg to Lilongwe via Blantyre Very impressed with Malawian Airlines On time departures and arrivals excellent food served both outbound lunch chicken and return breakfast fried eggs lovely coffee and generous baggage allowance Crucially Ethiopan Airlines the part owner has timed the flight with an early morning departure from Malawi such that a large majority of passengers were connecting on our flight in Johannesburg onto regional Southern Africa routes and donestically within SA whereas SAA schedule from Lilongwe would require an overnight stay in Johannesburg clever scheduling Both flights nearly full No entertainment or music onboard

Victoria Falls boasts a nice new terminal building that is uncluttered and pleasant I arrived for a flight to Addis Ababa and was immediately impressed with the pleasant surroundings of the terminal and its air conditioned comfort Check in procedures were swiftly handled and passengers then move on to clear security and immigration which are straight forward save for the fact that one has to deal with the nuisance of removing his shoes at security Following security one takes an elevator up to the departure level where there a number of shops very expensive shops and food outlets All of these were clean and presentable Restroom facilities were wellmaintained and clean Boarding was accomplished via an air bridge directly into the plane Surprisingly Victoria Falls International Airport is very straight forward and easy to negotiate Staff are friendly and helpful I feel that anyone traveling through Victoria Falls airport will have no difficulties or issues

Arrival was easy and bags arrived quickly waived through health control and landside within minutes departing again no issues although the airport was busy with the evening departures there was plenty of security checkpoints open and plenty of staff each employee at the airport I encountered was helpful and friendly once through security there is a excellent Duty Free and several restaurantsbars along with a small selection of shops

Amazing team at Hubli airport We had to change the plane in Bangalore to get to Kochi and we might be late however the team assured us that our baggage will go first from plane when we have landed Us and few other people in similar situation were brought by small bus faster than other customer to the airport and one guy from airport in Bangalore from Air Pegasus made sure and check our flights details that we will be on time Thank you one more time especially for team in Hubli Amazing customer service

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green

Good experience flying Finnair Tallinn to London via Helsinki No need for security as transfer flight helpful staff everywhere and for big airport very spacious Loved MOOMIN COFFEE and no queue or questions at border control after I was interrogated at Riga Airport due to long stays on my British Passport Loved Finnair too would fly again from Helsinki with this airline

I had two flights with Atlantic Airways Flight Bergen Faroe Islands and Faroe Islands to Copenhagen one week later Both flights on time Comfortable seats clean aircraft good food friendly service I will flight with Atlantic Airways again with pleasure

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

I have travelled through Derry airport numerous times in the last two years with a young child and usually on my own I cannot express enough how helpful staff have been on every single occasion They always offer to help me with bags usually fast track me through security scan my boarding card and passport so that I dont have to stand in long queues especially if my child is sleeping and have even bumped me up to priority boarding again ensuring I am not standing in queues struggling with bags or a toddler Their customer service is second to none and they always make the journey pleasurable

Airport is clean has good shops great seating area and has clear signs However the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that in the entire terminal you could literally i counted just find a total of five power outlets that should really be something to be improved so watch out for that

Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

I traveled with people from NYC We entered the airport and had no problems coming in Pretty fast service with immigration and getting our bags Outside was rather chaotic Too many men standing around to carry bags They should control them better maybe like cabs take turns as requested On the way out we found the airport entrance very clear Our bus pulled up and emptied better than it could in JFK It was comforting to see the UN security team right outside The building was well air conditioned which was great The ticketing area was easily accessible We found that there was a ton of security checks not sure why as it seemed to be for baggage mostly We had our IDs checked times and our bags screened twice We were told at the ticket area that once inside there were no rest rooms That was not completely true There is a rest room area inside TSA but before the final jetBlue secure gate area baggage screening Also the signs for the duty free shop inside could have been betterhigher to see Overall it was not horrible but just a little cramped in feeling and the double check of the bags while offering a feeling of security sent red flags up as to why they were doing that It seemed like a jetBlue thing as Spirit did not do that Also the place was clean

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

I prefer using this airport over almost any other in Texas major cities but in true American airport form there are advantages and drawbacks to using San Antonio SAT Here are the pros Access from either I or US is pretty easy considering that interchange is one of the busiest in the city Access to the very busy touristic downtown is relatively easy as the airport isnt far away by rideshare Parking is easy access from the parking garages to the terminal is easy signage leading to and within the airport is pretty easy to follow Delta checkin was quick and friendly Gate agents were professional and helpful Staff in the stores generally seemed friendly The terminal is mostly clean the presecurity checkin area is very spacious and modern Using CLEAR and PreCheck I breezed through security However here are the drawbacks Security TSA had an officious dour attitude that Id expect much more in Houston Miami LAX or NYC not San Antonio Dont know what that was about The restrooms were filthy Seating throughout the terminal was not at all ample for the crowds of people waiting to fly out the airport desperately needs expansion and that includes more seating and general modernization postsecurity Upon return baggage claim was remarkably slow for a small airport albeit a small airport serving a large metropolitan area So pound for pound SAT is an overall good option and Id still rather use them than anything in Houston or Austin but there is still room for improvement
This airport is great It has all the necessities that an airport should have I dont get how it is placed in the world It should be a top airport All the staff are very helpful and friendly

It was a lovely airport in August and it was my first time flying out of my local airport to Corfu with TUI B month old pretty new inside The airport was really good Easy checkin desk loads of duty free clear view of the incoming aircrafts outside of window The security was really quick for getting us through so we can get to the gate Food was brilliant at Wetherspoons near the duty free This airport is worth the visit for holidays and business friendly Staff were outstanding as well Spotting was good as well

Sarajevo Airport is very small and very manageable After you enter the main building there are check ins Afterwards you have to go to the first floor where is one departure hall with or departure gates There is plenty of seating they also have big beanbags for seating which can be quite fun and relaxing There is only one bar with snacks and one shop If you are travelling with children the signs for baby changing room is misleading after you follow the signs there is no baby room You have to follow the signs for the bathroom for disabled If you wait for a long time you might get very bored

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

Granada Airport is located about km west of Granada Single runway small terminal Regular buses run into the city If you arrive late no worries as it is only a short taxi ride In recent years the number of flights have increased Mainly to Madrid and Barcelona but with also Liverpool Stansted Melilla The usual facilities for a small airport so dont expect too much

Zurich to Dresden via their hub in Dusseldorf Both flights on As Checked in in ZRH without any hassle or feeling entering a lowcost carrier Gate bridging in airports convenient and saved time Flights were both precise on timing and arrival Luggage inscribed transferred and delivered within Minutes on final destination Transit in Dusseldorf smooth Payable catering service onboard rendered several interesting options from printed menu leaflets The airline was better than most reviews indicate I must render them credit at least out of If I had access to their lounges in ZRH and DUS the trip would have been perfected Not cheap but reliable no faults and could fly them again

Very modest airport that clearly cannot handle a high volume of flights Check in is very modest and slow and people speak very basic English Undoubtedly we are facing a country that urgently needs tourism and foreign funds to improve the quality of its infrastructure Fortunately the new international airport in Phnom Penh will open in a few years and I hope they will be able to guarantee the cleanliness of the space a better quality of service increase the number of places where you can sit and also the spaces before boarding

Friendly little airport which stinks of burned toast from a bagel vendor They really ought to get the vendor to install a ventilator hood The faux jazz piped in everywhere is also a poor choice The CNN monitors are loud but not as bad as some Ive been here a while because of the lousy service and rigid rules of Delta Airlines so this is a wellconsidered review

This is a fantastic airport Short walking distances nice staff good easytonavigate easytouse layout a stressfree atmosphere nice cafs I used Billund as a transit passenger on my way from Copenhagen to Berlin and my only minor remark is that the TRANSIT signs just pointed to a locked door I had to walk back exit and go through security again Never mind there was no queue and I doubt the locked door is standard procedure since the security folks got a little bit puzzled when they saw my Copenhagenissued boarding pass Dont hesitate to use this airport

Departing from Terminal for a domestic flight The airport was well connected with the public bus and train The terminal in general was clean modern and efficient Check in was fast and completely automatic via machines with ground staff was ready to help Surprising no long queue at the security and everything was smooth There were numerous comfy seats available for passengers Shopping and dining were also really good and at reasonable price

The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

This is a small yet spacious airport with two terminal piers jutting out in a Y shape There were ample seating space plug points to charge your phones and also an enclosed section with desks and chairs to do any work on your computer Large glass windows afforded views of the runways and let sunlight stream in Bathrooms clean TSA security was thorough Check in counters are opened a couple of hours before a flight and I found the staff friendly Car rental booths are in the baggage conveyor belt section and long term parking is just outside the terminal as are the parking lots for rental cars minimal walking required Very easy and fast entry and exit intoout of terminal Driving directions to airport were clearly marked Only a couple of shopsstores for food and drinks A selection of Wisconsin beer was available in the restaurant but not my favorite Leinenkugel Overall a very pleasant airport
