Worst airport ever Long lines no seating and not helpful staff Unbelievably unorganized and constant delays Avoid at all costs We had a perfect trip other than this airport We will not be back due to this airport Again avoid this airport

Absolutely horror experience They let you wait in the queue for more than hour with months old baby without stroller We asked twice if we please can go to the front and they told us we dont do this here you need to be in the queue In the security they obliged me to take out every single toy from My back pack and touched it

Frankly in shock after going through this airport times better to ferry to Athens instead and take a flight from there Airport authorities screaming at passengers to get on the plane pulling people out of line to charge them arbitrary amounts for additional baggage fees that has happened at no other airport with the same airline and then denying that the fees were paid and demanding money again People were sitting next to the bathroom on the floor in the stairwell crammed into the upstairs patio because there are no chairs anywhere else The bathrooms had no toilet paper or soap This was really really horrible

Two immigration officers for a rough count of customers Nearly an hour queuing at immigration Lounge A the one I was told to go to was about as far from my departure gate as possible With a bad knee and no help forthcoming I sat at the gate I stayed at the Citizen M Hotel the night before so I was checking in at I got to my gate in agony at Atrocious Airport experience For info I was a Platinum Royal Wing Elite member for nine years I used to love KLM and Schiphol I only flew this route to avoid UK APD I still refuse to pay this damaging tax but Ill find another route for future journeys

It is a nice airport but I was shocked to discover you need euro coin to be able to use the luggage trolley I had luggages and I carried a toddler It was impossible to carry all my bags after picking them up and my child I asked a security person for advice or a fake coin eventually for help He told me to go to Exchange stand I explained None of my countries I live in uses Euros He said it is my problem If it wasnt for some Czech passengers who heard me talking Czech to my child and who offered their help I dont know what I would do Its incerdibly rude from the airport management to require coins to use the trolleys I havent experienced this on any other international airports Also the toilets for people with babies are always occupied by people without kids and there is only one such toilet I think your trolley system should be reconsidered As the current situation makes the travel experience for people with kids and many luggages simply horrible Not to mentiom the rude security employee

I thought I would try out Air Zimbabwefrom Harare as it is a direct flight to London and I dislike the long wait at Joburg airport when flying SAABA etc However having had my Wednesday night flight postponed until Thursday then that cancelled until Friday then Friday flight cancelled without a single reason or apology I figure hours in Joburg is a small price to pay Shame on you Air Zimbabwe Never again

I have flown many times in many countries in Asia but Ive never seen such a high level of securitisation There are literally thousands of facial recognition cctv cameras watching you tracking what you do Staff were chasing foreign travellers and ordering them to remove their hats not in immigration or security just anywhere in the airport where they wanted to track you Foreign travellers arriving go to booths to be finger printed this is becoming more common in Asia Even to go through international transit you will have your face photographed and scanned into their systems Then once youre on board Air China flights all have state security agents dressed in black who walk up and down the flight carrying a camera Not to mention that the plane safety video has a whole section on how you should not commit a crime on board I will never return and I advise others not to

Incredibly rude aggressive threatening security very intimidating all of it unnecessary for returning holidaymakers to UK Gruff barked orders in your face attitudes from male and female security staff accompanied by very bad tempered high handed sneering Lovely holiday ending with dreadful experience It was like they hated us and wanted to frighten and control Reminiscent of camp commandants We were two old aged pensioners either an autistic son Three xray machines and body searches Over the top We wont be going back to Egypt

Staff a bit typically surly which doesnt bother me but upsets the Mrs and others at times Pretty fast and straightforward although they could do with showing the world cup match on a screen in a bar etc somewhere In departure lounge the gents toilets were disgustingly filthy with the urinals all near overflowing with a lot of urine on the floor and cubicles for a dozen terminals a huge queue of men constantly Utterly ridiculous Free WiFi with ambiguous marketing terms seems a con

Now everyone can fly because of cheap fares In a way this is a good thing However I dont think it brings about all good things Low cost on the other hand can also mean low quality You basically get what you pay for My flight with Air Asia Zest to Hong Kong from Manila had more of the negatives than the positives To begin with our flight was delayed for over three hours at Manila Airport The aircraft was delayed in an airport somewhere We were asked to move gates three times that just made everyone confused None of their ground crew came to inform and reassure passengers at least When the aircraft finally arrived another complication happened The air bridge was not working so we had to go down the stairs to the tarmac then stairs again to the aircraft Perhaps we burned some calories but all of us got wet it was raining heavily then Passenger comfort was basic and the food I preordered was not to my liking We arrived four hours late in Hong Kong AirAsia will get you to destination thats it Customer service and passenger comfort is not a priority for this airline

The worst airport I have been in Its crowded hot they charge for wifi after minutes there are no water fountains not enough restrooms security just before the gate that makes you toss all your water You cant take a drop of anything to drink on the flight with you If you have a long flight tough I hope you like being dehydrated Everything is expensive by airport standards You may have a really long walk between gates because there arent any moving platform and its spread out

Overcrowded filthy tiny airport No seats whatsoever People forced to stand on lines for hours Ridiculous Absolutely lowgrade in all respects I will do all I can to avoid this filthy trap in the future

La Vegas to Burbank Cheap flight and free drinks great snacks Great legroomIm Lounge in LAS was super nice No TSA I was put onto another airplane to shorten the delay without wifi but plane was supposed to have outlets and wifi There was a delay but the staff and crew were helpful and informative The captain even flew a lot faster to shorten the delay After landing I received an email from JetsuiteX apologizing for the delay and issued me a voucher JetsuiteX eliminates everything thats wrong with flying They even tried to fill up the remaining seats on the plane with people on the later flight

Never travel to Perpignan on a Sunday if you can help it There is only one bus no which goes about twice a day from the airport and shuttle buses which used to take you to Perpignan station no longer run at the moment I travelled in June You would have to check on this but they were not running when we were in Perpignan Be careful with taxis they run on a meter and are quite expensive We paid over euros to get to Collioures about half an hour drive we shared the cost with two other people who were going the same way During the week buses are much more frequent and perhaps the shuttle buses work during the peak season It would be easier to fly to Carcasonne transport seems to be better from there

Extremely bad climate control Bad in many aspects Crowded Rude and unrespectful security and passport control Prices in restaurants free shops and any merchandise price in the airport is extremely high A simple sandwich will cost you Free shops are charging you much higher than the product cost you anywhere else on this planet Im shocked that this is allowed to happen and airport authorities allowing this Be careful and keep this in mind

Completely unprofessional They refuse to give the money back and offer no choice but accepting their lousy vouchers only to keep cancelling the flights Briefly they receive money from the customers and transform it into virtual money that you never get the chance to use because they keep cancelling Avoid it by all means

Shanghai Airlines has the same level of quality as most mainland Chinese airlines an abysmal low one Old fashioned business class seats one of the worst meals I ever had in my long flying life indifferent crew the only positive point being the appropriate schedule

There is not enough seating if two flights are departing within a short space of time The prices for snacks and drinks are exorbitant more expensive than London Gatwick The toilet facilities are appalling hold your breath and get out quick One outside a janitor gives a square of toilet paper and holds his hands out for a tip Would travel through this airport again but would be a lot more prepared

Algiers to Paris the worst airline ever Aircraft is old and dirty Flight time was delayed and postponed The check in process at counter is very slow The only efficiency thing is their system down time The staff is not well trained etc

Clean and modern when it was inaugurated maybe years ago this airport is showing its age The large arching windows meant to let in light into the main ticketingcheckin areas are perpetually filthy Checkin area usually not too crowded especially with the de facto demise of Varig Airlines and de jure demise of Air Madrid but lines can vary widely by airline and time of day There is one line to get into the boarding area and at times the airport folks will now allow you in until a certain time which makes no sense since you will just be sitting in the boarding area Pretty boring airport for a long wait Food and shopping alternatives are limited and nearly nonexistent once you go through security Competency of airport staff uneven at best Wait for luggage can vary widely but usually not too bad I have arrived only on domestic flights so cannot comment on immigrationcustoms procedures I departed once on an international flight with domestic stops en route and the only difference for boarding was having to take off my shoes and show my passport

One of the worst experiences ever in a major airport There was no one in the immigration at gates F Orly building h of waiting to have a single policeman for or flights departing from this hall and of course they had to start with passengers with priority so additional minutes of waiting Never in my life I could imagine an airport with no immigration officers even in the worst airports in the world Once the immigration passed gates area is still under construction no wifi and very little number of electric plugs So if you are unlucky and have a flight departing from Orly hall F take everything you need in advance

The prices for food and drinks are eye watering The duty free prices are higher than our high street shop prices They have the worst WIFI of any airport I have ever been to You cant get on it for love nor money Shame really Its a lovely airport

Just to counterbalance the other reviews We had a am flight We arrived at the airport at and were completely through checkin and security by We checked luggage It would have been minutes faster with just carry on

I flew with Shaheen Air during Ramadan on international route Flight was comfortable and female crew was friendly Before iftar they served dates and juices and served dinner which was good biryani raita and cake also orange candy was nice touch There was a bad smell in the aircraft Hopefully next time they will use spray inside the aircraft for bad smell

Service we have received has been very good for the size of the place Incoming there is a long wait but would rather be checked in and out correctly The gate numbers can be confusing if it is the first time you have flown out as they do change regularly

Bandung Airport is a quaint airport in the middle of the city used to be the HQ of Indonesias domestic aircraft industry meanwhile nonexisting It served a number of domestic and international destinations and was a real asset to the city Then the government decided to build a grand new airport in Majalenka about or so kilometres north of Bandung which had to cater for a growing population in the Bandung area and East Jakarta It was opened pretty much on schedule which is rare in Indonesia but in the middle of nowhere far away from current populations and with poor connections Since no airlines wanted to move there the government forced the move of domestic flights from Bandung to the new Kertajati airport This included the popular Bandung Bali routes The result is that it now takes longer to get to the new airport about hours than it actually takes to fly to Bali Some people now prefer to drive all the way to Jakarta for more choice and cheaper flights Efforts are made to reinstate some domestic flights in Bandung but that does not include the Bali route for the time being Overall such a shortsighted decision to move all these flights from Bandung to Majalenka So for as long as Bandung Airport remains an empty shell in terms of domestic flights I will have to give it a low rating

I am thoroughly frustrated and disappointed by the lack of action and customer service from Brussels Airlines My flight from Vilnius to Geneva was cancelled on May and I promptly submitted a compensation claim On May the airline confirmed my compensation entitlement of per passenger Since then I have been waiting for payment which was promised to be processed within to weeks Its now September and I still have not received any compensation I have sent over emails and submitted new claims on their website but have received no response Ive also made phone calls to the customer service center sent a direct email to the head of customer service and still nothing This lack of communication and disregard for customer rights is appalling Under European law specifically EC Regulation passengers are entitled to compensation when a flight is cancelled Brussels Airlines is clearly violating this regulation by failing to honor their commitments It is unacceptable that an airline would promise a hour response time but not fulfill this or even acknowledge the claim after more than months This is a serious breach of consumer rights and I urge Brussels Airlines to finally pay attention to my claim and settle the compensation as required by law
